``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLTableElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions] attribute HTMLTableCaptionElement? caption;
  HTMLTableCaptionElement createCaption();
  [CEReactions] undefined deleteCaption();

  [CEReactions] attribute HTMLTableSectionElement? tHead;
  HTMLTableSectionElement createTHead();
  [CEReactions] undefined deleteTHead();

  [CEReactions] attribute HTMLTableSectionElement? tFoot;
  HTMLTableSectionElement createTFoot();
  [CEReactions] undefined deleteTFoot();

  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection tBodies;
  HTMLTableSectionElement createTBody();

  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection rows;
  HTMLTableRowElement insertRow(optional long index = -1);
  [CEReactions] undefined deleteRow(long index);

  // also has obsolete members
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) data with more than one dimension&#44; in the form of a <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;table"></a>[table](#concept-table)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element takes part in the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46; Tables have rows&#44; columns&#44; and cells given by their descendants&#46; The rows and columns form a grid&#59; a table&#39;s cells must completely cover that grid without overlap&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Precise rules for determining whether this conformance requirement is met are described in the description of the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model&#45;2"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

Authors are encouraged to provide information describing how to interpret complex tables&#46; Guidance on how to [provide such information](#table-descriptions-techniques) is given below&#46;

Tables must not be used as layout aids&#46; Historically&#44; some web authors have misused tables in HTML as a way to control their page layout&#46; This usage is non&#45;conforming&#44; because tools attempting to extract tabular data from such documents would obtain very confusing results&#46; In particular&#44; users of accessibility tools like screen readers are likely to find it very difficult to navigate pages with tables used for layout&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

There are a variety of alternatives to using HTML tables for layout&#44; such as CSS grid layout&#44; CSS flexible box layout &#40;&#34;flexbox&#34;&#41;&#44; CSS multi&#45;column layout&#44; CSS positioning&#44; and the CSS table model&#46; [&#91;CSS&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsCSS)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Tables can be complicated to understand and navigate&#46; To help users with this&#44; user agents should clearly delineate cells in a table from each other&#44; unless the user agent has classified the table as a &#40;non&#45;conforming&#41; layout table&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Authors and implementers are encouraged to consider using some of the [table design techniques](#table-layout-techniques) described below to make tables easier to navigate for users&#46;

User agents&#44; especially those that do table analysis on arbitrary content&#44; are encouraged to find heuristics to determine which tables actually contain data and which are merely being used for layout&#46; This specification does not define a precise heuristic&#44; but the following are suggested as possible indicators&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Feature      </th><th>Indication    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>The use of the <code id="the-table-element:attr-aria-role"><a href="html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-aria-role">role</a></code> attribute with the value <code id="the-table-element:attr-aria-role-presentation"><a data-x-internal="attr-aria-role-presentation" href="https://w3c.github.io/aria/#presentation">presentation</a></code>      </td><td>Probably a layout table     </td></tr><tr><td>The use of the non&#45;conforming <code id="the-table-element:attr-table-border"><a href="html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-table-border">border</a></code> attribute with the non&#45;conforming value 0      </td><td>Probably a layout table     </td></tr><tr><td>The use of the non&#45;conforming <code id="the-table-element:attr-table-cellspacing"><a href="html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-table-cellspacing">cellspacing</a></code> and      <code id="the-table-element:attr-table-cellpadding"><a href="html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-table-cellpadding">cellpadding</a></code> attributes with the value 0      </td><td>Probably a layout table    </td></tr></tbody><tbody><tr><td>The use of <code id="the-table-element:the-caption-element-2"><a href="#the-caption-element">caption</a></code>&#44; <code id="the-table-element:the-thead-element-2"><a href="#the-thead-element">thead</a></code>&#44; or <code id="the-table-element:the-th-element"><a href="#the-th-element">th</a></code> elements      </td><td>Probably a non&#45;layout table     </td></tr><tr><td>The use of the <code id="the-table-element:attr-tdth-headers"><a href="#attr-tdth-headers">headers</a></code> and <code id="the-table-element:attr-th-scope"><a href="#attr-th-scope">scope</a></code> attributes      </td><td>Probably a non&#45;layout table     </td></tr><tr><td>The use of the non&#45;conforming <code id="the-table-element:attr-table-border-2"><a href="html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-table-border">border</a></code> attribute with a value other than 0      </td><td>Probably a non&#45;layout table     </td></tr><tr><td>Explicit visible borders set using CSS      </td><td>Probably a non&#45;layout table    </td></tr></tbody><tbody><tr><td>The use of the <code id="the-table-element:attr-table-summary"><a href="html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-table-summary">summary</a></code> attribute      </td><td>Not a good indicator &#40;both layout and non&#45;layout tables have historically been given this attribute&#41;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

It is quite possible that the above suggestions are wrong&#46; Implementers are urged to provide feedback elaborating on their experiences with trying to create a layout table detection heuristic&#46;

If a <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element has a &#40;non&#45;conforming&#41; <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;table&#45;summary&#45;2"></a><code>[summary](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-table-summary)</code> attribute&#44; and the user agent has not classified the table as a layout table&#44; the user agent may report the contents of that attribute to the user&#46;

The elements in the collection must be ordered such that those elements whose parent is a <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> are included first&#44; in <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; followed by those elements whose parent is either <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;this&#45;32"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) or a <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code> element&#44; again in <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; followed finally by those elements whose parent is a <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#44; still in <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;3"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;table&#45;insertrow"></a><strong><code>insertRow&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>index</var> is less than −1 or greater than the number of elements in the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;2"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;7"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Let <var>tr</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;create&#45;a&#45;table&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[creating a table element](#create-a-table-element) given <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;this&#45;33"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and &#34;<code>tr</code>&#34;&#46;

3.  If the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;3"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection has zero elements in it&#44; and <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;this&#45;34"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) has no <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code> elements in it&#58;

    1.  Let <var>tbody</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;create&#45;a&#45;table&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[creating a table element](#create-a-table-element) given <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;this&#45;35"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and &#34;<code>tbody</code>&#34;&#46;

    2.  Append <var>tr</var> to <var>tbody</var>&#46;

    3.  Append <var>tbody</var> to <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;this&#45;36"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

4.  Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;4"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection has zero elements in it&#44; then append <var>tr</var> to the last <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code> element in <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;this&#45;37"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

5.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>index</var> is −1 or equal to the number of items in the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;5"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection&#44; then append <var>tr</var> to the parent of the last <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element in the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;6"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection&#46;

6.  Otherwise&#44; insert <var>tr</var> immediately before the <var>index</var>th <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element in the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;7"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection&#44; in the same parent&#46;

7.  Return <var>tr</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;table&#45;deleterow"></a><strong><code>deleteRow&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <var>index</var> is less than −1 or greater than or equal to the number of elements in the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;8"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;8"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If <var>index</var> is −1&#44; then <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) the last element in the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;9"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection from its parent&#44; or do nothing if the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;10"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection is empty&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove&#45;2"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) the <var>index</var>th element in the <a id="the&#45;table&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;11"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection from its parent&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here is an example of a table being used to mark up a Sudoku puzzle&#46; Observe the lack of headers&#44; which are not necessary in such a table&#46;

``` text
<style>
 #sudoku { border-collapse: collapse; border: solid thick; }
 #sudoku colgroup, table#sudoku tbody { border: solid medium; }
 #sudoku td { border: solid thin; height: 1.4em; width: 1.4em; text-align: center; padding: 0; }
</style>
<h1>Today's Sudoku</h1>
<table id="sudoku">
 <colgroup><col><col><col>
 <colgroup><col><col><col>
 <colgroup><col><col><col>
 <tbody>
  <tr> <td> 1 <td>   <td> 3 <td> 6 <td>   <td> 4 <td> 7 <td>   <td> 9
  <tr> <td>   <td> 2 <td>   <td>   <td> 9 <td>   <td>   <td> 1 <td>
  <tr> <td> 7 <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>   <td> 6
 <tbody>
  <tr> <td> 2 <td>   <td> 4 <td>   <td> 3 <td>   <td> 9 <td>   <td> 8
  <tr> <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>
  <tr> <td> 5 <td>   <td>   <td> 9 <td>   <td> 7 <td>   <td>   <td> 1
 <tbody>
  <tr> <td> 6 <td>   <td>   <td>   <td> 5 <td>   <td>   <td>   <td> 2
  <tr> <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>   <td> 7 <td>   <td>   <td>   <td>
  <tr> <td> 9 <td>   <td>   <td> 8 <td>   <td> 2 <td>   <td>   <td> 5
</table>
```

##### <a id="table&#45;descriptions&#45;techniques"></a>4&#46;9&#46;1&#46;1 Techniques for describing tables[](#table-descriptions-techniques)

<a id="table&#45;descriptions"></a>For tables that consist of more than just a grid of cells with headers in the first row and headers in the first column&#44; and for any table in general where the reader might have difficulty understanding the content&#44; authors should include explanatory information introducing the table&#46; This information is useful for all users&#44; but is especially useful for users who cannot see the table&#44; e&#46;g&#46; users of screen readers&#46;

Such explanatory information should introduce the purpose of the table&#44; outline its basic cell structure&#44; highlight any trends or patterns&#44; and generally teach the user how to use the table&#46;

For instance&#44; the following table&#58;

<table><caption>Characteristics with positive and negative sides</caption><thead><tr><th id="n"> Negative      </th><th> Characteristic      </th><th> Positive    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td headers="n r1"> Sad      </td><th id="r1"> Mood      </th><td> Happy     </td></tr><tr><td headers="n r2"> Failing      </td><th id="r2"> Grade      </th><td> Passing   </td></tr></tbody></table>

&#46;&#46;&#46;might benefit from a description explaining the way the table is laid out&#44; something like &#34;Characteristics are given in the second column&#44; with the negative side in the left column and the positive side in the right column&#34;&#46;

There are a variety of ways to include this information&#44; such as&#58;

<strong>In prose&#44; surrounding the table</strong>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

``` text
<p>In the following table, characteristics are given in the second
column, with the negative side in the left column and the positive
side in the right column.</p>
<table>
 <caption>Characteristics with positive and negative sides</caption>
 <thead>
  <tr>
   <th id="n"> Negative
   <th> Characteristic
   <th> Positive
 <tbody>
  <tr>
   <td headers="n r1"> Sad
   <th id="r1"> Mood
   <td> Happy
  <tr>
   <td headers="n r2"> Failing
   <th id="r2"> Grade
   <td> Passing
</table>
```

<strong>In the table&#39;s <a id="table&#45;descriptions&#45;techniques&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code></strong>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

``` text
<table>
 <caption>
  <strong>Characteristics with positive and negative sides.</strong>
  <p>Characteristics are given in the second column, with the
  negative side in the left column and the positive side in the right
  column.</p>
 </caption>
 <thead>
  <tr>
   <th id="n"> Negative
   <th> Characteristic
   <th> Positive
 <tbody>
  <tr>
   <td headers="n r1"> Sad
   <th id="r1"> Mood
   <td> Happy
  <tr>
   <td headers="n r2"> Failing
   <th id="r2"> Grade
   <td> Passing
</table>
```

<strong>In the table&#39;s <a id="table&#45;descriptions&#45;techniques&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code>&#44; in a <a id="table&#45;descriptions&#45;techniques&#58;the&#45;details&#45;element"></a><code>[details](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-details-element)</code> element</strong>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

``` text
<table>
 <caption>
  <strong>Characteristics with positive and negative sides.</strong>
  <details>
   <summary>Help</summary>
   <p>Characteristics are given in the second column, with the
   negative side in the left column and the positive side in the right
   column.</p>
  </details>
 </caption>
 <thead>
  <tr>
   <th id="n"> Negative
   <th> Characteristic
   <th> Positive
 <tbody>
  <tr>
   <td headers="n r1"> Sad
   <th id="r1"> Mood
   <td> Happy
  <tr>
   <td headers="n r2"> Failing
   <th id="r2"> Grade
   <td> Passing
</table>
```

<strong>Next to the table&#44; in the same <a id="table&#45;descriptions&#45;techniques&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code></strong>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

``` text
<figure>
 <figcaption>Characteristics with positive and negative sides</figcaption>
 <p>Characteristics are given in the second column, with the
 negative side in the left column and the positive side in the right
 column.</p>
 <table>
  <thead>
   <tr>
    <th id="n"> Negative
    <th> Characteristic
    <th> Positive
  <tbody>
   <tr>
    <td headers="n r1"> Sad
    <th id="r1"> Mood
    <td> Happy
   <tr>
    <td headers="n r2"> Failing
    <th id="r2"> Grade
    <td> Passing
 </table>
</figure>
```

<strong>Next to the table&#44; in a <a id="table&#45;descriptions&#45;techniques&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code>&#39;s <a id="table&#45;descriptions&#45;techniques&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code></strong>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

``` text
<figure>
 <figcaption>
  <strong>Characteristics with positive and negative sides</strong>
  <p>Characteristics are given in the second column, with the
  negative side in the left column and the positive side in the right
  column.</p>
 </figcaption>
 <table>
  <thead>
   <tr>
    <th id="n"> Negative
    <th> Characteristic
    <th> Positive
  <tbody>
   <tr>
    <td headers="n r1"> Sad
    <th id="r1"> Mood
    <td> Happy
   <tr>
    <td headers="n r2"> Failing
    <th id="r2"> Grade
    <td> Passing
 </table>
</figure>
```

Authors may also use other techniques&#44; or combinations of the above techniques&#44; as appropriate&#46;

The best option&#44; of course&#44; rather than writing a description explaining the way the table is laid out&#44; is to adjust the table such that no explanation is needed&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the case of the table used in the examples above&#44; a simple rearrangement of the table so that the headers are on the top and left sides removes the need for an explanation as well as removing the need for the use of <a id="table&#45;descriptions&#45;techniques&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code> attributes&#58;

``` text
<table>
 <caption>Characteristics with positive and negative sides</caption>
 <thead>
  <tr>
   <th> Characteristic
   <th> Negative
   <th> Positive
 <tbody>
  <tr>
   <th> Mood
   <td> Sad
   <td> Happy
  <tr>
   <th> Grade
   <td> Failing
   <td> Passing
</table>
```

##### <a id="table&#45;layout&#45;techniques"></a>4&#46;9&#46;1&#46;2 Techniques for table design[](#table-layout-techniques)

Good table design is key to making tables more readable and usable&#46;

In visual media&#44; providing column and row borders and alternating row backgrounds can be very effective to make complicated tables more readable&#46;

For tables with large volumes of numeric content&#44; using monospaced fonts can help users see patterns&#44; especially in situations where a user agent does not render the borders&#46; &#40;Unfortunately&#44; for historical reasons&#44; not rendering borders on tables is a common default&#46;&#41;

In speech media&#44; table cells can be distinguished by reporting the corresponding headers before reading the cell&#39;s contents&#44; and by allowing users to navigate the table in a grid fashion&#44; rather than serializing the entire contents of the table in source order&#46;

Authors are encouraged to use CSS to achieve these effects&#46;

User agents are encouraged to render tables using these techniques whenever the page does not use CSS and the table is not classified as a layout table&#46;

#### <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a>4&#46;9&#46;2 The <strong><code>caption</code></strong> element[](#the-caption-element)

[HTMLTableCaptionElement](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLTableCaptionElement)

Support in all current engines&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;categories"></a>[Categories](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-categories)&#58;</strong>

None&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a>[Contexts in which this element can be used](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-contexts)&#58;</strong>

As the first element child of a <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a>[Content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-content-model)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#44; but with no descendant <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

A <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) can be omitted if the <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code> element is not immediately followed by <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) or a <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;comments"></a>[comment](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-comments)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<strong><a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-caption)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-caption)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;category&#45;default"></a>[Default](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-category-default)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmltablecaptionelement"></a><a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLTableCaptionElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  // also has obsolete members
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the title of the <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> that is its parent&#44; if it has a parent and that is a <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code> element takes part in the <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

When a <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element is the only content in a <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;figure&#45;element"></a><code>[figure](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figure-element)</code> element other than the <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code>&#44; the <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code> element should be omitted in favor of the <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;the&#45;figcaption&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[figcaption](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-figcaption-element)</code>&#46;

A caption can introduce context for a table&#44; making it significantly easier to understand&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Consider&#44; for instance&#44; the following table&#58;

<table class="dice-example"><tr><th>   </th><th> 1 </th><th> 2 </th><th> 3 </th><th> 4 </th><th> 5 </th><th> 6     </th></tr><tr><th> 1 </th><td> 2 </td><td> 3 </td><td> 4 </td><td> 5 </td><td> 6 </td><td> 7     </td></tr><tr><th> 2 </th><td> 3 </td><td> 4 </td><td> 5 </td><td> 6 </td><td> 7 </td><td> 8     </td></tr><tr><th> 3 </th><td> 4 </td><td> 5 </td><td> 6 </td><td> 7 </td><td> 8 </td><td> 9     </td></tr><tr><th> 4 </th><td> 5 </td><td> 6 </td><td> 7 </td><td> 8 </td><td> 9 </td><td> 10     </td></tr><tr><th> 5 </th><td> 6 </td><td> 7 </td><td> 8 </td><td> 9 </td><td> 10 </td><td> 11     </td></tr><tr><th> 6 </th><td> 7 </td><td> 8 </td><td> 9 </td><td> 10 </td><td> 11 </td><td> 12    </td></tr></table>

In the abstract&#44; this table is not clear&#46; However&#44; with a caption giving the table&#39;s number &#40;for <a id="the&#45;caption&#45;element&#58;referenced"></a>[reference](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#referenced) in the main prose&#41; and explaining its use&#44; it makes more sense&#58;

``` text
<caption>
<p>Table 1.
<p>This table shows the total score obtained from rolling two
six-sided dice. The first row represents the value of the first die,
the first column the value of the second die. The total is given in
the cell that corresponds to the values of the two dice.
</caption>
```

This provides the user with more context&#58;

A <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;start&#45;tag"></a>[start tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-start-tag) can be omitted if the first thing inside the <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element is a <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> element&#44; and if the element is not immediately preceded by another <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element whose <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) has been omitted&#46; &#40;It can&#39;t be omitted if the element is empty&#46;&#41;

A <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag&#45;2"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) can be omitted if the <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element is not immediately followed by <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace) or a <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;comments"></a>[comment](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-comments)&#46;

<a id="htmltablecolelement"></a><a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectdefault"></a><a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectrange"></a><a id="dom&#45;colgroup&#45;span"></a>

};

The <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;group"></a>[group](#concept-column-group) of one or more <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;column"></a>[columns](#concept-column) in the <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> that is its parent&#44; if it has a parent and that is a <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element contains no <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> elements&#44; then the element may have a <a id="attr&#45;colgroup&#45;span"></a><strong><code>span</code></strong> content attribute specified&#44; whose value must be a <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer) greater than zero and less than or equal to 1000&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element and its <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;colgroup&#45;span&#45;5"></a><code>[span](#attr-colgroup-span)</code> attribute take part in the <a id="the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-tbody)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-tbody)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;category&#45;default"></a>[Default](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-category-default)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmltablesectionelement"></a><a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection"></a><a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows"></a><a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;htmltablerowelement"></a><a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;insertrow"></a><a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;deleterow"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLTableSectionElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection rows;
  HTMLTableRowElement insertRow(optional long index = -1);
  [CEReactions] undefined deleteRow(long index);

  // also has obsolete members
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;htmltablesectionelement"></a><code>[HTMLTableSectionElement](#htmltablesectionelement)</code> interface is also used for <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> elements&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group"></a>[block](#concept-row-group) of <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;row"></a>[rows](#concept-row) that consist of a body of data for the parent <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code> element has a parent and it is a <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code> element takes part in the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

<strong><code><var>tbody</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows&#45;dev"></a>[rows](#dom-tbody-rows)</code></strong>

Returns an <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> of the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> elements of the table section&#46;

<strong><code><var>tr</var> &#61; <var>tbody</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;tbody&#45;insertrow&#45;dev"></a>[insertRow](#dom-tbody-insertrow)&#40;&#91; <var>index</var> &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

Creates a <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; inserts it into the table section at the position given by the argument&#44; and returns the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code>&#46;

The position is relative to the rows in the table section&#46; The index −1&#44; which is the default if the argument is omitted&#44; is equivalent to inserting at the end of the table section&#46;

If the given position is less than −1 or greater than the number of rows&#44; throws an <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;indexsizeerror"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

<strong><code><var>tbody</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;tbody&#45;deleterow&#45;dev"></a>[deleteRow](#dom-tbody-deleterow)&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Removes the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element with the given position in the table section&#46;

The position is relative to the rows in the table section&#46; The index −1 is equivalent to deleting the last row of the table section&#46;

If the given position is less than −1 or greater than the index of the last row&#44; or if there are no rows&#44; throws an <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows"></a><strong><code>rows</code></strong> attribute must return an <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> rooted at this element&#44; whose filter matches only <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> elements that are children of this element&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;tbody&#45;insertrow"></a><strong><code>insertRow&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must act as follows&#58;

1.  If <var>index</var> is less than −1 or greater than the number of elements in the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows&#45;2"></a><code>[rows](#dom-tbody-rows)</code> collection&#44; throw an <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Let <var>table row</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element"></a>[creating an element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element) given this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; &#34;<code>tr</code>&#34;&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#46;

3.  If <var>index</var> is −1 or equal to the number of items in the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows&#45;3"></a><code>[rows](#dom-tbody-rows)</code> collection&#44; then <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append"></a>[append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) <var>table row</var> to this element&#46;

4.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;insert"></a>[insert](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert) <var>table row</var> as a child of this element&#44; immediately before the <var>index</var>th <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element in the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows&#45;4"></a><code>[rows](#dom-tbody-rows)</code> collection&#46;

5.  Return <var>table row</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;tbody&#45;deleterow"></a><strong><code>deleteRow&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must&#44; when invoked&#44; act as follows&#58;

1.  If <var>index</var> is less than −1 or greater than or equal to the number of elements in the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows&#45;5"></a><code>[rows](#dom-tbody-rows)</code> collection&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If <var>index</var> is −1&#44; then <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) the last element in the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows&#45;6"></a><code>[rows](#dom-tbody-rows)</code> collection from this element&#44; or do nothing if the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows&#45;7"></a><code>[rows](#dom-tbody-rows)</code> collection is empty&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove&#45;2"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) the <var>index</var>th element in the <a id="the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows&#45;8"></a><code>[rows](#dom-tbody-rows)</code> collection from this element&#46;

#### <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a>4&#46;9&#46;6 The <strong><code>thead</code></strong> element[](#the-thead-element)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;thead](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/thead)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

<strong><a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;categories"></a>[Categories](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-categories)&#58;</strong>

None&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a>[Contexts in which this element can be used](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-contexts)&#58;</strong>

As a child of a <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; after any <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> elements and before any <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> elements&#44; but only if there are no other <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> elements that are children of the <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a>[Content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-content-model)&#58;</strong>

Zero or more <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;script&#45;supporting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[script&#45;supporting](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#script-supporting-elements-2) elements&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

A <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) can be omitted if the <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> element is immediately followed by a <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code> or <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<strong><a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-thead)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-thead)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;category&#45;default"></a>[Default](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-category-default)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

Uses <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;htmltablesectionelement"></a><code>[HTMLTableSectionElement](#htmltablesectionelement)</code>&#44; as defined for <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code> elements&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group"></a>[block](#concept-row-group) of <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;row"></a>[rows](#concept-row) that consist of the column labels &#40;headers&#41; and any ancillary non&#45;header cells for the parent <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> element has a parent and it is a <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> element takes part in the <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This example shows a <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> element being used&#46; Notice the use of both <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> elements in the <a id="the&#45;thead&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> element&#58; the first row is the headers&#44; and the second row is an explanation of how to fill in the table&#46;

``` text
<table>
 <caption> School auction sign-up sheet </caption>
 <thead>
  <tr>
   <th><label for=e1>Name</label>
   <th><label for=e2>Product</label>
   <th><label for=e3>Picture</label>
   <th><label for=e4>Price</label>
  <tr>
   <td>Your name here
   <td>What are you selling?
   <td>Link to a picture
   <td>Your reserve price
 <tbody>
  <tr>
   <td>Ms Danus
   <td>Doughnuts
   <td><img src="https://example.com/mydoughnuts.png" title="Doughnuts from Ms Danus">
   <td>$45
  <tr>
   <td><input id=e1 type=text name=who required form=f>
   <td><input id=e2 type=text name=what required form=f>
   <td><input id=e3 type=url name=pic form=f>
   <td><input id=e4 type=number step=0.01 min=0 value=0 required form=f>
</table>
<form id=f action="/auction.cgi">
 <input type=button name=add value="Submit">
</form>
```

#### <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a>4&#46;9&#46;7 The <strong><code>tfoot</code></strong> element[](#the-tfoot-element)

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

<strong><a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;categories"></a>[Categories](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-categories)&#58;</strong>

None&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a>[Contexts in which this element can be used](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-contexts)&#58;</strong>

As a child of a <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; after any <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> elements&#44; but only if there are no other <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> elements that are children of the <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a>[Content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-content-model)&#58;</strong>

Zero or more <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;script&#45;supporting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[script&#45;supporting](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#script-supporting-elements-2) elements&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

A <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) can be omitted if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<strong><a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-tfoot)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-tfoot)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;category&#45;default"></a>[Default](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-category-default)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

Uses <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;htmltablesectionelement"></a><code>[HTMLTableSectionElement](#htmltablesectionelement)</code>&#44; as defined for <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code> elements&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group"></a>[block](#concept-row-group) of <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;row"></a>[rows](#concept-row) that consist of the column summaries &#40;footers&#41; for the parent <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> element has a parent and it is a <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> element takes part in the <a id="the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

<a id="htmltablerowelement"></a><a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;rowindex"></a><a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;sectionrowindex"></a><a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection"></a><a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;cells"></a><a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;htmltablecellelement"></a><a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;insertcell"></a><a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;deletecell"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLTableRowElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  readonly attribute long rowIndex;
  readonly attribute long sectionRowIndex;
  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection cells;
  HTMLTableCellElement insertCell(optional long index = -1);
  [CEReactions] undefined deleteCell(long index);

  // also has obsolete members
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;row"></a>[row](#concept-row) of <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;cell"></a>[cells](#concept-cell) in a <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;table"></a>[table](#concept-table)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element takes part in the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

<strong><code><var>tr</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;tr&#45;rowindex&#45;dev"></a>[rowIndex](#dom-tr-rowindex)</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLTableRowElement&#47;rowIndex](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLTableRowElement/rowIndex)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari3&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS1&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the position of the row in the table&#39;s <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> list&#46;

Returns −1 if the element isn&#39;t in a table&#46;

<strong><code><var>tr</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;tr&#45;sectionrowindex&#45;dev"></a>[sectionRowIndex](#dom-tr-sectionrowindex)</code></strong>

Returns the position of the row in the table section&#39;s <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows"></a><code>[rows](#dom-tbody-rows)</code> list&#46;

Returns −1 if the element isn&#39;t in a table section&#46;

<strong><code><var>tr</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;tr&#45;cells&#45;dev"></a>[cells](#dom-tr-cells)</code></strong>

Returns an <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> of the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> elements of the row&#46;

<strong><code><var>cell</var> &#61; <var>tr</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;tr&#45;insertcell&#45;dev"></a>[insertCell](#dom-tr-insertcell)&#40;&#91; <var>index</var> &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLTableRowElement&#47;insertCell](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLTableRowElement/insertCell)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari3&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS1&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Creates a <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> element&#44; inserts it into the table row at the position given by the argument&#44; and returns the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code>&#46;

The position is relative to the cells in the row&#46; The index −1&#44; which is the default if the argument is omitted&#44; is equivalent to inserting at the end of the row&#46;

If the given position is less than −1 or greater than the number of cells&#44; throws an <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;indexsizeerror"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

<strong><code><var>tr</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;tr&#45;deletecell&#45;dev"></a>[deleteCell](#dom-tr-deletecell)&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong>

Removes the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element with the given position in the row&#46;

The position is relative to the cells in the row&#46; The index −1 is equivalent to deleting the last cell of the row&#46;

If the given position is less than −1 or greater than the index of the last cell&#44; or if there are no cells&#44; throws an <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;tr&#45;rowindex"></a><strong><code>rowIndex</code></strong> attribute must&#44; if this element has a parent <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; or a parent <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> element and a <em>grandparent</em> <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; return the index of this <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element in that <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;2"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection&#46; If there is no such <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; then the attribute must return −1&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;tr&#45;sectionrowindex"></a><strong><code>sectionRowIndex</code></strong> attribute must&#44; if this element has a parent <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> element&#44; return the index of the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element in the parent element&#39;s <code>rows</code> collection &#40;for tables&#44; that&#39;s <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;htmltableelement"></a><code>[HTMLTableElement](#htmltableelement)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;table&#45;rows&#45;3"></a><code>[rows](#dom-table-rows)</code> collection&#59; for table sections&#44; that&#39;s <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;htmltablesectionelement"></a><code>[HTMLTableSectionElement](#htmltablesectionelement)</code>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tbody&#45;rows&#45;2"></a><code>[rows](#dom-tbody-rows)</code> collection&#41;&#46; If there is no such parent element&#44; then the attribute must return −1&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;tr&#45;cells"></a><strong><code>cells</code></strong> attribute must return an <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> rooted at this <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; whose filter matches only <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> elements that are children of the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;tr&#45;insertcell"></a><strong><code>insertCell&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must act as follows&#58;

1.  If <var>index</var> is less than −1 or greater than the number of elements in the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;cells&#45;2"></a><code>[cells](#dom-tr-cells)</code> collection&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;3"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Let <var>table cell</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element"></a>[creating an element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element) given this <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; &#34;<code>td</code>&#34;&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#46;

3.  If <var>index</var> is equal to −1 or equal to the number of items in <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;cells&#45;3"></a><code>[cells](#dom-tr-cells)</code> collection&#44; then <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;append"></a>[append](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-append) <var>table cell</var> to this <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element&#46;

4.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;insert"></a>[insert](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-insert) <var>table cell</var> as a child of this <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; immediately before the <var>index</var>th <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element in the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;cells&#45;4"></a><code>[cells](#dom-tr-cells)</code> collection&#46;

5.  Return <var>table cell</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;tr&#45;deletecell"></a><strong><code>deleteCell&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must act as follows&#58;

1.  If <var>index</var> is less than −1 or greater than or equal to the number of elements in the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;cells&#45;5"></a><code>[cells](#dom-tr-cells)</code> collection&#44; then throw an <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;indexsizeerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If <var>index</var> is −1&#44; then <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) the last element in the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;cells&#45;6"></a><code>[cells](#dom-tr-cells)</code> collection from its parent&#44; or do nothing if the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;cells&#45;7"></a><code>[cells](#dom-tr-cells)</code> collection is empty&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;remove&#45;2"></a>[remove](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-remove) the <var>index</var>th element in the <a id="the&#45;tr&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;cells&#45;8"></a><code>[cells](#dom-tr-cells)</code> collection from its parent&#46;

None&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a>[Contexts in which this element can be used](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-contexts)&#58;</strong>

As a child of a <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a>[Content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-content-model)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

A <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) can be omitted if the <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> element is immediately followed by a <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;colspan"></a><code>[colspan](#attr-tdth-colspan)</code> — Number of columns that the cell is to span

<a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;rowspan"></a><code>[rowspan](#attr-tdth-rowspan)</code> — Number of rows that the cell is to span

<a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code> — The header cells for this cell

<strong><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-td)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-td)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;category&#45;default"></a>[Default](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-category-default) with attributes <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;colspan&#45;2"></a><code>[colspan](#attr-tdth-colspan)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers&#45;2"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;rowspan&#45;2"></a><code>[rowspan](#attr-tdth-rowspan)</code>&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmltablecellelement"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectdefault"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectrange"></a><a id="dom&#45;tdth&#45;colspan"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectdefault&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectrange&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;tdth&#45;rowspan"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;3"></a><a id="dom&#45;tdth&#45;headers"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;tdth&#45;cellindex"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;th&#45;scope"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;5"></a><a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;4"></a><a id="dom&#45;th&#45;abbr"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLTableCellElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect, ReflectDefault=1, ReflectRange=(1, 1000)] attribute unsigned long colSpan;
  [CEReactions, Reflect, ReflectDefault=1, ReflectRange=(0, 65534)] attribute unsigned long rowSpan;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString headers;
  readonly attribute long cellIndex;

  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString scope; // only conforming for th elements
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString abbr;  // only conforming for th elements

  // also has obsolete members
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;htmltablecellelement"></a><code>[HTMLTableCellElement](#htmltablecellelement)</code> interface is also used for <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> elements&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a data <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;cell"></a>[cell](#concept-cell) in a table&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> element and its <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;colspan&#45;3"></a><code>[colspan](#attr-tdth-colspan)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;rowspan&#45;3"></a><code>[rowspan](#attr-tdth-rowspan)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers&#45;3"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code> attributes take part in the <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

User agents&#44; especially in non&#45;visual environments or where displaying the table as a 2D grid is impractical&#44; may give the user context for the cell when rendering the contents of a cell&#59; for instance&#44; giving its position in the <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model&#45;2"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#44; or listing the cell&#39;s header cells &#40;as determined by the <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;assigning&#45;header&#45;cells"></a>[algorithm for assigning header cells](#algorithm-for-assigning-header-cells)&#41;&#46; When a cell&#39;s header cells are being listed&#44; user agents may use the value of <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;abbr"></a><code>[abbr](#attr-th-abbr)</code> attributes on those header cells&#44; if any&#44; instead of the contents of the header cells themselves&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; we see a snippet of a web application consisting of a grid of editable cells &#40;essentially a simple spreadsheet&#41;&#46; One of the cells has been configured to show the sum of the cells above it&#46; Three have been marked as headings&#44; which use <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> elements instead of <a id="the&#45;td&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> elements&#46; A script would attach event handlers to these elements to maintain the total&#46;

``` text
<table>
 <tr>
  <th><input value="Name">
  <th><input value="Paid ($)">
 <tr>
  <td><input value="Jeff">
  <td><input value="14">
 <tr>
  <td><input value="Britta">
  <td><input value="9">
 <tr>
  <td><input value="Abed">
  <td><input value="25">
 <tr>
  <td><input value="Shirley">
  <td><input value="2">
 <tr>
  <td><input value="Annie">
  <td><input value="5">
 <tr>
  <td><input value="Troy">
  <td><input value="5">
 <tr>
  <td><input value="Pierce">
  <td><input value="1000">
 <tr>
  <th><input value="Total">
  <td><output value="1060">
</table>
```

#### <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element"></a>4&#46;9&#46;10 The <strong><code>th</code></strong> element[](#the-th-element)

[Element&#47;th](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/th)

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;
