------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

<strong><a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;categories"></a>[Categories](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-categories)&#58;</strong>

None&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a>[Contexts in which this element can be used](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-contexts)&#58;</strong>

As a child of a <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a>[Content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-content-model)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#44; but with no <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;header&#45;element"></a><code>[header](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-header-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;footer&#45;element"></a><code>[footer](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-footer-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;sectioning&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[sectioning content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#sectioning-content-2)&#44; or <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;heading&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[heading content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#heading-content-2) descendants&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

A <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) can be omitted if the <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element is immediately followed by a <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;colspan"></a><code>[colspan](#attr-tdth-colspan)</code> — Number of columns that the cell is to span

<a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;rowspan"></a><code>[rowspan](#attr-tdth-rowspan)</code> — Number of rows that the cell is to span

<a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code> — The header cells for this cell

<a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> — Specifies which cells the header cell applies to

<a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;abbr"></a><code>[abbr](#attr-th-abbr)</code> — Alternative label to use for the header cell when referencing the cell in other contexts

<strong><a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-th)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-th)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;category&#45;default"></a>[Default](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-category-default) with attributes <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;abbr&#45;2"></a><code>[abbr](#attr-th-abbr)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;colspan&#45;2"></a><code>[colspan](#attr-tdth-colspan)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers&#45;2"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;rowspan&#45;2"></a><code>[rowspan](#attr-tdth-rowspan)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;2"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code>&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

Uses <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;htmltablecellelement"></a><code>[HTMLTableCellElement](#htmltablecellelement)</code>&#44; as defined for <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> elements&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a header <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;cell"></a>[cell](#concept-cell) in a table&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element may have a <a id="attr&#45;th&#45;scope"></a><strong><code>scope</code></strong> content attribute specified&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;3"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attribute is an <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="th/scope" id="attr-th-scope-row" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>row</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-th-scope-row-state">Row</dfn>      </td><td>The header cell applies to some of the subsequent cells in the same row&#40;s&#41;&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="th/scope" id="attr-th-scope-col" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>col</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-th-scope-column-state">Column</dfn>      </td><td>The header cell applies to some of the subsequent cells in the same column&#40;s&#41;&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="th/scope" id="attr-th-scope-rowgroup" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>rowgroup</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-th-scope-rowgroup-state">Row Group</dfn>      </td><td>The header cell applies to all the remaining cells in the row group&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="th/scope" id="attr-th-scope-colgroup" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>colgroup</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-th-scope-colgroup-state">Column Group</dfn>      </td><td>The header cell applies to all the remaining cells in the column group&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;auto&#45;state"></a><strong>Auto</strong> state&#46; &#40;In this state the header cell applies to a set of cells selected based on context&#46;&#41;

A <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;4"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attribute must not be in the <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;rowgroup&#45;state"></a>[Row Group](#attr-th-scope-rowgroup-state) state if the element is not anchored in a <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group"></a>[row group](#concept-row-group)&#44; nor in the <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;colgroup&#45;state"></a>[Column Group](#attr-th-scope-colgroup-state) state if the element is not anchored in a <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;group"></a>[column group](#concept-column-group)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element may have an <a id="attr&#45;th&#45;abbr"></a><strong><code>abbr</code></strong> content attribute specified&#46; Its value must be an alternative label for the header cell&#44; to be used when referencing the cell in other contexts &#40;e&#46;g&#46; when describing the header cells that apply to a data cell&#41;&#46; It is typically an abbreviated form of the full header cell&#44; but can also be an expansion&#44; or merely a different phrasing&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element and its <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;colspan&#45;3"></a><code>[colspan](#attr-tdth-colspan)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;rowspan&#45;3"></a><code>[rowspan](#attr-tdth-rowspan)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers&#45;3"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;5"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attributes take part in the <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;table&#45;model"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following example shows how the <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;6"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;rowgroup"></a><code>[rowgroup](#attr-th-scope-rowgroup)</code> value affects which data cells a header cell applies to&#46;

Here is a markup fragment showing a table&#58;

``` text
<table>
 <thead>
  <tr> <th> ID <th> Measurement <th> Average <th> Maximum
 <tbody>
  <tr> <td> <th scope=rowgroup> Cats <td> <td>
  <tr> <td> 93 <th> Legs <td> 3.5 <td> 4
  <tr> <td> 10 <th> Tails <td> 1 <td> 1
 <tbody>
  <tr> <td> <th scope=rowgroup> English speakers <td> <td>
  <tr> <td> 32 <th> Legs <td> 2.67 <td> 4
  <tr> <td> 35 <th> Tails <td> 0.33 <td> 1
</table>
```

This would result in the following table&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th> ID </th><th> Measurement </th><th> Average </th><th> Maximum     </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td> </td><th scope="rowgroup"> Cats </th><td> </td><td>      </td></tr><tr><td> 93 </td><th> Legs </th><td> 3&#46;5 </td><td> 4      </td></tr><tr><td> 10 </td><th> Tails </th><td> 1 </td><td> 1     </td></tr></tbody><tbody><tr><td> </td><th scope="rowgroup"> English speakers </th><td> </td><td>      </td></tr><tr><td> 32 </td><th> Legs </th><td> 2&#46;67 </td><td> 4      </td></tr><tr><td> 35 </td><th> Tails </th><td> 0&#46;33 </td><td> 1    </td></tr></tbody></table>

The headers in the first row all apply directly down to the rows in their column&#46;

The headers with a <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;7"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attribute in the <a id="the&#45;th&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;rowgroup&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Row Group](#attr-th-scope-rowgroup-state) state apply to all the cells in their row group other than the cells in the first column&#46;

The remaining headers apply just to the cells to the right of them&#46;

![](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/table-scope-diagram.png)

#### <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements"></a>4&#46;9&#46;11 Attributes common to <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> and <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> elements[](#attributes-common-to-td-and-th-elements)

The <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> and <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> elements may have a <a id="attr&#45;tdth&#45;colspan"></a><strong><code>colspan</code></strong> content attribute specified&#44; whose value must be a <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer) greater than zero and less than or equal to 1000&#46;

The <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> and <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> elements may also have a <a id="attr&#45;tdth&#45;rowspan"></a><strong><code>rowspan</code></strong> content attribute specified&#44; whose value must be a <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer&#45;2"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer) less than or equal to 65534&#46; For this attribute&#44; the value zero means that the cell is to span all the remaining rows in the row group&#46;

These attributes give the number of columns and rows respectively that the cell is to span&#46; These attributes must not be used to overlap cells&#44; as described in the description of the <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;table&#45;model"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> and <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element may have a <a id="attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers"></a><strong><code>headers</code></strong> content attribute specified&#46; The <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must contain a string consisting of an <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;unordered&#45;set&#45;of&#45;unique&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>[unordered set of unique space&#45;separated tokens](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#unordered-set-of-unique-space-separated-tokens)&#44; none of which are <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;identical&#45;to"></a>[identical to](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is) another token and each of which must have the value of an <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;id"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) of a <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element taking part in the same <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;table"></a>[table](#concept-table) as the <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element &#40;as defined by the <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;table&#45;model&#45;2"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#41;&#46;

A <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element with <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;id&#45;2"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) <var>id</var> is said to be <em>directly targeted</em> by all <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> and <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> elements in the same <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;table&#45;2"></a>[table](#concept-table) that have <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers&#45;2"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code> attributes whose values include as one of their tokens the <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;concept&#45;id&#45;3"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) <var>id</var>&#46; A <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element <var>A</var> is said to be <em>targeted</em> by a <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> or <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> element <var>B</var> if either <var>A</var> is <em>directly targeted</em> by <var>B</var> or if there exists an element <var>C</var> that is itself <em>targeted</em> by the element <var>B</var> and <var>A</var> is <em>directly targeted</em> by <var>C</var>&#46;

A <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element must not be <em>targeted</em> by itself&#46;

The <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;colspan"></a><code>[colspan](#attr-tdth-colspan)</code>&#44; <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;rowspan"></a><code>[rowspan](#attr-tdth-rowspan)</code>&#44; and <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers&#45;3"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code> attributes take part in the <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;table&#45;model&#45;3"></a>[table model](#table-model)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong><code><var>cell</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;tdth&#45;cellindex&#45;dev"></a>[cellIndex](#dom-tdth-cellindex)</code></strong>

Returns the position of the cell in the row&#39;s <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;cells"></a><code>[cells](#dom-tr-cells)</code> list&#46; This does not necessarily correspond to the <var>x</var>&#45;position of the cell in the table&#44; since earlier cells might cover multiple rows or columns&#46;

Returns −1 if the element isn&#39;t in a row&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;tdth&#45;cellindex"></a><strong><code>cellIndex</code></strong> IDL attribute must&#44; if the element has a parent <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element&#44; return the index of the cell&#39;s element in the parent element&#39;s <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;dom&#45;tr&#45;cells&#45;2"></a><code>[cells](#dom-tr-cells)</code> collection&#46; If there is no such parent element&#44; then the attribute must return −1&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;th&#45;scope"></a><strong><code>scope</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the content attribute of the same name&#44; <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;td&#45;and&#45;th&#45;elements&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

#### <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model"></a>4&#46;9&#46;12 <a id="processing&#45;model&#45;2"></a>Processing model[](#table-processing-model)

The various table elements and their content attributes together define the <a id="table&#45;model"></a><strong>table model</strong>&#46;

A <a id="concept&#45;table"></a><strong>table</strong> consists of cells aligned on a two&#45;dimensional grid of <a id="concept&#45;slots"></a><strong>slots</strong> with coordinates &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#46; The grid is finite&#44; and is either empty or has one or more slots&#46; If the grid has one or more slots&#44; then the <var>x</var> coordinates are always in the range 0 ≤ <var>x</var> &#60; <var>x<sub>width</sub></var>&#44; and the <var>y</var> coordinates are always in the range 0 ≤ <var>y</var> &#60; <var>y<sub>height</sub></var>&#46; If one or both of <var>x<sub>width</sub></var> and <var>y<sub>height</sub></var> are zero&#44; then the table is empty &#40;has no slots&#41;&#46; Tables correspond to <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> elements&#46;

A <a id="concept&#45;cell"></a><strong>cell</strong> is a set of slots anchored at a slot &#40;<var>cell<sub>x</sub></var>&#44; <var>cell<sub>y</sub></var>&#41;&#44; and with a particular <var>width</var> and <var>height</var> such that the cell covers all the slots with coordinates &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; where <var>cell<sub>x</sub></var> ≤ <var>x</var> &#60; <var>cell<sub>x</sub></var>&#43;<var>width</var> and <var>cell<sub>y</sub></var> ≤ <var>y</var> &#60; <var>cell<sub>y</sub></var>&#43;<var>height</var>&#46; Cells can either be <em>data cells</em> or <em>header cells</em>&#46; Data cells correspond to <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> elements&#44; and header cells correspond to <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> elements&#46; Cells of both types can have zero or more associated header cells&#46;

It is possible&#44; in certain error cases&#44; for two cells to occupy the same slot&#46;

A <a id="concept&#45;row"></a><strong>row</strong> is a complete set of slots from <var>x</var>&#61;0 to <var>x</var>&#61;<var>x<sub>width</sub></var>&#45;1&#44; for a particular value of <var>y</var>&#46; Rows usually correspond to <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> elements&#44; though a <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group"></a>[row group](#concept-row-group) can have some implied <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;row"></a>[rows](#concept-row) at the end in some cases involving <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;cell"></a>[cells](#concept-cell) spanning multiple rows&#46;

A <a id="concept&#45;column"></a><strong>column</strong> is a complete set of slots from <var>y</var>&#61;0 to <var>y</var>&#61;<var>y<sub>height</sub></var>&#45;1&#44; for a particular value of <var>x</var>&#46; Columns can correspond to <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> elements&#46; In the absence of <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> elements&#44; columns are implied&#46;

A <a id="concept&#45;row&#45;group"></a><strong>row group</strong> is a set of <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;2"></a>[rows](#concept-row) anchored at a slot &#40;0&#44; <var>group<sub>y</sub></var>&#41; with a particular <var>height</var> such that the row group covers all the slots with coordinates &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; where 0 ≤ <var>x</var> &#60; <var>x<sub>width</sub></var> and <var>group<sub>y</sub></var> ≤ <var>y</var> &#60; <var>group<sub>y</sub></var>&#43;<var>height</var>&#46; Row groups correspond to <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> elements&#46; Not every row is necessarily in a row group&#46;

A <a id="concept&#45;column&#45;group"></a><strong>column group</strong> is a set of <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;column"></a>[columns](#concept-column) anchored at a slot &#40;<var>group<sub>x</sub></var>&#44; 0&#41; with a particular <var>width</var> such that the column group covers all the slots with coordinates &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; where <var>group<sub>x</sub></var> ≤ <var>x</var> &#60; <var>group<sub>x</sub></var>&#43;<var>width</var> and 0 ≤ <var>y</var> &#60; <var>y<sub>height</sub></var>&#46; Column groups correspond to <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> elements&#46; Not every column is necessarily in a column group&#46;

<a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group&#45;2"></a>[Row groups](#concept-row-group) cannot overlap each other&#46; Similarly&#44; <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;group"></a>[column groups](#concept-column-group) cannot overlap each other&#46;

A <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;cell&#45;2"></a>[cell](#concept-cell) cannot cover slots that are from two or more <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group&#45;3"></a>[row groups](#concept-row-group)&#46; It is&#44; however&#44; possible for a cell to be in multiple <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;group&#45;2"></a>[column groups](#concept-column-group)&#46; All the slots that form part of one cell are part of zero or one <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group&#45;4"></a>[row groups](#concept-row-group) and zero or more <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;group&#45;3"></a>[column groups](#concept-column-group)&#46;

In addition to <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;cell&#45;3"></a>[cells](#concept-cell)&#44; <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;2"></a>[columns](#concept-column)&#44; <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;3"></a>[rows](#concept-row)&#44; <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group&#45;5"></a>[row groups](#concept-row-group)&#44; and <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;group&#45;4"></a>[column groups](#concept-column-group)&#44; <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;table"></a>[tables](#concept-table) can have a <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code> element associated with them&#46; This gives the table a heading&#44; or legend&#46;

A <a id="table&#45;model&#45;error"></a><strong>table model error</strong> is an error with the data represented by <a id="table&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> elements and their descendants&#46; Documents must not have table model errors&#46;

##### <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table"></a>4&#46;9&#46;12&#46;1 Forming a table[](#forming-a-table)

To determine which elements correspond to which slots in a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;table"></a>[table](#concept-table) associated with a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#44; to determine the dimensions of the table &#40;<var>x<sub>width</sub></var> and <var>y<sub>height</sub></var>&#41;&#44; and to determine if there are any <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;table&#45;model&#45;error"></a>[table model errors](#table-model-error)&#44; user agents must use the following algorithm&#58;

1.  Let <var>x<sub>width</sub></var> be 0&#46;

2.  Let <var>y<sub>height</sub></var> be 0&#46;

3.  Let <var>pending <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> elements</var> be a list of <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> elements&#44; initially empty&#46;

4.  Let <var>the table</var> be the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;table&#45;2"></a>[table](#concept-table) represented by the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#46; The <var>x<sub>width</sub></var> and <var>y<sub>height</sub></var> variables give <var>the table</var>&#39;s dimensions&#46; <var>The table</var> is initially empty&#46;

5.  If the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element has no children elements&#44; then return <var>the table</var> &#40;which will be empty&#41;&#46;

6.  Associate the first <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code> element child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element with <var>the table</var>&#46; If there are no such children&#44; then it has no associated <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;caption&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[caption](#the-caption-element)</code> element&#46;

7.  Let the <var>current element</var> be the first element child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code> element&#46;

    If a step in this algorithm ever requires the <var>current element</var> to be <a id="concept&#45;table&#45;advance"></a><strong>advanced to the next child of the <code>table</code></strong> when there is no such next child&#44; then the user agent must jump to the step labeled <em>end</em>&#44; near the end of this algorithm&#46;

8.  While the <var>current element</var> is not one of the following elements&#44; <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;table&#45;advance"></a>[advance](#concept-table-advance) the <var>current element</var> to the next child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#58;

    - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code>
    - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code>
    - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code>
    - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code>
    - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code>

9.  If the <var>current element</var> is a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code>&#44; follow these substeps&#58;

    1.  <em>Column groups</em>&#58; Process the <var>current element</var> according to the appropriate case below&#58;

        <strong>If the <var>current element</var> has any <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> element children</strong>

        Follow these steps&#58;

        1.  Let <var>x<sub>start</sub></var> have the value of <var>x<sub>width</sub></var>&#46;

        2.  Let the <var>current column</var> be the first <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> element child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#46;

        3.  <em>Columns</em>&#58; If the <var>current column</var> <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> element has a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;attr&#45;col&#45;span"></a><code>[span](#attr-col-span)</code> attribute&#44; then parse its value using the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers"></a>[rules for parsing non&#45;negative integers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers)&#46;

            If the result of parsing the value is not an error or zero&#44; then let <var>span</var> be that value&#46;

            Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> element has no <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;attr&#45;col&#45;span&#45;2"></a><code>[span](#attr-col-span)</code> attribute&#44; or if trying to parse the attribute&#39;s value resulted in an error or zero&#44; then let <var>span</var> be 1&#46;

            If <var>span</var> is greater than 1000&#44; let it be 1000 instead&#46;

        4.  Increase <var>x<sub>width</sub></var> by <var>span</var>&#46;

        5.  Let the last <var>span</var> <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;column"></a>[columns](#concept-column) in <var>the table</var> correspond to the <var>current column</var> <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> element&#46;

        6.  If <var>current column</var> is not the last <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> element child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#44; then let the <var>current column</var> be the next <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> element child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#44; and return to the step labeled <em>columns</em>&#46;

        7.  Let all the last <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;2"></a>[columns](#concept-column) in <var>the table</var> from x&#61;<var>x<sub>start</sub></var> to x&#61;<var>x<sub>width</sub></var>&#45;1 form a new <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;group"></a>[column group](#concept-column-group)&#44; anchored at the slot &#40;<var>x<sub>start</sub></var>&#44; 0&#41;&#44; with width <var>x<sub>width</sub></var>&#45;<var>x<sub>start</sub></var>&#44; corresponding to the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#46;

        <strong>If the <var>current element</var> has no <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;col&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[col](#the-col-element)</code> element children</strong>

        1.  If the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element has a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;attr&#45;colgroup&#45;span"></a><code>[span](#attr-colgroup-span)</code> attribute&#44; then parse its value using the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers&#45;2"></a>[rules for parsing non&#45;negative integers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers)&#46;

            If the result of parsing the value is not an error or zero&#44; then let <var>span</var> be that value&#46;

            Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element has no <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;attr&#45;colgroup&#45;span&#45;2"></a><code>[span](#attr-colgroup-span)</code> attribute&#44; or if trying to parse the attribute&#39;s value resulted in an error or zero&#44; then let <var>span</var> be 1&#46;

            If <var>span</var> is greater than 1000&#44; let it be 1000 instead&#46;

        2.  Increase <var>x<sub>width</sub></var> by <var>span</var>&#46;

        3.  Let the last <var>span</var> <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;3"></a>[columns](#concept-column) in <var>the table</var> form a new <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;group&#45;2"></a>[column group](#concept-column-group)&#44; anchored at the slot &#40;<var>x<sub>width</sub></var>&#45;<var>span</var>&#44; 0&#41;&#44; with width <var>span</var>&#44; corresponding to the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#46;

    2.  <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;table&#45;advance&#45;2"></a>[Advance](#concept-table-advance) the <var>current element</var> to the next child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#46;

    3.  While the <var>current element</var> is not one of the following elements&#44; <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;table&#45;advance&#45;3"></a>[advance](#concept-table-advance) the <var>current element</var> to the next child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#58;

        - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code>
        - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code>
        - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code>
        - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code>
        - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code>

    4.  If the <var>current element</var> is a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;colgroup&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[colgroup](#the-colgroup-element)</code> element&#44; jump to the step labeled <em>column groups</em> above&#46;

10. Let <var>y<sub>current</sub></var> be 0&#46;

11. Let the <var>list of downward&#45;growing cells</var> be an empty list&#46;

12. <em>Rows</em>&#58; While the <var>current element</var> is not one of the following elements&#44; <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;table&#45;advance&#45;4"></a>[advance](#concept-table-advance) the <var>current element</var> to the next child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#58;

    - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code>
    - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code>
    - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code>
    - <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code>

13. If the <var>current element</var> is a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code>&#44; then run the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;processing&#45;rows"></a>[algorithm for processing rows](#algorithm-for-processing-rows)&#44; <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;table&#45;advance&#45;5"></a>[advance](#concept-table-advance) the <var>current element</var> to the next child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#44; and return to the step labeled <em>rows</em>&#46;

14. Run the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;ending&#45;a&#45;row&#45;group"></a>[algorithm for ending a row group](#algorithm-for-ending-a-row-group)&#46;

15. If the <var>current element</var> is a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code>&#44; then add that element to the list of <var>pending <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> elements</var>&#44; <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;table&#45;advance&#45;6"></a>[advance](#concept-table-advance) the <var>current element</var> to the next child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#44; and return to the step labeled <em>rows</em>&#46;

16. The <var>current element</var> is either a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code> or a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code>&#46;

    Run the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;processing&#45;row&#45;groups"></a>[algorithm for processing row groups](#algorithm-for-processing-row-groups)&#46;

17. <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;table&#45;advance&#45;7"></a>[Advance](#concept-table-advance) the <var>current element</var> to the next child of the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;table&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[table](#the-table-element)</code>&#46;

18. Return to the step labeled <em>rows</em>&#46;

19. <em>End</em>&#58; For each <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> element in the list of <var>pending <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> elements</var>&#44; in <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; run the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;processing&#45;row&#45;groups&#45;2"></a>[algorithm for processing row groups](#algorithm-for-processing-row-groups)&#46;

20. If there exists a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;row"></a>[row](#concept-row) or <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;4"></a>[column](#concept-column) in <var>the table</var> containing only <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;slots"></a>[slots](#concept-slots) that do not have a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;cell"></a>[cell](#concept-cell) anchored to them&#44; then this is a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;table&#45;model&#45;error&#45;2"></a>[table model error](#table-model-error)&#46;

21. Return <var>the table</var>&#46;

The <a id="algorithm&#45;for&#45;processing&#45;row&#45;groups"></a><strong>algorithm for processing row groups</strong>&#44; which is invoked by the set of steps above for processing <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;thead&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[thead](#the-thead-element)</code>&#44; <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tbody&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[tbody](#the-tbody-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tfoot&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[tfoot](#the-tfoot-element)</code> elements&#44; is&#58;

1.  Let <var>y<sub>start</sub></var> have the value of <var>y<sub>height</sub></var>&#46;

2.  For each <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element that is a child of the element being processed&#44; in tree order&#44; run the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;processing&#45;rows&#45;2"></a>[algorithm for processing rows](#algorithm-for-processing-rows)&#46;

3.  If <var>y<sub>height</sub></var> &#62; <var>y<sub>start</sub></var>&#44; then let all the last <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;2"></a>[rows](#concept-row) in <var>the table</var> from y&#61;<var>y<sub>start</sub></var> to y&#61;<var>y<sub>height</sub></var>&#45;1 form a new <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group"></a>[row group](#concept-row-group)&#44; anchored at the slot with coordinate &#40;0&#44; <var>y<sub>start</sub></var>&#41;&#44; with height <var>y<sub>height</sub></var>&#45;<var>y<sub>start</sub></var>&#44; corresponding to the element being processed&#46;

4.  Run the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;ending&#45;a&#45;row&#45;group&#45;2"></a>[algorithm for ending a row group](#algorithm-for-ending-a-row-group)&#46;

The <a id="algorithm&#45;for&#45;ending&#45;a&#45;row&#45;group"></a><strong>algorithm for ending a row group</strong>&#44; which is invoked by the set of steps above when starting and ending a block of rows&#44; is&#58;

1.  While <var>y<sub>current</sub></var> is less than <var>y<sub>height</sub></var>&#44; follow these steps&#58;

    1.  Run the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;growing&#45;downward&#45;growing&#45;cells"></a>[algorithm for growing downward&#45;growing cells](#algorithm-for-growing-downward-growing-cells)&#46;

    2.  Increase <var>y<sub>current</sub></var> by 1&#46;

2.  Empty the <var>list of downward&#45;growing cells</var>&#46;

The <a id="algorithm&#45;for&#45;processing&#45;rows"></a><strong>algorithm for processing rows</strong>&#44; which is invoked by the set of steps above for processing <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> elements&#44; is&#58;

1.  If <var>y<sub>height</sub></var> is equal to <var>y<sub>current</sub></var>&#44; then increase <var>y<sub>height</sub></var> by 1&#46; &#40;<var>y<sub>current</sub></var> is never <em>greater</em> than <var>y<sub>height</sub></var>&#46;&#41;

2.  Let <var>x<sub>current</sub></var> be 0&#46;

3.  Run the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;growing&#45;downward&#45;growing&#45;cells&#45;2"></a>[algorithm for growing downward&#45;growing cells](#algorithm-for-growing-downward-growing-cells)&#46;

4.  If the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element being processed has no <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element children&#44; then increase <var>y<sub>current</sub></var> by 1&#44; abort this set of steps&#44; and return to the algorithm above&#46;

5.  Let <var>current cell</var> be the first <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element child in the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element being processed&#46;

6.  <em>Cells</em>&#58; While <var>x<sub>current</sub></var> is less than <var>x<sub>width</sub></var> and the slot with coordinate &#40;<var>x<sub>current</sub></var>&#44; <var>y<sub>current</sub></var>&#41; already has a cell assigned to it&#44; increase <var>x<sub>current</sub></var> by 1&#46;

7.  If <var>x<sub>current</sub></var> is equal to <var>x<sub>width</sub></var>&#44; increase <var>x<sub>width</sub></var> by 1&#46; &#40;<var>x<sub>current</sub></var> is never <em>greater</em> than <var>x<sub>width</sub></var>&#46;&#41;

8.  If the <var>current cell</var> has a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;colspan"></a><code>[colspan](#attr-tdth-colspan)</code> attribute&#44; then <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers&#45;3"></a>[parse that attribute&#39;s value](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers)&#44; and let <var>colspan</var> be the result&#46;

    If parsing that value failed&#44; or returned zero&#44; or if the attribute is absent&#44; then let <var>colspan</var> be 1&#44; instead&#46;

    If <var>colspan</var> is greater than 1000&#44; let it be 1000 instead&#46;

9.  If the <var>current cell</var> has a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;rowspan"></a><code>[rowspan](#attr-tdth-rowspan)</code> attribute&#44; then <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers&#45;4"></a>[parse that attribute&#39;s value](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers)&#44; and let <var>rowspan</var> be the result&#46;

    If parsing that value failed or if the attribute is absent&#44; then let <var>rowspan</var> be 1&#44; instead&#46;

    If <var>rowspan</var> is greater than 65534&#44; let it be 65534 instead&#46;

10. Let <var>cell grows downward</var> be false&#46;

11. If <var>rowspan</var> is zero&#44; then set <var>cell grows downward</var> to true and set <var>rowspan</var> to 1&#46;

12. If <var>x<sub>width</sub></var> &#60; <var>x<sub>current</sub></var>&#43;<var>colspan</var>&#44; then let <var>x<sub>width</sub></var> be <var>x<sub>current</sub></var>&#43;<var>colspan</var>&#46;

13. If <var>y<sub>height</sub></var> &#60; <var>y<sub>current</sub></var>&#43;<var>rowspan</var>&#44; then let <var>y<sub>height</sub></var> be <var>y<sub>current</sub></var>&#43;<var>rowspan</var>&#46;

14. Let the slots with coordinates &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; such that <var>x<sub>current</sub></var> ≤ <var>x</var> &#60; <var>x<sub>current</sub></var>&#43;<var>colspan</var> and <var>y<sub>current</sub></var> ≤ <var>y</var> &#60; <var>y<sub>current</sub></var>&#43;<var>rowspan</var> be covered by a new <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;cell&#45;2"></a>[cell](#concept-cell) <var>c</var>&#44; anchored at &#40;<var>x<sub>current</sub></var>&#44; <var>y<sub>current</sub></var>&#41;&#44; which has width <var>colspan</var> and height <var>rowspan</var>&#44; corresponding to the <var>current cell</var> element&#46;

    If the <var>current cell</var> element is a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element&#44; let this new cell <var>c</var> be a header cell&#59; otherwise&#44; let it be a data cell&#46;

    To establish which header cells apply to the <var>current cell</var> element&#44; use the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;algorithm&#45;for&#45;assigning&#45;header&#45;cells"></a>[algorithm for assigning header cells](#algorithm-for-assigning-header-cells) described in the next section&#46;

    If any of the slots involved already had a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;cell&#45;3"></a>[cell](#concept-cell) covering them&#44; then this is a <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;table&#45;model&#45;error&#45;3"></a>[table model error](#table-model-error)&#46; Those slots now have two cells overlapping&#46;

15. If <var>cell grows downward</var> is true&#44; then add the tuple &#123;<var>c</var>&#44; <var>x<sub>current</sub></var>&#44; <var>colspan</var>&#125; to the <var>list of downward&#45;growing cells</var>&#46;

16. Increase <var>x<sub>current</sub></var> by <var>colspan</var>&#46;

17. If <var>current cell</var> is the last <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element child in the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element being processed&#44; then increase <var>y<sub>current</sub></var> by 1&#44; abort this set of steps&#44; and return to the algorithm above&#46;

18. Let <var>current cell</var> be the next <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;td&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[td](#the-td-element)</code> or <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;th&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[th](#the-th-element)</code> element child in the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;the&#45;tr&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[tr](#the-tr-element)</code> element being processed&#46;

19. Return to the step labeled <em>cells</em>&#46;

When the algorithms above require the user agent to run the <a id="algorithm&#45;for&#45;growing&#45;downward&#45;growing&#45;cells"></a><strong>algorithm for growing downward&#45;growing cells</strong>&#44; the user agent must&#44; for each &#123;<var>cell</var>&#44; <var>cell<sub>x</sub></var>&#44; <var>width</var>&#125; tuple in the <var>list of downward&#45;growing cells</var>&#44; if any&#44; extend the <a id="forming&#45;a&#45;table&#58;concept&#45;cell&#45;4"></a>[cell](#concept-cell) <var>cell</var> so that it also covers the slots with coordinates &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y<sub>current</sub></var>&#41;&#44; where <var>cell<sub>x</sub></var> ≤ <var>x</var> &#60; <var>cell<sub>x</sub></var>&#43;<var>width</var>&#46;

##### <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics"></a>4&#46;9&#46;12&#46;2 Forming relationships between data cells and header cells[](#header-and-data-cell-semantics)

Each cell can be assigned zero or more header cells&#46; The <a id="algorithm&#45;for&#45;assigning&#45;header&#45;cells"></a><strong>algorithm for assigning header cells</strong> to a cell <var>principal cell</var> is as follows&#46;

1.  Let <var>header list</var> be an empty list of cells&#46;

2.  Let &#40;<var>principal<sub>x</sub></var>&#44; <var>principal<sub>y</sub></var>&#41; be the coordinate of the slot to which the <var>principal cell</var> is anchored&#46;

3.  <strong>If the <var>principal cell</var> has a <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code> attribute specified</strong>

    1.  Take the value of the <var>principal cell</var>&#39;s <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers&#45;2"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code> attribute and <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;split&#45;a&#45;string&#45;on&#45;spaces"></a>[split it on ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace)&#44; letting <var>id list</var> be the list of tokens obtained&#46;

    2.  For each token in the <var>id list</var>&#44; if the first element in the <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;document"></a><code>[Document](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#document)</code> with an <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;concept&#45;id"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) equal to the token is a cell in the same <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;concept&#45;table"></a>[table](#concept-table)&#44; and that cell is not the <var>principal cell</var>&#44; then add that cell to <var>header list</var>&#46;

    <strong>If <var>principal cell</var> does not have a <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;tdth&#45;headers&#45;3"></a><code>[headers](#attr-tdth-headers)</code> attribute specified</strong>

    1.  Let <var>principal<sub>width</sub></var> be the width of the <var>principal cell</var>&#46;

    2.  Let <var>principal<sub>height</sub></var> be the height of the <var>principal cell</var>&#46;

    3.  For each value of <var>y</var> from <var>principal<sub>y</sub></var> to <var>principal<sub>y</sub></var>&#43;<var>principal<sub>height</sub></var>&#45;1&#44; run the <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;internal&#45;algorithm&#45;for&#45;scanning&#45;and&#45;assigning&#45;header&#45;cells"></a>[internal algorithm for scanning and assigning header cells](#internal-algorithm-for-scanning-and-assigning-header-cells)&#44; with the <var>principal cell</var>&#44; the <var>header list</var>&#44; the initial coordinate &#40;<var>principal<sub>x</sub></var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; and the increments Δ<var>x</var>&#61;−1 and Δ<var>y</var>&#61;0&#46;

    4.  For each value of <var>x</var> from <var>principal<sub>x</sub></var> to <var>principal<sub>x</sub></var>&#43;<var>principal<sub>width</sub></var>&#45;1&#44; run the <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;internal&#45;algorithm&#45;for&#45;scanning&#45;and&#45;assigning&#45;header&#45;cells&#45;2"></a>[internal algorithm for scanning and assigning header cells](#internal-algorithm-for-scanning-and-assigning-header-cells)&#44; with the <var>principal cell</var>&#44; the <var>header list</var>&#44; the initial coordinate &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>principal<sub>y</sub></var>&#41;&#44; and the increments Δ<var>x</var>&#61;0 and Δ<var>y</var>&#61;−1&#46;

    5.  If the <var>principal cell</var> is anchored in a <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;concept&#45;row&#45;group"></a>[row group](#concept-row-group)&#44; then add all header cells that are <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;row&#45;group&#45;header"></a>[row group headers](#row-group-header) and are anchored in the same row group with an <var>x</var>&#45;coordinate less than or equal to <var>principal<sub>x</sub></var>&#43;<var>principal<sub>width</sub></var>&#45;1 and a <var>y</var>&#45;coordinate less than or equal to <var>principal<sub>y</sub></var>&#43;<var>principal<sub>height</sub></var>&#45;1 to <var>header list</var>&#46;

    6.  If the <var>principal cell</var> is anchored in a <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;concept&#45;column&#45;group"></a>[column group](#concept-column-group)&#44; then add all header cells that are <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;column&#45;group&#45;header"></a>[column group headers](#column-group-header) and are anchored in the same column group with an <var>x</var>&#45;coordinate less than or equal to <var>principal<sub>x</sub></var>&#43;<var>principal<sub>width</sub></var>&#45;1 and a <var>y</var>&#45;coordinate less than or equal to <var>principal<sub>y</sub></var>&#43;<var>principal<sub>height</sub></var>&#45;1 to <var>header list</var>&#46;

4.  Remove all the <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;empty&#45;cell"></a>[empty cells](#empty-cell) from the <var>header list</var>&#46;

5.  Remove any duplicates from the <var>header list</var>&#46;

6.  Remove <var>principal cell</var> from the <var>header list</var> if it is there&#46;

7.  Assign the headers in the <var>header list</var> to the <var>principal cell</var>&#46;

The <a id="internal&#45;algorithm&#45;for&#45;scanning&#45;and&#45;assigning&#45;header&#45;cells"></a><strong>internal algorithm for scanning and assigning header cells</strong>&#44; given a <var>principal cell</var>&#44; a <var>header list</var>&#44; an initial coordinate &#40;<var>initial<sub>x</sub></var>&#44; <var>initial<sub>y</sub></var>&#41;&#44; and Δ<var>x</var> and Δ<var>y</var> increments&#44; is as follows&#58;

1.  Let <var>x</var> equal <var>initial<sub>x</sub></var>&#46;

2.  Let <var>y</var> equal <var>initial<sub>y</sub></var>&#46;

3.  Let <var>opaque headers</var> be an empty list of cells&#46;

4.  <strong>If <var>principal cell</var> is a header cell</strong>

    Let <var>in header block</var> be true&#44; and let <var>headers from current header block</var> be a list of cells containing just the <var>principal cell</var>&#46;

    <strong>Otherwise</strong>

    Let <var>in header block</var> be false and let <var>headers from current header block</var> be an empty list of cells&#46;

5.  <em>Loop</em>&#58; Increment <var>x</var> by Δ<var>x</var>&#59; increment <var>y</var> by Δ<var>y</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    For each invocation of this algorithm&#44; one of Δ<var>x</var> and Δ<var>y</var> will be −1&#44; and the other will be 0&#46;

6.  If either <var>x</var> or <var>y</var> are less than 0&#44; then abort this internal algorithm&#46;

7.  If there is no cell covering slot &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; or if there is more than one cell covering slot &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#44; return to the substep labeled <em>loop</em>&#46;

8.  Let <var>current cell</var> be the cell covering slot &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41;&#46;

9.  <strong>If <var>current cell</var> is a header cell</strong>

    1.  Set <var>in header block</var> to true&#46;

    2.  Add <var>current cell</var> to <var>headers from current header block</var>&#46;

    3.  Let <var>blocked</var> be false&#46;

    4.  <strong>If Δ<var>x</var> is 0</strong>

        If there are any cells in the <var>opaque headers</var> list anchored with the same <var>x</var>&#45;coordinate as the <var>current cell</var>&#44; and with the same width as <var>current cell</var>&#44; then let <var>blocked</var> be true&#46;

        If the <var>current cell</var> is not a <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;column&#45;header"></a>[column header](#column-header)&#44; then let <var>blocked</var> be true&#46;

        <strong>If Δ<var>y</var> is 0</strong>

        If there are any cells in the <var>opaque headers</var> list anchored with the same <var>y</var>&#45;coordinate as the <var>current cell</var>&#44; and with the same height as <var>current cell</var>&#44; then let <var>blocked</var> be true&#46;

        If the <var>current cell</var> is not a <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;row&#45;header"></a>[row header](#row-header)&#44; then let <var>blocked</var> be true&#46;

    5.  If <var>blocked</var> is false&#44; then add the <var>current cell</var> to the <var>header list</var>&#46;

    <strong>If <var>current cell</var> is a data cell and <var>in header block</var> is true</strong>

    Set <var>in header block</var> to false&#46; Add all the cells in <var>headers from current header block</var> to the <var>opaque headers</var> list&#44; and empty the <var>headers from current header block</var> list&#46;

10. Return to the step labeled <em>loop</em>&#46;

A header cell anchored at the slot with coordinate &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; with width <var>width</var> and height <var>height</var> is said to be a <a id="column&#45;header"></a><strong>column header</strong> if any of the following are true&#58;

- the cell&#39;s <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attribute is in the <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;column&#45;state"></a>[Column](#attr-th-scope-column-state) state&#59; or

- the cell&#39;s <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;2"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attribute is in the <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;auto&#45;state"></a>[Auto](#attr-th-scope-auto-state) state&#44; and there are no data cells in any of the cells covering slots with <var>y</var>&#45;coordinates <var>y</var> &#46;&#46; <var>y</var>&#43;<var>height</var>&#45;1&#46;

A header cell anchored at the slot with coordinate &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; with width <var>width</var> and height <var>height</var> is said to be a <a id="row&#45;header"></a><strong>row header</strong> if any of the following are true&#58;

- the cell&#39;s <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;3"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attribute is in the <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;row&#45;state"></a>[Row](#attr-th-scope-row-state) state&#59; or

- the cell&#39;s <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;4"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attribute is in the <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;auto&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Auto](#attr-th-scope-auto-state) state&#44; the cell is not a <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;column&#45;header&#45;2"></a>[column header](#column-header)&#44; and there are no data cells in any of the cells covering slots with <var>x</var>&#45;coordinates <var>x</var> &#46;&#46; <var>x</var>&#43;<var>width</var>&#45;1&#46;

A header cell is said to be a <a id="column&#45;group&#45;header"></a><strong>column group header</strong> if its <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;5"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attribute is in the <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;colgroup&#45;state"></a>[Column Group](#attr-th-scope-colgroup-state) state&#46;

A header cell is said to be a <a id="row&#45;group&#45;header"></a><strong>row group header</strong> if its <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;6"></a><code>[scope](#attr-th-scope)</code> attribute is in the <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;attr&#45;th&#45;scope&#45;rowgroup&#45;state"></a>[Row Group](#attr-th-scope-rowgroup-state) state&#46;

A cell is said to be an <a id="empty&#45;cell"></a><strong>empty cell</strong> if it contains no elements and its <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content)&#44; if any&#44; consists only of <a id="header&#45;and&#45;data&#45;cell&#45;semantics&#58;space&#45;characters"></a>[ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-whitespace)&#46;
