The <a id="dom&#45;form&#45;autocomplete"></a><strong><code>autocomplete</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the content attribute of the same name&#44; <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;form&#45;elements"></a><strong><code>elements</code></strong> IDL attribute must return an <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;htmlformcontrolscollection&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLFormControlsCollection](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#htmlformcontrolscollection)</code> rooted at the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;root"></a>[root](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-root)&#44; whose filter matches <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;category&#45;listed"></a>[listed elements](#category-listed) whose <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; with the exception of <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements whose <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state&#44; which must&#44; for historical reasons&#44; be excluded from this particular collection&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;form&#45;length"></a><strong><code>length</code></strong> IDL attribute must return the number of nodes <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection"></a>[represented](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection) by the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;form&#45;elements&#45;2"></a><code>[elements](#dom-form-elements)</code> collection&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices) at any instant are the indices supported by the object returned by the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;form&#45;elements&#45;3"></a><code>[elements](#dom-form-elements)</code> attribute at that instant&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;form&#45;item"></a>To <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;determine&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;an&#45;indexed&#45;property"></a>[determine the value of an indexed property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-determine-the-value-of-an-indexed-property) for a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; the user agent must return the value returned by the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;item"></a><code>[item](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-htmlcollection-item)</code> method on the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;form&#45;elements&#45;4"></a><code>[elements](#dom-form-elements)</code> collection&#44; when invoked with the given index as its argument&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element has a mapping of names to elements called the <a id="past&#45;names&#45;map"></a><strong>past names map</strong>&#46; It is used to persist names of controls even when they change names&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;names"></a>[supported property names](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-names) consist of the names obtained from the following algorithm&#44; in the order obtained from this algorithm&#58;

1.  Let <var>sourced names</var> be an initially empty ordered list of tuples consisting of a string&#44; an element&#44; a source&#44; where the source is either <em>id</em>&#44; <em>name</em>&#44; or <em>past</em>&#44; and&#44; if the source is <em>past</em>&#44; an age&#46;

2.  For each <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;category&#45;listed&#45;2"></a>[listed element](#category-listed) <var>candidate</var> whose <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; with the exception of any <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements whose <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state&#58;

    1.  If <var>candidate</var> has an <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute&#44; add an entry to <var>sourced names</var> with that <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute&#39;s value as the string&#44; <var>candidate</var> as the element&#44; and <em>id</em> as the source&#46;

    2.  If <var>candidate</var> has a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;3"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute&#44; add an entry to <var>sourced names</var> with that <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;4"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute&#39;s value as the string&#44; <var>candidate</var> as the element&#44; and <em>name</em> as the source&#46;

3.  For each <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> element <var>candidate</var> whose <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;3"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#58;

    1.  If <var>candidate</var> has an <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;3"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute&#44; add an entry to <var>sourced names</var> with that <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;4"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute&#39;s value as the string&#44; <var>candidate</var> as the element&#44; and <em>id</em> as the source&#46;

    2.  If <var>candidate</var> has a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;name"></a><code>[name](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-img-name)</code> attribute&#44; add an entry to <var>sourced names</var> with that <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-img-name)</code> attribute&#39;s value as the string&#44; <var>candidate</var> as the element&#44; and <em>name</em> as the source&#46;

4.  For each entry <var>past entry</var> in the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;past&#45;names&#45;map"></a>[past names map](#past-names-map)&#44; add an entry to <var>sourced names</var> with the <var>past entry</var>&#39;s name as the string&#44; <var>past entry</var>&#39;s element as the element&#44; <em>past</em> as the source&#44; and the length of time <var>past entry</var> has been in the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;past&#45;names&#45;map&#45;2"></a>[past names map](#past-names-map) as the age&#46;

5.  Sort <var>sourced names</var> by <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) of the element entry of each tuple&#44; sorting entries with the same element by putting entries whose source is <em>id</em> first&#44; then entries whose source is <em>name</em>&#44; and finally entries whose source is <em>past</em>&#44; and sorting entries with the same element and source by their age&#44; oldest first&#46;

6.  Remove any entries in <var>sourced names</var> that have the empty string as their name&#46;

7.  Remove any entries in <var>sourced names</var> that have the same name as an earlier entry in the map&#46;

8.  Return the list of names from <var>sourced names</var>&#44; maintaining their relative order&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;form&#45;nameditem"></a>To <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;determine&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;a&#45;named&#45;property"></a>[determine the value of a named property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-determine-the-value-of-a-named-property) <var>name</var> for a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>candidates</var> be a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;live"></a>[live](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#live) <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;radionodelist&#45;4"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#radionodelist)</code> object containing all the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;category&#45;listed&#45;3"></a>[listed elements](#category-listed)&#44; whose <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;4"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; that have either an <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;5"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute or a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;5"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute equal to <var>name</var>&#44; with the exception of <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements whose <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#45;3"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state&#44; in <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

2.  If <var>candidates</var> is empty&#44; let <var>candidates</var> be a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;live&#45;2"></a>[live](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#live) <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;radionodelist&#45;5"></a><code>[RadioNodeList](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#radionodelist)</code> object containing all the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> elements&#44; whose <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;5"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; that have either an <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;id&#45;attribute&#45;6"></a><code>[id](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-id-attribute)</code> attribute or a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;name&#45;3"></a><code>[name](html-language-obsolete--877d6146487f--66870e9cdabe.md#attr-img-name)</code> attribute equal to <var>name</var>&#44; in <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;3"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

3.  If <var>candidates</var> is empty&#44; <var>name</var> is the name of one of the entries in the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;past&#45;names&#45;map&#45;3"></a>[past names map](#past-names-map)&#58; return the object associated with <var>name</var> in that map&#46;

4.  If <var>candidates</var> contains more than one node&#44; return <var>candidates</var>&#46;

5.  Otherwise&#44; <var>candidates</var> contains exactly one node&#46; Add a mapping from <var>name</var> to the node in <var>candidates</var> in the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;past&#45;names&#45;map&#45;4"></a>[past names map](#past-names-map)&#44; replacing the previous entry with the same name&#44; if any&#46;

6.  Return the node in <var>candidates</var>&#46;

If an element listed in a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;past&#45;names&#45;map&#45;5"></a>[past names map](#past-names-map) changes <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;6"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#44; then its entries must be removed from that map&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;form&#45;submit"></a><strong><code>submit&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are to <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;submit"></a>[submit](#concept-form-submit) <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) from <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#44; with <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;submit&#45;subbmitted&#45;from&#45;method"></a><em>[submitted from <code>submit&#40;&#41;</code> method](#submit-subbmitted-from-method)</em> set to true&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;form&#45;requestsubmit"></a><strong><code>requestSubmit&#40;<var>submitter</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If <var>submitter</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  If <var>submitter</var> is not a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;2"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button)&#44; then throw a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;typeerror"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code>&#46;

    2.  If <var>submitter</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;7"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is not this <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; then throw a <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;notfounderror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotFoundError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notfounderror) <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#44; set <var>submitter</var> to this <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;submit&#45;2"></a>[Submit](#concept-form-submit) this <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; from <var>submitter</var>&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;form&#45;reset"></a><strong><code>reset&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element is marked as <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;locked&#45;for&#45;reset"></a><em>[locked for reset](#locked-for-reset)</em>&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Mark the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element as <a id="locked&#45;for&#45;reset"></a><strong>locked for reset</strong>&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset"></a>[Reset](#concept-form-reset) the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#46;

4.  Unmark the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element as <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;locked&#45;for&#45;reset&#45;2"></a><em>[locked for reset](#locked-for-reset)</em>&#46;

If the <a id="dom&#45;form&#45;checkvalidity"></a><strong><code>checkValidity&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method is invoked&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;statically&#45;validate&#45;the&#45;constraints"></a>[statically validate the constraints](#statically-validate-the-constraints) of the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; and return true if the constraint validation returned a <em>positive</em> result&#44; and false if it returned a <em>negative</em> result&#46;

If the <a id="dom&#45;form&#45;reportvalidity"></a><strong><code>reportValidity&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method is invoked&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;interactively&#45;validate&#45;the&#45;constraints&#45;3"></a>[interactively validate the constraints](#interactively-validate-the-constraints) of the <a id="the&#45;form&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; and return true if the constraint validation returned a <em>positive</em> result&#44; and false if it returned a <em>negative</em> result&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This example shows two search forms&#58;

``` text
<form action="https://www.google.com/search" method="get">
 <label>Google: <input type="search" name="q"></label> <input type="submit" value="Search...">
</form>
<form action="https://www.bing.com/search" method="get">
 <label>Bing: <input type="search" name="q"></label> <input type="submit" value="Search...">
</form>
```

<strong><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmllabelelement"></a><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;htmlformelement"></a><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;label&#45;form"></a><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;label&#45;for&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;label&#45;htmlfor"></a><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;htmlelement&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;label&#45;control"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLLabelElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  readonly attribute HTMLFormElement? form;
  [CEReactions, Reflect="for"] attribute DOMString htmlFor;
  readonly attribute HTMLElement? control;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a caption in a user interface&#46; The caption can be associated with a specific form control&#44; known as the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="labeled&#45;control"></a><strong>labeled control</strong>&#44; either using the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;label&#45;for&#45;3"></a><code>[for](#attr-label-for)</code> attribute&#44; or by putting the form control inside the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element itself&#46;

Except where otherwise specified by the following rules&#44; a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element has no <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;2"></a>[labeled control](#labeled-control)&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Attributes&#47;for](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/for)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari4&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;label&#45;for"></a><strong><code>for</code></strong> attribute may be specified to indicate a form control with which the caption is to be associated&#46; If the attribute is specified&#44; the attribute&#39;s value must be the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;id"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) of a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;category&#45;label&#45;2"></a>[labelable element](#category-label) in the same <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;tree"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree) as the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element&#46; If the attribute is specified and there is an element in the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;2"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree) whose <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;id&#45;2"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) is equal to the value of the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;label&#45;for&#45;4"></a><code>[for](#attr-label-for)</code> attribute&#44; and the first such element in <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) is a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;category&#45;label&#45;3"></a>[labelable element](#category-label)&#44; then that element is the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;3"></a>[labeled control](#labeled-control)&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;label&#45;for&#45;5"></a><code>[for](#attr-label-for)</code> attribute is not specified&#44; but the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element has a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;category&#45;label&#45;4"></a>[labelable element](#category-label) descendant&#44; then the first such descendant in <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) is the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;4"></a>[labeled control](#labeled-control)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element&#39;s exact default presentation and behavior&#44; in particular what its <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;activation&#45;behaviour"></a>[activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior) might be&#44; if anything&#44; should match the platform&#39;s label behavior&#46; The <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;activation&#45;behaviour&#45;2"></a>[activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior) of a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element for events targeted at <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;interactive&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[interactive content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#interactive-content-2) descendants of a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element&#44; and any descendants of those <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;interactive&#45;content&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[interactive content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#interactive-content-2) descendants&#44; must be to do nothing&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[Form&#45;associated custom elements](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element) are <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;category&#45;label&#45;5"></a>[labelable elements](#category-label)&#44; so for user agents where the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;activation&#45;behaviour&#45;3"></a>[activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior) impacts the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;5"></a>[labeled control](#labeled-control)&#44; both built&#45;in and custom elements will be impacted&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; on platforms where clicking a label activates the form control&#44; clicking the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> in the following snippet could trigger the user agent to <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;fire&#45;a&#45;click&#45;event"></a>[fire a <code>click</code> event](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fire-a-click-event) at the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; as if the element itself had been triggered by the user&#58;

``` text
<label><input type=checkbox name=lost> Lost</label>
```

Similarly&#44; assuming <code>my&#45;checkbox</code> was declared as a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element) &#40;like in [this example](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#custom-elements-face-example)&#41;&#44; then the code

``` text
<label><my-checkbox name=lost></my-checkbox> Lost</label>
```

would have the same behavior&#44; <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;fire&#45;a&#45;click&#45;event&#45;2"></a>[firing a <code>click</code> event](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fire-a-click-event) at the <code>my&#45;checkbox</code> element&#46;

On other platforms&#44; the behavior in both cases might be just to focus the control&#44; or to do nothing&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following example shows three form controls each with a label&#44; two of which have small text showing the right format for users to use&#46;

``` text
<p><label>Full name: <input name=fn> <small>Format: First Last</small></label></p>
<p><label>Age: <input name=age type=number min=0></label></p>
<p><label>Post code: <input name=pc> <small>Format: AB12 3CD</small></label></p>
```

The <a id="dom&#45;label&#45;control"></a><strong><code>control</code></strong> IDL attribute must return the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;6"></a>[labeled control](#labeled-control)&#44; if any&#44; or null if there isn&#39;t one&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;label&#45;form"></a><strong><code>form</code></strong> IDL attribute must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element has no <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;7"></a>[labeled control](#labeled-control)&#44; then return null&#46;

2.  If the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;8"></a>[labeled control](#labeled-control) is not a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated element](#form-associated-element)&#44; then return null&#46;

3.  Return the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;9"></a>[labeled control](#labeled-control)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) &#40;which can still be null&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;label&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#dom-label-form)</code> IDL attribute on the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element is different from the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fae&#45;form"></a><code>[form](#attr-fae-form)</code> IDL attribute on <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;category&#45;listed"></a>[listed](#category-listed) <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[form&#45;associated elements](#form-associated-element)&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> element does not have a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#attr-fae-form)</code> content attribute&#46;

Returns a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;nodelist"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> of all the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> elements that the form control is associated with&#46;

<a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;category&#45;label&#45;6"></a>[Labelable elements](#category-label) and all <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements have a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;live"></a>[live](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#live) <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;nodelist&#45;2"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> object associated with them that represents the list of <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> elements&#44; in <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;3"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; whose <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;10"></a>[labeled control](#labeled-control) is the element in question&#46; The <a id="dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels"></a><strong><code>labels</code></strong> IDL attribute of <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;category&#45;label&#45;7"></a>[labelable elements](#category-label) that are not <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[form&#45;associated custom elements](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels"></a><code>[labels](#dom-lfe-labels)</code> IDL attribute of <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements&#44; on getting&#44; must return that <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;nodelist&#45;3"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> object&#44; and that same value must always be returned&#44; unless this element is an <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;"></a>[Hidden](#hidden-state-(type=hidden)) state&#44; in which case it must instead return null&#46;

<a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[Form&#45;associated custom elements](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element) don&#39;t have a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels&#45;2"></a><code>[labels](#dom-lfe-labels)</code> IDL attribute&#46; Instead&#44; their <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;elementinternals"></a><code>[ElementInternals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#elementinternals)</code> object has a <a id="dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;labels"></a><strong><code>labels</code></strong> IDL attribute&#46; On getting&#44; it must throw a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;notsupportederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;internals&#45;target"></a>[target element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#internals-target) is not a <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46; Otherwise&#44; it must return that <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;nodelist&#45;4"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> object&#44; and that same value must always be returned&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This &#40;non&#45;conforming&#41; example shows what happens to the <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;nodelist&#45;5"></a><code>[NodeList](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-nodelist)</code> and what <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels&#45;3"></a><code>[labels](#dom-lfe-labels)</code> returns when an <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element has its <a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute changed&#46;

<a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;11"></a><a id="the&#45;label&#45;element&#58;labeled&#45;control&#45;12"></a>

``` text
<!doctype html>
<p><label><input></label></p>
<script>
 const input = document.querySelector('input');
 const labels = input.labels;
 console.assert(labels.length === 1);

 input.type = 'hidden';
 console.assert(labels.length === 0); // the input is no longer the label's labeled control
 console.assert(input.labels === null);

 input.type = 'checkbox';
 console.assert(labels.length === 1); // the input is once again the label's labeled control
 console.assert(input.labels === labels); // same value as returned originally
</script>
```

interface HTMLInputElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString accept;

  attribute boolean checked;

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean disabled;
  readonly attribute HTMLFormElement? form;
  attribute FileList? files;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute USVString formAction;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString formEnctype;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString formMethod;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean formNoValidate;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString formTarget;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute unsigned long height;
  attribute boolean indeterminate;
  readonly attribute HTMLDataListElement? list;

† If the control has no selectable text&#44; the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select&#45;4"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code> method results in a no&#45;op&#44; with no <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

Some states of the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;29"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute define a <a id="value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>value sanitization algorithm</strong>&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element has a <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; which is exposed by the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;3"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute&#46; Some states define an <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;number"></a><strong>algorithm to convert a string to a number</strong>&#44; an <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;number&#45;string"></a><strong>algorithm to convert a number to a string</strong>&#44; an <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;date"></a><strong>algorithm to convert a string to a <code>Date</code> object</strong>&#44; and an <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;date&#45;string"></a><strong>algorithm to convert a <code>Date</code> object to a string</strong>&#44; which are used by <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max&#45;4"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min&#45;4"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step&#45;4"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate&#45;4"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber&#45;4"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup&#45;4"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code>&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) must be set to true whenever the user interacts with the control in a way that changes the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46; &#40;It is also set to true when the value is programmatically changed&#44; as described in the definition of the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;4"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute&#46;&#41;

The <a id="attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> content attribute gives the default <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#46; When the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;3"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute is added&#44; set&#44; or removed&#44; if the control&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty&#45;2"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) is false&#44; the user agent must set the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element to the value of the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;4"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute&#44; if there is one&#44; or the empty string otherwise&#44; and then run the current <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm)&#44; if one is defined&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element has a <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked)&#44; which is exposed by the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;4"></a><code>[checked](#dom-input-checked)</code> IDL attribute&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element has a boolean <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;dirty&#45;flag"></a><strong>dirty checkedness flag</strong>&#46; When it is true&#44; the element is said to have a <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;dirty"></a><strong><em>dirty checkedness</em></strong>&#46; The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;dirty&#45;flag"></a>[dirty checkedness flag](#concept-input-checked-dirty-flag) must be initially set to false when the element is created&#44; and must be set to true whenever the user interacts with the control in a way that changes the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;2"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked)&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#35;checked](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#checked)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

The <a id="attr&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><strong><code>checked</code></strong> content attribute is a <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute) that gives the default <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;3"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) of the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#46; When the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;5"></a><code>[checked](#attr-input-checked)</code> content attribute is added&#44; if the control does not have <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;dirty"></a><em>[dirty checkedness](#concept-input-checked-dirty)</em>&#44; the user agent must set the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;4"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) of the element to true&#59; when the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;6"></a><code>[checked](#attr-input-checked)</code> content attribute is removed&#44; if the control does not have <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;dirty&#45;2"></a><em>[dirty checkedness](#concept-input-checked-dirty)</em>&#44; the user agent must set the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;5"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) of the element to false&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset&#45;control"></a>[reset algorithm](#concept-form-reset-control) for <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements is to set its <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;user&#45;validity"></a>[user validity](#user-validity)&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty&#45;3"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty)&#44; and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;dirty&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[dirty checkedness flag](#concept-input-checked-dirty-flag) back to false&#44; set the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element to the value of the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;5"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute&#44; if there is one&#44; or the empty string otherwise&#44; set the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;6"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) of the element to true if the element has a <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;7"></a><code>[checked](#attr-input-checked)</code> content attribute and false if it does not&#44; empty the list of <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected)&#44; and then invoke the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm)&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;30"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s current state defines one&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element can be <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#46; Except where otherwise specified&#44; an <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element is always <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;2"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#46; Similarly&#44; except where otherwise specified&#44; the user agent should not allow the user to modify the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) or <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;7"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked)&#46;

When an <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element is <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled)&#44; it is not <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;3"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;readonly&#45;4"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-input-readonly)</code> attribute can also in some cases &#40;e&#46;g&#46; for the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Date](#date-state-(type=date)) state&#44; but not the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Checkbox](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)) state&#41; stop an <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element from being <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;4"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element can <a id="input&#45;support&#45;picker"></a><strong>support a picker</strong>&#46; A picker is a user interface element that allows the end user to choose a value&#46; Whether an <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element supports a picker depends on the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;31"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute state and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) behavior&#46; An <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element must support a picker when its <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;32"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#45;5"></a>[File Upload](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) state&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

As of the time of this writing&#44; typical browser implementations show such picker UI for&#58;

- <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements whose <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;33"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attributes are in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#45;5"></a>[Date](#date-state-(type=date))&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Month](#month-state-(type=month))&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Week](#week-state-(type=week))&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Time](#time-state-(type=time))&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Local Date and Time](#local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local))&#44; and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Color](#color-state-(type=color)) states&#59;

- <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements in various states that have a <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;list"></a>[suggestions source element](#concept-input-list)&#59;

- <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements whose <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;34"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#45;6"></a>[File Upload](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) state&#59; and

- <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> elements&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;clone&#45;ext"></a>[cloning steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-clone-ext) for <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements given <var>node</var>&#44; <var>copy</var>&#44; and <var>subtree</var> are to propagate the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty&#45;4"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty)&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;8"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked)&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;dirty&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[dirty checkedness flag](#concept-input-checked-dirty-flag)&#44; and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;indeterminate"></a>[indeterminateness](#concept-input-indeterminate) from <var>node</var> to <var>copy</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;activation&#45;behaviour"></a>[activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior) for <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements <var>element</var>&#44; given <var>event</var>&#44; are these steps&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> is not <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;5"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; and <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;35"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is neither in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#45;5"></a>[Checkbox](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)) nor in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Radio](#radio-button-state-(type=radio)) state&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Run <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a><strong>input activation behavior</strong>&#44; if any&#44; and do nothing otherwise&#46;

3.  If <var>element</var> has a <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) and <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;36"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is not in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;button&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Button](#button-state-(type=button)) state&#44; then return&#46;

4.  Run the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;popover&#45;target&#45;attribute&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[popover target attribute activation behavior](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#popover-target-attribute-activation-behavior) given <var>element</var> and <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;target"></a>[target](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event-target)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Recall that an element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;activation&#45;behaviour&#45;2"></a>[activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior) runs for both user&#45;initiated activations and for synthetic activations &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; via <code>el&#46;click&#40;&#41;</code>&#41;&#46; User agents might also have behaviors for a given control — not specified here — that are triggered only by true user&#45;initiated activations&#46; A common choice is to <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;show&#45;the&#45;picker&#44;&#45;if&#45;applicable"></a>[show the picker&#44; if applicable](#show-the-picker,-if-applicable)&#44; for the control&#46; In contrast&#44; the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior) only shows pickers for the special historical cases of the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#45;7"></a>[File Upload](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#45;5"></a>[Color](#color-state-(type=color)) states&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;legacy&#45;pre&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[legacy&#45;pre&#45;activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-legacy-pre-activation-behavior) for <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements are these steps&#58;

1.  If this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;37"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#45;6"></a>[Checkbox state](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox))&#44; then set this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;9"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) to its opposite value &#40;i&#46;e&#46; true if it is false&#44; false if it is true&#41; and set this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;indeterminate&#45;2"></a>[indeterminateness](#concept-input-indeterminate) to false&#46;

2.  If this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;38"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#45;5"></a>[Radio Button state](#radio-button-state-(type=radio))&#44; then get a reference to the element in this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group"></a>[radio button group](#radio-button-group) that has its <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;10"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) set to true&#44; if any&#44; and then set this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;11"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) to true&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;legacy&#45;canceled&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[legacy&#45;canceled&#45;activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-legacy-canceled-activation-behavior) for <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements are these steps&#58;

1.  If the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;39"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#45;7"></a>[Checkbox state](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox))&#44; then set the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;12"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) and the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;indeterminate&#45;3"></a>[indeterminateness](#concept-input-indeterminate) back to the values they had before the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;legacy&#45;pre&#45;activation&#45;behavior&#45;2"></a>[legacy&#45;pre&#45;activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-legacy-pre-activation-behavior) was run&#46;

2.  If this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;40"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#45;6"></a>[Radio Button state](#radio-button-state-(type=radio))&#44; then if the element to which a reference was obtained in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;legacy&#45;pre&#45;activation&#45;behavior&#45;3"></a>[legacy&#45;pre&#45;activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-legacy-pre-activation-behavior)&#44; if any&#44; is still in what is now this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group&#45;2"></a>[radio button group](#radio-button-group)&#44; if it still has one&#44; and if so&#44; set that element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;13"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) to true&#59; or else&#44; if there was no such element&#44; or that element is no longer in this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group&#45;3"></a>[radio button group](#radio-button-group)&#44; or if this element no longer has a <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group&#45;4"></a>[radio button group](#radio-button-group)&#44; set this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;14"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) to false&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

When an <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element is first created&#44; the element&#39;s rendering and behavior must be set to the rendering and behavior defined for the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;41"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s state&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm&#45;3"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm)&#44; if one is defined for the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;42"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s state&#44; must be invoked&#46;

<a id="input&#45;type&#45;change"></a>

When an <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;43"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute changes state&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If the previous state of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;44"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute put the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;5"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value&#45;10"></a><em>[value](#dom-input-value-value)</em> mode&#44; and the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;8"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) is not the empty string&#44; and the new state of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;45"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute puts the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;6"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute in either the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default&#45;5"></a><em>[default](#dom-input-value-default)</em> mode or the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default&#45;on&#45;2"></a><em>[default&#47;on](#dom-input-value-default-on)</em> mode&#44; then set the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;6"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute to the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;9"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

2.  Otherwise&#44; if the previous state of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;46"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute put the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;7"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute in any mode other than the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value&#45;11"></a><em>[value](#dom-input-value-value)</em> mode&#44; and the new state of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;47"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute puts the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;8"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value&#45;12"></a><em>[value](#dom-input-value-value)</em> mode&#44; then set the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;10"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element to the value of the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;7"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute&#44; if there is one&#44; or the empty string otherwise&#44; and then set the control&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty&#45;5"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) to false&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#44; if the previous state of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;48"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute put the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;9"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute in any mode other than the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;filename&#45;2"></a><em>[filename](#dom-input-value-filename)</em> mode&#44; and the new state of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;49"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute puts the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;10"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;filename&#45;3"></a><em>[filename](#dom-input-value-filename)</em> mode&#44; then set the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;11"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element to the empty string&#46;

4.  Update the element&#39;s rendering and behavior to the new state&#39;s&#46;

5.  <a id="signal&#45;a&#45;type&#45;change"></a><strong>Signal a type change</strong> for the element&#46; &#40;The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#45;7"></a>[Radio Button](#radio-button-state-(type=radio)) state uses this&#44; in particular&#46;&#41;

6.  Invoke the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm&#45;4"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm)&#44; if one is defined for the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;50"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s new state&#46;

7.  Let <var>previouslySelectable</var> be true if <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext&#45;5"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code> previously <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[applied](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

8.  Let <var>nowSelectable</var> be true if <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext&#45;6"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code> now <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;3"></a>[applies](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

9.  If <var>previouslySelectable</var> is false and <var>nowSelectable</var> is true&#44; set the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;cursor"></a>[text entry cursor position](#concept-textarea/input-cursor) to the beginning of the text control&#44; and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;set&#45;the&#45;selection&#45;direction"></a>[set its selection direction](#set-the-selection-direction) to &#34;<code>none</code>&#34;&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute represents the element&#39;s name&#46; The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname&#45;4"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code> attribute controls how the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;directionality&#45;2"></a>[directionality](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-directionality) is submitted&#46; The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-fe-disabled)</code> attribute is used to make the control non&#45;interactive and to prevent its value from being submitted&#46; The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#attr-fae-form)</code> attribute is used to explicitly associate the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element with its <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;4"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute controls how the user agent provides autofill behavior&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element has an <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;indeterminate"></a><strong>indeterminateness</strong>&#44; a boolean which is initially false&#46; It only has an effect on <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#45;8"></a>[checkbox](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)) controls&#44; including their rendering and accessibility semantics&#46; An <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s indeterminateness is independent of its <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;15"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked)&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLInputElement&#35;indeterminate](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement#indeterminate)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox3&#46;6&#43;Safari3&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera≤12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS1&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android≤12&#46;1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

[caniuse&#46;com table](https://caniuse.com/#feat=indeterminate-checkbox)

The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;indeterminate"></a><strong><code>indeterminate</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;indeterminate&#45;4"></a>[indeterminateness](#concept-input-indeterminate)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;indeterminate&#45;2"></a><code>[indeterminate](#dom-input-indeterminate)</code> setter steps are to set <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;indeterminate&#45;5"></a>[indeterminateness](#concept-input-indeterminate) to the given value&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;colorspace"></a><strong><code>colorSpace</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace&#45;4"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code> content attribute&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46; The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;reflect&#45;2"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the respective content attribute of the same name&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;width"></a><strong><code>width</code></strong> and <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;height"></a><strong><code>height</code></strong> getter steps are to return the respective component of the result of determining the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;input&#45;img&#45;dimensions"></a>[dimensions](#input-img-dimensions) of <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

To determine the <a id="input&#45;img&#45;dimensions"></a><strong>dimensions</strong> of an <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <var>input</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>input</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;51"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is not in the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state&#44; then return a width of 0 and a height of 0&#46; &#40;In that case no image is <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;input&#45;img&#45;available"></a><em>[available](#input-img-available)</em>&#46;&#41;

2.  Let <var>naturalDimensions</var> be null&#46;

3.  If an image is <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;input&#45;img&#45;available&#45;2"></a><em>[available](#input-img-available)</em>&#44; then set <var>naturalDimensions</var> to the result of applying the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;default&#45;sizing&#45;algorithm"></a>[default sizing algorithm](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#default-sizing) with that image&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;natural&#45;dimensions"></a>[natural width&#44; natural height&#44; and natural aspect ratio](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions)&#44; if any&#44; using a <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;default&#45;object&#45;size"></a>[default object size](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#default-object-size) of 300 by 150&#46;

4.  Return the result of <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;determine&#45;dimensions"></a>[determining the dimensions](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#determine-dimensions) of <var>input</var> given <var>naturalDimensions</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;willvalidate&#45;2"></a><code>[willValidate](#dom-cva-willvalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validity&#45;2"></a><code>[validity](#dom-cva-validity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validationmessage&#45;2"></a><code>[validationMessage](#dom-cva-validationmessage)</code> IDL attributes&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;checkvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[checkValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-checkvalidity)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;reportvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[reportValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-reportvalidity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[setCustomValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity)</code> methods&#44; are part of the <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api"></a>[constraint validation API](#the-constraint-validation-api)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels&#45;2"></a><code>[labels](#dom-lfe-labels)</code> IDL attribute provides a list of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code>s&#46; The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select&#45;5"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionstart&#45;4"></a><code>[selectionStart](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionend&#45;4"></a><code>[selectionEnd](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectiondirection&#45;4"></a><code>[selectionDirection](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext&#45;7"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setselectionrange&#45;4"></a><code>[setSelectionRange&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange)</code> methods and IDL attributes expose the element&#39;s text selection&#46; The <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a><code>[disabled](#dom-fe-disabled)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#dom-fae-form)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;input&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;fe&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#dom-fe-name)</code> IDL attributes are part of the element&#39;s forms API&#46;

##### <a id="states&#45;of&#45;the&#45;type&#45;attribute"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1 States of the <a id="states&#45;of&#45;the&#45;type&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute[](#states-of-the-type-attribute)

###### <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;1 <strong>Hidden</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;hidden</code>&#41;[](#hidden-state-(type=hidden))
