When an <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;"></a>[Hidden](#hidden-state-(type=hidden)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a value that is not intended to be examined or manipulated by the user&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If an <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Hidden](#hidden-state-(type=hidden)) state&#44; it is <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;barred&#45;from&#45;constraint&#45;validation"></a>[barred from constraint validation](#barred-from-constraint-validation)&#46;

If the <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute is present and has a value that is an <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;charset"></a><code>[&#95;charset&#95;](#attr-fe-name-charset)</code>&#34;&#44; then the element&#39;s <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute must be omitted&#46;

The <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> and <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code> content attributes <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to this element&#46;

The <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[applies](#concept-input-apply) to this element and is in mode <a id="hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default"></a>[default](#dom-input-value-default)&#46;

When an <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;"></a>[Text](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)) state or the <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Search](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a one line plain text edit control for the element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The difference between the <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#45;3"></a>[Text](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)) state and the <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Search](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)) state is primarily stylistic&#58; on platforms where search controls are distinguished from regular text controls&#44; the <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#45;5"></a>[Search](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)) state might result in an appearance consistent with the platform&#39;s search controls rather than appearing like a regular text control&#46;

If the element is <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; its <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) should be editable by the user&#46; User agents must not allow users to insert U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; or U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; characters into the element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

If the element is <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;2"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the writing direction of the element&#44; setting it either to a left&#45;to&#45;right writing direction or a right&#45;to&#45;left writing direction&#46; If the user does so&#44; the user agent must then run the following steps&#58;

1.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dir"></a><code>[dir](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-dir)</code> attribute to &#34;<a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;ltr"></a><code>[ltr](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-dir-ltr)</code>&#34; if the user selected a left&#45;to&#45;right writing direction&#44; and &#34;<a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;rtl"></a><code>[rtl](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-dir-rtl)</code>&#34; if the user selected a right&#45;to&#45;left writing direction&#46;

2.  <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the element to <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at the element&#44; with the <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#46;

The <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that contains no U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; or U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; characters&#46;

<strong>The <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;strip&#45;newlines"></a>[Strip newlines](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-newlines) from the <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

The following common <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code>&#44; <a id="text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; ###### <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;3 <strong>Telephone</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;tel</code>&#41;[](#telephone-state-(type=tel))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;tel](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/tel)

Support in all current engines&#46;

FirefoxYesSafari4&#43;Chrome3&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera11&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android18&#43;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android11&#43;

When an <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;"></a>[Telephone](#telephone-state-(type=tel)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for editing a telephone number given in the element&#39;s <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

If the element is <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; its <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) should be editable by the user&#46; User agents may change the spacing and&#44; with care&#44; the punctuation of <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[values](#concept-fe-value) that the user enters&#46; User agents must not allow users to insert U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; or U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; characters into the element&#39;s <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

The <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that contains no U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; or U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; characters&#46;

<strong>The <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;strip&#45;newlines"></a>[Strip newlines](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-newlines) from the <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Unlike the <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;"></a>[URL](#url-state-(type=url)) and <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;"></a>[Email](#email-state-(type=email)) types&#44; the <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Telephone](#telephone-state-(type=tel)) type does not enforce a particular syntax&#46; This is intentional&#59; in practice&#44; telephone number fields tend to be free&#45;form fields&#44; because there are a wide variety of valid phone numbers&#46; Systems that need to enforce a particular format are encouraged to use the <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;pattern"></a><code>[pattern](#attr-input-pattern)</code> attribute or the <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity"></a><code>[setCustomValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity)</code> method to hook into the client&#45;side validation mechanism&#46;

The following common <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code>&#44; <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; and <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;size"></a><code>[size](#attr-input-size)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionstart"></a><code>[selectionStart](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart)</code>&#44; <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionend"></a><code>[selectionEnd](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend)</code>&#44; and <a id="telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-width)</code>&#46;

###### <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;4 <strong>URL</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;url</code>&#41;[](#url-state-(type=url))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;url](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/url)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera11&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

When an <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;"></a>[URL](#url-state-(type=url)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for editing a single <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;absolute&#45;url"></a>[absolute URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute) given in the element&#39;s <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

If the element is <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the URL represented by its <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46; User agents may allow the user to set the <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string that is not a <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;valid&#45;url&#45;string"></a>[valid](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-url-string) <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;absolute&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[absolute URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute)&#44; but may also or instead automatically escape characters entered by the user so that the <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) is always a <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;valid&#45;url&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[valid](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-url-string) <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;absolute&#45;url&#45;3"></a>[absolute URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute) &#40;even if that isn&#39;t the actual value seen and edited by the user in the interface&#41;&#46; User agents should allow the user to set the <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the empty string&#46; User agents must not allow users to insert U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; or U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; characters into the <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

The <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified and not empty&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;valid&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces) that is also an <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;absolute&#45;url&#45;4"></a>[absolute URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;strip&#45;newlines"></a>[Strip newlines](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-newlines) from the <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; then <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;strip&#45;leading&#45;and&#45;trailing&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace"></a>[strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace) from the <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;8"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;9"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element is neither the empty string nor a <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;valid&#45;url&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[valid](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-url-string) <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;absolute&#45;url&#45;5"></a>[absolute URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#syntax-url-absolute)&#44; the element is <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;type&#45;mismatch"></a>[suffering from a type mismatch](#suffering-from-a-type-mismatch)&#46;

The following common <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;maxlength"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-input-maxlength)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;minlength"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-input-minlength)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;pattern"></a><code>[pattern](#attr-input-pattern)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;placeholder"></a><code>[placeholder](#attr-input-placeholder)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;readonly"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-input-readonly)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code>&#44; and <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;size"></a><code>[size](#attr-input-size)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionstart"></a><code>[selectionStart](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionend"></a><code>[selectionEnd](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectiondirection"></a><code>[selectionDirection](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection)</code>&#44; and <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code>&#44; and <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setselectionrange"></a><code>[setSelectionRange&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange)</code> methods&#46;

The <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value"></a>[value](#dom-input-value-value)&#46;

The <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#46;

The following content attributes must not be specified and <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;accept"></a><code>[accept](#attr-input-accept)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alpha"></a><code>[alpha](#attr-input-alpha)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-input-alt)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#attr-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-height)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertarget"></a><code>[popovertarget](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertarget)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertargetaction"></a><code>[popovertargetaction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertargetaction)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code>&#44; and <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-width)</code>&#46;

The following IDL attributes and methods <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#dom-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;files"></a><code>[files](#dom-input-files)</code>&#44; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code>&#44; and <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code> and <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> methods&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

If a document contained the following markup&#58;

``` text
<input type="url" name="location" list="urls">
<datalist id="urls">
 <option label="MIME: Format of Internet Message Bodies" value="https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2045">
 <option label="HTML" value="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/">
 <option label="DOM" value="https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/">
 <option label="Fullscreen" value="https://fullscreen.spec.whatwg.org/">
 <option label="Media Session" value="https://mediasession.spec.whatwg.org/">
 <option label="The Single UNIX Specification, Version 3" value="http://www.unix.org/version3/">
</datalist>
```

&#46;&#46;&#46;and the user had typed &#34;spec&#46;w&#34;&#44; and the user agent had also found that the user had visited <code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;url&#46;spec&#46;whatwg&#46;org&#47;&#35;url&#45;parsing</code> and <code>https&#58;&#47;&#47;streams&#46;spec&#46;whatwg&#46;org&#47;</code> in the recent past&#44; then the rendering might look like this&#58;

![A text box with an icon on the left followed by the text &#34;spec&#46;w&#34; and a cursor&#44; with a drop down button on the right hand side&#59; with&#44; below&#44; a drop down box containing a list of six URLs on the left&#44; with the first four having grayed out labels on the right&#59; and a scrollbar to the right of the drop down box&#44; indicating further values are available&#46;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/sample-url.svg)

The first four URLs in this sample consist of the four URLs in the author&#45;specified list that match the text the user has entered&#44; sorted in some <a id="url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) manner &#40;maybe by how frequently the user refers to those URLs&#41;&#46; Note how the UA is using the knowledge that the values are URLs to allow the user to omit the scheme part and perform intelligent matching on the domain name&#46;

The last two URLs &#40;and probably many more&#44; given the scrollbar&#39;s indications of more values being available&#41; are the matches from the user agent&#39;s session history data&#46; This data is not made available to the page DOM&#46; In this particular case&#44; the UA has no titles to provide for those values&#46;

###### <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;5 <strong>Email</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;email</code>&#41;<a id="e&#45;mail&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;"></a>[](#email-state-(type=email))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;email](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/email)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari5&#43;Chrome5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera11&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS3&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android11&#43;

When an <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;"></a>[Email](#email-state-(type=email)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

How the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Email](#email-state-(type=email)) state operates depends on whether the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code> attribute is specified or not&#46;

<strong>When the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple&#45;2"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code> attribute is not specified on the element</strong>

The <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for editing an email address given in the element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

If the element is <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the email address represented by its <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46; User agents may allow the user to set the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string that is not a <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;valid&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;address"></a>[valid email address](#valid-e-mail-address)&#46; The user agent should act in a manner consistent with expecting the user to provide a single email address&#46; User agents should allow the user to set the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the empty string&#46; User agents must not allow users to insert U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; or U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; characters into the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46; User agents may transform the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) for display and editing&#59; in particular&#44; user agents should convert punycode in the domain labels of the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to IDN in the display and vice versa&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the user interface is representing input that the user agent cannot convert to punycode&#44; the control is <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input"></a>[suffering from bad input](#suffering-from-bad-input)&#46;

The <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified and not empty&#44; must have a value that is a single <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;valid&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;address&#45;2"></a>[valid email address](#valid-e-mail-address)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;strip&#45;newlines"></a>[Strip newlines](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-newlines) from the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;8"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; then <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;strip&#45;leading&#45;and&#45;trailing&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace"></a>[strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace) from the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;9"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;10"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element is neither the empty string nor a single <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;valid&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;address&#45;3"></a>[valid email address](#valid-e-mail-address)&#44; the element is <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;type&#45;mismatch"></a>[suffering from a type mismatch](#suffering-from-a-type-mismatch)&#46;

<strong>When the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple&#45;3"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code> attribute <em>is</em> specified on the element</strong>

The <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;represents&#45;2"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for adding&#44; removing&#44; and editing the email addresses given in the element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;values"></a>[value<em>s</em>](#concept-fe-values)&#46;

If the element is <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;2"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to add&#44; remove&#44; and edit the email addresses represented by its <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[values](#concept-fe-values)&#46; User agents may allow the user to set any individual value in the list of <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;11"></a>[value<em>s</em>](#concept-fe-value) to a string that is not a <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;valid&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;address&#45;4"></a>[valid email address](#valid-e-mail-address)&#44; but must not allow users to set any individual value to a string containing U&#43;002C COMMA &#40;&#44;&#41;&#44; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41;&#44; or U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; characters&#46; User agents should allow the user to remove all the addresses in the element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;values&#45;3"></a>[values](#concept-fe-values)&#46; User agents may transform the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;values&#45;4"></a>[values](#concept-fe-values) for display and editing&#59; in particular&#44; user agents should convert punycode in the domain labels of the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;12"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to IDN in the display and vice versa&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the user interface describes a situation where an individual value contains a U&#43;002C COMMA &#40;&#44;&#41; or is representing input that the user agent cannot convert to punycode&#44; the control is <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input&#45;2"></a>[suffering from bad input](#suffering-from-bad-input)&#46;

Whenever the user changes the element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;13"></a>[value<em>s</em>](#concept-fe-value)&#44; the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>latest values</var> be a copy of the element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;14"></a>[value<em>s</em>](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

2.  <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;strip&#45;leading&#45;and&#45;trailing&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace&#45;2"></a>[Strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace) from each value in <var>latest values</var>&#46;

3.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;15"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the result of concatenating all the values in <var>latest values</var>&#44; separating each value from the next by a single U&#43;002C COMMA character &#40;&#44;&#41;&#44; maintaining the list&#39;s order&#46;

The <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;valid&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;address&#45;list"></a>[valid email address list](#valid-e-mail-address-list)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58;

1.  <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;split&#45;a&#45;string&#45;on&#45;commas"></a>[Split on commas](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-commas) the element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;16"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;strip&#45;leading&#45;and&#45;trailing&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace&#45;3"></a>[strip leading and trailing ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-leading-and-trailing-ascii-whitespace) from each resulting token&#44; if any&#44; and let the element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;values&#45;5"></a>[values](#concept-fe-values) be the &#40;possibly empty&#41; resulting list of &#40;possibly empty&#41; tokens&#44; maintaining the original order&#46;

2.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;17"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the result of concatenating the element&#39;s <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;values&#45;6"></a>[values](#concept-fe-values)&#44; separating each value from the next by a single U&#43;002C COMMA character &#40;&#44;&#41;&#44; maintaining the list&#39;s order&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;18"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element is not a <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;valid&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;address&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[valid email address list](#valid-e-mail-address-list)&#44; the element is <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;type&#45;mismatch&#45;2"></a>[suffering from a type mismatch](#suffering-from-a-type-mismatch)&#46;

When the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple&#45;4"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code> attribute is set or removed&#44; the user agent must run the <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm&#45;3"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm)&#46;

A <a id="valid&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;address"></a><strong>valid email address</strong> is a string that matches the <code>email</code> production of the following ABNF&#44; the character set for which is Unicode&#46; This ABNF implements the extensions described in RFC 1123&#46; [&#91;ABNF&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsABNF) [&#91;RFC5322&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsRFC5322) [&#91;RFC1034&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsRFC1034) [&#91;RFC1123&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsRFC1123)

``` text
email         = 1*( atext / "." ) "@" label *( "." label )
label         = let-dig [ [ ldh-str ] let-dig ]  ; limited to a length of 63 characters by RFC 1034 section 3.5
atext         = < as defined in RFC 5322 section 3.2.3 >
let-dig       = < as defined in RFC 1034 section 3.5 >
ldh-str       = < as defined in RFC 1034 section 3.5 >
```

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This requirement is a <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;willful&#45;violation"></a>[willful violation](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#willful-violation) of RFC 5322&#44; which defines a syntax for email addresses that is simultaneously too strict &#40;before the &#34;&#64;&#34; character&#41;&#44; too vague &#40;after the &#34;&#64;&#34; character&#41;&#44; and too lax &#40;allowing comments&#44; whitespace characters&#44; and quoted strings in manners unfamiliar to most users&#41; to be of practical use here&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The following JavaScript&#45; and Perl&#45;compatible regular expression is an implementation of the above definition&#46;

``` text
/^[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+\/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?(?:\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*$/
```

A <a id="valid&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;address&#45;list"></a><strong>valid email address list</strong> is a <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;set&#45;of&#45;comma&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>[set of comma&#45;separated tokens](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#set-of-comma-separated-tokens)&#44; where each token is itself a <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;valid&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;address&#45;5"></a>[valid email address](#valid-e-mail-address)&#46; To obtain the list of tokens from a <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;valid&#45;e&#45;mail&#45;address&#45;list&#45;3"></a>[valid email address list](#valid-e-mail-address-list)&#44; an implementation must <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;split&#45;a&#45;string&#45;on&#45;commas&#45;2"></a>[split the string on commas](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-commas)&#46;

The following common <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;maxlength"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-input-maxlength)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;minlength"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-input-minlength)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple&#45;5"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;pattern"></a><code>[pattern](#attr-input-pattern)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;placeholder"></a><code>[placeholder](#attr-input-placeholder)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;readonly"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-input-readonly)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code>&#44; and <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;size"></a><code>[size](#attr-input-size)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code> and <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code> method&#46;

The <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value"></a>[value](#dom-input-value-value)&#46;

The <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#46;

The following content attributes must not be specified and <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;accept"></a><code>[accept](#attr-input-accept)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alpha"></a><code>[alpha](#attr-input-alpha)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-input-alt)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#attr-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-height)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertarget"></a><code>[popovertarget](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertarget)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertargetaction"></a><code>[popovertargetaction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertargetaction)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code>&#44; and <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-width)</code>&#46;

The following IDL attributes and methods <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#dom-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;files"></a><code>[files](#dom-input-files)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionstart"></a><code>[selectionStart](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionend"></a><code>[selectionEnd](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectiondirection"></a><code>[selectionDirection](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code>&#44; and <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setselectionrange"></a><code>[setSelectionRange&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange)</code>&#44; <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code> and <a id="email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> methods&#46;

The <a id="password&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;password&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="password&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;password&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a one line plain text edit control for the element&#39;s <a id="password&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;password&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46; The user agent should obscure the value so that people other than the user cannot see it&#46;

The <a id="password&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;password&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that contains no U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; or U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; characters&#46;

<strong>The <a id="password&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;password&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; <a id="password&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;password&#41;&#58;strip&#45;newlines"></a>[Strip newlines](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-newlines) from the <a id="password&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;password&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

###### <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;7 <strong>Date</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;date</code>&#41;[](#date-state-(type=date))

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS5&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android11&#43;

When an <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;"></a>[Date](#date-state-(type=date)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for setting the element&#39;s <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string representing a specific <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;date"></a>[date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-date)&#46;

If the element is <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;date&#45;2"></a>[date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-date) represented by its <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; as obtained by <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;date&#45;string"></a>[parsing a date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-date-string) from it&#46; User agents must not allow the user to set the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a non&#45;empty string that is not a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;valid&#45;date&#45;string"></a>[valid date string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-date-string)&#46; If the user agent provides a user interface for selecting a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;date&#45;3"></a>[date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-date)&#44; then the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) must be set to a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;valid&#45;date&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[valid date string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-date-string) representing the user&#39;s selection&#46; User agents should allow the user to set the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the empty string&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;valid&#45;date&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[valid date string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-date-string)&#44; the control is <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input"></a>[suffering from bad input](#suffering-from-bad-input)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

See the [introduction section](#input-author-notes) for a discussion of the difference between the input format and submission format for date&#44; time&#44; and number form controls&#44; and the [implementation notes](#input-impl-notes) regarding localization of form controls&#46;

The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified and not empty&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;valid&#45;date&#45;string&#45;4"></a>[valid date string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-date-string)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; If the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element is not a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;valid&#45;date&#45;string&#45;5"></a>[valid date string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-date-string)&#44; then set it to the empty string instead&#46;

The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;valid&#45;date&#45;string&#45;6"></a>[valid date string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-date-string)&#46; The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;valid&#45;date&#45;string&#45;7"></a>[valid date string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-date-string)&#46;

The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> attribute is expressed in days&#46; The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;scale"></a>[step scale factor](#concept-input-step-scale) is 86&#44;400&#44;000 &#40;which converts the days to milliseconds&#44; as used in the other algorithms&#41;&#46; The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;default"></a>[default step](#concept-input-step-default) is 1 day&#46;

When the element is <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch"></a>[suffering from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#44; the user agent may round the element&#39;s <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the nearest <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;date&#45;4"></a>[date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-date) for which the element would not <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch&#45;2"></a>[suffer from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;number"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a number](#concept-input-value-string-number)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;date&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[parsing a date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-date-string) from <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return the number of milliseconds elapsed from midnight UTC on the morning of 1970&#45;01&#45;01 &#40;the time represented by the value &#34;<code>1970&#45;01&#45;01T00&#58;00&#58;00&#46;0Z</code>&#34;&#41; to midnight UTC on the morning of the parsed <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;date&#45;5"></a>[date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-date)&#44; ignoring leap seconds&#46;

<strong>The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;number&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a number to a string](#concept-input-value-number-string)&#44; given a number <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;valid&#45;date&#45;string&#45;8"></a>[valid date string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-date-string) that represents the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;date&#45;6"></a>[date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-date) that&#44; in UTC&#44; is current <var>input</var> milliseconds after midnight UTC on the morning of 1970&#45;01&#45;01 &#40;the time represented by the value &#34;<code>1970&#45;01&#45;01T00&#58;00&#58;00&#46;0Z</code>&#34;&#41;&#46;

<strong>The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;date"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a <code>Date</code> object](#concept-input-value-string-date)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;date&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[parsing a date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-date-string) from <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;create&#45;a&#45;date&#45;object"></a>[a new <code>Date</code> object](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#create-a-date-object) representing midnight UTC on the morning of the parsed <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;date&#45;7"></a>[date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-date)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;date&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a <code>Date</code> object to a string](#concept-input-value-date-string)&#44; given a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;date"></a><code>[Date](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-date-objects)</code> object <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return a <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;valid&#45;date&#45;string&#45;9"></a>[valid date string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-date-string) that represents the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;date&#45;8"></a>[date](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-date) current at the time represented by <var>input</var> in the UTC time zone&#46;

<a id="only&#45;contemporary&#45;times"></a>

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

[](#only-contemporary-times)

The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Date](#date-state-(type=date)) state &#40;and other date&#45; and time&#45;related states described in subsequent sections&#41; is not intended for the entry of values for which a precise date and time relative to the contemporary calendar cannot be established&#46; For example&#44; it would be inappropriate for the entry of times like &#34;one millisecond after the big bang&#34;&#44; &#34;the early part of the Jurassic period&#34;&#44; or &#34;a winter around 250 BCE&#34;&#46;

For the input of dates before the introduction of the Gregorian calendar&#44; authors are encouraged to not use the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#45;3"></a>[Date](#date-state-(type=date)) state &#40;and the other date&#45; and time&#45;related states described in subsequent sections&#41;&#44; as user agents are not required to support converting dates and times from earlier periods to the Gregorian calendar&#44; and asking users to do so manually puts an undue burden on users&#46; &#40;This is complicated by the manner in which the Gregorian calendar was phased in&#44; which occurred at different times in different countries&#44; ranging from partway through the 16th century all the way to early in the 20th&#46;&#41; Instead&#44; authors are encouraged to provide fine&#45;grained input controls using the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element and <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements with the <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;"></a>[Number](#number-state-(type=number)) state&#46;

The following common <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max&#45;2"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code>&#44; <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min&#45;2"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;readonly"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-input-readonly)</code>&#44; <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code>&#44; and <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step&#45;2"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code>&#44; <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code>&#44; <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code>&#44; and <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> methods&#46;

The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value"></a>[value](#dom-input-value-value)&#46;

The <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#46;

###### <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;8 <strong>Month</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;month</code>&#41;[](#month-state-(type=month))
