When an <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;"></a>[Month](#month-state-(type=month)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for setting the element&#39;s <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string representing a specific <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;month"></a>[month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-month)&#46;

If the element is <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;month&#45;2"></a>[month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-month) represented by its <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; as obtained by <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;month&#45;string"></a>[parsing a month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-month-string) from it&#46; User agents must not allow the user to set the <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a non&#45;empty string that is not a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;valid&#45;month&#45;string"></a>[valid month string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-month-string)&#46; If the user agent provides a user interface for selecting a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;month&#45;3"></a>[month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-month)&#44; then the <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) must be set to a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;valid&#45;month&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[valid month string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-month-string) representing the user&#39;s selection&#46; User agents should allow the user to set the <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the empty string&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;valid&#45;month&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[valid month string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-month-string)&#44; the control is <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input"></a>[suffering from bad input](#suffering-from-bad-input)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

See the [introduction section](#input-author-notes) for a discussion of the difference between the input format and submission format for date&#44; time&#44; and number form controls&#44; and the [implementation notes](#input-impl-notes) regarding localization of form controls&#46;

The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified and not empty&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;valid&#45;month&#45;string&#45;4"></a>[valid month string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-month-string)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; If the <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element is not a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;valid&#45;month&#45;string&#45;5"></a>[valid month string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-month-string)&#44; then set it to the empty string instead&#46;

The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;valid&#45;month&#45;string&#45;6"></a>[valid month string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-month-string)&#46; The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;valid&#45;month&#45;string&#45;7"></a>[valid month string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-month-string)&#46;

The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> attribute is expressed in months&#46; The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;scale"></a>[step scale factor](#concept-input-step-scale) is 1 &#40;there is no conversion needed as the algorithms use months&#41;&#46; The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;default"></a>[default step](#concept-input-step-default) is 1 month&#46;

When the element is <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch"></a>[suffering from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#44; the user agent may round the element&#39;s <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the nearest <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;month&#45;4"></a>[month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-month) for which the element would not <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch&#45;2"></a>[suffer from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;number"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a number](#concept-input-value-string-number)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;month&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[parsing a month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-month-string) from <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return the number of months between January 1970 and the parsed <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;month&#45;5"></a>[month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-month)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;number&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a number to a string](#concept-input-value-number-string)&#44; given a number <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;valid&#45;month&#45;string&#45;8"></a>[valid month string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-month-string) that represents the <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;month&#45;6"></a>[month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-month) that has <var>input</var> months between it and January 1970&#46;

<strong>The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;date"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a <code>Date</code> object](#concept-input-value-string-date)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;month&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[parsing a month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-month-string) from <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;create&#45;a&#45;date&#45;object"></a>[a new <code>Date</code> object](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#create-a-date-object) representing midnight UTC on the morning of the first day of the parsed <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;month&#45;7"></a>[month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-month)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;date&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a <code>Date</code> object to a string](#concept-input-value-date-string)&#44; given a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;date"></a><code>[Date](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-date-objects)</code> object <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return a <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;valid&#45;month&#45;string&#45;9"></a>[valid month string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-month-string) that represents the <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;month&#45;8"></a>[month](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-month) current at the time represented by <var>input</var> in the UTC time zone&#46;

The following common <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max&#45;2"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code>&#44; <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min&#45;2"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;readonly"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-input-readonly)</code>&#44; <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code>&#44; and <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step&#45;2"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code>&#44; ###### <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;9 <strong>Week</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;week</code>&#41;[](#week-state-(type=week))

When an <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;"></a>[Week](#week-state-(type=week)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for setting the element&#39;s <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string representing a specific <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;week"></a>[week](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-week)&#46;

If the element is <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;week&#45;2"></a>[week](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-week) represented by its <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; as obtained by <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;week&#45;string"></a>[parsing a week](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-week-string) from it&#46; User agents must not allow the user to set the <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a non&#45;empty string that is not a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;valid&#45;week&#45;string"></a>[valid week string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-week-string)&#46; If the user agent provides a user interface for selecting a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;week&#45;3"></a>[week](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-week)&#44; then the <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) must be set to a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;valid&#45;week&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[valid week string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-week-string) representing the user&#39;s selection&#46; User agents should allow the user to set the <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the empty string&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;valid&#45;week&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[valid week string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-week-string)&#44; the control is <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input"></a>[suffering from bad input](#suffering-from-bad-input)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

See the [introduction section](#input-author-notes) for a discussion of the difference between the input format and submission format for date&#44; time&#44; and number form controls&#44; and the [implementation notes](#input-impl-notes) regarding localization of form controls&#46;

The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified and not empty&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;valid&#45;week&#45;string&#45;4"></a>[valid week string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-week-string)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; If the <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element is not a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;valid&#45;week&#45;string&#45;5"></a>[valid week string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-week-string)&#44; then set it to the empty string instead&#46;

The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;valid&#45;week&#45;string&#45;6"></a>[valid week string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-week-string)&#46; The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;valid&#45;week&#45;string&#45;7"></a>[valid week string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-week-string)&#46;

The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> attribute is expressed in weeks&#46; The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;scale"></a>[step scale factor](#concept-input-step-scale) is 604&#44;800&#44;000 &#40;which converts the weeks to milliseconds&#44; as used in the other algorithms&#41;&#46; The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;default"></a>[default step](#concept-input-step-default) is 1 week&#46; The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;default&#45;base"></a>[default step base](#concept-input-step-default-base) is −259&#44;200&#44;000 &#40;the start of week 1970&#45;W01&#41;&#46;

When the element is <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch"></a>[suffering from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#44; the user agent may round the element&#39;s <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the nearest <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;week&#45;4"></a>[week](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-week) for which the element would not <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch&#45;2"></a>[suffer from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;number"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a number](#concept-input-value-string-number)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;week&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[parsing a week string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-week-string) from <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return the number of milliseconds elapsed from midnight UTC on the morning of 1970&#45;01&#45;01 &#40;the time represented by the value &#34;<code>1970&#45;01&#45;01T00&#58;00&#58;00&#46;0Z</code>&#34;&#41; to midnight UTC on the morning of the Monday of the parsed <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;week&#45;5"></a>[week](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-week)&#44; ignoring leap seconds&#46;

<strong>The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;number&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a number to a string](#concept-input-value-number-string)&#44; given a number <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;valid&#45;week&#45;string&#45;8"></a>[valid week string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-week-string) that represents the <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;week&#45;6"></a>[week](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-week) that&#44; in UTC&#44; is current <var>input</var> milliseconds after midnight UTC on the morning of 1970&#45;01&#45;01 &#40;the time represented by the value &#34;<code>1970&#45;01&#45;01T00&#58;00&#58;00&#46;0Z</code>&#34;&#41;&#46;

<strong>The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;date"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a <code>Date</code> object](#concept-input-value-string-date)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;week&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[parsing a week](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-week-string) from <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;create&#45;a&#45;date&#45;object"></a>[a new <code>Date</code> object](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#create-a-date-object) representing midnight UTC on the morning of the Monday of the parsed <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;week&#45;7"></a>[week](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-week)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;date&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a <code>Date</code> object to a string](#concept-input-value-date-string)&#44; given a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;date"></a><code>[Date](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-date-objects)</code> object <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return a <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;valid&#45;week&#45;string&#45;9"></a>[valid week string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-week-string) that represents the <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;week&#45;8"></a>[week](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-week) current at the time represented by <var>input</var> in the UTC time zone&#46;

The following common <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max&#45;2"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code>&#44; <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min&#45;2"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;readonly"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-input-readonly)</code>&#44; <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code>&#44; <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code>&#44; and <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code> IDL attributes&#59; The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value"></a>[value](#dom-input-value-value)&#46;

The <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#46;

###### <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;10 <strong>Time</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;time</code>&#41;[](#time-state-(type=time))

[Element&#47;input&#47;time](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/time)

When an <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;"></a>[Time](#time-state-(type=time)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for setting the element&#39;s <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string representing a specific <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;time"></a>[time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-time)&#46;

If the element is <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;time&#45;2"></a>[time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-time) represented by its <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; as obtained by <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;time&#45;string"></a>[parsing a time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-time-string) from it&#46; User agents must not allow the user to set the <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a non&#45;empty string that is not a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;valid&#45;time&#45;string"></a>[valid time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-time-string)&#46; If the user agent provides a user interface for selecting a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;time&#45;3"></a>[time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-time)&#44; then the <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) must be set to a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;valid&#45;time&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[valid time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-time-string) representing the user&#39;s selection&#46; User agents should allow the user to set the <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the empty string&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;valid&#45;time&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[valid time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-time-string)&#44; the control is <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input"></a>[suffering from bad input](#suffering-from-bad-input)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

See the [introduction section](#input-author-notes) for a discussion of the difference between the input format and submission format for date&#44; time&#44; and number form controls&#44; and the [implementation notes](#input-impl-notes) regarding localization of form controls&#46;

The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified and not empty&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;valid&#45;time&#45;string&#45;4"></a>[valid time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-time-string)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; If the <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element is not a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;valid&#45;time&#45;string&#45;5"></a>[valid time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-time-string)&#44; then set it to the empty string instead&#46;

The form control <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;has&#45;a&#45;periodic&#45;domain"></a>[has a periodic domain](#has-a-periodic-domain)&#46;

The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;valid&#45;time&#45;string&#45;6"></a>[valid time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-time-string)&#46; The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;valid&#45;time&#45;string&#45;7"></a>[valid time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-time-string)&#46;

The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> attribute is expressed in seconds&#46; The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;scale"></a>[step scale factor](#concept-input-step-scale) is 1000 &#40;which converts the seconds to milliseconds&#44; as used in the other algorithms&#41;&#46; The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;default"></a>[default step](#concept-input-step-default) is 60 seconds&#46;

When the element is <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch"></a>[suffering from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#44; the user agent may round the element&#39;s <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the nearest <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;time&#45;4"></a>[time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-time) for which the element would not <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch&#45;2"></a>[suffer from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;number"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a number](#concept-input-value-string-number)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;time&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[parsing a time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-time-string) from <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return the number of milliseconds elapsed from midnight to the parsed <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;time&#45;5"></a>[time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-time) on a day with no time changes&#46;

<strong>The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;number&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a number to a string](#concept-input-value-number-string)&#44; given a number <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;valid&#45;time&#45;string&#45;8"></a>[valid time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-time-string) that represents the <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;time&#45;6"></a>[time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-time) that is <var>input</var> milliseconds after midnight on a day with no time changes&#46;

<strong>The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;date"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a <code>Date</code> object](#concept-input-value-string-date)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;time&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[parsing a time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-time-string) from <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;create&#45;a&#45;date&#45;object"></a>[a new <code>Date</code> object](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#create-a-date-object) representing the parsed <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;time&#45;7"></a>[time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-time) in UTC on 1970&#45;01&#45;01&#46;

<strong>The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;date&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a <code>Date</code> object to a string](#concept-input-value-date-string)&#44; given a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;date"></a><code>[Date](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-date-objects)</code> object <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return a <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;valid&#45;time&#45;string&#45;9"></a>[valid time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-time-string) that represents the UTC <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;time&#45;8"></a>[time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-time) component that is represented by <var>input</var>&#46;

The following common <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max&#45;2"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code>&#44; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min&#45;2"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;readonly"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-input-readonly)</code>&#44; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code>&#44; and <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step&#45;2"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code>&#44; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code>&#44; and <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code>&#44; <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code>&#44; and <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> methods&#46;

The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value"></a>[value](#dom-input-value-value)&#46;

The <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#46;

###### <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;11 <strong>Local Date and Time</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;datetime&#45;local</code>&#41;[](#local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;datetime&#45;local](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/datetime-local)

When an <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;"></a>[Local Date and Time](#local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for setting the element&#39;s <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string representing a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;datetime&#45;local"></a>[local date and time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-datetime-local)&#44; with no time&#45;zone offset information&#46;

If the element is <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;datetime&#45;local&#45;2"></a>[date and time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-datetime-local) represented by its <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; as obtained by <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string"></a>[parsing a date and time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-local-date-and-time-string) from it&#46; User agents must not allow the user to set the <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a non&#45;empty string that is not a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;valid&#45;normalised&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string"></a>[valid normalized local date and time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-normalised-local-date-and-time-string)&#46; If the user agent provides a user interface for selecting a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;datetime&#45;local&#45;3"></a>[local date and time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-datetime-local)&#44; then the <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) must be set to a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;valid&#45;normalised&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[valid normalized local date and time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-normalised-local-date-and-time-string) representing the user&#39;s selection&#46; User agents should allow the user to set the <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the empty string&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;valid&#45;normalised&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[valid normalized local date and time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-normalised-local-date-and-time-string)&#44; the control is <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input"></a>[suffering from bad input](#suffering-from-bad-input)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

See the [introduction section](#input-author-notes) for a discussion of the difference between the input format and submission format for date&#44; time&#44; and number form controls&#44; and the [implementation notes](#input-impl-notes) regarding localization of form controls&#46;

The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified and not empty&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;valid&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string"></a>[valid local date and time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-local-date-and-time-string)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; If the <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element is a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;valid&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[valid local date and time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-local-date-and-time-string)&#44; then set it to a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;valid&#45;normalised&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string&#45;4"></a>[valid normalized local date and time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-normalised-local-date-and-time-string) representing the same date and time&#59; otherwise&#44; set it to the empty string instead&#46;

The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;valid&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[valid local date and time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-local-date-and-time-string)&#46; The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;valid&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string&#45;4"></a>[valid local date and time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-local-date-and-time-string)&#46;

The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> attribute is expressed in seconds&#46; The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;scale"></a>[step scale factor](#concept-input-step-scale) is 1000 &#40;which converts the seconds to milliseconds&#44; as used in the other algorithms&#41;&#46; The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;default"></a>[default step](#concept-input-step-default) is 60 seconds&#46;

When the element is <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch"></a>[suffering from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#44; the user agent may round the element&#39;s <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the nearest <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;datetime&#45;local&#45;4"></a>[local date and time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-datetime-local) for which the element would not <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch&#45;2"></a>[suffer from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;number"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a number](#concept-input-value-string-number)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;parse&#45;a&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[parsing a date and time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#parse-a-local-date-and-time-string) from <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return the number of milliseconds elapsed from midnight on the morning of 1970&#45;01&#45;01 &#40;the time represented by the value &#34;<code>1970&#45;01&#45;01T00&#58;00&#58;00&#46;0</code>&#34;&#41; to the parsed <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;datetime&#45;local&#45;5"></a>[local date and time](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-datetime-local)&#44; ignoring leap seconds&#46;

<strong>The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;number&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a number to a string](#concept-input-value-number-string)&#44; given a number <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return a <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;valid&#45;normalised&#45;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;string&#45;5"></a>[valid normalized local date and time string](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-normalised-local-date-and-time-string) that represents the date and time that is <var>input</var> milliseconds after midnight on the morning of 1970&#45;01&#45;01 &#40;the time represented by the value &#34;<code>1970&#45;01&#45;01T00&#58;00&#58;00&#46;0</code>&#34;&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

See [the note on historical dates](#only-contemporary-times) in the <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;"></a>[Date](#date-state-(type=date)) state section&#46;

The following common <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max&#45;2"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min&#45;2"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;readonly"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-input-readonly)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code>&#44; and <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step&#45;2"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code>&#44; and <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code>&#44; and <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> methods&#46;

The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value"></a>[value](#dom-input-value-value)&#46;

The <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#46;

The following content attributes must not be specified and <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;accept"></a><code>[accept](#attr-input-accept)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alpha"></a><code>[alpha](#attr-input-alpha)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-input-alt)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#attr-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-height)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;maxlength"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-input-maxlength)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;minlength"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-input-minlength)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;pattern"></a><code>[pattern](#attr-input-pattern)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;placeholder"></a><code>[placeholder](#attr-input-placeholder)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertarget"></a><code>[popovertarget](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertarget)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertargetaction"></a><code>[popovertargetaction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertargetaction)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;size"></a><code>[size](#attr-input-size)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code>&#44; and <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-width)</code>&#46;

The following IDL attributes and methods <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#dom-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;files"></a><code>[files](#dom-input-files)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionstart"></a><code>[selectionStart](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionend"></a><code>[selectionEnd](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend)</code>&#44; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectiondirection"></a><code>[selectionDirection](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection)</code>&#44; and <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code>&#44; and <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setselectionrange"></a><code>[setSelectionRange&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange)</code> methods&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following example shows part of a flight booking application&#46; The application uses an <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element with its <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute set to <a id="local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#58;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;&#45;2"></a><code>[datetime&#45;local](#local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local))</code>&#44; and it then interprets the given date and time in the time zone of the selected airport&#46;

``` text
<fieldset>
 <legend>Destination</legend>
 <p><label>Airport: <input type=text name=to list=airports></label></p>
 <p><label>Departure time: <input type=datetime-local name=totime step=3600></label></p>
</fieldset>
<datalist id=airports>
 <option value=ATL label="Atlanta">
 <option value=MEM label="Memphis">
 <option value=LHR label="London Heathrow">
 <option value=LAX label="Los Angeles">
 <option value=FRA label="Frankfurt">
</datalist>
```

###### <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;12 <a id="number&#45;state"></a><strong>Number</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;number</code>&#41;[](#number-state-(type=number))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;number](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/number)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox29&#43;Safari5&#46;1&#43;Chrome7&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

When an <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;"></a>[Number](#number-state-(type=number)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for setting the element&#39;s <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string representing a number&#46;

If the element is <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the number represented by its <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; as obtained from applying the <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;values"></a>[rules for parsing floating&#45;point number values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-floating-point-number-values) to it&#46; User agents must not allow the user to set the <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a non&#45;empty string that is not a <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#46; If the user agent provides a user interface for selecting a number&#44; then the <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) must be set to the <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;best&#45;representation&#45;of&#45;the&#45;number&#45;as&#45;a&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number"></a>[best representation of the number representing the user&#39;s selection as a floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#best-representation-of-the-number-as-a-floating-point-number)&#46; User agents should allow the user to set the <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the empty string&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;2"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#44; the control is <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input"></a>[suffering from bad input](#suffering-from-bad-input)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This specification does not define what user interface user agents are to use&#59; user agent vendors are encouraged to consider what would best serve their users&#39; needs&#46; For example&#44; a user agent in Persian or Arabic markets might support Persian and Arabic numeric input &#40;converting it to the format required for submission as described above&#41;&#46; Similarly&#44; a user agent designed for Romans might display the value in Roman numerals rather than in decimal&#59; or &#40;more realistically&#41; a user agent designed for the French market might display the value with apostrophes between thousands and commas before the decimals&#44; and allow the user to enter a value in that manner&#44; internally converting it to the submission format described above&#46;

The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified and not empty&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;3"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; If the <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element is not a <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;4"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#44; then set it to the empty string instead&#46;

The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;5"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#46; The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;6"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#46;

The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;scale"></a>[step scale factor](#concept-input-step-scale) is 1&#46; The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;default"></a>[default step](#concept-input-step-default) is 1 &#40;allowing only integers to be selected by the user&#44; unless the <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;zero"></a>[step base](#concept-input-min-zero) has a non&#45;integer value&#41;&#46;

When the element is <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch"></a>[suffering from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#44; the user agent may round the element&#39;s <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the nearest number for which the element would not <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch&#45;2"></a>[suffer from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#46; If there are two such numbers&#44; user agents are encouraged to pick the one nearest positive infinity&#46;

<strong>The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;number"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a number](#concept-input-value-string-number)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If applying the <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[rules for parsing floating&#45;point number values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-floating-point-number-values) to <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return the resulting number&#46;

<strong>The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;number&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a number to a string](#concept-input-value-number-string)&#44; given a number <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return a <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;7"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number) that represents <var>input</var>&#46;

The following common <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max&#45;2"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min&#45;2"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;placeholder"></a><code>[placeholder](#attr-input-placeholder)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;readonly"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-input-readonly)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code>&#44; and <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code>&#44; and <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code>&#44; and <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> methods&#46;

The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value"></a>[value](#dom-input-value-value)&#46;

The <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#46;

The following content attributes must not be specified and <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;accept"></a><code>[accept](#attr-input-accept)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alpha"></a><code>[alpha](#attr-input-alpha)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-input-alt)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#attr-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-height)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;maxlength"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-input-maxlength)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;minlength"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-input-minlength)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;pattern"></a><code>[pattern](#attr-input-pattern)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertarget"></a><code>[popovertarget](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertarget)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertargetaction"></a><code>[popovertargetaction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertargetaction)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;size"></a><code>[size](#attr-input-size)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code>&#44; and <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-width)</code>&#46;
