The following IDL attributes and methods <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#dom-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;files"></a><code>[files](#dom-input-files)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionstart"></a><code>[selectionStart](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionend"></a><code>[selectionEnd](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend)</code>&#44; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectiondirection"></a><code>[selectionDirection](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection)</code>&#44; and <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code>&#44; and <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setselectionrange"></a><code>[setSelectionRange&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange)</code> methods&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here is an example of using a numeric input control&#58;

``` text
<label>How much do you want to charge? $<input type=number min=0 step=0.01 name=price></label>
```

As described above&#44; a user agent might support numeric input in the user&#39;s local format&#44; converting it to the format required for submission as described above&#46; This might include handling grouping separators &#40;as in &#34;872&#44;000&#44;000&#44;000&#34;&#41; and various decimal separators &#40;such as &#34;3&#44;99&#34; vs &#34;3&#46;99&#34;&#41; or using local digits &#40;such as those in Arabic&#44; Devanagari&#44; Persian&#44; and Thai&#41;&#46;

<a id="when&#45;number&#45;is&#45;not&#45;appropriate"></a>

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

[](#when-number-is-not-appropriate)The <code>type&#61;number</code> state is not appropriate for input that happens to only consist of numbers but isn&#39;t strictly speaking a number&#46; For example&#44; it would be inappropriate for credit card numbers or US postal codes&#46; A simple way of determining whether to use <code>type&#61;number</code> is to consider whether it would make sense for the input control to have a spinbox interface &#40;e&#46;g&#46; with &#34;up&#34; and &#34;down&#34; arrows&#41;&#46; Getting a credit card number wrong by 1 in the last digit isn&#39;t a minor mistake&#44; it&#39;s as wrong as getting every digit incorrect&#46; So it would not make sense for the user to select a credit card number using &#34;up&#34; and &#34;down&#34; buttons&#46; When a spinbox interface is not appropriate&#44; <code>type&#61;text</code> is probably the right choice &#40;possibly with an <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;inputmode"></a><code>[inputmode](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-inputmode)</code> or <a id="number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;pattern&#45;2"></a><code>[pattern](#attr-input-pattern)</code> attribute&#41;&#46;

###### <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;13 <strong>Range</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;range</code>&#41;[](#range-state-(type=range))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;range](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/range)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox23&#43;Safari3&#46;1&#43;Chrome4&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera11&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android52&#43;Safari iOS5&#43;Chrome Android57&#43;WebView Android4&#46;4&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android11&#43;

When an <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;"></a>[Range](#range-state-(type=range)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for setting the element&#39;s <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string representing a number&#44; but with the caveat that the exact value is not important&#44; letting UAs provide a simpler interface than they do for the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;"></a>[Number](#number-state-(type=number)) state&#46;

If the element is <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the number represented by its <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; as obtained from applying the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;values"></a>[rules for parsing floating&#45;point number values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-floating-point-number-values) to it&#46; User agents must not allow the user to set the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string that is not a <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#46; If the user agent provides a user interface for selecting a number&#44; then the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) must be set to a <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;best&#45;representation&#45;of&#45;the&#45;number&#45;as&#45;a&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number"></a>[best representation of the number representing the user&#39;s selection as a floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#best-representation-of-the-number-as-a-floating-point-number)&#46; User agents must not allow the user to set the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the empty string&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the user interface describes input that the user agent cannot convert to a <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;2"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#44; the control is <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input"></a>[suffering from bad input](#suffering-from-bad-input)&#46;

The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;3"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#46;

<strong>The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; If the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element is not a <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;4"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#44; then set it to the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;best&#45;representation&#45;of&#45;the&#45;number&#45;as&#45;a&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;2"></a>[best representation&#44; as a floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#best-representation-of-the-number-as-a-floating-point-number)&#44; of the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default&#45;range"></a>[default value](#concept-input-value-default-range)&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default&#45;range"></a><strong>default value</strong> is the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min) plus half the difference between the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;2"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min) and the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max)&#44; unless the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;2"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max) is less than the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;3"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min)&#44; in which case the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default&#45;range&#45;2"></a>[default value](#concept-input-value-default-range) is the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;4"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min)&#46;

When the element is <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;an&#45;underflow"></a>[suffering from an underflow](#suffering-from-an-underflow)&#44; the user agent must set the element&#39;s <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;best&#45;representation&#45;of&#45;the&#45;number&#45;as&#45;a&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;3"></a>[best representation&#44; as a floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#best-representation-of-the-number-as-a-floating-point-number)&#44; of the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;5"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min)&#46;

When the element is <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;an&#45;overflow"></a>[suffering from an overflow](#suffering-from-an-overflow)&#44; if the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;3"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max) is not less than the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;6"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min)&#44; the user agent must set the element&#39;s <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;8"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;5"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number) that represents the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;4"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max)&#46;

When the element is <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch"></a>[suffering from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#44; the user agent must round the element&#39;s <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;9"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the nearest number for which the element would not <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch&#45;2"></a>[suffer from a step mismatch](#suffering-from-a-step-mismatch)&#44; and which is greater than or equal to the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;7"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min)&#44; and&#44; if the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;5"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max) is not less than the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;8"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min)&#44; which is less than or equal to the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;6"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max)&#44; if there is a number that matches these constraints&#46; If two numbers match these constraints&#44; then user agents must use the one nearest to positive infinity&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; the markup <code>&#60;input type&#61;&#34;range&#34; min&#61;0 max&#61;100 step&#61;20 value&#61;50&#62;</code> results in a range control whose initial value is 60&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here is an example of a range control using an autocomplete list with the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code> attribute&#46; This could be useful if there are values along the full range of the control that are especially important&#44; such as preconfigured light levels or typical speed limits in a range control used as a speed control&#46; The following markup fragment&#58;

``` text
<input type="range" min="-100" max="100" value="0" step="10" name="power" list="powers">
<datalist id="powers">
<option value="0">
<option value="-30">
<option value="30">
 <option value="++50">
</datalist>
```

&#46;&#46;&#46;with the following style sheet applied&#58;

``` text
input { writing-mode: vertical-lr; height: 75px; width: 49px; background: #D5CCBB; color: black; }
```

&#46;&#46;&#46;might render as&#58;

![A vertical slider control whose primary color is black and whose background color is beige&#44; with the slider having five tick marks&#44; one long one at each extremity&#44; and three short ones clustered around the midpoint&#46;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/sample-range.png)

Note how the UA determined the orientation of the control from the ratio of the style&#45;sheet&#45;specified height and width properties&#46; The colors were similarly derived from the style sheet&#46; The tick marks&#44; however&#44; were derived from the markup&#46; In particular&#44; the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> attribute has not affected the placement of tick marks&#44; the UA deciding to only use the author&#45;specified completion values and then adding longer tick marks at the extremes&#46;

Note also how the invalid value <code>&#43;&#43;50</code> was ignored&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For another example&#44; consider the following markup fragment&#58;

``` text
<input name=x type=range min=100 max=700 step=9.09090909 value=509.090909>
```

A user agent could display in a variety of ways&#44; for instance&#58;

![As a dial&#46;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/sample-range-2a.png)

Or&#44; alternatively&#44; for instance&#58;

![As a long horizontal slider with tick marks&#46;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/sample-range-2b.png)

The user agent could pick which one to display based on the dimensions given in the style sheet&#46; This would allow it to maintain the same resolution for the tick marks&#44; despite the differences in width&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Finally&#44; here is an example of a range control with two labeled values&#58;

``` text
<input type="range" name="a" list="a-values">
<datalist id="a-values">
<option value="10" label="Low">
<option value="90" label="High">
</datalist>
```

With styles that make the control draw vertically&#44; it might look as follows&#58;

![A vertical slider control with two tick marks&#44; one near the top labeled &#39;High&#39;&#44; and one near the bottom labeled &#39;Low&#39;&#46;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/images/sample-range-labels.png)

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In this state&#44; the range and step constraints are enforced even during user input&#44; and there is no way to set the value to the empty string&#46;

The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;6"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#46; The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;default"></a>[default minimum](#concept-input-min-default) is 0&#46; The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;7"></a>[valid floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#46; The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;default"></a>[default maximum](#concept-input-max-default) is 100&#46;

The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;scale"></a>[step scale factor](#concept-input-step-scale) is 1&#46; The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;default"></a>[default step](#concept-input-step-default) is 1 &#40;allowing only integers&#44; unless the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min&#45;2"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code> attribute has a non&#45;integer value&#41;&#46;

<strong>The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;number"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a number](#concept-input-value-string-number)&#44; given a string <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; If applying the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[rules for parsing floating&#45;point number values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-floating-point-number-values) to <var>input</var> results in an error&#44; then return an error&#59; otherwise&#44; return the resulting number&#46;

<strong>The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;number&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a number to a string](#concept-input-value-number-string)&#44; given a number <var>input</var>&#44; is as follows</strong>&#58; Return the <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;best&#45;representation&#45;of&#45;the&#45;number&#45;as&#45;a&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;4"></a>[best representation&#44; as a floating&#45;point number](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#best-representation-of-the-number-as-a-floating-point-number)&#44; of <var>input</var>&#46;

The following common <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes&#44; IDL attributes&#44; and methods <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list&#45;2"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max&#45;2"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min&#45;3"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; and <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step&#45;2"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code>&#44; and <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code> and <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> methods&#46;

The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value"></a>[value](#dom-input-value-value)&#46;

The <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#46;

The following content attributes must not be specified and <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;accept"></a><code>[accept](#attr-input-accept)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alpha"></a><code>[alpha](#attr-input-alpha)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-input-alt)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#attr-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-height)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;maxlength"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-input-maxlength)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;minlength"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-input-minlength)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;pattern"></a><code>[pattern](#attr-input-pattern)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;placeholder"></a><code>[placeholder](#attr-input-placeholder)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertarget"></a><code>[popovertarget](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertarget)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertargetaction"></a><code>[popovertargetaction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertargetaction)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;readonly"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-input-readonly)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;size"></a><code>[size](#attr-input-size)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code>&#44; and <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-width)</code>&#46;

The following IDL attributes and methods <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#dom-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;files"></a><code>[files](#dom-input-files)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionstart"></a><code>[selectionStart](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionend"></a><code>[selectionEnd](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectiondirection"></a><code>[selectionDirection](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection)</code>&#44; and <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code>&#44; <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code>&#44; and <a id="range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setselectionrange"></a><code>[setSelectionRange&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange)</code> methods&#46;

###### <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;14 <strong>Color</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;color</code>&#41;[](#color-state-(type=color))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;color](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/color)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox29&#43;Safari12&#46;1&#43;Chrome20&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;14&#43;Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android🔰 27&#43;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#43;

When an <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;"></a>[Color](#color-state-(type=color)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a color well control&#44; for setting the element&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string representing the serialization of a CSS color&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In this state&#44; there is always a CSS color picked&#44; and there is no way for the end user to set the value to the empty string&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;input&#45;alpha"></a><strong><code>alpha</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; If present&#44; it indicates the CSS color&#39;s alpha component can be manipulated by the end user and does not have to be fully opaque&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace"></a><strong><code>colorspace</code></strong> attribute indicates the color space of the serialized CSS color&#46; It also hints at the desired user interface for selecting a CSS color&#46; It is an <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th> Keyword      </th><th> State      </th><th> Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="input/colorspace" id="attr-input-colorspace-limited-srgb" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>limited&#45;srgb</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-input-colorspace-limited-srgb-state">Limited sRGB</dfn>      </td><td>The CSS color is converted to the <a id="color-state-(type=color):'srgb'" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#valdef-color-srgb" data-x-internal="'srgb'">&#39;srgb&#39;</a> color space and limited to 8&#45;bits per      component&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; &#34;<code>&#35;123456</code>&#34; or &#34;<code>color&#40;srgb 0 1 0 &#47; 0&#46;5&#41;</code>&#34;&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="input/colorspace" id="attr-input-colorspace-display-p3" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>display&#45;p3</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-input-colorspace-display-p3-state">Display P3</dfn>      </td><td>The CSS color is converted to the <a id="color-state-(type=color):'display-p3'" href="https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#valdef-color-display-p3" data-x-internal="'display-p3'">&#39;display&#45;p3&#39;</a> color space&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; &#34;<code>color&#40;display&#45;p3 1&#46;84 &#45;0&#46;19 0&#46;72 &#47; 0&#46;6&#41;</code>&#34;&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The attribute&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace&#45;limited&#45;srgb&#45;state"></a>[Limited sRGB](#attr-input-colorspace-limited-srgb-state) state&#46;

Whenever the element&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alpha"></a><code>[alpha](#attr-input-alpha)</code> or <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code> attributes are changed&#44; the user agent must run <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;update&#45;a&#45;color&#45;well&#45;control&#45;color"></a>[update a color well control color](#update-a-color-well-control-color) given the element&#46;

If the element is <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the color represented by its <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; as obtained from <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;parsed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;css&#45;color&#45;value"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#parse-a-css-color-value) it&#46; User agents must not allow the user to set the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to a string that running <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;update&#45;a&#45;color&#45;well&#45;control&#45;color&#45;2"></a>[update a color well control color](#update-a-color-well-control-color) for the element would not set it to&#46; If the user agent provides a user interface for selecting a CSS color&#44; then the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) must be set to the result of <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;serialize&#45;a&#45;color&#45;well&#45;control&#45;color"></a>[serializing a color well control color](#serialize-a-color-well-control-color) given the element and the end user&#39;s selection&#46;

The <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior) for such an element <var>element</var> is to <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;show&#45;the&#45;picker&#44;&#45;if&#45;applicable"></a>[show the picker&#44; if applicable](#show-the-picker,-if-applicable)&#44; for <var>element</var>&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; While the element&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) is not the empty string and <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;parsed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;css&#45;color&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#parse-a-css-color-value) it returns failure&#44; the control is <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input"></a>[suffering from bad input](#suffering-from-bad-input)&#46;

The <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; if specified and not the empty string&#44; must have a value that is a CSS color&#46;

<strong>The <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm) is as follows</strong>&#58; Run <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;update&#45;a&#45;color&#45;well&#45;control&#45;color&#45;3"></a>[update a color well control color](#update-a-color-well-control-color) for the element&#46;

To <a id="update&#45;a&#45;color&#45;well&#45;control&#45;color"></a><strong>update a color well control color</strong>&#44; given an element <var>element</var>&#58;

1.  <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>element</var> is an <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Color](#color-state-(type=color)) state&#46;

2.  Let <var>value</var> be the result of running these steps&#58;

    1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) is false&#44; then return the result of <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;get&#45;by&#45;namespace"></a>[getting an attribute by namespace and local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-get-by-namespace) given null&#44; &#34;<code>value</code>&#34;&#44; and <var>element</var>&#46;

    2.  Return <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

3.  Let <var>color</var> be the result of <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;parsed&#45;as&#45;a&#45;css&#45;color&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[parsing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#parse-a-css-color-value) <var>value</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>color</var> is failure&#44; then set <var>color</var> to <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;opaque&#45;black"></a>[opaque black](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#opaque-black)&#46;

5.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the result of <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;serialize&#45;a&#45;color&#45;well&#45;control&#45;color&#45;2"></a>[serializing a color well control color](#serialize-a-color-well-control-color) given <var>element</var> and <var>color</var>&#46;

To <a id="serialize&#45;a&#45;color&#45;well&#45;control&#45;color"></a><strong>serialize a color well control color</strong>&#44; given an element <var>element</var> and a CSS color <var>color</var>&#58;

1.  <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>element</var> is an <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#45;3"></a>[Color](#color-state-(type=color)) state&#46;

2.  Let <var>htmlCompatible</var> be false&#46;

3.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alpha&#45;2"></a><code>[alpha](#attr-input-alpha)</code> attribute is not specified&#44; then set <var>color</var>&#39;s alpha component to be fully opaque&#46;

4.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace&#45;2"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code> attribute is in the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace&#45;limited&#45;srgb&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Limited sRGB](#attr-input-colorspace-limited-srgb-state) state&#58;

    1.  Set <var>color</var> to <var>color</var> <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;converting&#45;colors"></a>[converted](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-conversion) to the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;&#39;srgb&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;srgb&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#valdef-color-srgb) color space&#46;

    2.  Round each of <var>color</var>&#39;s components so they are in the range 0 to 255&#44; inclusive&#46; Components are to be [rounded towards &#43;∞](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values-4/#combine-integers)&#46;

    3.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alpha&#45;3"></a><code>[alpha](#attr-input-alpha)</code> attribute is not specified&#44; then set <var>htmlCompatible</var> to true&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        This intentionally uses a different serialization path for compatibility with an earlier version of the color well control&#46;

    4.  Otherwise&#44; set <var>color</var> to <var>color</var> converted using the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;color&#45;function"></a>[&#39;color&#40;&#41;&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-function) function&#46;

5.  Otherwise&#58;

    1.  <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;assert&#45;3"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace&#45;3"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code> attribute is in the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace&#45;display&#45;p3&#45;state"></a>[Display P3](#attr-input-colorspace-display-p3-state) state&#46;

    2.  Set <var>color</var> to <var>color</var> <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;converting&#45;colors&#45;2"></a>[converted](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-conversion) to the <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;&#39;display&#45;p3&#39;&#45;2"></a>[&#39;display&#45;p3&#39;](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#valdef-color-display-p3) color space&#46;

6.  Return the result of <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;serialisation&#45;of&#45;a&#45;color"></a>[serializing](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#serializing-color-values) <var>color</var>&#46; If <var>htmlCompatible</var> is true&#44; then do so with <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;html&#45;compatible&#45;serialization&#45;is&#45;requested"></a>[HTML&#45;compatible serialization requested](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-color/#color-serialization-html-compatible-serialization-is-requested)&#46;

The following common <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes and IDL attributes <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alpha&#45;4"></a><code>[alpha](#attr-input-alpha)</code>&#44; <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace&#45;4"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code>&#44; and <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#dom-input-list)</code> and <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code> method&#46;

The <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#46;

###### <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;15 <strong>Checkbox</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;checkbox</code>&#41;[](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;checkbox](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/checkbox)

When an <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;"></a>[Checkbox](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a two&#45;state control that represents the element&#39;s <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) state&#46; If the element&#39;s <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;2"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) state is true&#44; the control represents a positive selection&#44; and if it is false&#44; a negative selection&#46; If the element&#39;s <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;indeterminate"></a>[indeterminateness](#concept-input-indeterminate) is true&#44; then the control&#39;s selection should be obscured&#46;

The <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior) is to run the following steps&#58;

1.  If the element is not <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;connected"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at the element with the <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#46;

3.  <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> at the element with the <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;2"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If the element is <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;required"></a><em>[required](#concept-input-required)</em> and its <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;3"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) is false&#44; then the element is <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;missing"></a>[suffering from being missing](#suffering-from-being-missing)&#46;

<strong><code><var>input</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;input&#45;indeterminate&#45;dev"></a>[indeterminate](#dom-input-indeterminate) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

When set&#44; overrides the rendering of <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#45;2"></a>[checkbox](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)) controls so that the current value is not visible&#46;

The following common <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes and IDL attributes <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#attr-input-checked)</code>&#44; and <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#dom-input-checked)</code> and <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attributes&#46;

The <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default&#45;on"></a>[default&#47;on](#dom-input-value-default-on)&#46;

<a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code>&#44; and <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code> IDL attributes&#59; <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code>&#44; <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code>&#44; <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setselectionrange"></a><code>[setSelectionRange&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange)</code>&#44; <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code>&#44; and <a id="checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> methods&#46;

###### <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;16 <strong>Radio Button</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;radio</code>&#41;[](#radio-button-state-(type=radio))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;radio](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/radio)

Support in all current engines&#46;

When an <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;"></a>[Radio Button](#radio-button-state-(type=radio)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control that&#44; when used in conjunction with other <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements&#44; forms a <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group"></a><em>[radio button group](#radio-button-group)</em> in which only one control can have its <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) state set to true&#46; If the element&#39;s <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;2"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) state is true&#44; the control represents the selected control in the group&#44; and if it is false&#44; it indicates a control in the group that is not selected&#46;

The <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;group"></a><strong><em>radio button group</em></strong> that contains an <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <var>a</var> also contains all the other <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements <var>b</var> that fulfill all of the following conditions&#58;

- The <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <var>b</var>&#39;s <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Radio Button](#radio-button-state-(type=radio)) state&#46;
- Either <var>a</var> and <var>b</var> have the same <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#44; or they both have no <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#46;
- Both <var>a</var> and <var>b</var> are in the same <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;tree"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree)&#46;
- They both have a <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute&#44; their <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attributes are not empty&#44; and the value of <var>a</var>&#39;s <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;3"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute equals the value of <var>b</var>&#39;s <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;4"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute&#46;

A <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;tree&#45;2"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree) must not contain an <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group&#45;2"></a><em>[radio button group](#radio-button-group)</em> contains only that element&#46;

When any of the following phenomena occur&#44; if the element&#39;s <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;3"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) state is true after the occurrence&#44; the <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;4"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) state of all the other elements in the same <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group&#45;3"></a><em>[radio button group](#radio-button-group)</em> must be set to false&#58;

- The element&#39;s <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;5"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) state is set to true &#40;for whatever reason&#41;&#46;
- The element&#39;s <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;5"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute is set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#46;
- The element&#39;s <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;3"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) changes&#46;
- <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;signal&#45;a&#45;type&#45;change"></a>[A type change is signalled](#signal-a-type-change) for the element&#46;
- The element <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;becomes&#45;connected"></a>[becomes connected](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#becomes-connected)&#46;

The <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior) is to run the following steps&#58;

1.  If the element is not <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;connected"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at the element with the <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#46;

3.  <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> at the element with the <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;2"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If an element in the <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group&#45;4"></a><em>[radio button group](#radio-button-group)</em> is <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;required"></a><em>[required](#concept-input-required)</em>&#44; and all of the <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements in the <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group&#45;5"></a><em>[radio button group](#radio-button-group)</em> have a <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;6"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) that is false&#44; then the element is <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;missing"></a>[suffering from being missing](#suffering-from-being-missing)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following example&#44; for some reason&#44; has specified that puppers are both <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;required&#45;2"></a>[required](#concept-input-required) and <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled)&#58;

``` text
<form>
 <p><label><input type="radio" name="dog-type" value="pupper" required disabled> Pupper</label>
 <p><label><input type="radio" name="dog-type" value="doggo"> Doggo</label>
 <p><button>Make your choice</button>
</form>
```

If the user tries to submit this form without first selecting &#34;Doggo&#34;&#44; then <em>both</em> <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements will be <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;missing&#45;2"></a>[suffering from being missing](#suffering-from-being-missing)&#44; since an element in the <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group&#45;6"></a>[radio button group](#radio-button-group) is <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;required&#45;3"></a>[required](#concept-input-required) &#40;viz&#46; the first element&#41;&#44; and both of the elements in the radio button group have a false <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;7"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked)&#46;

On the other hand&#44; if the user selects &#34;Doggo&#34; and then submits the form&#44; then neither <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element will be <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;missing&#45;3"></a>[suffering from being missing](#suffering-from-being-missing)&#44; since while one of them is <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;required&#45;4"></a>[required](#concept-input-required)&#44; not all of them have a false <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;8"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

If none of the radio buttons in a <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group&#45;7"></a>[radio button group](#radio-button-group) are checked&#44; then they will all be initially unchecked in the interface&#44; until such time as one of them is checked &#40;either by the user or by script&#41;&#46;

The following common <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes and IDL attributes <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#attr-input-checked)</code> and <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#dom-input-checked)</code> and <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attributes&#46;

The <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default&#45;on"></a>[default&#47;on](#dom-input-value-default-on)&#46;

The <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;event&#45;input&#45;2"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;event&#45;change&#45;2"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#46;

The following content attributes must not be specified and <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;accept"></a><code>[accept](#attr-input-accept)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alpha"></a><code>[alpha](#attr-input-alpha)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-input-alt)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;colorspace"></a><code>[colorspace](#attr-input-colorspace)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-height)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;maxlength"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-input-maxlength)</code>&#44; <a id="radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code>&#44; When an <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;"></a>[File Upload](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a list of <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected"></a><strong>selected files</strong>&#44; each file consisting of a filename&#44; a file type&#44; and a file body &#40;the contents of the file&#41;&#46;

Filenames must not contain <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;file&#45;path"></a>[path components](#concept-input-file-path)&#44; even in the case that a user has selected an entire directory hierarchy or multiple files with the same name from different directories&#46; <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;file&#45;path"></a><strong>Path components</strong>&#44; for the purposes of the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#45;2"></a>[File Upload](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) state&#44; are those parts of filenames that are separated by U&#43;005C REVERSE SOLIDUS character &#40;&#92;&#41; characters&#46;

Unless the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code> attribute is set&#44; there must be no more than one file in the list of <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected)&#46;

The <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior) for such an element <var>element</var> is to <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;show&#45;the&#45;picker&#44;&#45;if&#45;applicable"></a>[show the picker&#44; if applicable](#show-the-picker,-if-applicable)&#44; for <var>element</var>&#46;

If the element is <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the files on the list in other ways also&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; adding or removing files by drag&#45;and&#45;drop&#46; When the user does so&#44; the user agent must <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;update&#45;the&#45;file&#45;selection"></a>[update the file selection](#update-the-file-selection) for the element&#46;

If the element is not <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;2"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent must not allow the user to change the element&#39;s selection&#46;

To <a id="update&#45;the&#45;file&#45;selection"></a><strong>update the file selection</strong> for an element <var>element</var>&#58;

1.  <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given <var>element</var> and the following steps&#58;

    1.  Update <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected&#45;2"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected) so that it represents the user&#39;s selection&#46;

    2.  <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#46;

    3.  <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> at the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;2"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If the element is <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;required"></a><em>[required](#concept-input-required)</em> and the list of <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected&#45;3"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected) is empty&#44; then the element is <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;missing"></a>[suffering from being missing](#suffering-from-being-missing)&#46;
