Firefox Android37&#43;Safari iOS11&#46;3&#43;Chrome Android26&#43;WebView Android4&#46;4&#43;Samsung Internet1&#46;5&#43;Opera Android15&#43;

The <a id="attr&#45;input&#45;accept"></a><strong><code>accept</code></strong> attribute may be specified to provide user agents with a hint of what file types will be accepted&#46;

If specified&#44; the attribute must consist of a <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;set&#45;of&#45;comma&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>[set of comma&#45;separated tokens](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#set-of-comma-separated-tokens)&#44; each of which must be an <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for one of the following&#58;

<strong>The string &#34;<code>audio&#47;&#42;</code>&#34;</strong>

Indicates that sound files are accepted&#46;

<strong>The string &#34;<code>video&#47;&#42;</code>&#34;</strong>

Indicates that video files are accepted&#46;

<strong>The string &#34;<code>image&#47;&#42;</code>&#34;</strong>

Indicates that image files are accepted&#46;

<strong>A <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;valid&#45;mime&#45;type&#45;string&#45;with&#45;no&#45;parameters"></a>[valid MIME type string with no parameters](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#valid-mime-type-with-no-parameters)</strong>

Indicates that files of the specified type are accepted&#46;

<strong>A string whose first character is a U&#43;002E FULL STOP character &#40;&#46;&#41;</strong>

Indicates that files with the specified file extension are accepted&#46;

The tokens must not be <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) matches for any of the other tokens &#40;i&#46;e&#46; duplicates are not allowed&#41;&#46; To obtain the list of tokens from the attribute&#44; the user agent must <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;split&#45;a&#45;string&#45;on&#45;commas"></a>[split the attribute value on commas](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-commas)&#46;

User agents may use the value of this attribute to display a more appropriate user interface than a generic file picker&#46; For instance&#44; given the value <code>image&#47;&#42;</code>&#44; a user agent could offer the user the option of using a local camera or selecting a photograph from their photo collection&#59; given the value <code>audio&#47;&#42;</code>&#44; a user agent could offer the user the option of recording a clip using a headset microphone&#46;

User agents should prevent the user from selecting files that are not accepted by one &#40;or more&#41; of these tokens&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Authors are encouraged to specify both any MIME types and any corresponding extensions when looking for data in a specific format&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; consider an application that converts Microsoft Word documents to Open Document Format files&#46; Since Microsoft Word documents are described with a wide variety of MIME types and extensions&#44; the site can list several&#44; as follows&#58;

``` text
<input type="file" accept=".doc,.docx,.xml,application/msword,application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document">
```

On platforms that only use file extensions to describe file types&#44; the extensions listed here can be used to filter the allowed documents&#44; while the MIME types can be used with the system&#39;s type registration table &#40;mapping MIME types to extensions used by the system&#41;&#44; if any&#44; to determine any other extensions to allow&#46; Similarly&#44; on a system that does not have filenames or extensions but labels documents with MIME types internally&#44; the MIME types can be used to pick the allowed files&#44; while the extensions can be used if the system has an extension registration table that maps known extensions to MIME types used by the system&#46;

<strong>Warning&#58;</strong>

Extensions tend to be ambiguous &#40;e&#46;g&#46; there are an untold number of formats that use the &#34;<code>&#46;dat</code>&#34; extension&#44; and users can typically quite easily rename their files to have a &#34;<code>&#46;doc</code>&#34; extension even if they are not Microsoft Word documents&#41;&#44; and MIME types tend to be unreliable &#40;e&#46;g&#46; many formats have no formally registered types&#44; and many formats are in practice labeled using a number of different MIME types&#41;&#46; Authors are reminded that&#44; as usual&#44; data received from a client should be treated with caution&#44; as it may not be in an expected format even if the user is not hostile and the user agent fully obeyed the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;accept"></a><code>[accept](#attr-input-accept)</code> attribute&#39;s requirements&#46;

MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;file](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/file)

<a id="fakepath&#45;srsly"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#fakepath-srsly)

For historical reasons&#44; the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute prefixes the filename with the string &#34;<code>C&#58;&#92;fakepath&#92;</code>&#34;&#46; Some legacy user agents actually included the full path &#40;which was a security vulnerability&#41;&#46; As a result of this&#44; obtaining the filename from the <a id="file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute in a backwards&#45;compatible way is non&#45;trivial&#46; The following function extracts the filename in a suitably compatible manner&#58;

``` text
function extractFilename(path) {
  if (path.substr(0, 12) == "C:\\fakepath\\")
    return path.substr(12); // modern browser
  var x;
  x = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  if (x >= 0) // Unix-based path
    return path.substr(x+1);
  x = path.lastIndexOf('\\');
  if (x >= 0) // Windows-based path
    return path.substr(x+1);
  return path; // just the filename
}
```

This can be used as follows&#58;

``` text
<p><input type=file name=image onchange="updateFilename(this.value)"></p>
<p>The name of the file you picked is: <span id="filename">(none)</span></p>
<script>
 function updateFilename(path) {
   var name = extractFilename(path);
   document.getElementById('filename').textContent = name;
 }
</script>
```

###### <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;18 <strong>Submit Button</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;submit</code>&#41;[](#submit-button-state-(type=submit))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;submit](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/submit)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

When an <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;"></a>[Submit Button](#submit-button-state-(type=submit)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

<a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;tracking&#45;vector"></a>[![&#40;This is a tracking vector&#46;&#41;](https://resources.whatwg.org/tracking-vector.svg)](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#tracking-vector) The <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a button that&#44; when activated&#44; submits the form&#46; If the element has a <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; the button&#39;s label must be the value of that attribute&#59; otherwise&#44; it must be an <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) string that means &#34;Submit&#34; or some such&#46; The element is a <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;concept&#45;button"></a>[button](#concept-button)&#44; specifically a <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Since the default label is <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;implementation&#45;defined&#45;2"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined)&#44; and the width of the button typically depends on the button&#39;s label&#44; the button&#39;s width can leak a few bits of fingerprintable information&#46; These bits are likely to be strongly correlated to the identity of the user agent and the user&#39;s locale&#46;

The element&#39;s <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;optional&#45;value"></a>[optional value](#concept-fe-optional-value) is the value of the element&#39;s <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-button-value)</code> attribute&#44; if there is one&#59; otherwise null&#46;

The element&#39;s <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior) given <var>event</var> is as follows&#58;

1.  If the element does not have a <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If the element&#39;s <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;submit"></a>[Submit](#concept-form-submit) the element&#39;s <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) from the element with <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;submit&#45;user&#45;involvement"></a><em>[userInvolvement](#submit-user-involvement)</em> set to <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;event&#45;uni"></a>[user navigation involvement](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-uni)&#46;

The <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; and <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code> attributes are <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attributes&#45;for&#45;form&#45;submission"></a>[attributes for form submission](#attributes-for-form-submission)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate&#45;2"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code> attribute can be used to make submit buttons that do not trigger the constraint validation&#46;

The following common <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes and IDL attributes <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code>&#44; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction&#45;2"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype&#45;2"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod&#45;2"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate&#45;3"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget&#45;2"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code>&#44; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertarget"></a><code>[popovertarget](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertarget)</code>&#44; and <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertargetaction"></a><code>[popovertargetaction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertargetaction)</code> content attributes&#59; <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute&#46;

The <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute is in mode <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default"></a>[default](#dom-input-value-default)&#46;

The following content attributes must not be specified and <a id="submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; ###### <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;19 <strong>Image Button</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;image</code>&#41;[](#image-button-state-(type=image))

[Element&#47;input&#47;image](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/image)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

When an <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

The <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) either an image from which a user can select a coordinate and submit the form&#44; or alternatively a button from which the user can submit the form&#46; The element is a <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;button"></a>[button](#concept-button)&#44; specifically a <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The coordinate is sent to the server <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;constructing&#45;the&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set"></a>[during form submission](#constructing-the-form-data-set) by sending two entries for the element&#44; derived from the name of the control but with &#34;<code>&#46;x</code>&#34; and &#34;<code>&#46;y</code>&#34; appended to the name with the <var>x</var> and <var>y</var> components of the coordinate respectively&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#35;src](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#src)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

The image is given by the <a id="attr&#45;input&#45;src"></a><strong><code>src</code></strong> attribute&#46; The <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code> attribute must be present&#44; and must contain a <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces) referencing a non&#45;interactive&#44; optionally animated&#44; image resource that is neither paged nor scripted&#46;

When any of these events occur&#58;

- the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is first set to the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state &#40;possibly when the element is first created&#41;&#44; and the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src&#45;2"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code> attribute is present
- the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is changed back to the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#45;3"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state&#44; and the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src&#45;3"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code> attribute is present&#44; and its value has changed since the last time the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;4"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute was in the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#45;4"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state
- the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;5"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#45;5"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state&#44; and the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src&#45;4"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code> attribute is set or changed

then unless the user agent cannot support images&#44; or its support for images has been disabled&#44; or the user agent only fetches images on demand&#44; or the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src&#45;5"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code> attribute&#39;s value is the empty string&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>url</var> be the result of <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url) given the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src&#45;6"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code> attribute&#39;s value&#44; relative to the element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

2.  If <var>url</var> is failure&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Let <var>request</var> be a new <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;request"></a>[request](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request) whose <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;url"></a>[URL](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-url) is <var>url</var>&#44; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;client"></a>[client](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-client) is the element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#44; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;destination"></a>[destination](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-destination) is &#34;<code>image</code>&#34;&#44; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;initiator&#45;type"></a>[initiator type](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-initiator-type) is &#34;<code>input</code>&#34;&#44; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;request&#45;credentials&#45;mode"></a>[credentials mode](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-credentials-mode) is &#34;<code>include</code>&#34;&#44; and whose <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;use&#45;url&#45;credentials&#45;flag"></a>[use&#45;URL&#45;credentials flag](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-request-use-url-credentials-flag) is set&#46;

4.  <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fetch"></a>[Fetch](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-fetch) <var>request</var>&#44; with <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;processresponseendofbody"></a><em>[processResponseEndOfBody](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#fetch-processresponseendofbody)</em> set to the following steps given <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;response"></a>[response](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-response) <var>response</var>&#58;

    1.  If the download was successful and the image is <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;input&#45;img&#45;available"></a><em>[available](#input-img-available)</em>&#44; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element to <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;event&#45;load"></a><code>[load](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-load)</code> at the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#46;

    2.  Otherwise&#44; if the fetching process fails without a response from the remote server&#44; or completes but the image is not a valid or supported image&#44; then <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element to <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;event&#45;error"></a><code>[error](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-error)</code> on the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#46;

Fetching the image must <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;delay&#45;the&#45;load&#45;event"></a>[delay the load event](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#delay-the-load-event) of the element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) until the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) once the resource has been fetched &#40;defined below&#41; has been run&#46;

If the image was successfully obtained&#44; with no network errors&#44; and the image&#39;s type is a supported image type&#44; and the image is a valid image of that type&#44; then the image is said to be <a id="input&#45;img&#45;available"></a><strong><em>available</em></strong>&#46; If this is true before the image is completely downloaded&#44; each <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that is <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) by the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;networking&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[networking task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#networking-task-source) while the image is being fetched must update the presentation of the image appropriately&#46;

The user agent should apply the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;content&#45;type&#45;sniffing&#58;&#45;image"></a>[image sniffing rules](https://mimesniff.spec.whatwg.org/#rules-for-sniffing-images-specifically) to determine the type of the image&#44; with the image&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;content&#45;type"></a>[associated Content&#45;Type headers](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type) giving the <var>official type</var>&#46; If these rules are not applied&#44; then the type of the image must be the type given by the image&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;content&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[associated Content&#45;Type headers](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type)&#46;

User agents must not support non&#45;image resources with the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#46; User agents must not run executable code embedded in the image resource&#46; User agents must only display the first page of a multipage resource&#46; User agents must not allow the resource to act in an interactive fashion&#44; but should honor any animation in the resource&#46;

[Element&#47;input&#35;alt](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#alt)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

The <a id="attr&#45;input&#45;alt"></a><strong><code>alt</code></strong> attribute provides the textual label for the button for users and user agents who cannot use the image&#46; The <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](#attr-input-alt)</code> attribute must be present&#44; and must contain a non&#45;empty string giving the label that would be appropriate for an equivalent button if the image was unavailable&#46;

The <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element supports <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;dimension&#45;attributes"></a>[dimension attributes](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#dimension-attributes)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

If the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src&#45;7"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code> attribute is set&#44; and the image is <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;input&#45;img&#45;available&#45;2"></a><em>[available](#input-img-available)</em> and the user agent is configured to display that image&#44; then the element <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;represents&#45;2"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for selecting a <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;image&#45;coordinate"></a>[coordinate](#concept-input-type-image-coordinate) from the image specified by the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;src&#45;8"></a><code>[src](#attr-input-src)</code> attribute&#46; In that case&#44; if the element is <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to select this <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;image&#45;coordinate&#45;2"></a>[coordinate](#concept-input-type-image-coordinate)&#46;

Otherwise&#44; the element <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;represents&#45;3"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a submit button whose label is given by the value of the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;alt&#45;2"></a><code>[alt](#attr-input-alt)</code> attribute&#46;

The element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior) given <var>event</var> is as follows&#58;

1.  If the element does not have a <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If the element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44; then return&#46;

3.  If the user activated the control while explicitly selecting a coordinate&#44; then set the element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;image&#45;coordinate&#45;3"></a>[selected coordinate](#concept-input-type-image-coordinate) to that coordinate&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    This is only possible under the conditions outlined above&#44; when the element <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;represents&#45;4"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for selecting such a coordinate&#46; Even then&#44; the user might activate the control without explicitly selecting a coordinate&#46;

4.  <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;submit"></a>[Submit](#concept-form-submit) the element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) from the element with <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;submit&#45;user&#45;involvement"></a><em>[userInvolvement](#submit-user-involvement)</em> set to <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;event&#45;uni"></a>[user navigation involvement](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-uni)&#46;

The element&#39;s <a id="concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;image&#45;coordinate"></a><strong>selected coordinate</strong> consists of an <var>x</var>&#45;component and a <var>y</var>&#45;component&#46; It is initially &#40;0&#44; 0&#41;&#46; The coordinates represent the position relative to the edge of the element&#39;s image&#44; with the coordinate space having the positive <var>x</var> direction to the right&#44; and the positive <var>y</var> direction downwards&#46;

The <var>x</var>&#45;component must be a <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;valid&#45;integer"></a>[valid integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-integer) representing a number <var>x</var> in the range −&#40;<var>border<sub>left</sub></var>&#43;<var>padding<sub>left</sub></var>&#41; ≤ <var>x</var> ≤ <var>width</var>&#43;<var>border<sub>right</sub></var>&#43;<var>padding<sub>right</sub></var>&#44; where <var>width</var> is the rendered width of the image&#44; <var>border<sub>left</sub></var> is the width of the border on the left of the image&#44; <var>padding<sub>left</sub></var> is the width of the padding on the left of the image&#44; <var>border<sub>right</sub></var> is the width of the border on the right of the image&#44; and <var>padding<sub>right</sub></var> is the width of the padding on the right of the image&#44; with all dimensions given in <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;&#39;px&#39;"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

The <var>y</var>&#45;component must be a <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;valid&#45;integer&#45;2"></a>[valid integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-integer) representing a number <var>y</var> in the range −&#40;<var>border<sub>top</sub></var>&#43;<var>padding<sub>top</sub></var>&#41; ≤ <var>y</var> ≤ <var>height</var>&#43;<var>border<sub>bottom</sub></var>&#43;<var>padding<sub>bottom</sub></var>&#44; where <var>height</var> is the rendered height of the image&#44; <var>border<sub>top</sub></var> is the width of the border above the image&#44; <var>padding<sub>top</sub></var> is the width of the padding above the image&#44; <var>border<sub>bottom</sub></var> is the width of the border below the image&#44; and <var>padding<sub>bottom</sub></var> is the width of the padding below the image&#44; with all dimensions given in <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;2"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

Where a border or padding is missing&#44; its width is zero <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;&#39;px&#39;&#45;3"></a>[CSS pixels](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-values/#px)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; and <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code> attributes are <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attributes&#45;for&#45;form&#45;submission"></a>[attributes for form submission](#attributes-for-form-submission)&#46;

<strong><code><var>image</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;input&#45;width&#45;dev"></a>[width](#dom-input-width) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

<strong><code><var>image</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;input&#45;height&#45;dev"></a>[height](#dom-input-height) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

These attributes return the rendered dimensions of the image&#46; When the image is not being rendered&#44; they return the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;width"></a><code>[width](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-width)</code> and <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;dim&#45;height"></a><code>[height](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-dim-height)</code> content attributes&#39; values&#44; defaulting to the image&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;natural&#45;dimensions"></a>[natural dimensions](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-images/#natural-dimensions)&#44; if any&#59; otherwise 0&#46;

They can be set&#44; to change the corresponding content attributes&#46;

The element&#39;s <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute must be omitted&#46;

The following IDL attributes and methods <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><code>[checked](#dom-input-checked)</code>&#44; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setselectionrange"></a><code>[setSelectionRange&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange)</code>&#44; <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code>&#44; and <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> methods&#46;

The <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;3"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Many aspects of this state&#39;s behavior are similar to the behavior of the <a id="image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> element&#46; Readers are encouraged to read that section&#44; where many of the same requirements are described in more detail&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Take the following form&#58;

``` text
<form action="process.cgi">
 <input type=image src=map.png name=where alt="Show location list">
</form>
```

If the user clicked on the image at coordinate &#40;127&#44;40&#41; then the URL used to submit the form would be &#34;<code>process&#46;cgi&#63;where&#46;x&#61;127&#38;where&#46;y&#61;40</code>&#34;&#46;

&#40;In this example&#44; it&#39;s assumed that for users who don&#39;t see the map&#44; and who instead just see a button labeled &#34;Show location list&#34;&#44; clicking the button will cause the server to show a list of locations to pick from instead of the map&#46;&#41;

###### <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;1&#46;20 <strong>Reset Button</strong> state &#40;<code>type&#61;reset</code>&#41;[](#reset-button-state-(type=reset))

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#47;reset](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/reset)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

When an <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;"></a>[Reset Button](#reset-button-state-(type=reset)) state&#44; the rules in this section apply&#46;

<a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;tracking&#45;vector"></a>[![&#40;This is a tracking vector&#46;&#41;](https://resources.whatwg.org/tracking-vector.svg)](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#tracking-vector) The <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a button that&#44; when activated&#44; resets the form&#46; If the element has a <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; the button&#39;s label must be the value of that attribute&#59; otherwise&#44; it must be an <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) string that means &#34;Reset&#34; or some such&#46; The element is a <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;concept&#45;button"></a>[button](#concept-button)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Since the default label is <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;implementation&#45;defined&#45;2"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined)&#44; and the width of the button typically depends on the button&#39;s label&#44; the button&#39;s width can leak a few bits of fingerprintable information&#46; These bits are likely to be strongly correlated to the identity of the user agent and the user&#39;s locale&#46;

The element&#39;s <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior) is as follows&#58;

1.  If the element does not have a <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If the element&#39;s <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset"></a>[Reset](#concept-form-reset) the <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) from the element&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; The element is <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;barred&#45;from&#45;constraint&#45;validation"></a>[barred from constraint validation](#barred-from-constraint-validation)&#46;

The <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#dom-input-value)</code> IDL attribute <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[applies](#concept-input-apply) to this element and is in mode <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default"></a>[default](#dom-input-value-default)&#46;

The following common <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element content attributes <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to the element&#58; <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertarget"></a><code>[popovertarget](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertarget)</code> and <a id="reset&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;reset&#41;&#58;attr&#45;popovertargetaction"></a><code>[popovertargetaction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertargetaction)</code>&#46;

##### <a id="input&#45;impl&#45;notes"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;2 Implementation notes regarding localization of form controls[](#input-impl-notes)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

The formats shown to the user in date&#44; time&#44; and number controls is independent of the format used for form submission&#46;

Browsers are encouraged to use user interfaces that present dates&#44; times&#44; and numbers according to the conventions of either the locale implied by the <a id="input&#45;impl&#45;notes&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="input&#45;impl&#45;notes&#58;language"></a>[language](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#language) or the user&#39;s preferred locale&#46; Using the page&#39;s locale will ensure consistency with page&#45;provided data&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; it would be confusing to users if an American English page claimed that a Cirque De Soleil show was going to be showing on 02&#47;03&#44; but their browser&#44; configured to use the British English locale&#44; only showed the date 03&#47;02 in the ticket purchase date picker&#46; Using the page&#39;s locale would at least ensure that the date was presented in the same format everywhere&#46; &#40;There&#39;s still a risk that the user would end up arriving a month late&#44; of course&#44; but there&#39;s only so much that can be done about such cultural differences&#46;&#46;&#46;&#41;

##### <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;3 Common <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element attributes[](#common-input-element-attributes)

These attributes only <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) to an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element if its <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in a state whose definition declares that the attribute <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[applies](#concept-input-apply)&#46; When an attribute <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;attributes&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply"></a>[doesn&#39;t apply](#do-not-apply) to an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; user agents must <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;attributes&#58;ignore"></a>[ignore](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#ignore) the attribute&#44; regardless of the requirements and definitions below&#46;
