<strong><code><var>input</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown&#45;dev"></a>[stepDown](#dom-input-stepdown)&#40;&#91; <var>n</var> &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

MDN

[HTMLInputElement&#47;stepDown](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/stepDown)

Firefox🔰 16&#43;Safari5&#43;Chrome5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS4&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android37&#43;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Changes the form control&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) by the value given in the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> attribute&#44; multiplied by <var>n</var>&#46; The default value for <var>n</var> is 1&#46;

Throws <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if the control is neither date&#45; or time&#45;based nor numeric&#44; or if the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step&#45;2"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> attribute&#39;s value is &#34;<code>any</code>&#34;&#46;

<strong><code><var>input</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;input&#45;list&#45;dev"></a>[list](#dom-input-list)</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element indicated by the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code> attribute&#46;

<strong><code><var>input</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;input&#45;showpicker&#45;dev"></a>[showPicker](#dom-input-showpicker)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

Shows any applicable picker UI for <var>input</var>&#44; so that the user can select a value&#46;

If <var>input</var> does not <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;input&#45;support&#45;picker"></a>[support a picker](#input-support-picker)&#44; this method does nothing&#46;

Throws an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;5"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if <var>input</var> is not <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#46;

Throws a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;notallowederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotAllowedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notallowederror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;6"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if called without <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;transient&#45;activation"></a>[transient user activation](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#transient-activation)&#46;

Throws a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;securityerror"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;7"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if <var>input</var> is inside a cross&#45;origin <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code>&#44; unless <var>input</var> is in the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;"></a>[File Upload](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) or <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;"></a>[Color](#color-state-(type=color)) states&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> IDL attribute allows scripts to manipulate the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#46; The attribute is in one of the following modes&#44; which define its behavior&#58;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;value"></a><strong>value</strong></strong>

On getting&#44; return the current <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element&#46;

On setting&#58;

1.  Let <var>oldValue</var> be the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#46;

2.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;8"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to the new value&#46;

3.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) to true&#46;

4.  Invoke the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm)&#44; if the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s current state defines one&#46;

5.  If the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;9"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) &#40;after applying the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;value&#45;sanitization&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[value sanitization algorithm](#value-sanitization-algorithm)&#41; is different from <var>oldValue</var>&#44; and the element has a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;cursor"></a>[text entry cursor position](#concept-textarea/input-cursor)&#44; move the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;cursor&#45;2"></a>[text entry cursor position](#concept-textarea/input-cursor) to the end of the text control&#44; unselecting any selected text and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;set&#45;the&#45;selection&#45;direction"></a>[resetting the selection direction](#set-the-selection-direction) to &#34;<code>none</code>&#34;&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default"></a><strong>default</strong></strong>

On getting&#44; if the element has a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute&#44; return that attribute&#39;s value&#59; otherwise&#44; return the empty string&#46;

On setting&#44; set the value of the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute to the new value&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;default&#45;on"></a><strong>default&#47;on</strong></strong>

On getting&#44; if the element has a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;3"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute&#44; return that attribute&#39;s value&#59; otherwise&#44; return the string &#34;<code>on</code>&#34;&#46;

On setting&#44; set the value of the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;4"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> content attribute to the new value&#46;

<strong><a id="dom&#45;input&#45;value&#45;filename"></a><strong>filename</strong></strong>

<a id="fakepath&#45;orly"></a>

On getting&#44; return the string &#34;<code>C&#58;&#92;fakepath&#92;</code>&#34; followed by the name of the first file in the list of <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected&#45;3"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected)&#44; if any&#44; or the empty string if the list is empty&#46;

On setting&#44; if the new value is the empty string&#44; empty the list of <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected&#45;4"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected)&#59; otherwise&#44; throw an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;6"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;8"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This &#34;fakepath&#34; requirement is a sad accident of history&#46; See [the example in the File Upload state section](#fakepath-srsly) for more information&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Since <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;file&#45;path"></a>[path components](#concept-input-file-path) are not permitted in filenames in the list of <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected&#45;5"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected)&#44; the &#34;&#92;fakepath&#92;&#34; cannot be mistaken for a path component&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;checked"></a><strong><code>checked</code></strong> IDL attribute allows scripts to manipulate the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;3"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) of an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#46; On getting&#44; it must return the current <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;4"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) of the element&#59; and on setting&#44; it must set the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;5"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) to the new value and set the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;checked&#45;dirty&#45;flag"></a>[dirty checkedness flag](#concept-input-checked-dirty-flag) to true&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;files"></a><strong><code>files</code></strong> IDL attribute allows scripts to access the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected&#45;6"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected)&#46;

On getting&#44; if the IDL attribute <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[applies](#concept-input-apply)&#44; it must return a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;filelist&#45;3"></a><code>[FileList](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#filelist-section)</code> object that represents the current <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected&#45;7"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected)&#46; The same object must be returned until the list of <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected&#45;8"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected) changes&#46; If the IDL attribute <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply"></a>[does not apply](#do-not-apply)&#44; then it must instead return null&#46; [&#91;FILEAPI&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsFILEAPI)

On setting&#44; it must run these steps&#58;

1.  If the IDL attribute <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[does not apply](#do-not-apply) or the given value is null&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Replace the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected&#45;9"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected) with the given value&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate"></a><strong><code>valueAsDate</code></strong> IDL attribute represents the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;10"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element&#44; interpreted as a date&#46;

On getting&#44; if the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code> attribute <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;3"></a>[does not apply](#do-not-apply)&#44; as defined for the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s current state&#44; then return null&#46; Otherwise&#44; run the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;date"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a <code>Date</code> object](#concept-input-value-string-date) defined for that state to the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;11"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#59; if the algorithm returned a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;date&#45;2"></a><code>[Date](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-date-objects)</code> object&#44; then return it&#44; otherwise&#44; return null&#46;

On setting&#44; if the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasdate&#45;2"></a><code>[valueAsDate](#dom-input-valueasdate)</code> attribute <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;4"></a>[does not apply](#do-not-apply)&#44; as defined for the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s current state&#44; then throw an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;7"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;9"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#59; otherwise&#44; if the new value is not null and not a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;date&#45;3"></a><code>[Date](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-date-objects)</code> object throw a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;typeerror"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code> exception&#59; otherwise&#44; if the new value is null or a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;date&#45;4"></a><code>[Date](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-date-objects)</code> object representing the NaN time value&#44; then set the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;12"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element to the empty string&#59; otherwise&#44; run the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;date&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a <code>Date</code> object to a string](#concept-input-value-date-string)&#44; as defined for that state&#44; on the new value&#44; and set the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;13"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element to the resulting string&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber"></a><strong><code>valueAsNumber</code></strong> IDL attribute represents the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;14"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element&#44; interpreted as a number&#46;

On getting&#44; if the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code> attribute <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;5"></a>[does not apply](#do-not-apply)&#44; as defined for the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;4"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s current state&#44; then return a Not&#45;a&#45;Number &#40;NaN&#41; value&#46; Otherwise&#44; run the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;number"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a number](#concept-input-value-string-number) defined for that state to the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;15"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#59; if the algorithm returned a number&#44; then return it&#44; otherwise&#44; return a Not&#45;a&#45;Number &#40;NaN&#41; value&#46;

On setting&#44; if the new value is infinite&#44; then throw a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;typeerror&#45;2"></a><code>[TypeError](https://tc39.es/ecma262/#sec-native-error-types-used-in-this-standard-typeerror)</code> exception&#46; Otherwise&#44; if the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;valueasnumber&#45;2"></a><code>[valueAsNumber](#dom-input-valueasnumber)</code> attribute <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;6"></a>[does not apply](#do-not-apply)&#44; as defined for the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;5"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s current state&#44; then throw an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;8"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;10"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46; Otherwise&#44; if the new value is a Not&#45;a&#45;Number &#40;NaN&#41; value&#44; then set the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;16"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element to the empty string&#46; Otherwise&#44; run the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;number&#45;string"></a>[algorithm to convert a number to a string](#concept-input-value-number-string)&#44; as defined for that state&#44; on the new value&#44; and set the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;17"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element to the resulting string&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><strong><code>stepDown&#40;<var>n</var>&#41;</code></strong> and <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><strong><code>stepUp&#40;<var>n</var>&#41;</code></strong> methods&#44; when invoked&#44; must run the following algorithm&#58;

1.  If the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code> and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> methods <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;7"></a>[do not apply](#do-not-apply)&#44; as defined for the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;6"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s current state&#44; then throw an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;9"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;11"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If the element has no <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step"></a>[allowed value step](#concept-input-step)&#44; then throw an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;10"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;12"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

3.  If the element has a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min) and a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max) and the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;2"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min) is greater than the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;2"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max)&#44; then return&#46;

4.  If the element has a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;3"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min) and a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;3"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max) and there is no value greater than or equal to the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;4"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min) and less than or equal to the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;4"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max) that&#44; when subtracted from the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;zero"></a>[step base](#concept-input-min-zero)&#44; is an integral multiple of the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;2"></a>[allowed value step](#concept-input-step)&#44; then return&#46;

5.  If applying the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;string&#45;number&#45;2"></a>[algorithm to convert a string to a number](#concept-input-value-string-number) to the string given by the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;18"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) does not result in an error&#44; then let <var>value</var> be the result of that algorithm&#46; Otherwise&#44; let <var>value</var> be zero&#46;

6.  Let <var>valueBeforeStepping</var> be <var>value</var>&#46;

7.  If <var>value</var> subtracted from the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;zero&#45;2"></a>[step base](#concept-input-min-zero) is not an integral multiple of the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;3"></a>[allowed value step](#concept-input-step)&#44; then set <var>value</var> to the nearest value that&#44; when subtracted from the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;zero&#45;3"></a>[step base](#concept-input-min-zero)&#44; is an integral multiple of the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;4"></a>[allowed value step](#concept-input-step)&#44; and that is less than <var>value</var> if the method invoked was the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown&#45;2"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code> method&#44; and more than <var>value</var> otherwise&#46;

    Otherwise &#40;<var>value</var> subtracted from the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;zero&#45;4"></a>[step base](#concept-input-min-zero) is an integral multiple of the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;5"></a>[allowed value step](#concept-input-step)&#41;&#58;

    1.  Let <var>n</var> be the argument&#46;

    2.  Let <var>delta</var> be the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;6"></a>[allowed value step](#concept-input-step) multiplied by <var>n</var>&#46;

    3.  If the method invoked was the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown&#45;3"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code> method&#44; negate <var>delta</var>&#46;

    4.  Let <var>value</var> be the result of adding <var>delta</var> to <var>value</var>&#46;

8.  If the element has a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;5"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min)&#44; and <var>value</var> is less than that <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;6"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min)&#44; then set <var>value</var> to the smallest value that&#44; when subtracted from the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;zero&#45;5"></a>[step base](#concept-input-min-zero)&#44; is an integral multiple of the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;7"></a>[allowed value step](#concept-input-step)&#44; and that is more than or equal to that <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;7"></a>[minimum](#concept-input-min)&#46;

9.  If the element has a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;5"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max)&#44; and <var>value</var> is greater than that <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;6"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max)&#44; then set <var>value</var> to the largest value that&#44; when subtracted from the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;min&#45;zero&#45;6"></a>[step base](#concept-input-min-zero)&#44; is an integral multiple of the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;step&#45;8"></a>[allowed value step](#concept-input-step)&#44; and that is less than or equal to that <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;max&#45;7"></a>[maximum](#concept-input-max)&#46;

10. If either the method invoked was the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepdown&#45;4"></a><code>[stepDown&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepdown)</code> method and <var>value</var> is greater than <var>valueBeforeStepping</var>&#44; or the method invoked was the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup&#45;2"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> method and <var>value</var> is less than <var>valueBeforeStepping</var>&#44; then return&#46;

    <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

    This ensures that invoking the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;input&#45;stepup&#45;3"></a><code>[stepUp&#40;&#41;](#dom-input-stepup)</code> method on the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element in the following example does not change the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;19"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of that element&#58;

    ``` text
    <input type=number value=1 max=0>
    ```

11. Let <var>value as string</var> be the result of running the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;value&#45;number&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[algorithm to convert a number to a string](#concept-input-value-number-string)&#44; as defined for the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;7"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s current state&#44; on <var>value</var>&#46;

12. Set the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;20"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the element to <var>value as string</var>&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;list"></a><strong><code>list</code></strong> IDL attribute must return the current <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;list"></a>[suggestions source element](#concept-input-list)&#44; if any&#44; or null otherwise&#46;

[HTMLInputElement&#47;showPicker](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLInputElement/showPicker)

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;htmlinputelement"></a><code>[HTMLInputElement](#htmlinputelement)</code> <a id="dom&#45;input&#45;showpicker"></a><strong><code>showPicker&#40;&#41;</code></strong> and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;htmlselectelement"></a><code>[HTMLSelectElement](#htmlselectelement)</code> <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;showpicker"></a><strong><code>showPicker&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is not <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;2"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; then throw an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;11"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;13"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  If <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;settings&#45;object&#45;origin"></a>[origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-settings-object-origin) is not <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;same&#45;origin"></a>[same origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#same-origin) with <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;relevant&#45;settings&#45;object&#45;2"></a>[relevant settings object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#relevant-settings-object)&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;environment&#45;top&#45;level&#45;origin"></a>[top&#45;level origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-environment-top-level-origin)&#44; and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; or <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;8"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is not in the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#45;2"></a>[File Upload](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) state or <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Color](#color-state-(type=color)) state&#44; then throw a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;securityerror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;14"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#45;3"></a>[File](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;&#45;3"></a>[Color](#color-state-(type=color)) inputs are exempted from this check for historical reason&#58; their <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior) also shows their pickers&#44; and has never been guarded by an origin check&#46;

3.  If <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global) does not have <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;transient&#45;activation&#45;2"></a>[transient activation](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#transient-activation)&#44; then throw a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;notallowederror&#45;2"></a>[&#34;<code>NotAllowedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notallowederror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;15"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

4.  If <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is not <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#44; then throw a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;notsupportederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;domexception&#45;16"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

5.  <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;show&#45;the&#45;picker&#44;&#45;if&#45;applicable"></a>[Show the picker&#44; if applicable](#show-the-picker,-if-applicable)&#44; for <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

To <a id="show&#45;the&#45;picker&#44;&#45;if&#45;applicable"></a><strong>show the picker&#44; if applicable</strong> for an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> or <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>element</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;2"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global) does not have <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;transient&#45;activation&#45;3"></a>[transient activation](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#transient-activation)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var> is not <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;3"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;consume&#45;user&#45;activation"></a>[Consume user activation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#consume-user-activation) given <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;relevant&#45;global&#45;3"></a>[relevant global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-relevant-global)&#46;

4.  If <var>element</var> does not <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;input&#45;support&#45;picker&#45;2"></a>[support a picker](#input-support-picker)&#44; then return&#46;

5.  If <var>element</var> is an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element and <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;9"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;&#45;4"></a>[File Upload](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) state&#44; then run these steps <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;in&#45;parallel"></a>[in parallel](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#in-parallel)&#58;

    1.  Optionally&#44; wait until any prior execution of this algorithm has terminated&#46;

    2.  Let <var>dismissed</var> be the result of <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;webdriver&#45;bidi&#45;file&#45;dialog&#45;opened"></a>[WebDriver BiDi file dialog opened](https://w3c.github.io/webdriver-bidi/#webdriver-bidi-file-dialog-opened) with <var>element</var>&#46;

    3.  If <var>dismissed</var> is false&#58;

        1.  Display a prompt to the user requesting that the user specify some files&#46; If the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;multiple"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-input-multiple)</code> attribute is not set on <var>element</var>&#44; there must be no more than one file selected&#59; otherwise&#44; any number may be selected&#46; Files can be from the filesystem or created on the fly&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; a picture taken from a camera connected to the user&#39;s device&#46;

        2.  Wait for the user to have made their selection&#46;

    4.  If <var>dismissed</var> is true or if the user dismissed the prompt without changing their selection&#44; then <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given <var>element</var> to <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;event&#45;cancel"></a><code>[cancel](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-cancel)</code> at <var>element</var>&#44; with the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

    5.  Otherwise&#44; <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;update&#45;the&#45;file&#45;selection"></a>[update the file selection](#update-the-file-selection) for <var>element</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    As with all user interface specifications&#44; user agents have a good deal of freedom in how they interpret these requirements&#46; The above text implies that a user either dismisses the prompt or changes their selection&#59; exactly one of these will be true&#46; But the mapping of these possibilities to specific user interface elements is not mandated by the standard&#46; For example&#44; a user agent might interpret clicking the &#34;Cancel&#34; button when files were previously selected as a change of selection to select zero files&#44; thus firing <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code>&#46; Or it might interpret such a click as a dismissal that leaves the selection unchanged&#44; thus firing <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;event&#45;cancel&#45;2"></a><code>[cancel](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-cancel)</code>&#46; Similarly&#44; it&#39;s up to the user agent whether re&#45;selecting the same files as were previously selected counts as a dismissal&#44; or as a change of selection&#46;

6.  Otherwise&#44; the user agent should show the relevant user interface for selecting a value for <var>element</var>&#44; in the way it normally would when the user interacts with the control&#46;

    When showing such a user interface&#44; it must respect the requirements stated in the relevant parts of the specification for how <var>element</var> behaves given its <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;10"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute state&#46; &#40;For example&#44; various sections describe restrictions on the resulting <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;21"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) string&#46;&#41;

    This step can have side effects&#44; such as closing other pickers that were previously shown by this algorithm&#46; &#40;If this closes a file selection picker&#44; then per the above that will lead to firing either <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;event&#45;input&#45;2"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;event&#45;change&#45;2"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events&#44; or a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;apis&#58;event&#45;cancel&#45;3"></a><code>[cancel](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-cancel)</code> event&#46;&#41;

##### <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events"></a>4&#46;10&#46;5&#46;5 Common event behaviors[](#common-input-element-events)

When the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> events <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply) &#40;which is the case for all <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> controls other than <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;button"></a>[buttons](#concept-button) and those with the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;"></a>[Hidden](#hidden-state-(type=hidden)) state&#41;&#44; the events are fired to indicate that the user has interacted with the control&#46; The <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;input&#45;2"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> event fires whenever the user has modified the data of the control&#46; The <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;change&#45;2"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> event fires when the value is committed&#44; if that makes sense for the control&#44; or else when the control [loses focus](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#unfocus-causes-change-event)&#46; In all cases&#44; the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;input&#45;3"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> event comes before the corresponding <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;change&#45;3"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> event &#40;if any&#41;&#46;

When an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element has a defined <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior)&#44; the rules for dispatching these events&#44; if they <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;2"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#44; are given in the section above that defines the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute&#39;s state&#46; &#40;This is the case for all <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> controls with the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;"></a>[Checkbox](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)) state&#44; the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;"></a>[Radio Button](#radio-button-state-(type=radio)) state&#44; or the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;"></a>[File Upload](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) state&#46;&#41;

For <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements without a defined <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior&#45;2"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior)&#44; but to which these events <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;3"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#44; and for which the user interface involves both interactive manipulation and an explicit commit action&#44; then when the user changes the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; the user agent must <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element to <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;input&#45;4"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#44; and any time the user commits the change&#44; the user agent must <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element to set its <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;user&#45;validity"></a>[user validity](#user-validity) to true and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;change&#45;4"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> at the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;2"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

An example of a user interface involving both interactive manipulation and a commit action would be a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;"></a>[Range](#range-state-(type=range)) controls that use a slider&#44; when manipulated using a pointing device&#46; While the user is dragging the control&#39;s knob&#44; <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;input&#45;5"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> events would fire whenever the position changed&#44; whereas the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;change&#45;5"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> event would only fire when the user let go of the knob&#44; committing to a specific value&#46;

For <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements without a defined <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior&#45;3"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior)&#44; but to which these events <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;4"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#44; and for which the user interface involves an explicit commit action but no intermediate manipulation&#44; then any time the user commits a change to the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; the user agent must <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;3"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source&#45;3"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element to first <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;3"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;input&#45;6"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;3"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed&#45;2"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#44; and then <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;4"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;change&#45;6"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> at the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;4"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

An example of a user interface with a commit action would be a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;color&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;color&#41;"></a>[Color](#color-state-(type=color)) control that consists of a single button that brings up a color wheel&#58; if the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) only changes when the dialog is closed&#44; then that would be the explicit commit action&#46; On the other hand&#44; if manipulating the control changes the color interactively&#44; then there might be no commit action&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Another example of a user interface with a commit action would be a <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;"></a>[Date](#date-state-(type=date)) control that allows both text&#45;based user input and user selection from a drop&#45;down calendar&#58; while text input might not have an explicit commit step&#44; selecting a date from the drop down calendar and then dismissing the drop down would be a commit action&#46;

For <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements without a defined <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;input&#45;activation&#45;behavior&#45;4"></a>[input activation behavior](#input-activation-behavior)&#44; but to which these events <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply&#45;5"></a>[apply](#concept-input-apply)&#44; any time the user causes the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) to change without an explicit commit action&#44; the user agent must <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;4"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source&#45;4"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element to <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;5"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;input&#45;7"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;5"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed&#45;3"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#46; The corresponding <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;change&#45;7"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> event&#44; if any&#44; will be fired when the control [loses focus](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#unfocus-causes-change-event)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Examples of a user changing the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) would include the user typing into a text control&#44; pasting a new value into the control&#44; or undoing an edit in that control&#46; Some user interactions do not cause changes to the value&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; hitting the &#34;delete&#34; key in an empty text control&#44; or replacing some text in the control with text from the clipboard that happens to be exactly the same text&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

A <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;range&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;range&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Range](#range-state-(type=range)) control in the form of a slider that the user has <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;focused"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused) and is interacting with using a keyboard would be another example of the user changing the element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) without a commit step&#46;

In the case of <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[tasks](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task) that just fire an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;input&#45;8"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> event&#44; user agents may wait for a suitable break in the user&#39;s interaction before <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;5"></a>[queuing](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) the tasks&#59; for example&#44; a user agent could wait for the user to have not hit a key for 100ms&#44; so as to only fire the event when the user pauses&#44; instead of continuously for each keystroke&#46;

When the user agent is to change an <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) on behalf of the user &#40;e&#46;g&#46; as part of a form prefilling feature&#41;&#44; the user agent must <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;6"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source&#45;5"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element to first update the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;8"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) accordingly&#44; then <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;6"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;input&#45;9"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;6"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed&#45;4"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#44; then <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;7"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;event&#45;change&#45;8"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> at the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;7"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

These events are not fired in response to changes made to the values of form controls by scripts&#46; &#40;This is to make it easier to update the values of form controls in response to the user manipulating the controls&#44; without having to then filter out the script&#39;s own changes to avoid an infinite loop&#46;&#41;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

These events are also not fired when the browser changes the values of form controls as part of <a id="common&#45;input&#45;element&#45;events&#58;restore&#45;persisted&#45;state"></a>[state restoration during navigation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#restore-persisted-state)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;categories"></a>[Categories](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-categories)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;flow&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Flow content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#flow-content-2)&#46;

<a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#46;

<a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;interactive&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Interactive content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#interactive-content-2)&#46;

<a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;category&#45;listed"></a>[Listed](#category-listed)&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;category&#45;label"></a>[labelable](#category-label)&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;category&#45;submit"></a>[submittable](#category-submit)&#44; and <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;category&#45;autocapitalize"></a>[autocapitalize&#45;and&#45;autocorrect inheriting](#category-autocapitalize) <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated element](#form-associated-element)&#46;

<a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;palpable&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Palpable content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#palpable-content-2)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a>[Contexts in which this element can be used](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-contexts)&#58;</strong>

Where <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2) is expected&#46;

As the first child of a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a>[Content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-content-model)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[Phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#44; but there must be no <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;interactive&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[interactive content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#interactive-content-2) descendant and no descendant with the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tabindex"></a><code>[tabindex](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-tabindex)</code> attribute specified&#46; If the element is the first child of a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; then it may also have one descendant <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;selectedcontent&#45;element"></a><code>[selectedcontent](#the-selectedcontent-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

Neither tag is omissible&#46;

<a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code> — <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;navigable"></a>[Navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigable) for <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;form&#45;submission&#45;2&#45;5"></a>[form submission](#form-submission-2)

<a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;popovertargetaction"></a><code>[popovertargetaction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popovertargetaction)</code> — Indicates whether a targeted popover element is to be toggled&#44; shown&#44; or hidden
