``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLButtonElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute DOMString command;
  [CEReactions, Reflect="commandfor"] attribute Element? commandForElement;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean disabled;
  readonly attribute HTMLFormElement? form;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute USVString formAction;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString formEnctype;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString formMethod;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean formNoValidate;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString formTarget;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString name;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute DOMString type;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString value;

  readonly attribute boolean willValidate;
  readonly attribute ValidityState validity;
  readonly attribute DOMString validationMessage;
  boolean checkValidity();
  boolean reportValidity();
  undefined setCustomValidity(DOMString error);

  readonly attribute NodeList labels;
};
HTMLButtonElement includes PopoverTargetAttributes;
```

The <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element"></a><code>[button](#the-button-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a button labeled by its contents&#46;

The element is a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;button"></a>[button](#concept-button)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;button&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> attribute controls the behavior of the button when it is activated&#46; It is an <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th> Keyword      </th><th> State      </th><th> Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="button/type" id="attr-button-type-submit" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>submit</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-button-type-submit-state">Submit Button</dfn>      </td><td>Submits the form&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="button/type" id="attr-button-type-reset" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>reset</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-button-type-reset-state">Reset Button</dfn>      </td><td>Resets the form&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="button/type" id="attr-button-type-button" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>button</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-button-type-button-state">Button</dfn>      </td><td>Does nothing&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;auto&#45;state"></a><strong>Auto</strong> state&#46;

A <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[button](#the-button-element)</code> element is said to be a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button) if any of the following are true&#58;

- the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-button-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;auto&#45;state"></a>[Auto](#attr-button-type-auto-state) state&#44; both the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;2"></a><code>[command](#attr-button-command)</code> and <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;commandfor&#45;3"></a><code>[commandfor](#attr-button-commandfor)</code> content attributes are not present&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;parent"></a>[parent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-parent) node is not a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#59; or

- the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-button-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;submit&#45;state"></a>[Submit Button](#attr-button-type-submit-state) state&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If the element is not a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;2"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button)&#44; the element is <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;barred&#45;from&#45;constraint&#45;validation"></a>[barred from constraint validation](#barred-from-constraint-validation)&#46;

If a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[button](#the-button-element)</code> element is the first <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;tree&#45;child"></a>[child](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-child) which is an <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;element"></a>[element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element) of a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; then it is <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;inert"></a>[inert](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#inert)&#46;

If specified&#44; the <a id="attr&#45;button&#45;commandfor"></a><strong><code>commandfor</code></strong> attribute value must be the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;id"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) of an element in the same <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;tree"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree) as the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;button&#45;2"></a>[button](#concept-button) with the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;commandfor&#45;4"></a><code>[commandfor](#attr-button-commandfor)</code> attribute&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;button&#45;command"></a><strong><code>command</code></strong> attribute is an <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[enumerated attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/command" id="attr-button-command-toggle-popover" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>toggle&#45;popover</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-button-command-toggle-popover-state">Toggle Popover</dfn>      </td><td>Shows or hides the targeted <code id="the-button-element:attr-popover"><a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popover">popover</a></code> element&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/command" id="attr-button-command-show-popover" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>show&#45;popover</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-button-command-show-popover-state">Show Popover</dfn>      </td><td>Shows the targeted <code id="the-button-element:attr-popover-2"><a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popover">popover</a></code> element&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/command" id="attr-button-command-hide-popover" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>hide&#45;popover</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-button-command-hide-popover-state">Hide Popover</dfn>      </td><td>Hides the targeted <code id="the-button-element:attr-popover-3"><a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popover">popover</a></code> element&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/command" id="attr-button-command-close" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>close</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-button-command-close-state">Close</dfn>      </td><td>Closes the targeted <code id="the-button-element:the-dialog-element"><a href="html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-dialog-element">dialog</a></code> element&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/command" id="attr-button-command-request-close" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>request&#45;close</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-button-command-request-close-state">Request Close</dfn>      </td><td>Requests to close the targeted <code id="the-button-element:the-dialog-element-2"><a href="html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-dialog-element">dialog</a></code> element&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="html-global/command" id="attr-button-command-show-modal" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>show&#45;modal</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-button-command-show-modal-state">Show Modal</dfn>      </td><td>Opens the targeted <code id="the-button-element:the-dialog-element-3"><a href="html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-dialog-element">dialog</a></code> element as modal&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td>A <a href="#attr-button-command-custom" id="the-button-element:attr-button-command-custom">custom command keyword</a>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-button-command-custom-state">Custom</dfn>      </td><td>Only dispatches the <code id="the-button-element:event-command"><a href="https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-command">command</a></code> event on the targeted      element&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default&#45;2"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default&#45;2"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;unknown&#45;state"></a><strong>Unknown</strong> state&#46;

A <a id="attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;custom"></a><strong>custom command keyword</strong> is a string that <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;starts&#45;with"></a>[starts with](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-starts-with) &#34;<code>&#45;&#45;</code>&#34;&#46;

To <a id="determine&#45;if&#45;command&#45;is&#45;valid"></a><strong>determine if a command is valid for a target</strong> given a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;3"></a><code>[command](#attr-button-command)</code> attribute <var>command</var> and an element <var>target</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;unknown&#45;state"></a>[Unknown](#attr-button-command-unknown-state) state&#44; then return false&#46;

2.  If <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;custom&#45;state"></a>[Custom](#attr-button-command-custom-state) state&#44; then return true&#46;

3.  If <var>target</var> is not an <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;html&#45;elements"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements)&#44; then return false&#46;

4.  If <var>command</var> is in any of the following states&#58;

    - <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;toggle&#45;popover&#45;state"></a>[Toggle Popover](#attr-button-command-toggle-popover-state)

    - <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;show&#45;popover&#45;state"></a>[Show Popover](#attr-button-command-show-popover-state)

    - <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;hide&#45;popover&#45;state"></a>[Hide Popover](#attr-button-command-hide-popover-state)

    then return true&#46;

5.  If this standard does not define <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;is&#45;valid&#45;command&#45;steps"></a>[is valid command steps](#is-valid-command-steps) for <var>target</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;local&#45;name"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-local-name)&#44; then return false&#46;

6.  Otherwise&#44; return the result of running <var>target</var>&#39;s corresponding <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;is&#45;valid&#45;command&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[is valid command steps](#is-valid-command-steps) given <var>command</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The intent is to avoid dispatching a command event on an element type that does not support that command&#46;

However&#44; element state is not considered&#46; If an element can support a particular command&#44; the event is dispatched&#44; even if that element is in a state where it cannot execute that command&#46;

This means&#44; for example&#44; that command events are dispatched for popover commands on all <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[HTML elements](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements)&#44; even if they do not have a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;popover&#45;4"></a><code>[popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popover)</code> attribute&#46;

A <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[button](#the-button-element)</code> element <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;activation&#45;behaviour"></a>[activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior) given <var>event</var> is&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> is <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document) is not <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;fully&#45;active"></a>[fully active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fully-active)&#44; then return&#46;

3.  If <var>element</var> has a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#58;

    1.  If <var>element</var> is a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;3"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button)&#44; then <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;submit"></a>[submit](#concept-form-submit) <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) from <var>element</var> with <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;submit&#45;user&#45;involvement"></a><em>[userInvolvement](#submit-user-involvement)</em> set to <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;event&#45;uni"></a>[user navigation involvement](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-uni)&#44; and return&#46;

    2.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;4"></a><code>[type](#attr-button-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;reset&#45;state"></a>[Reset Button](#attr-button-type-reset-state) state&#44; then <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset"></a>[reset](#concept-form-reset) <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;3"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#44; and return&#46;

    3.  If <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;5"></a><code>[type](#attr-button-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;auto&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Auto](#attr-button-type-auto-state) state&#44; then return&#46;

4.  Let <var>target</var> be the result of running <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;associated&#45;element"></a>[get the <code>commandfor</code>&#45;associated element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-associated-element)&#46;

5.  If <var>target</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  Let <var>command</var> be <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;4"></a><code>[command](#attr-button-command)</code> attribute&#46;

    2.  If the result of <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;determine&#45;if&#45;command&#45;is&#45;valid"></a>[determining if a command is valid for a target](#determine-if-command-is-valid) given <var>command</var> and <var>target</var> is false&#44; then return&#46;

    3.  Let <var>continue</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[firing an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;event&#45;command&#45;2"></a><code>[command](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-command)</code> at <var>target</var>&#44; using <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;commandevent"></a><code>[CommandEvent](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#commandevent)</code>&#44; with its <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;commandevent&#45;command"></a><code>[command](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-commandevent-command)</code> attribute initialized to <var>command</var>&#44; its <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;commandevent&#45;source"></a><code>[source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-commandevent-source)</code> attribute initialized to <var>element</var>&#44; and its <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;cancelable"></a><code>[cancelable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

        [DOM standard issue &#35;1328](https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/1328) tracks how to better standardize associated event data in a way which makes sense on Events&#46; Currently an event attribute initialized to a value cannot also have a getter&#44; and so an internal slot &#40;or map of additional fields&#41; is required to properly specify this&#46;

    4.  If <var>continue</var> is false&#44; then return&#46;

    5.  If <var>target</var> is not <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;connected"></a>[connected](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#connected)&#44; then return&#46;

    6.  If <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;custom&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Custom](#attr-button-command-custom-state) state&#44; then return&#46;

    7.  If <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;hide&#45;popover&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Hide Popover](#attr-button-command-hide-popover-state) state&#58;

        1.  Let <var>validity</var> be the result of running <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;check&#45;popover&#45;validity"></a>[check popover validity](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#check-popover-validity) given <var>target</var>&#44; true&#44; and null&#46; If this throws an exception&#44; catch it&#44; and let <var>validity</var> be false&#46;

        2.  If <var>validity</var> is true&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;hide&#45;popover&#45;algorithm"></a>[hide popover algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#hide-popover-algorithm) given <var>target</var>&#44; true&#44; true&#44; false&#44; and <var>element</var>&#46;

    8.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;toggle&#45;popover&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Toggle Popover](#attr-button-command-toggle-popover-state) state&#58;

        1.  Let <var>validity</var> be the result of running <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;check&#45;popover&#45;validity&#45;2"></a>[check popover validity](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#check-popover-validity) given <var>target</var>&#44; false&#44; and null&#46; If this throws an exception&#44; catch it&#44; and let <var>validity</var> be false&#46;

        2.  If <var>validity</var> is true&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;show&#45;popover"></a>[show popover algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#show-popover) given <var>target</var>&#44; false&#44; and <var>element</var>&#46;

        3.  Otherwise&#58;

            1.  Let <var>validity</var> be the result of running <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;check&#45;popover&#45;validity&#45;3"></a>[check popover validity](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#check-popover-validity) given <var>target</var>&#44; true&#44; and null&#46; If this throws an exception&#44; catch it&#44; and let <var>validity</var> be false&#46;

            2.  If <var>validity</var> is true&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;hide&#45;popover&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[hide popover algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#hide-popover-algorithm) given <var>target</var>&#44; true&#44; true&#44; false&#44; and <var>element</var>&#46;

    9.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;show&#45;popover&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Show Popover](#attr-button-command-show-popover-state) state&#58;

        1.  Let <var>validity</var> be the result of running <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;check&#45;popover&#45;validity&#45;4"></a>[check popover validity](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#check-popover-validity) given <var>target</var>&#44; false&#44; and null&#46; If this throws an exception&#44; catch it&#44; and let <var>validity</var> be false&#46;

        2.  If <var>validity</var> is true&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;show&#45;popover&#45;2"></a>[show popover algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#show-popover) given <var>target</var>&#44; false&#44; and <var>element</var>&#46;

    10. Otherwise&#44; if this standard defines <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;command&#45;steps"></a>[command steps](#command-steps) for <var>target</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;local&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-local-name)&#44; then run the corresponding <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;command&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[command steps](#command-steps) given <var>target</var>&#44; <var>element</var>&#44; and <var>command</var>&#46;

6.  Otherwise&#44; run the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;popover&#45;target&#45;attribute&#45;activation&#45;behavior"></a>[popover target attribute activation behavior](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#popover-target-attribute-activation-behavior) given <var>element</var> and <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;target"></a>[target](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#event-target)&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;html&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[HTML element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-elements) can have specific <a id="is&#45;valid&#45;command&#45;steps"></a><strong>is valid command steps</strong> and <a id="command&#45;steps"></a><strong>command steps</strong> defined for the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;local&#45;name&#45;3"></a>[local name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-local-name)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#attr-fae-form)</code> attribute is used to explicitly associate the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[button](#the-button-element)</code> element with its <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;4"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute represents the element&#39;s name&#46; The <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-fe-disabled)</code> attribute is used to make the control non&#45;interactive and to prevent its value from being submitted&#46; The <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction&#45;3"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype&#45;2"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod&#45;2"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate&#45;2"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget&#45;2"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code> attributes are <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attributes&#45;for&#45;form&#45;submission"></a>[attributes for form submission](#attributes-for-form-submission)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate&#45;3"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code> attribute can be used to make submit buttons that do not trigger the constraint validation&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction&#45;4"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype&#45;3"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod&#45;3"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate&#45;4"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget&#45;3"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code> must not be specified if the element is not a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;4"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;button&#45;command"></a><strong><code>command</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>command</var> be <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;5"></a><code>[command](#attr-button-command)</code> attribute&#46;

2.  If <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;custom&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[Custom](#attr-button-command-custom-state) state&#44; then return <var>command</var>&#39;s value&#46;

3.  If <var>command</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;unknown&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Unknown](#attr-button-command-unknown-state) state&#44; then return the empty string&#46;

4.  Return the keyword corresponding to the value of <var>command</var>&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;button&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> attribute gives the element&#39;s value for the purposes of form submission&#46; The element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) is the value of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#attr-button-value)</code> attribute&#44; if there is one&#59; otherwise the empty string&#46; The element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;optional&#45;value"></a>[optional value](#concept-fe-optional-value) is the value of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;value&#45;3"></a><code>[value](#attr-button-value)</code> attribute&#44; if there is one&#59; otherwise null&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

A button &#40;and its value&#41; is only included in the form submission if the button itself was used to initiate the form submission&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="dom&#45;button&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;5"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button)&#44; then return &#34;<code>submit</code>&#34;&#46;

2.  Let <var>state</var> be <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;6"></a><code>[type](#attr-button-type)</code> attribute&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>state</var> is not in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;submit&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Submit Button](#attr-button-type-submit-state) state&#46;

4.  If <var>state</var> is in the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;type&#45;auto&#45;state&#45;3"></a>[Auto](#attr-button-type-auto-state) state&#44; then return &#34;<code>button</code>&#34;&#46;

5.  Return the keyword value corresponding to <var>state</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;willvalidate&#45;2"></a><code>[willValidate](#dom-cva-willvalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validity&#45;2"></a><code>[validity](#dom-cva-validity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validationmessage&#45;2"></a><code>[validationMessage](#dom-cva-validationmessage)</code> IDL attributes&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;checkvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[checkValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-checkvalidity)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;reportvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[reportValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-reportvalidity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[setCustomValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity)</code> methods&#44; are part of the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api"></a>[constraint validation API](#the-constraint-validation-api)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels&#45;2"></a><code>[labels](#dom-lfe-labels)</code> IDL attribute provides a list of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code>s&#46; The <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;button&#45;disabled"></a><code>[disabled](#dom-button-disabled)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#dom-fae-form)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;button&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#dom-button-name)</code> IDL attributes are part of the element&#39;s forms API&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following button is labeled &#34;Show hint&#34; and pops up a dialog box when activated&#58;

``` text
<button type=button
        onclick="alert('This 15-20 minute piece was composed by George Gershwin.')">
 Show hint
</button>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following shows how <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;button&#45;3"></a>[buttons](#concept-button) can use <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;commandfor&#45;5"></a><code>[commandfor](#attr-button-commandfor)</code> to show and hide an element with the <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;popover&#45;5"></a><code>[popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#attr-popover)</code> attribute when activated&#58;

``` text
<button type=button
        commandfor="the-popover"
        command="show-popover">
 Show menu
</button>
<div popover
     id="the-popover">
 <button commandfor="the-popover"
         command="hide-popover">
  Hide menu
 </button>
</div>
    
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following shows how buttons can use <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;commandfor&#45;6"></a><code>[commandfor](#attr-button-commandfor)</code> with a <a id="the&#45;button&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;button&#45;command&#45;custom&#45;2"></a>[custom command keyword](#attr-button-command-custom) on an element&#44; demonstrating how one could use custom commands for unspecified behavior&#58;

``` text
<button type=button
        commandfor="the-image"
        command="--rotate-landscape">
 Rotate Left
</button>
<button type=button
        commandfor="the-image"
        command="--rotate-portrait">
 Rotate Right
</button>
<img id="the-image"
     src="photo.jpg">
<script>
  const image = document.getElementById("the-image");
  image.addEventListener("command", (event) => {
   if ( event.command == "--rotate-landscape" ) {
    event.target.style.rotate = "-90deg"
   } else if ( event.command == "--rotate-portrait" ) {
    event.target.style.rotate = "0deg"
   }
  });
</script>
    
```

[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLSelectElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute DOMString autocomplete;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean disabled;
  readonly attribute HTMLFormElement? form;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean multiple;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString name;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean required;
  [CEReactions, Reflect, ReflectDefault=0] attribute unsigned long size;
  

  readonly attribute DOMString type;

  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLOptionsCollection options;
  [CEReactions] attribute unsigned long length;
  getter HTMLOptionElement? item(unsigned long index);
  HTMLOptionElement? namedItem(DOMString name);
  [CEReactions] undefined add((HTMLOptionElement or HTMLOptGroupElement) element, optional (HTMLElement or long)? before = null);
  [CEReactions] undefined remove(); // ChildNode overload
  [CEReactions] undefined remove(long index);
  [CEReactions] setter undefined (unsigned long index, HTMLOptionElement? option);

  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection selectedOptions;
  [CEReactions] attribute long selectedIndex;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString value;

  readonly attribute boolean willValidate;
  readonly attribute ValidityState validity;
  readonly attribute DOMString validationMessage;
  boolean checkValidity();
  boolean reportValidity();
  undefined setCustomValidity(DOMString error);

  undefined showPicker();

  readonly attribute NodeList labels;
};

The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element represents a control for selecting amongst a set of options&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Attributes&#47;multiple](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/multiple)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari3&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;select&#45;multiple"></a><strong><code>multiple</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; If the attribute is present&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for selecting zero or more options from the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list)&#46; If the attribute is absent&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;represents&#45;2"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a control for selecting a single option from the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list)&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Attributes&#47;size](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/size)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari3&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;select&#45;size"></a><strong><code>size</code></strong> attribute gives the number of options to show to the user&#46; The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;size&#45;3"></a><code>[size](#attr-select-size)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer) greater than zero&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Attributes&#47;required](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/required)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox4&#43;Safari5&#46;1&#43;Chrome10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;select&#45;required"></a><strong><code>required</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; When specified&#44; the user will be required to select a value before submitting the form&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#attr-fae-form)</code> attribute is used to explicitly associate the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element with its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute represents the element&#39;s name&#46; The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-fe-disabled)</code> attribute is used to make the control non&#45;interactive and to prevent its value from being submitted&#46; The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;2"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute controls how the user agent provides autofill behavior&#46;

If a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element has a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;required&#45;2"></a><code>[required](#attr-select-required)</code> attribute specified&#44; and has a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;size"></a>[display size](#concept-select-size) of 1&#59; and if the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-option-value) of the first <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element in the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;3"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) &#40;if any&#41; is the empty string&#44; and that <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element does not have an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;ancestor"></a>[ancestor](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-ancestor) <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> in between itself and the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; then that <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> is the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="placeholder&#45;label&#45;option"></a><strong>placeholder label option</strong>&#46;

If a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element has a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;required&#45;3"></a><code>[required](#attr-select-required)</code> attribute specified&#44; does not have a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;3"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute specified&#44; and has a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;size&#45;2"></a>[display size](#concept-select-size) of 1&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element must have a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;placeholder&#45;label&#45;option"></a>[placeholder label option](#placeholder-label-option)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In practice&#44; the requirement stated in the paragraph above can only apply when a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element does not have a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;size&#45;4"></a><code>[size](#attr-select-size)</code> attribute with a value greater than 1&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If the element has its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;required&#45;4"></a><code>[required](#attr-select-required)</code> attribute specified&#44; and either none of the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements in the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;4"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) have their <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) set to true&#44; or the only <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element in the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;5"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) with its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;2"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) set to true is the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;placeholder&#45;label&#45;option&#45;2"></a>[placeholder label option](#placeholder-label-option)&#44; then the element is <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;missing"></a>[suffering from being missing](#suffering-from-being-missing)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset&#45;control"></a>[reset algorithm](#concept-form-reset-control) for a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>selectElement</var> is&#58;

1.  Set <var>selectElement</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;user&#45;validity"></a>[user validity](#user-validity) to false&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;list&#45;iterate"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>optionElement</var> of <var>selectElement</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;6"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list)&#58;

    1.  If <var>optionElement</var> has a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>optionElement</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;3"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to true&#59; otherwise set it to false&#46;

    2.  Set <var>optionElement</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;dirtiness"></a>[dirtiness](#concept-option-dirtiness) to false&#46;

3.  Run the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;selectedness&#45;setting&#45;algorithm"></a>[selectedness setting algorithm](#selectedness-setting-algorithm) given <var>selectElement</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;update&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements"></a>[Update a <code>select</code>&#39;s descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements](#update-a-select's-descendant-selectedcontent-elements) given <var>selectElement</var>&#46;

A <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element that is not <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled) is <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The user agent should allow the user to pick an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element from a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element in its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;7"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) &#40;either through a click&#44; or through unfocusing the element after changing its value&#44; or through a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command"></a>[menu command](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#using-the-option-element-to-define-a-command)&#44; or through any other mechanism&#41; by running the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;pick"></a>[pick an option](#concept-select-pick) algorithm given the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; and if the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;select&#39;s&#45;options&#45;are&#45;being&#45;rendered&#45;with&#45;base&#45;appearance"></a>[<code>select</code>&#39;s contents are being rendered with base appearance](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#select's-options-are-being-rendered-with-base-appearance)&#44; a corresponding <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;event&#45;keydown"></a><code>[keydown](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-keydown)</code> or <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;event&#45;mouseup"></a><code>[mouseup](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#mouseup)</code> event&#44; otherwise null&#46;

To <a id="concept&#45;select&#45;pick"></a><strong>pick an option</strong> given a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>select</var>&#44; an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element <var>option</var>&#44; and an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;event"></a><code>[Event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-event)</code> or null <var>event</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>select</var> has the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;4"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute or <var>select</var> is <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>event</var> is not null and <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;canceled&#45;flag"></a>[canceled flag](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#canceled-flag) is set&#44; then return&#46;

3.  If <var>event</var> is a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;mouseevent"></a><code>[MouseEvent](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent)</code> and <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;mouseevent&#45;button"></a><code>[button](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent-button)</code> attribute is not 0&#44; then return&#46;

4.  Set <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;4"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to true&#46;

5.  Set <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;dirtiness&#45;2"></a>[dirtiness](#concept-option-dirtiness) to true&#46;

6.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;send&#45;select&#45;update&#45;notifications"></a>[Send <code>select</code> update notifications](#send-select-update-notifications) given <var>select</var>&#46;

7.  If <var>select</var> is being rendered as a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;drop&#45;down&#45;box&#45;2"></a>[drop&#45;down box](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#drop-down-box) with <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;base&#45;appearance"></a>[base appearance](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-ui/#base-appearance)&#44; then run the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;hide&#45;popover&#45;algorithm"></a>[hide popover algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#hide-popover-algorithm) given <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;select&#45;popover"></a>[select popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#select-popover)&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;5"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute is absent&#44; whenever an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element in the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;8"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) has its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;5"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) set to true&#44; and whenever an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element with its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;6"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) set to true is added to the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;9"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list)&#44; the user agent must set the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;7"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) of all the other <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements in its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;10"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) to false&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;6"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute is absent and the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;size&#45;3"></a>[display size](#concept-select-size) is greater than 1&#44; then the user agent should also allow the user to request that the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> whose <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;8"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) is true&#44; if any&#44; be unselected&#46; Upon this request being conveyed to the user agent&#44; and before the relevant user interaction event is queued &#40;e&#46;g&#46; before the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;event&#45;click"></a><code>[click](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#click)</code> event&#41;&#44; the user agent must set the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;9"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) of that <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element to false&#44; set its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;dirtiness&#45;3"></a>[dirtiness](#concept-option-dirtiness) to true&#44; and then <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;send&#45;select&#45;update&#45;notifications&#45;2"></a>[send <code>select</code> update notifications](#send-select-update-notifications)&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> is being rendered as a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;drop&#45;down&#45;box&#45;3"></a>[drop&#45;down box](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#drop-down-box) with <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;base&#45;appearance&#45;2"></a>[base appearance](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-ui/#base-appearance)&#44; then the user agent should allow the user to <a id="select&#45;open&#45;picker"></a><strong>open the picker</strong> given a corresponding <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>select</var> and a corresponding <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;event&#45;mousedown"></a><code>[mousedown](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#mousedown)</code> or <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;event&#45;keydown&#45;2"></a><code>[keydown](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-keydown)</code> event <var>event</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;canceled&#45;flag&#45;2"></a>[canceled flag](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#canceled-flag) is set&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>event</var> is a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;mouseevent&#45;2"></a><code>[MouseEvent](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent)</code> and <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;mouseevent&#45;button&#45;2"></a><code>[button](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#dom-mouseevent-button)</code> attribute is not 0&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Run the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;show&#45;popover"></a>[show popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#show-popover) algorithm given <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;select&#45;popover&#45;2"></a>[select popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#select-popover)&#44; false&#44; and <var>select</var>&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> is being rendered with <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;base&#45;appearance&#45;3"></a>[base appearance](https://drafts.csswg.org/css-ui/#base-appearance)&#44; then the user agent should allow the user to <a id="focus&#45;another&#45;option"></a><strong>focus another option</strong> given the new <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element to focus <var>option</var> and a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;event&#45;keydown&#45;3"></a><code>[keydown](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-keydown)</code> event <var>event</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>event</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;canceled&#45;flag&#45;3"></a>[canceled flag](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#canceled-flag) is set&#44; then return&#46;

2.  Run the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;focusing&#45;steps"></a>[focusing steps](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusing-steps) on <var>option</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Implementations commonly allow the user to focus the next or previous option via the arrow&#45;up and arrow&#45;down keys&#44; focus the first or last option via the Home or End keys&#44; or focus the first or last option in the viewport of the picker via the PageUp or PageDown keys&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Which particular keys of the keyboard cause these actions might differ across implementations and platforms&#46; The ARIA Authoring Practices Guide has good [recommendations](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/examples/combobox-select-only/) for this behavior&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;7"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute is present&#44; and the element is not <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled&#45;3"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled)&#44; then the user agent should allow the user to <a id="concept&#45;select&#45;toggle"></a><strong>toggle</strong> the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;10"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) of the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements in its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;11"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) that are themselves not <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-option-disabled)&#46; Upon such an element being <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;toggle"></a>[toggled](#concept-select-toggle) &#40;either through a click&#44; or through a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;using&#45;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;to&#45;define&#45;a&#45;command&#45;2"></a>[menu command](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#using-the-option-element-to-define-a-command)&#44; or any other mechanism&#41;&#44; and before the relevant user interaction event is queued &#40;e&#46;g&#46; before a related <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;event&#45;click&#45;2"></a><code>[click](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#click)</code> event&#41;&#44; the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;11"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) of the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element must be changed &#40;from true to false or false to true&#41;&#44; the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;dirtiness&#45;4"></a>[dirtiness](#concept-option-dirtiness) of the element must be set to true&#44; and the user agent must <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;send&#45;select&#45;update&#45;notifications&#45;3"></a>[send <code>select</code> update notifications](#send-select-update-notifications)&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

The <a id="concept&#45;select&#45;size"></a><strong>display size</strong> of a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element is the result of applying the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers"></a>[rules for parsing non&#45;negative integers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers) to the value of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;size&#45;5"></a><code>[size](#attr-select-size)</code> attribute&#44; if it has one and parsing it is successful&#46; If applying those rules to the attribute&#39;s value is not successful&#44; or if the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;size&#45;6"></a><code>[size](#attr-select-size)</code> attribute is absent&#44; then the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;size&#45;4"></a>[display size](#concept-select-size) is 4 if the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;8"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> content attribute is present&#44; and 1 otherwise&#46;

To get the <a id="concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list"></a><strong>list of options</strong> given a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>select</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>options</var> be « »&#46;

2.  Let <var>node</var> be the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;first&#45;child"></a>[first child](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-first-child) of <var>select</var> in <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;while"></a>[While](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-while) <var>node</var> is not null&#58;

    1.  If <var>node</var> is an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; then <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;list&#45;append"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) <var>node</var> to <var>options</var>&#46;

    2.  If any of the following conditions are true&#58;

        - <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#59;

        - <var>node</var> is an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;hr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[hr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-hr-element)</code> element&#59;

        - <var>node</var> is an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#59;

        - <var>node</var> is a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element&#59;

        - <var>node</var> is an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element and <var>node</var> has an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;ancestor&#45;2"></a>[ancestor](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-ancestor) <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> in between itself and <var>select</var>&#44;

        then set <var>node</var> to the next <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;descendant"></a>[descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant) of <var>select</var> in <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; excluding <var>node</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;descendant&#45;2"></a>[descendants](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant)&#44; if any such node exists&#59; otherwise null&#46;

        Otherwise&#44; set <var>node</var> to the next <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;descendant&#45;3"></a>[descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant) of <var>select</var> in <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;3"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#44; if any such node exists&#59; otherwise null&#46;

4.  Return <var>options</var>&#46;

To <a id="ask&#45;for&#45;a&#45;reset"></a><strong>ask for a reset</strong> given an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element <var>option</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>select</var> be <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;cached&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select&#45;element"></a>[cached nearest ancestor <code>select</code> element](#cached-nearest-ancestor-select-element)&#46;

2.  If <var>select</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Run the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;selectedness&#45;setting&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[selectedness setting algorithm](#selectedness-setting-algorithm) given <var>select</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;update&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[Update a <code>select</code>&#39;s descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements](#update-a-select's-descendant-selectedcontent-elements) given <var>select</var>&#46;

To run the <a id="selectedness&#45;setting&#45;algorithm"></a><strong>selectedness setting algorithm</strong> given a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>select</var>&#44; run these steps&#46; They return a boolean&#46;

1.  If <var>select</var> has the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;9"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute&#44; then return false&#46;

2.  Let <var>hasChanged</var> be false&#46;

3.  Let <var>firstEnabledOption</var> be null&#46;

4.  Let <var>lastSelectedOption</var> be null&#46;

5.  For each <var>option</var> of <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;12"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list)&#58;

    1.  If <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;12"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) is true&#58;

        1.  If <var>lastSelectedOption</var> is not null&#58;

            1.  Set <var>lastSelectedOption</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;13"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to false&#46;

            2.  Set <var>hasChanged</var> to true&#46;

        2.  Set <var>lastSelectedOption</var> to <var>option</var>&#46;

    2.  If <var>firstEnabledOption</var> is null and <var>option</var> is not <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a>[disabled](#concept-option-disabled)&#44; then set <var>firstEnabledOption</var> to <var>option</var>&#46;

6.  If <var>lastSelectedOption</var> is null&#44; <var>firstEnabledOption</var> is not null&#44; and <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;size&#45;5"></a>[display size](#concept-select-size) is 1&#58;

    1.  Set <var>firstEnabledOption</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;14"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to true&#46;

    2.  Set <var>hasChanged</var> to true&#46;

7.  Return <var>hasChanged</var>&#46;

To <a id="reset&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;selectedness"></a><strong>reset a <code>select</code>&#39;s selectedness</strong>&#44; given a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>select</var> and a boolean <var>hasChanged</var>&#58;

1.  If the result of running the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;selectedness&#45;setting&#45;algorithm&#45;3"></a>[selectedness setting algorithm](#selectedness-setting-algorithm) given <var>select</var> is true&#44; then set <var>hasChanged</var> to true&#46;

2.  If <var>hasChanged</var> is false&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;update&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[Update a <code>select</code>&#39;s descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements](#update-a-select's-descendant-selectedcontent-elements) given <var>select</var>&#46;

Whenever a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;30"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;size&#45;7"></a><code>[size](#attr-select-size)</code> attribute is set&#44; changed&#44; or removed&#44; <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;reset&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;selectedness"></a>[reset a <code>select</code>&#39;s selectedness](#reset-a-select's-selectedness) given the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;31"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element and false&#46;

Whenever a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;32"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;10"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute is added or removed&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  If the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;11"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute was removed&#44; then set the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;15"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) of all but the first <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element with its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;16"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) set to true in <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;13"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) to false&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;reset&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;selectedness&#45;2"></a>[Reset a <code>select</code>&#39;s selectedness](#reset-a-select's-selectedness) given <var>select</var> and true&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;selectedcontent&#45;element"></a><code>[selectedcontent](#the-selectedcontent-element)</code> elements of a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;33"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element are not kept up to date while it has a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;12"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute&#44; which is why they are always updated here&#46;

To <a id="send&#45;select&#45;update&#45;notifications"></a><strong>send <code>select</code> update notifications</strong> for a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;34"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>element</var>&#44; <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given <var>element</var> to run these steps&#58;

1.  Set <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;user&#45;validity&#45;2"></a>[user validity](#user-validity) to true&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;update&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements&#45;4"></a>[Update a <code>select</code>&#39;s descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements](#update-a-select's-descendant-selectedcontent-elements) given <var>element</var>&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;clone&#45;selected&#45;option&#45;into&#45;select&#45;button"></a>[Clone selected <code>option</code> into <code>select</code> button](#clone-selected-option-into-select-button) given <var>element</var>&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at <var>element</var>&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#46;

5.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;event&#45;change"></a><code>[change](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-change)</code> at <var>element</var>&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;2"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

Inserts <var>element</var> before the node given by <var>before</var>&#46;

The <var>before</var> argument can be a number&#44; in which case <var>element</var> is inserted before the item with that number&#44; or an element from the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;18"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list)&#44; in which case <var>element</var> is inserted before that element&#46;

If <var>before</var> is omitted&#44; null&#44; or a number out of range&#44; then <var>element</var> will be added at the end of the list&#46;

This method will throw a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;hierarchyrequesterror"></a>[&#34;<code>HierarchyRequestError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#hierarchyrequesterror) <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;domexception"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if <var>element</var> is an ancestor of the element into which it is to be inserted&#46;
