Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS1&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns the index of the first selected item&#44; if any&#44; or −1 if there is no selected item&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the selection&#46;

<strong><code><var>select</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;select&#45;value&#45;dev"></a>[value](#dom-select-value) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-option-value) of the first selected item&#44; if any&#44; or the empty string if there is no selected item&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the selection&#46;

<strong><code><var>select</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;select&#45;showpicker&#45;dev"></a>[showPicker](#dom-select-showpicker)&#40;&#41;</code></strong>

Shows any applicable picker UI for <var>select</var>&#44; so that the user can select a value&#46;

Throws an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;invalidstateerror"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;2"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if <var>select</var> is not <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;2"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#46;

Throws a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;notallowederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotAllowedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notallowederror) <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;3"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if called without <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;transient&#45;activation"></a>[transient user activation](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#transient-activation)&#46;

Throws a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;securityerror"></a>[&#34;<code>SecurityError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#securityerror) <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if <var>select</var> is inside a cross&#45;origin <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;iframe&#45;element"></a><code>[iframe](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-iframe-element)</code>&#46;

Throws a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;notsupportederror"></a>[&#34;<code>NotSupportedError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#notsupportederror) <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;domexception&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code> if <var>select</var> is not <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> IDL attribute&#44; on getting&#44; must return the string &#34;<code>select&#45;one</code>&#34; if the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;14"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute is absent&#44; and the string &#34;<code>select&#45;multiple</code>&#34; if the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;15"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute is present&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;options"></a><strong><code>options</code></strong> IDL attribute must return an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;htmloptionscollection&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLOptionsCollection](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#htmloptionscollection)</code> rooted at the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;37"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> node&#44; whose filter matches the elements in the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;20"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;options&#45;2"></a><code>[options](#dom-select-options)</code> collection is also mirrored on the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;htmlselectelement"></a><code>[HTMLSelectElement](#htmlselectelement)</code> object&#46; The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;supported&#45;property&#45;indices"></a>[supported property indices](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-supported-property-indices) at any instant are the indices supported by the object returned by the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;options&#45;3"></a><code>[options](#dom-select-options)</code> attribute at that instant&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;length"></a><strong><code>length</code></strong> IDL attribute must return the number of nodes <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;represented&#45;by&#45;the&#45;collection"></a>[represented](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#represented-by-the-collection) by the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;options&#45;4"></a><code>[options](#dom-select-options)</code> collection&#46; On setting&#44; it must act like the attribute of the same name on the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;options&#45;5"></a><code>[options](#dom-select-options)</code> collection&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;item"></a><strong><code>item&#40;<var>index</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must return the value returned by <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;item"></a>[the method of the same name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-htmlcollection-item) on the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;options&#45;6"></a><code>[options](#dom-select-options)</code> collection&#44; when invoked with the same argument&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;nameditem"></a><strong><code>namedItem&#40;<var>name</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must return the value returned by <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;htmlcollection&#45;nameditem"></a>[the method of the same name](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-htmlcollection-nameditem) on the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;options&#45;7"></a><code>[options](#dom-select-options)</code> collection&#44; when invoked with the same argument&#46;

<a id="dom&#45;select&#45;setter"></a>When the user agent is to <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;set&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;a&#45;new&#45;indexed&#45;property"></a>[set the value of a new indexed property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-set-the-value-of-a-new-indexed-property) or <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;set&#45;the&#45;value&#45;of&#45;an&#45;existing&#45;indexed&#45;property"></a>[set the value of an existing indexed property](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-set-the-value-of-an-existing-indexed-property) for a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;38"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; it must instead run [the corresponding algorithm](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#dom-htmloptionscollection-setter) on the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;39"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;options&#45;8"></a><code>[options](#dom-select-options)</code> collection&#46;

Similarly&#44; the <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;add"></a><strong><code>add&#40;<var>element</var>&#44; <var>before</var>&#41;</code></strong> method must act like its namesake method on that same <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;options&#45;9"></a><code>[options](#dom-select-options)</code> collection&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLSelectElement&#47;remove](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLSelectElement/remove)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari3&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS1&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

The <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;remove"></a><strong><code>remove&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method must act like its namesake method on that same <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;options&#45;10"></a><code>[options](#dom-select-options)</code> collection when it has arguments&#44; and like its namesake method on the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;childnode"></a><code>[ChildNode](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-childnode)</code> interface implemented by the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;htmlselectelement&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLSelectElement](#htmlselectelement)</code> ancestor interface <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;element"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> when it has no arguments&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;selectedoptions"></a><strong><code>selectedOptions</code></strong> IDL attribute must return an <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> rooted at the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;40"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> node&#44; whose filter matches the elements in the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;21"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) that have their <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;17"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) set to true&#46;

A <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;41"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="select&#45;selected&#45;index"></a><strong>selected index</strong> is the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;index"></a>[index](#concept-option-index) of the first <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element in its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;22"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) in <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;5"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) that has its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;18"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) set to true&#46; If there isn&#39;t one&#44; then it is −1&#46;

To <a id="set&#45;the&#45;selected&#45;index"></a><strong>set the selected index</strong> of a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;42"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>select</var> to a value <var>value</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>firstMatchingOption</var> be null&#46;

2.  For each <var>option</var> of <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;23"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list)&#58;

    1.  Set <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;19"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to false&#46;

    2.  If <var>firstMatchingOption</var> is null and <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;index&#45;2"></a>[index](#concept-option-index) is equal to <var>value</var>&#44; then set <var>firstMatchingOption</var> to <var>option</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>firstMatchingOption</var> is not null&#44; then set <var>firstMatchingOption</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;20"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to true and set <var>firstMatchingOption</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;dirtiness&#45;5"></a>[dirtiness](#concept-option-dirtiness) to true&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;update&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements&#45;5"></a>[Update a <code>select</code>&#39;s descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements](#update-a-select's-descendant-selectedcontent-elements) given <var>select</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This can result in no element having a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;21"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) set to true even in the case of the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;43"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element having no <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;16"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute and a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;size&#45;6"></a>[display size](#concept-select-size) of 1&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;selectedindex"></a><strong><code>selectedIndex</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;select&#45;selected&#45;index"></a>[selected index](#select-selected-index)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;selectedindex&#45;2"></a><code>[selectedIndex](#dom-select-selectedindex)</code> setter steps are to <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;set&#45;the&#45;selected&#45;index"></a>[set the selected index](#set-the-selected-index) of <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) to the given value&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;select&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> getter steps are to return the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-option-value) of the first <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element in <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;24"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) in <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;6"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) that has its <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;22"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) set to true&#44; if any&#46; If there isn&#39;t one&#44; then return the empty string&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-select-value)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>firstMatchingOption</var> be null&#46;

2.  For each <var>option</var> of <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;25"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list)&#58;

    1.  Set <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;23"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to false&#46;

    2.  If <var>firstMatchingOption</var> is null and <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-option-value) is equal to the given value&#44; then set <var>firstMatchingOption</var> to <var>option</var>&#46;

3.  If <var>firstMatchingOption</var> is not null&#44; then set <var>firstMatchingOption</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;24"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to true and set <var>firstMatchingOption</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;dirtiness&#45;6"></a>[dirtiness](#concept-option-dirtiness) to true&#46;

4.  <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;update&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements&#45;6"></a>[Update a <code>select</code>&#39;s descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements](#update-a-select's-descendant-selectedcontent-elements) given <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This can result in no element having a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;25"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) set to true even in the case of the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;44"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element having no <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;17"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute and a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;size&#45;7"></a>[display size](#concept-select-size) of 1&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

For historical reasons&#44; the default value of the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;size"></a><code>[size](#dom-select-size)</code> IDL attribute does not return the actual size used&#44; which&#44; in the absence of the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;size&#45;8"></a><code>[size](#attr-select-size)</code> content attribute&#44; is either 1 or 4 depending on the presence of the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;18"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;willvalidate&#45;2"></a><code>[willValidate](#dom-cva-willvalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validity&#45;2"></a><code>[validity](#dom-cva-validity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validationmessage&#45;2"></a><code>[validationMessage](#dom-cva-validationmessage)</code> IDL attributes&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;checkvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[checkValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-checkvalidity)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;reportvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[reportValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-reportvalidity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[setCustomValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity)</code> methods&#44; are part of the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api"></a>[constraint validation API](#the-constraint-validation-api)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels&#45;2"></a><code>[labels](#dom-lfe-labels)</code> IDL attribute provides a list of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code>s&#46; The <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;disabled"></a><code>[disabled](#dom-select-disabled)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#dom-fae-form)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#dom-select-name)</code> IDL attributes are part of the element&#39;s forms API&#46;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following example shows how a <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;45"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element can be used to offer the user with a set of options from which the user can select a single option&#46; The default option is preselected&#46;

``` text
<p>
 <label for="unittype">Select unit type:</label>
 <select id="unittype" name="unittype">
  <option value="1"> Miner </option>
  <option value="2"> Puffer </option>
  <option value="3" selected> Snipey </option>
  <option value="4"> Max </option>
  <option value="5"> Firebot </option>
 </select>
</p>
```

When there is no default option&#44; a placeholder can be used instead&#58;

``` text
<select name="unittype" required>
 <option value=""> Select unit type </option>
 <option value="1"> Miner </option>
 <option value="2"> Puffer </option>
 <option value="3"> Snipey </option>
 <option value="4"> Max </option>
 <option value="5"> Firebot </option>
</select>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here&#44; the user is offered a set of options from which they can select any number&#46; By default&#44; all five options are selected&#46;

``` text
<p>
 <label for="allowedunits">Select unit types to enable on this map:</label>
 <select id="allowedunits" name="allowedunits" multiple>
  <option value="1" selected> Miner </option>
  <option value="2" selected> Puffer </option>
  <option value="3" selected> Snipey </option>
  <option value="4" selected> Max </option>
  <option value="5" selected> Firebot </option>
 </select>
</p>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Sometimes&#44; a user has to select one or more items&#46; This example shows such an interface&#46;

``` text
<label>
 Select the songs from that you would like on your Act II Mix Tape:
 <select multiple required name="act2">
  <option value="s1">It Sucks to Be Me (Reprise)
  <option value="s2">There is Life Outside Your Apartment
  <option value="s3">The More You Ruv Someone
  <option value="s4">Schadenfreude
  <option value="s5">I Wish I Could Go Back to College
  <option value="s6">The Money Song
  <option value="s7">School for Monsters
  <option value="s8">The Money Song (Reprise)
  <option value="s9">There's a Fine, Fine Line (Reprise)
  <option value="s10">What Do You Do With a B.A. in English? (Reprise)
  <option value="s11">For Now
 </select>
</label>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Occasionally it can be useful to have a separator&#58;

``` text
<label>
 Select the song to play next:
 <select required name="next">
  <option value="sr">Random
  <hr>
  <option value="s1">It Sucks to Be Me (Reprise)
  <option value="s2">There is Life Outside Your Apartment
  …
```

<a id="example&#45;customizable&#45;select"></a>

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

[](#example-customizable-select)

Here is an example which uses <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element"></a><code>[legend](#the-legend-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[button](#the-button-element)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;selectedcontent&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[selectedcontent](#the-selectedcontent-element)</code> elements&#58;

``` text
<select>
  <button>
    <selectedcontent></selectedcontent>
  </button>
  <div class="border">
    <optgroup>
      <legend>WHATWG Specifications</legend>
      <option>
        <img src="html.jpg" alt="">
        HTML
      </option>
      <option>
        <img src="dom.jpg" alt="">
        DOM
      </option>
    </optgroup>
  </div>
  <div class="border">
    <optgroup>
      <legend>W3C Specifications</legend>
      <option>
        <img src="forms.jpg" alt="">
        CSS Form Control Styling
      </option>
      <option>
        <img src="pseudo.jpg" alt="">
        CSS Pseudo-Elements
      </option>
    <optgroup>
  </div>
</select>
```

<a id="note&#45;first&#45;button&#45;in&#45;select&#45;not&#45;submit"></a>

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

[](#note-first-button-in-select-not-submit)The first child <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[button](#the-button-element)</code> element as allowed by the content model of <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;46"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> is not a submit button&#46; It is used to replace the in&#45;page rendering of the <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;47"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#46; Its form submission behavior is prevented because it is <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;inert"></a>[inert](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#inert)&#46; A <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;selectedcontent&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[selectedcontent](#the-selectedcontent-element)</code> element can be used inside this <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[button](#the-button-element)</code> element to display the contents of the currently selected <a id="the&#45;select&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#46;

Or&#58; Zero or more <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> and <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;script&#45;supporting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[script&#45;supporting](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#script-supporting-elements-2) elements&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

Neither tag is omissible&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<strong><a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmldatalistelement"></a><a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection"></a><a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;datalist&#45;options"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLDataListElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [SameObject] readonly attribute HTMLCollection options;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element represents a set of <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements that represent predefined options for other controls&#46; In the rendering&#44; the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) nothing and it&#44; along with its children&#44; should be hidden&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element can be used in two ways&#46; In the simplest case&#44; the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element has just <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element children&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

``` text
<label>
 Animal:
 <input name=animal list=animals>
 <datalist id=animals>
  <option value="Cat">
  <option value="Dog">
 </datalist>
</label>
```

In the more elaborate case&#44; the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element can be given contents that are to be displayed for down&#45;level clients that don&#39;t support <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code>&#46; In this case&#44; the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements are provided inside a <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element inside the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

``` text
<label>
 Animal:
 <input name=animal list=animals>
</label>
<datalist id=animals>
 <label>
  or select from the list:
  <select name=animal>
   <option value="">
   <option>Cat
   <option>Dog
  </select>
 </label>
</datalist>
```

The <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element is hooked up to an <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element using the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;list"></a><code>[list](#attr-input-list)</code> attribute on the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element that is a descendant of the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element&#44; that is not <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-option-disabled)&#44; and whose <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-option-value) is a string that isn&#39;t the empty string&#44; represents a suggestion&#46; Each suggestion has a <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-option-value) and a <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;label"></a>[label](#concept-option-label)&#46;

<strong><code><var>datalist</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;datalist&#45;options&#45;dev"></a>[options](#dom-datalist-options)</code></strong>

Returns an <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection&#45;2"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> of the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements of the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;datalist&#45;options"></a><strong><code>options</code></strong> IDL attribute must return an <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;htmlcollection&#45;3"></a><code>[HTMLCollection](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-htmlcollection)</code> rooted at the <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> node&#44; whose filter matches <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If an element has a <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element ancestor&#44; it is <a id="the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#58;barred&#45;from&#45;constraint&#45;validation"></a>[barred from constraint validation](#barred-from-constraint-validation)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;contexts"></a>[Contexts in which this element can be used](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-contexts)&#58;</strong>

As a descendant of a <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a>[Content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-content-model)&#58;</strong>

Zero or one <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element"></a><code>[legend](#the-legend-element)</code> element followed by zero or more <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements&#44; <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;script&#45;supporting&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[script&#45;supporting elements](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#script-supporting-elements-2)&#44; <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;noscript&#45;element"></a><code>[noscript](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-noscript-element)</code> elements&#44; or <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

An <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) can be omitted if the <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element is immediately followed by another <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; if it is immediately followed by an <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;hr&#45;element"></a><code>[hr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-hr-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<strong><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-optgroup)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-optgroup)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmloptgroupelement"></a><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="dom&#45;optgroup&#45;disabled"></a><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;optgroup&#45;label"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLOptGroupElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean disabled;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString label;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;optgroup&#45;option&#45;group"></a>[group of <code>option</code> elements](#optgroup-option-group) with a common label&#46;

The <a id="optgroup&#45;option&#45;group"></a><strong>element&#39;s group of <code>option</code> elements</strong> consists of the <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements that are descendants of the <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#46;

When showing <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements in <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> elements&#44; user agents should show the <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements of such groups as being related to each other and separate from other <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Attributes&#47;disabled](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/disabled)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari4&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer8&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;optgroup&#45;disabled"></a><strong><code>disabled</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute) and can be used to <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;disabled"></a>[disable](#concept-option-disabled) a <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;optgroup&#45;option&#45;group&#45;2"></a>[group of <code>option</code> elements](#optgroup-option-group) together&#46;

Whenever an <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;optgroup&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-optgroup-disabled)</code> attribute is added or removed&#44; then&#58;

1.  Let <var>select</var> be the <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;option&#45;element&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select"></a>[nearest ancestor <code>select</code>](#option-element-nearest-ancestor-select)&#46;

2.  If <var>select</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;reset&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;selectedness"></a>[Reset a <code>select</code>&#39;s selectedness](#reset-a-select's-selectedness) given <var>select</var> and false&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;optgroup&#45;label"></a><strong><code>label</code></strong> attribute must be specified if the <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> has no child <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[legend](#the-legend-element)</code> element&#46;

To <a id="concept&#45;optgroup&#45;label"></a><strong>get an <code>optgroup</code> element&#39;s label</strong>&#44; given an <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> <var>optgroup</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>optgroup</var>&#39;s first element child is a <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[legend](#the-legend-element)</code> element&#44; then return the result of <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;get&#45;html&#45;aware&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[get HTML&#45;aware text content](#get-html-aware-text-content) given that <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[legend](#the-legend-element)</code> element and true&#46;

2.  If <var>optgroup</var> has a <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;optgroup&#45;label&#45;2"></a><code>[label](#attr-optgroup-label)</code> attribute&#44; then return the value of that attribute&#46;

3.  Return the empty string&#46;

The value of the <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;optgroup&#45;label"></a>[<code>optgroup</code> label algorithm](#concept-optgroup-label) gives the name of the group&#44; for the purposes of the user interface&#46; User agents should use this attribute&#39;s value when labeling the group of <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements in a <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

There is no way to select an <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#46; Only <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements can be selected&#46; An <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element merely provides a label for a group of <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

The following snippet shows how a set of lessons from three courses could be offered in a <a id="the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> drop&#45;down widget&#58;

``` text
<form action="courseselector.dll" method="get">
 <p>Which course would you like to watch today?
 <p><label>Course:
  <select name="c">
   <optgroup label="8.01 Physics I: Classical Mechanics">
    <option value="8.01.1">Lecture 01: Powers of Ten
    <option value="8.01.2">Lecture 02: 1D Kinematics
    <option value="8.01.3">Lecture 03: Vectors
   <optgroup label="8.02 Electricity and Magnetism">
    <option value="8.02.1">Lecture 01: What holds our world together?
    <option value="8.02.2">Lecture 02: Electric Field
    <option value="8.02.3">Lecture 03: Electric Flux
   <optgroup label="8.03 Physics III: Vibrations and Waves">
    <option value="8.03.1">Lecture 01: Periodic Phenomenon
    <option value="8.03.2">Lecture 02: Beats
    <option value="8.03.3">Lecture 03: Forced Oscillations with Damping
  </select>
 </label>
 <p><input type=submit value="▶ Play">
</form>
```

As a descendant of a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element&#46;

If the element has a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;label"></a><code>[label](#attr-option-label)</code> attribute and a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-option-value)</code> attribute&#58; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;content&#45;nothing"></a>[Nothing](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-content-nothing)&#46;

If the element has a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;label&#45;2"></a><code>[label](#attr-option-label)</code> attribute but no <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#attr-option-value)</code> attribute&#58; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;text&#45;content"></a>[Text](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#text-content)&#46;

If the element has no <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;label&#45;3"></a><code>[label](#attr-option-label)</code> attribute and is not a descendant of a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element&#58; Zero or more <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;div&#45;element"></a><code>[div](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-div-element)</code> elements or <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#44; but there must be no <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;interactive&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[interactive content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#interactive-content-2) descendant&#44; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element descendant&#44; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;object&#45;element"></a><code>[object](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-object-element)</code> element descendant&#44; or descendant with the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;tabindex"></a><code>[tabindex](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-tabindex)</code> attribute specified

If the element has no <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;label&#45;4"></a><code>[label](#attr-option-label)</code> attribute and is a descendant of a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element&#58; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;text&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Text](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#text-content)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

An <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;syntax&#45;end&#45;tag"></a>[end tag](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#syntax-end-tag) can be omitted if the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element is immediately followed by another <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; if it is immediately followed by an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; if it is immediately followed by an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;hr&#45;element"></a><code>[hr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-hr-element)</code> element&#44; or if there is no more content in the parent element&#46;
