<a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;legacyfactoryfunction"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option"></a><a id="htmloptionelement"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="dom&#45;option&#45;disabled"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;htmlformelement"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option&#45;form"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option&#45;label"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;option&#45;defaultselected"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option&#45;selected"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;5"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option&#45;value"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;6"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option&#45;text"></a><a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option&#45;index"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window,
 LegacyFactoryFunction=Option(optional DOMString text = "", optional DOMString value, optional boolean defaultSelected = false, optional boolean selected = false)]
interface HTMLOptionElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean disabled;
  readonly attribute HTMLFormElement? form;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute DOMString label;
  [CEReactions, Reflect="selected"] attribute boolean defaultSelected;
  [CEReactions] attribute boolean selected;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute DOMString value;

  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString text;
  readonly attribute long index;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) an option in a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element or as part of a list of suggestions in a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element&#46;

In certain circumstances described in the definition of the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element can be a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;placeholder&#45;label&#45;option"></a>[placeholder label option](#placeholder-label-option)&#46; A <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;placeholder&#45;label&#45;option&#45;2"></a>[placeholder label option](#placeholder-label-option) does not represent an actual option&#44; but instead represents a label for the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> control&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Attributes&#47;disabled](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/disabled)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari4&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet ExplorerYes

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android&#63;

The <a id="attr&#45;option&#45;disabled"></a><strong><code>disabled</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; An <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element <var>option</var> is <a id="concept&#45;option&#45;disabled"></a><strong>disabled</strong> if the following steps return true&#58;

1.  If <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-option-disabled)</code> attribute is present&#44; then return true&#46;

2.  For each <var>ancestor</var> of <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;ancestor"></a>[ancestors](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-ancestor) in reverse <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#58;

    1.  If <var>ancestor</var> is a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;hr&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[hr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-hr-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; then return false&#46;

    2.  If <var>ancestor</var> is an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#44; then return true if <var>ancestor</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;optgroup&#45;disabled"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-optgroup-disabled)</code> attribute is present&#59; otherwise false&#46;

3.  Return false&#46;

Whenever an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;disabled&#45;3"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-option-disabled)</code> attribute is added or removed&#44; then&#58;

1.  Let <var>select</var> be the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cached&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select&#45;element"></a>[cached nearest ancestor <code>select</code> element](#cached-nearest-ancestor-select-element)&#46;

2.  If <var>select</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;reset&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;selectedness"></a>[Reset a <code>select</code>&#39;s selectedness](#reset-a-select's-selectedness) given <var>select</var> and false&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element that is <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;disabled&#45;4"></a>[disabled](#attr-option-disabled) must prevent any <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;event&#45;click"></a><code>[click](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#click)</code> events that are <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) on the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) from being dispatched on the element&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Being <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-option-disabled) does not prevent all modifications to the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#46; For example&#44; its <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) could be modified programmatically from JavaScript&#46; Or&#44; it could be indirectly modified by user action&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; if other non&#45;disabled <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements in the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element were modified&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;option&#45;label"></a><strong><code>label</code></strong> attribute provides a label for the element&#46;

To <a id="concept&#45;option&#45;label"></a><strong>get an <code>option</code> element&#39;s label</strong>&#44; given an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element <var>option</var> and a boolean <var>includeAltText</var>&#58;

1.  If <var>option</var> has a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;label&#45;6"></a><code>[label](#attr-option-label)</code> attribute whose value is not the empty string&#44; then return that value&#46;

2.  Return the result of <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;get&#45;html&#45;aware&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[get HTML&#45;aware text content](#get-html-aware-text-content) given <var>option</var> and <var>includeAltText</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;label&#45;7"></a><code>[label](#attr-option-label)</code> content attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must not be empty&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;option&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> attribute provides a value for the element&#46; The <a id="concept&#45;option&#45;value"></a><strong>value</strong> of an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element is the value of the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;value&#45;4"></a><code>[value](#attr-option-value)</code> content attribute&#44; if there is one&#44; or&#44; if there is not&#44; the result of <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;get&#45;html&#45;aware&#45;text&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[get HTML&#45;aware text content](#get-html-aware-text-content) given <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and false&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;option&#45;selected"></a><strong><code>selected</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; It represents the default <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;2"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) of the element&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;option&#45;dirtiness"></a><strong>dirtiness</strong> of an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element is a boolean state&#44; initially false&#46; It controls whether adding or removing the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;3"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code> content attribute has any effect&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness"></a><strong>selectedness</strong> of an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element is a boolean state&#44; initially false&#46; Except where otherwise specified&#44; when the element is created&#44; its <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;3"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) must be set to true if the element has a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;4"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code> attribute&#46;

Whenever an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;5"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code> attribute is added or removed&#58;

1.  Let <var>hasChanged</var> be false&#46;

2.  If <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;dirtiness"></a>[dirtiness](#concept-option-dirtiness) is false&#58;

    1.  If the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;6"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code> attribute was added and <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;4"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) is false&#44; then set <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;5"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to true and set <var>hasChanged</var> to true&#46;

    2.  If the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;7"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code> attribute was removed and <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;6"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) is true&#44; then set <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;7"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to false and set <var>hasChanged</var> to true&#46;

3.  Let <var>select</var> be <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cached&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[cached nearest ancestor <code>select</code> element](#cached-nearest-ancestor-select-element)&#46;

4.  If <var>select</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

5.  <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;reset&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;selectedness&#45;2"></a>[Reset a <code>select</code>&#39;s selectedness](#reset-a-select's-selectedness) given <var>select</var> and <var>hasChanged</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; in a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element without a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute&#44; adding the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;8"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code> attribute to an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> that is not selected deselects the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;19"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> that was&#46; The <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;selectedness&#45;setting&#45;algorithm"></a>[selectedness setting algorithm](#selectedness-setting-algorithm) then has nothing left to change&#44; so without <var>hasChanged</var> the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;selectedcontent&#45;element"></a><code>[selectedcontent](#the-selectedcontent-element)</code> elements would not be updated&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option&#45;2"></a><code>[Option&#40;&#41;](#dom-option)</code> constructor&#44; when called with three or fewer arguments&#44; overrides the initial state of the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;8"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) state to always be false even if the third argument is true &#40;implying that a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;9"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code> attribute is to be set&#41;&#46; The fourth argument can be used to explicitly set the initial <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;9"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) state when using the constructor&#46;

A <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element whose <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;select&#45;multiple&#45;2"></a><code>[multiple](#attr-select-multiple)</code> attribute is not specified must not have more than one descendant <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;20"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element with its <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;10"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code> attribute set&#46;

An <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;21"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="concept&#45;option&#45;index"></a><strong>index</strong> is the number of <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;22"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements that are in the same <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) but that come before it in <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46; If the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;23"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element is not in a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list)&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;24"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;index"></a>[index](#concept-option-index) is zero&#46;

Each <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;25"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element has a <a id="cached&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select&#45;element"></a><strong>cached nearest ancestor <code>select</code> element</strong>&#44; which is a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element or null&#44; initially set to null&#46;

To <a id="update&#45;an&#45;option&#39;s&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select"></a><strong>update an <code>option</code>&#39;s nearest ancestor <code>select</code></strong>&#44; given an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;26"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> <var>option</var>&#44; run these steps&#46; They return a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> elements whose <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;descendant"></a>[descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant) <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;selectedcontent&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[selectedcontent](#the-selectedcontent-element)</code> elements need updating&#46;

1.  Let <var>oldSelect</var> be <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cached&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[cached nearest ancestor <code>select</code> element](#cached-nearest-ancestor-select-element)&#46;

2.  Let <var>newSelect</var> be <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;option&#45;element&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select"></a>[nearest ancestor <code>select</code>](#option-element-nearest-ancestor-select)&#46;

3.  Set <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cached&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[cached nearest ancestor <code>select</code> element](#cached-nearest-ancestor-select-element) to <var>newSelect</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>oldSelect</var> is <var>newSelect</var>&#44; then return « »&#46;

5.  Let <var>result</var> be « »&#46;

6.  For each <var>select</var> of « <var>oldSelect</var>&#44; <var>newSelect</var> »&#58;

    1.  If <var>select</var> is null&#44; then <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;continue"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    2.  Let <var>hasChanged</var> be the result of running the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;selectedness&#45;setting&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[selectedness setting algorithm](#selectedness-setting-algorithm) given <var>select</var>&#46;

    3.  If <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;10"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) is true or <var>hasChanged</var> is true&#44; then <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;list&#45;append"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) <var>select</var> to <var>result</var>&#46;

7.  Return <var>result</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;insertion&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element insertion steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-insertion-steps)&#44; given <var>insertedOption</var>&#44; are to <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;update&#45;an&#45;option&#39;s&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select"></a>[update an <code>option</code>&#39;s nearest ancestor <code>select</code>](#update-an-option's-nearest-ancestor-select) given <var>insertedOption</var>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The returned <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> elements are intentionally ignored here&#46; Any <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;selectedcontent&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[selectedcontent](#the-selectedcontent-element)</code> update is instead performed by the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;post&#45;connection&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element post&#45;connection steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-post-connection-steps)&#44; which run once the tree is in a consistent state&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;post&#45;connection&#45;steps&#45;2"></a>[HTML element post&#45;connection steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-post-connection-steps)&#44; given <var>insertedOption</var>&#44; are to <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;update&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements&#45;for&#45;an&#45;option"></a>[update descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements for an <code>option</code>](#update-descendant-selectedcontent-elements-for-an-option) given <var>insertedOption</var>&#46;

To <a id="update&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements&#45;for&#45;an&#45;option"></a><strong>update descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements for an <code>option</code></strong>&#44; given an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;30"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element <var>option</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>select</var> be <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;cached&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[cached nearest ancestor <code>select</code> element](#cached-nearest-ancestor-select-element)&#46;

2.  If <var>select</var> is null or <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;11"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) is false&#44; then return&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;update&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements"></a>[Update a <code>select</code>&#39;s descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements](#update-a-select's-descendant-selectedcontent-elements) given <var>select</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;31"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;removing&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element removing steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-removing-steps)&#44; given <var>removedNode</var>&#44; <var>isSubtreeRoot</var>&#44; and <var>oldAncestor</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  Let <var>selects</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;update&#45;an&#45;option&#39;s&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select&#45;2"></a>[update an <code>option</code>&#39;s nearest ancestor <code>select</code>](#update-an-option's-nearest-ancestor-select) given <var>removedNode</var>&#46;

2.  For each <var>select</var> of <var>selects</var>&#58; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;microtask"></a>[queue a microtask](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-microtask) to <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;update&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements&#45;2"></a>[update a <code>select</code>&#39;s descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements](#update-a-select's-descendant-selectedcontent-elements) given <var>select</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;32"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;html&#45;element&#45;moving&#45;steps"></a>[HTML element moving steps](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#html-element-moving-steps)&#44; given <var>movedNode</var>&#44; <var>isSubtreeRoot</var>&#44; and <var>oldAncestor</var>&#44; are&#58;

1.  Let <var>selects</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;update&#45;an&#45;option&#39;s&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select&#45;3"></a>[update an <code>option</code>&#39;s nearest ancestor <code>select</code>](#update-an-option's-nearest-ancestor-select) given <var>movedNode</var>&#46;

2.  For each <var>select</var> of <var>selects</var>&#58; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;microtask&#45;2"></a>[queue a microtask](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-microtask) to <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;update&#45;a&#45;select&#39;s&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements&#45;3"></a>[update a <code>select</code>&#39;s descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements](#update-a-select's-descendant-selectedcontent-elements) given <var>select</var>&#46;

To get the <a id="option&#45;element&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select"></a><strong>nearest ancestor <code>select</code></strong> given an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;element"></a><code>[Element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-element)</code> <var>element</var>&#44; run these steps&#46; They return a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element or null&#46;

1.  Let <var>ancestorOptgroup</var> be null&#46;

2.  For each <var>ancestor</var> of <var>element</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;ancestor&#45;2"></a>[ancestors](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-ancestor)&#44; in reverse <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;3"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#58;

    1.  If <var>ancestor</var> is a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;hr&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[hr](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-hr-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;33"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; then return null&#46;

    2.  If <var>ancestor</var> is an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> element&#58;

        1.  If <var>ancestorOptgroup</var> is not null&#44; then return null&#46;

        2.  Set <var>ancestorOptgroup</var> to <var>ancestor</var>&#46;

    3.  If <var>ancestor</var> is a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code>&#44; then return <var>ancestor</var>&#46;

3.  Return null&#46;

To <a id="clone&#45;selected&#45;option&#45;into&#45;select&#45;button"></a><strong>clone selected <code>option</code> into <code>select</code> button</strong>&#44; given a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element <var>select</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>option</var> be the first element of <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list&#45;3"></a>[option list](#concept-select-option-list) whose <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;12"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) is set to true&#44; if such an element exists&#59; otherwise null&#46;

2.  Let <var>text</var> be the empty string&#46;

3.  If <var>option</var> is not null&#44; then set <var>text</var> to <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option&#45;label&#45;2"></a>[label](#dom-option-label)&#46;

4.  Set <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;select&#45;fallback&#45;button&#45;text"></a>[select fallback button text](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#select-fallback-button-text) to <var>text</var>&#46;

When an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;34"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element <var>option</var> is popped off the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#stack-of-open-elements) of an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) or <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;xml&#45;parser"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser)&#44; <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;update&#45;descendant&#45;selectedcontent&#45;elements&#45;for&#45;an&#45;option&#45;2"></a>[update descendant <code>selectedcontent</code> elements for an <code>option</code>](#update-descendant-selectedcontent-elements-for-an-option) given <var>option</var>&#46;

<strong><code><var>option</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;dev"></a>[selected](#dom-option-selected)</code></strong>

Returns true if the element is selected&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

Can be set&#44; to override the current state of the element&#46;

<strong><code><var>option</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;option&#45;index&#45;dev"></a>[index](#dom-option-index)</code></strong>

Returns the index of the element in its <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;select&#45;options"></a><code>[options](#dom-select-options)</code> list&#46;

<strong><code><var>option</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;option&#45;form&#45;dev"></a>[form](#dom-option-form)</code></strong>

Returns the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#44; if any&#44; or null otherwise&#46;

<strong><code><var>option</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;option&#45;text&#45;dev"></a>[text](#dom-option-text)</code></strong>

Same as <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;textcontent"></a><code>[textContent](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-node-textcontent)</code>&#44; except that spaces are collapsed and <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> elements are skipped&#46;

<strong><code><var>option</var> &#61; new <a id="dom&#45;option&#45;dev"></a>[Option](#dom-option)&#40;&#91; <var>text</var> &#91;&#44; <var>value</var> &#91;&#44; <var>defaultSelected</var> &#91;&#44; <var>selected</var> &#93; &#93; &#93; &#93;&#41;</code></strong>

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[HTMLOptionElement&#47;Option](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/HTMLOptionElement/Option)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#46;2&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

Returns a new <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;35"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#46;

The <var>text</var> argument sets the contents of the element&#46;

The <var>value</var> argument sets the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;value&#45;5"></a><code>[value](#attr-option-value)</code> attribute&#46;

The <var>defaultSelected</var> argument sets the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;11"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code> attribute&#46;

The <var>selected</var> argument sets whether or not the element is selected&#46; If it is omitted&#44; even if the <var>defaultSelected</var> argument is true&#44; the element is not selected&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;option&#45;label"></a><strong><code>label</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>attribute</var> be <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;label&#45;8"></a><code>[label](#attr-option-label)</code> attribute&#46;

2.  If <var>attribute</var> is null&#44; then return the result of <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;label"></a>[getting an <code>option</code> element&#39;s label](#concept-option-label) given <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and false&#46;

3.  Return <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;option&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-option-value)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;option&#45;selected"></a><strong><code>selected</code></strong> getter steps are to return true if <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;13"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) is true&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;2"></a><code>[selected](#dom-option-selected)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Set <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;14"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to the given value&#46;

2.  Set <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;dirtiness&#45;2"></a>[dirtiness](#concept-option-dirtiness) to true&#46;

3.  <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;ask&#45;for&#45;a&#45;reset"></a>[Ask for a reset](#ask-for-a-reset) given <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this&#45;8"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;option&#45;index"></a><strong><code>index</code></strong> IDL attribute must return the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;index&#45;2"></a>[index](#concept-option-index)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;option&#45;text"></a><strong><code>text</code></strong> getter steps are to return the result of <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;get&#45;html&#45;aware&#45;text&#45;content&#45;3"></a>[get HTML&#45;aware text content](#get-html-aware-text-content) given <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this&#45;9"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and false&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;option&#45;text&#45;2"></a><code>[text](#dom-option-text)</code> setter steps are to <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;string&#45;replace&#45;all"></a>[string replace all](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#string-replace-all) with the given value within <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this&#45;10"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;option&#45;form"></a><strong><code>form</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>select</var> be <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;this&#45;11"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;option&#45;element&#45;nearest&#45;ancestor&#45;select&#45;2"></a>[nearest ancestor <code>select</code>](#option-element-nearest-ancestor-select)&#46;

2.  If <var>select</var> is null&#44; then return null&#46;

3.  Return <var>select</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#46;

A legacy factory function is provided for creating <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;htmloptionelement"></a><code>[HTMLOptionElement](#htmloptionelement)</code> objects &#40;in addition to the factory methods from DOM such as <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;document&#45;createelement"></a><code>[createElement&#40;&#41;](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-document-createelement)</code>&#41;&#58; <a id="dom&#45;option"></a><strong><code>Option&#40;<var>text</var>&#44; <var>value</var>&#44; <var>defaultSelected</var>&#44; <var>selected</var>&#41;</code></strong>&#46; When invoked&#44; the legacy factory function must perform the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>document</var> be the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;current&#45;global&#45;object"></a>[current global object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#current-global-object)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;document&#45;window"></a>[associated <code>Document</code>](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-document-window)&#46;

2.  Let <var>option</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;create&#45;an&#45;element"></a>[creating an element](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-create-element) given <var>document</var>&#44; &#34;<code>option</code>&#34;&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;html&#45;namespace&#45;2"></a>[HTML namespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#html-namespace)&#46;

3.  If <var>text</var> is not the empty string&#44; then append to <var>option</var> a new <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;text"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node whose data is <var>text</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>value</var> is given&#44; then <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;set&#45;value"></a>[set an attribute value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value) for <var>option</var> using &#34;<a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;value&#45;6"></a><code>[value](#attr-option-value)</code>&#34; and <var>value</var>&#46;

5.  If <var>defaultSelected</var> is true&#44; then <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes&#45;set&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[set an attribute value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-set-value) for <var>option</var> using &#34;<a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;selected&#45;12"></a><code>[selected](#attr-option-selected)</code>&#34; and the empty string&#46;

6.  If <var>selected</var> is true&#44; then set <var>option</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;15"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to true&#59; otherwise set its <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness&#45;16"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) to false &#40;even if <var>defaultSelected</var> is true&#41;&#46;

7.  Return <var>option</var>&#46;

To <a id="get&#45;html&#45;aware&#45;text&#45;content"></a><strong>get HTML&#45;aware text content</strong>&#44; given an element <var>element</var> and a boolean <var>includeAltText</var>&#58;

1.  Let <var>text</var> be the empty string&#46;

2.  For each <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;descendant&#45;2"></a>[descendant](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant) <var>descendant</var> of <var>element</var> in <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;4"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#58;

    1.  If <var>descendant</var> is a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;script&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[script](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-script-element)</code> or <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;svg&#45;script"></a>[SVG <code>script</code>](https://w3c.github.io/svgwg/svg2-draft/interact.html#elementdef-script) element&#44; then <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;continue&#45;2"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue) skipping all <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;descendant&#45;3"></a>[descendants](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant) of <var>descendant</var>&#46;

    2.  If <var>descendant</var> is a <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;text&#45;2"></a><code>[Text](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-text)</code> node&#44; then set <var>text</var> to the concatenation of <var>text</var> and <var>descendant</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;cd&#45;data"></a>[data](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-cd-data)&#46;

    3.  If <var>descendant</var> is an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> element with an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt"></a><code>[alt](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute and <var>includeAltText</var> is true&#44; then set <var>text</var> to the concatenation of <var>text</var> and the value of <var>descendant</var>&#39;s <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;img&#45;alt&#45;2"></a><code>[alt](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#attr-img-alt)</code> attribute&#46;

    4.  If <var>descendant</var> is an <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;img&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[img](html-language-elements-embedded--877d6146487f--48a1a13e5cfe.md#the-img-element)</code> element&#44; then <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;continue&#45;3"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue) skipping all <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;descendant&#45;4"></a>[descendants](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-descendant) of <var>descendant</var>&#46;

3.  Return the result of <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;strip&#45;and&#45;collapse&#45;ascii&#45;whitespace"></a>[strip and collapse ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#strip-and-collapse-ascii-whitespace) given <var>text</var>&#46;

<a id="note&#45;option&#45;no&#45;value"></a>

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

[](#note-option-no-value)When no <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;value&#45;7"></a><code>[value](#attr-option-value)</code> attribute is set on the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;36"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; its text contents are used to generate a submittable value&#46; In the case that the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;37"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element has child elements&#44; this can lead to unexpected results such as <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;38"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements which render differently but have the same value&#46; In order to address this&#44; setting the <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;value&#45;8"></a><code>[value](#attr-option-value)</code> attribute on <a id="the&#45;option&#45;element&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;39"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements is recommended&#46;
