``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLTextAreaElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute DOMString autocomplete;
  [CEReactions, ReflectPositiveWithFallback, ReflectDefault=20] attribute unsigned long cols;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString dirName;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean disabled;
  readonly attribute HTMLFormElement? form;
  [CEReactions, ReflectNonNegative] attribute long maxLength;
  [CEReactions, ReflectNonNegative] attribute long minLength;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString name;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString placeholder;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean readOnly;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute boolean required;
  [CEReactions, ReflectPositiveWithFallback, ReflectDefault=2] attribute unsigned long rows;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString wrap;

  readonly attribute DOMString type;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString defaultValue;
  attribute [LegacyNullToEmptyString] DOMString value;
  readonly attribute unsigned long textLength;

  readonly attribute boolean willValidate;
  readonly attribute ValidityState validity;
  readonly attribute DOMString validationMessage;
  boolean checkValidity();
  boolean reportValidity();
  undefined setCustomValidity(DOMString error);

  readonly attribute NodeList labels;

  undefined select();
  attribute unsigned long selectionStart;
  attribute unsigned long selectionEnd;
  attribute DOMString selectionDirection;
  undefined setRangeText(DOMString replacement);
  undefined setRangeText(DOMString replacement, unsigned long start, unsigned long end, optional SelectionMode selectionMode = "preserve");
  undefined setSelectionRange(unsigned long start, unsigned long end, optional DOMString direction);
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a multiline plain text edit control for the element&#39;s <a id="concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value"></a><strong>raw value</strong>&#46; The contents of the control represent the control&#39;s default value&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value"></a>[raw value](#concept-textarea-raw-value) of a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> control must be initially the empty string&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This element [has rendering requirements involving the bidirectional algorithm](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#bidireq)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;textarea&#45;readonly"></a><strong><code>readonly</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute) used to control whether the text can be edited by the user or not&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a text control is marked read&#45;only because it represents a read&#45;only file&#58;

``` text
Filename: <code>/etc/bash.bashrc</code>
<textarea name="buffer" readonly>
# System-wide .bashrc file for interactive bash(1) shells.

# To enable the settings / commands in this file for login shells as well,
# this file has to be sourced in /etc/profile.

# If not running interactively, don't do anything
[ -z "$PS1" ] &amp;&amp; return

...</textarea>
```

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;readonly&#45;2"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-textarea-readonly)</code> attribute is specified on a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element&#44; the element is <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;barred&#45;from&#45;constraint&#45;validation"></a>[barred from constraint validation](#barred-from-constraint-validation)&#46;

A <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element is <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable) if it is neither <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled) nor has a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;readonly&#45;3"></a><code>[readonly](#attr-textarea-readonly)</code> attribute specified&#46;

When a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> is <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;2"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; its <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[raw value](#concept-textarea-raw-value) should be editable by the user&#58; the user agent should allow the user to edit&#44; insert&#44; and remove text&#44; and to insert and remove line breaks in the form of U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; characters&#46; Any time the user causes the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[raw value](#concept-textarea-raw-value) to change&#44; the user agent must <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element to <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#46; User agents may wait for a suitable break in the user&#39;s interaction before queuing the task&#59; for example&#44; a user agent could wait for the user to have not hit a key for 100ms&#44; so as to only fire the event when the user pauses&#44; instead of continuously for each keystroke&#46;

A <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) must be set to true whenever the user interacts with the control in a way that changes the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[raw value](#concept-textarea-raw-value)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;node&#45;clone&#45;ext"></a>[cloning steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-clone-ext) for <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> elements given <var>node</var>&#44; <var>copy</var>&#44; and <var>subtree</var> are to propagate the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[raw value](#concept-textarea-raw-value) and <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty&#45;2"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) from <var>node</var> to <var>copy</var>&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;children&#45;changed&#45;steps"></a>[children changed steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-children-changed-ext) for <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> elements must&#44; if the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty&#45;3"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) is false&#44; set the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[raw value](#concept-textarea-raw-value) to its <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset&#45;control"></a>[reset algorithm](#concept-form-reset-control) for <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> elements is to set the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;user&#45;validity"></a>[user validity](#user-validity) to false&#44; the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty&#45;4"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) back to false&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[raw value](#concept-textarea-raw-value) to its <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content)&#46;

When a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;12"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element is popped off the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;stack&#45;of&#45;open&#45;elements"></a>[stack of open elements](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#stack-of-open-elements) of an <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;html&#45;parser"></a>[HTML parser](html-language-syntax-parser--877d6146487f--37a9ba51eed8.md#html-parser) or <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;xml&#45;parser"></a>[XML parser](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#xml-parser)&#44; then the user agent must invoke the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset&#45;control&#45;2"></a>[reset algorithm](#concept-form-reset-control)&#46;

If the element is <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;3"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; the user agent should allow the user to change the writing direction of the element&#44; setting it either to a left&#45;to&#45;right writing direction or a right&#45;to&#45;left writing direction&#46; If the user does so&#44; the user agent must then run the following steps&#58;

1.  Set the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dir"></a><code>[dir](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-dir)</code> attribute to &#34;<a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;ltr"></a><code>[ltr](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-dir-ltr)</code>&#34; if the user selected a left&#45;to&#45;right writing direction&#44; and &#34;<a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;dir&#45;rtl"></a><code>[rtl](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-dir-rtl)</code>&#34; if the user selected a right&#45;to&#45;left writing direction&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source&#45;2"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element to <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;event&#45;input&#45;2"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> at the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles&#45;2"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;composed&#45;2"></a><code>[composed](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-composed)</code> attributes initialized to true&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;textarea&#45;cols"></a><strong><code>cols</code></strong> attribute specifies the expected maximum number of characters per line&#46; If the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;cols&#45;2"></a><code>[cols](#attr-textarea-cols)</code> attribute is specified&#44; its value must be a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer) greater than zero&#46; If applying the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers"></a>[rules for parsing non&#45;negative integers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers) to the attribute&#39;s value results in a number greater than zero&#44; then the element&#39;s <a id="attr&#45;textarea&#45;cols&#45;value"></a><strong>character width</strong> is that value&#59; otherwise&#44; it is 20&#46;

The user agent may use the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;cols&#45;value"></a>[character width](#attr-textarea-cols-value) as a hint to the user as to how many characters the server prefers per line &#40;e&#46;g&#46; for visual user agents by making the width of the control be that many characters&#41;&#46; In visual renderings&#44; the user agent should wrap the user&#39;s input in the rendering so that each line is no wider than this number of characters&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;textarea&#45;rows"></a><strong><code>rows</code></strong> attribute specifies the number of lines to show&#46; If the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;rows&#45;2"></a><code>[rows](#attr-textarea-rows)</code> attribute is specified&#44; its value must be a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer&#45;2"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer) greater than zero&#46; If applying the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers&#45;2"></a>[rules for parsing non&#45;negative integers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers) to the attribute&#39;s value results in a number greater than zero&#44; then the element&#39;s <a id="attr&#45;textarea&#45;rows&#45;value"></a><strong>character height</strong> is that value&#59; otherwise&#44; it is 2&#46;

Visual user agents should set the height of the control to the number of lines given by <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;rows&#45;value"></a>[character height](#attr-textarea-rows-value)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;textarea&#45;wrap"></a><strong><code>wrap</code></strong> attribute is an <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="textarea/wrap" id="attr-textarea-wrap-soft" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>soft</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-textarea-wrap-soft-state">Soft</dfn>      </td><td>Text is not to be wrapped when submitted &#40;though can still be wrapped in the rendering&#41;&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="textarea/wrap" id="attr-textarea-wrap-hard" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>hard</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-textarea-wrap-hard-state">Hard</dfn>      </td><td>Text is to have newlines added by the user agent so that the text is wrapped when it is      submitted&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The attribute&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;wrap&#45;soft&#45;state"></a>[Soft](#attr-textarea-wrap-soft-state) state&#46;

If the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;wrap&#45;2"></a><code>[wrap](#attr-textarea-wrap)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;wrap&#45;hard&#45;state"></a>[Hard](#attr-textarea-wrap-hard-state) state&#44; the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;cols&#45;3"></a><code>[cols](#attr-textarea-cols)</code> attribute must be specified&#46;

For historical reasons&#44; the element&#39;s value is normalized in three different ways for three different purposes&#46; The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value&#45;8"></a>[raw value](#concept-textarea-raw-value) is the value as it was originally set&#46; It is not normalized&#46; The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value) is the value used in the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-textarea-value)</code> IDL attribute&#44; <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#45;textlength&#45;2"></a><code>[textLength](#dom-textarea-textlength)</code> IDL attribute&#44; and by the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;maxlength"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-fe-maxlength)</code> and <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;minlength"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-fe-minlength)</code> content attributes&#46; It is normalized so that line breaks use U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; characters&#46; Finally&#44; there is the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value)&#44; as used in form submission and other processing models in this specification&#46; It is normalized as for the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value)&#44; and in addition&#44; if necessary given the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;wrap&#45;3"></a><code>[wrap](#attr-textarea-wrap)</code> attribute&#44; additional line breaks are inserted to wrap the text at the given width&#46;

<a id="textarea&#45;line&#45;break&#45;normalisation&#45;transformation"></a>The algorithm for obtaining the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value) is to return the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value&#45;9"></a>[raw value](#concept-textarea-raw-value)&#44; with <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;normalize&#45;newlines"></a>[newlines normalized](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#normalize-newlines)&#46;

The element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) is defined to be the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value) with the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;textarea&#45;wrapping&#45;transformation"></a>[textarea wrapping transformation](#textarea-wrapping-transformation) applied&#46; The <a id="textarea&#45;wrapping&#45;transformation"></a><strong>textarea wrapping transformation</strong> is the following algorithm&#44; as applied to a string&#58;

1.  If the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;wrap&#45;4"></a><code>[wrap](#attr-textarea-wrap)</code> attribute is in the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;wrap&#45;hard&#45;state&#45;2"></a>[Hard](#attr-textarea-wrap-hard-state) state&#44; insert U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; characters into the string using an <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;implementation&#45;defined"></a>[implementation&#45;defined](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#implementation-defined) algorithm so that each line has no more than <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;cols&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[character width](#attr-textarea-cols-value) characters&#46; For the purposes of this requirement&#44; lines are delimited by the start of the string&#44; the end of the string&#44; and U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; characters&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;textarea&#45;maxlength"></a><strong><code>maxlength</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;maxlength&#45;2"></a>[form control <code>maxlength</code> attribute](#attr-fe-maxlength)&#46;

If the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element has a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;maximum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length"></a>[maximum allowed value length](#maximum-allowed-value-length)&#44; then the element&#39;s children must be such that the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;length&#45;3"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) of the value of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content) with <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;normalize&#45;newlines&#45;2"></a>[newlines normalized](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#normalize-newlines) is less than or equal to the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;maximum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length&#45;2"></a>[maximum allowed value length](#maximum-allowed-value-length)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;textarea&#45;minlength"></a><strong><code>minlength</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;minlength&#45;2"></a>[form control <code>minlength</code> attribute](#attr-fe-minlength)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;textarea&#45;required"></a><strong><code>required</code></strong> attribute is a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;boolean&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; When specified&#44; the user will be required to enter a value before submitting the form&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If the element has its <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;required&#45;2"></a><code>[required](#attr-textarea-required)</code> attribute specified&#44; and the element is <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;mutable&#45;4"></a>[mutable](#concept-fe-mutable)&#44; and the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) is the empty string&#44; then the element is <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;missing"></a>[suffering from being missing](#suffering-from-being-missing)&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;textarea&#45;placeholder"></a><strong><code>placeholder</code></strong> attribute represents a <em>short</em> hint &#40;a word or short phrase&#41; intended to aid the user with data entry when the control has no value&#46; A hint could be a sample value or a brief description of the expected format&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;placeholder&#45;2"></a><code>[placeholder](#attr-textarea-placeholder)</code> attribute should not be used as an alternative to a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code>&#46; For a longer hint or other advisory text&#44; the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;title"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute is more appropriate&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

These mechanisms are very similar but subtly different&#58; the hint given by the control&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code> is shown at all times&#59; the short hint given in the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;placeholder&#45;3"></a><code>[placeholder](#attr-textarea-placeholder)</code> attribute is shown before the user enters a value&#59; and the hint in the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;title&#45;2"></a><code>[title](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#attr-title)</code> attribute is shown when the user requests further help&#46;

User agents should present this hint to the user when the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) is the empty string and the control is not <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;focused"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused) &#40;e&#46;g&#46; by displaying it inside a blank unfocused control&#41;&#46; All U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN U&#43;000A LINE FEED character pairs &#40;CRLF&#41; in the hint&#44; as well as all other U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; and U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; characters in the hint&#44; must be treated as line breaks when rendering the hint&#46;

If a user agent normally doesn&#39;t show this hint to the user when the control is <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;focused&#45;2"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused)&#44; then the user agent should nonetheless show the hint for the control if it was focused as a result of the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autofocus"></a><code>[autofocus](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-fe-autofocus)</code> attribute&#44; since in that case the user will not have had an opportunity to examine the control before focusing it&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute represents the element&#39;s name&#46; The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname&#45;2"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code> attribute controls how the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;directionality&#45;2"></a>[directionality](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-directionality) is submitted&#46; The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-fe-disabled)</code> attribute is used to make the control non&#45;interactive and to prevent its value from being submitted&#46; The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#attr-fae-form)</code> attribute is used to explicitly associate the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;17"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element with its <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;2"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute controls how the user agent provides autofill behavior&#46;

<strong><code><var>textarea</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;textarea&#45;type&#45;dev"></a>[type](#dom-textarea-type)</code></strong>

Returns the string &#34;<code>textarea</code>&#34;&#46;

<strong><code><var>textarea</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;textarea&#45;value&#45;dev"></a>[value](#dom-textarea-value)</code></strong>

Returns the current value of the element&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the value&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;textarea&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> IDL attribute must return the value &#34;<code>textarea</code>&#34;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;textarea&#45;defaultvalue"></a><strong><code>defaultValue</code></strong> attribute&#39;s getter must return the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;child&#45;text&#45;content&#45;3"></a>[child text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-child-text-content)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#45;defaultvalue&#45;2"></a><code>[defaultValue](#dom-textarea-defaultvalue)</code> attribute&#39;s setter must <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;string&#45;replace&#45;all"></a>[string replace all](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#string-replace-all) with the given value within this element&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;textarea&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> IDL attribute must&#44; on getting&#44; return the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value)&#46; On setting&#44; it must perform the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>oldAPIValue</var> be this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value)&#46;

2.  Set this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#45;raw&#45;value&#45;10"></a>[raw value](#concept-textarea-raw-value) to the new value&#46;

3.  Set this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty&#45;5"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) to true&#46;

4.  If the new <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value) is different from <var>oldAPIValue</var>&#44; then move the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;cursor"></a>[text entry cursor position](#concept-textarea/input-cursor) to the end of the text control&#44; unselecting any selected text and <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;set&#45;the&#45;selection&#45;direction"></a>[resetting the selection direction](#set-the-selection-direction) to &#34;<code>none</code>&#34;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;textarea&#45;textlength"></a><strong><code>textLength</code></strong> IDL attribute must return the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;length&#45;4"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value&#45;8"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;willvalidate&#45;2"></a><code>[willValidate](#dom-cva-willvalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validity&#45;2"></a><code>[validity](#dom-cva-validity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validationmessage&#45;2"></a><code>[validationMessage](#dom-cva-validationmessage)</code> IDL attributes&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;checkvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[checkValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-checkvalidity)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;reportvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[reportValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-reportvalidity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[setCustomValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity)</code> methods&#44; are part of the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api"></a>[constraint validation API](#the-constraint-validation-api)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels&#45;2"></a><code>[labels](#dom-lfe-labels)</code> IDL attribute provides a list of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code>s&#46; The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;select&#45;2"></a><code>[select&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-select)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionstart&#45;2"></a><code>[selectionStart](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionend&#45;2"></a><code>[selectionEnd](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectiondirection&#45;2"></a><code>[selectionDirection](#dom-textarea/input-selectiondirection)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext&#45;3"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setselectionrange&#45;2"></a><code>[setSelectionRange&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange)</code> methods and IDL attributes expose the element&#39;s text selection&#46; The <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#45;disabled"></a><code>[disabled](#dom-textarea-disabled)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#dom-fae-form)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#dom-textarea-name)</code> IDL attributes are part of the element&#39;s forms API&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here is an example of a <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;18"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> being used for unrestricted free&#45;form text input in a form&#58;

``` text
<p>If you have any comments, please let us know: <textarea cols=80 name=comments></textarea></p>
```

To specify a maximum length for the comments&#44; one can use the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;maxlength&#45;2"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-textarea-maxlength)</code> attribute&#58;

``` text
<p>If you have any short comments, please let us know: <textarea cols=80 name=comments maxlength=200></textarea></p>
```

To give a default value&#44; text can be included inside the element&#58;

``` text
<p>If you have any comments, please let us know: <textarea cols=80 name=comments>You rock!</textarea></p>
```

You can also give a minimum length&#46; Here&#44; a letter needs to be filled out by the user&#59; a template &#40;which is shorter than the minimum length&#41; is provided&#44; but is insufficient to submit the form&#58;

``` text
<textarea required minlength="500">Dear Madam Speaker,

Regarding your letter dated ...

...

Yours Sincerely,

...</textarea>
```

A placeholder can be given as well&#44; to suggest the basic form to the user&#44; without providing an explicit template&#58;

``` text
<textarea placeholder="Dear Francine,

They closed the parks this week, so we won't be able to
meet your there. Should we just have dinner?

Love,
Daddy"></textarea>
```

To have the browser submit <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;the&#45;directionality&#45;3"></a>[the directionality](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-directionality) of the element along with the value&#44; the <a id="the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname&#45;3"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code> attribute can be specified&#58;

``` text
<p>If you have any comments, please let us know (you may use either English or Hebrew for your comments):
<textarea cols=80 name=comments dirname=comments.dir></textarea></p>
```

Where <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2) is expected&#46;

<a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[Phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

Neither tag is omissible&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;global&#45;attributes"></a>[Global attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#global-attributes)

<a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;output&#45;for"></a><code>[for](#attr-output-for)</code> — Specifies controls from which the output was calculated

<a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fae&#45;form"></a><code>[form](#attr-fae-form)</code> — Associates the element with a <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element

<a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> — Name of the element to use in the <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;form&#45;elements"></a><code>[form&#46;elements](#dom-form-elements)</code> API&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-output)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-output)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmloutputelement"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;domtokenlist&#45;value"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;output&#45;for&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;domtokenlist"></a><a id="dom&#45;output&#45;htmlfor"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;htmlformelement"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;fae&#45;form"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflect&#45;2"></a><a id="dom&#45;output&#45;name"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;output&#45;type"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;output&#45;defaultvalue"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;output&#45;value"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;willvalidate"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;validitystate"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validity"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validationmessage"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;checkvalidity"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;reportvalidity"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;nodelist"></a><a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLOutputElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [SameObject, PutForwards=value, Reflect="for"] readonly attribute DOMTokenList htmlFor;
  readonly attribute HTMLFormElement? form;
  [CEReactions, Reflect] attribute DOMString name;

  readonly attribute DOMString type;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString defaultValue;
  [CEReactions] attribute DOMString value;

  readonly attribute boolean willValidate;
  readonly attribute ValidityState validity;
  readonly attribute DOMString validationMessage;
  boolean checkValidity();
  boolean reportValidity();
  undefined setCustomValidity(DOMString error);

  readonly attribute NodeList labels;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;the&#45;output&#45;element"></a><code>[output](#the-output-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the result of a calculation performed by the application&#44; or the result of a user action&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

This element can be contrasted with the <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;the&#45;samp&#45;element"></a><code>[samp](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#the-samp-element)</code> element&#44; which is the appropriate element for quoting the output of other programs run previously&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Attributes&#47;for](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/for)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox4&#43;Safari7&#43;Chrome10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera11&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;18Internet ExplorerNo

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android11&#43;

The <a id="attr&#45;output&#45;for"></a><strong><code>for</code></strong> content attribute allows an explicit relationship to be made between the result of a calculation and the elements that represent the values that went into the calculation or that otherwise influenced the calculation&#46; The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;output&#45;for&#45;3"></a><code>[for](#attr-output-for)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must contain a string consisting of an <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;unordered&#45;set&#45;of&#45;unique&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>[unordered set of unique space&#45;separated tokens](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#unordered-set-of-unique-space-separated-tokens)&#44; none of which are <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;identical&#45;to"></a>[identical to](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is) another token and each of which must have the value of an <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;id"></a>[ID](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-id) of an element in the same <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;tree"></a>[tree](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#attr-fae-form)</code> attribute is used to explicitly associate the <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;the&#45;output&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[output](#the-output-element)</code> element with its <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute represents the element&#39;s name&#46; The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;the&#45;output&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[output](#the-output-element)</code> element is associated with a form so that it can be easily <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;referenced"></a>[referenced](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#referenced) from the event handlers of form controls&#59; the element&#39;s value itself is not submitted when the form is submitted&#46;

The element has a <a id="concept&#45;output&#45;default&#45;value&#45;override"></a><strong>default value override</strong> &#40;null or a string&#41;&#46; Initially it must be null&#46;

The element&#39;s <a id="concept&#45;output&#45;default&#45;value"></a><strong>default value</strong> is determined by the following steps&#58;

1.  If this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;output&#45;default&#45;value&#45;override"></a>[default value override](#concept-output-default-value-override) is non&#45;null&#44; then return it&#46;

2.  Return this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset&#45;control"></a>[reset algorithm](#concept-form-reset-control) for <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;the&#45;output&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[output](#the-output-element)</code> elements is to run these steps&#58;

1.  <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;string&#45;replace&#45;all"></a>[String replace all](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#string-replace-all) with this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;output&#45;default&#45;value"></a>[default value](#concept-output-default-value) within this element&#46;

2.  Set this element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;output&#45;default&#45;value&#45;override&#45;2"></a>[default value override](#concept-output-default-value-override) to null&#46;

<strong><code><var>output</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;output&#45;value&#45;dev"></a>[value](#dom-output-value) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns the element&#39;s current value&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the value&#46;

<strong><code><var>output</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;output&#45;defaultvalue&#45;dev"></a>[defaultValue](#dom-output-defaultvalue) &#91; &#61; <var>value</var> &#93;</code></strong>

Returns the element&#39;s current default value&#46;

Can be set&#44; to change the default value&#46;

<strong><code><var>output</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;output&#45;type&#45;dev"></a>[type](#dom-output-type)</code></strong>

Returns the string &#34;<code>output</code>&#34;&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;output&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> getter steps are to return <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;descendant&#45;text&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[descendant text content](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-descendant-text-content)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;output&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-output-value)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  Set <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;output&#45;default&#45;value&#45;override&#45;3"></a>[default value override](#concept-output-default-value-override) to its <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;output&#45;default&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[default value](#concept-output-default-value)&#46;

2.  <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;string&#45;replace&#45;all&#45;2"></a>[String replace all](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#string-replace-all) with the given value within <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;output&#45;defaultvalue"></a><strong><code>defaultValue</code></strong> getter steps are to return the result of running <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;output&#45;default&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[default value](#concept-output-default-value)&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;output&#45;defaultvalue&#45;2"></a><code>[defaultValue](#dom-output-defaultvalue)</code> setter steps are&#58;

1.  If <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;output&#45;default&#45;value&#45;override&#45;4"></a>[default value override](#concept-output-default-value-override) is null&#44; then <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;string&#45;replace&#45;all&#45;3"></a>[string replace all](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#string-replace-all) with the given value within <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) and return&#46;

2.  Set <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;this&#45;7"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;output&#45;default&#45;value&#45;override&#45;5"></a>[default value override](#concept-output-default-value-override) to the given value&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;output&#45;type"></a><strong><code>type</code></strong> getter steps are to return &#34;<code>output</code>&#34;&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;willvalidate&#45;2"></a><code>[willValidate](#dom-cva-willvalidate)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validity&#45;2"></a><code>[validity](#dom-cva-validity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;validationmessage&#45;2"></a><code>[validationMessage](#dom-cva-validationmessage)</code> IDL attributes&#44; and the <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;checkvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[checkValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-checkvalidity)</code>&#44; <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;reportvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[reportValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-reportvalidity)</code>&#44; and <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[setCustomValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity)</code> methods&#44; are part of the <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api"></a>[constraint validation API](#the-constraint-validation-api)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels&#45;2"></a><code>[labels](#dom-lfe-labels)</code> IDL attribute provides a list of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code>s&#46; The <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;fae&#45;form&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#dom-fae-form)</code> and <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;output&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#dom-output-name)</code> IDL attributes are part of the element&#39;s forms API&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

A simple calculator could use <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;the&#45;output&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[output](#the-output-element)</code> for its display of calculated results&#58;

``` text
<form onsubmit="return false" oninput="o.value = a.valueAsNumber + b.valueAsNumber">
 <input id=a type=number step=any> +
 <input id=b type=number step=any> =
 <output id=o for="a b"></output>
</form>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; an <a id="the&#45;output&#45;element&#58;the&#45;output&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[output](#the-output-element)</code> element is used to report the results of a calculation performed by a remote server&#44; as they come in&#58;

``` text
<output id="result"></output>
<script>
 var primeSource = new WebSocket('ws://primes.example.net/');
 primeSource.onmessage = function (event) {
   document.getElementById('result').value = event.data;
 }
</script>
```

<a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2"></a>[Phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#46;

Where <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;2"></a>[phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2) is expected&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;content&#45;model"></a>[Content model](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-content-model)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;phrasing&#45;content&#45;2&#45;3"></a>[Phrasing content](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#phrasing-content-2)&#44; but there must be no <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;the&#45;progress&#45;element"></a><code>[progress](#the-progress-element)</code> element descendants&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;tag&#45;omission"></a>[Tag omission in text&#47;html](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-tag-omission)&#58;</strong>

Neither tag is omissible&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;attributes"></a>[Content attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-attributes)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-progress-max)</code> — Upper bound of range

<strong><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;accessibility&#45;considerations"></a>[Accessibility considerations](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-accessibility-considerations)&#58;</strong>

[For authors](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/#el-progress)&#46;

[For implementers](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/#el-progress)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;sanitization"></a>[Sanitization](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-sanitization)&#58;</strong>

<a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;sanitizer&#45;uncategorized"></a>[Uncategorized](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sanitizer-uncategorized)&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmlprogresselement"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;progress&#45;value"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectpositive"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectdefault"></a><a id="dom&#45;progress&#45;max"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;progress&#45;position"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;nodelist"></a><a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLProgressElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute double value;
  [CEReactions, ReflectPositive, ReflectDefault=1.0] attribute double max;
  readonly attribute double position;
  readonly attribute NodeList labels;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;the&#45;progress&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[progress](#the-progress-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) the completion progress of a task&#46; The progress is either indeterminate&#44; indicating that progress is being made but that it is not clear how much more work remains to be done before the task is complete &#40;e&#46;g&#46; because the task is waiting for a remote host to respond&#41;&#44; or the progress is a number in the range zero to a maximum&#44; giving the fraction of work that has so far been completed&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Attributes&#47;max](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/max)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox6&#43;Safari6&#43;Chrome6&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera11&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS7&#43;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android11&#43;

There are two attributes that determine the current task completion represented by the element&#46; The <a id="attr&#45;progress&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> attribute specifies how much of the task has been completed&#44; and the <a id="attr&#45;progress&#45;max"></a><strong><code>max</code></strong> attribute specifies how much work the task requires in total&#46; The units are arbitrary and not specified&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

To make a determinate progress bar&#44; add a <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#attr-progress-value)</code> attribute with the current progress &#40;either a number from 0&#46;0 to 1&#46;0&#44; or&#44; if the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;max&#45;2"></a><code>[max](#attr-progress-max)</code> attribute is specified&#44; a number from 0 to the value of the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;max&#45;3"></a><code>[max](#attr-progress-max)</code> attribute&#41;&#46; To make an indeterminate progress bar&#44; remove the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;3"></a><code>[value](#attr-progress-value)</code> attribute&#46;

Authors are encouraged to also include the current value and the maximum value inline as text inside the element&#44; so that the progress is made available to users of legacy user agents&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here is a snippet of a web application that shows the progress of some automated task&#58;

``` text
<section>
 <h2>Task Progress</h2>
 <p>Progress: <progress id=p max=100><span>0</span>%</progress></p>
 <script>
  var progressBar = document.getElementById('p');
  function updateProgress(newValue) {
    progressBar.value = newValue;
    progressBar.getElementsByTagName('span')[0].textContent = newValue;
  }
 </script>
</section>
```

&#40;The <code>updateProgress&#40;&#41;</code> method in this example would be called by some other code on the page to update the actual progress bar as the task progressed&#46;&#41;

The <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;4"></a><code>[value](#attr-progress-value)</code> and <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;max&#45;4"></a><code>[max](#attr-progress-max)</code> attributes&#44; when present&#44; must have values that are <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;valid&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number"></a>[valid floating&#45;point numbers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-floating-point-number)&#46; The <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;5"></a><code>[value](#attr-progress-value)</code> attribute&#44; if present&#44; must have a value greater than or equal to zero&#44; and less than or equal to the value of the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;max&#45;5"></a><code>[max](#attr-progress-max)</code> attribute&#44; if present&#44; or 1&#46;0&#44; otherwise&#46; The <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;max&#45;6"></a><code>[max](#attr-progress-max)</code> attribute&#44; if present&#44; must have a value greater than zero&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;the&#45;progress&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[progress](#the-progress-element)</code> element is the wrong element to use for something that is just a gauge&#44; as opposed to task progress&#46; For instance&#44; indicating disk space usage using <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;the&#45;progress&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[progress](#the-progress-element)</code> would be inappropriate&#46; Instead&#44; the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;the&#45;meter&#45;element"></a><code>[meter](#the-meter-element)</code> element is available for such use cases&#46;

<strong>User agent requirements</strong>&#58; If the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;6"></a><code>[value](#attr-progress-value)</code> attribute is omitted&#44; then the progress bar is an indeterminate progress bar&#46; Otherwise&#44; it is a determinate progress bar&#46;

If the progress bar is a determinate progress bar and the element has a <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;max&#45;7"></a><code>[max](#attr-progress-max)</code> attribute&#44; the user agent must parse the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;max&#45;8"></a><code>[max](#attr-progress-max)</code> attribute&#39;s value according to the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;values"></a>[rules for parsing floating&#45;point number values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-floating-point-number-values)&#46; If this does not result in an error&#44; and if the parsed value is greater than zero&#44; then the <a id="concept&#45;progress&#45;maximum"></a><strong>maximum value</strong> of the progress bar is that value&#46; Otherwise&#44; if the element has no <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;max&#45;9"></a><code>[max](#attr-progress-max)</code> attribute&#44; or if it has one but parsing it resulted in an error&#44; or if the parsed value was less than or equal to zero&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;maximum"></a>[maximum value](#concept-progress-maximum) of the progress bar is 1&#46;0&#46;

If the progress bar is a determinate progress bar&#44; user agents must parse the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;7"></a><code>[value](#attr-progress-value)</code> attribute&#39;s value according to the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;floating&#45;point&#45;number&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[rules for parsing floating&#45;point number values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-floating-point-number-values)&#46; If this does not result in an error and the parsed value is greater than zero&#44; then the <a id="concept&#45;progress&#45;value"></a><strong>value</strong> of the progress bar is that parsed value&#46; Otherwise&#44; if parsing the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;attr&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;8"></a><code>[value](#attr-progress-value)</code> attribute&#39;s value resulted in an error or a number less than or equal to zero&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-progress-value) of the progress bar is zero&#46;

If the progress bar is a determinate progress bar&#44; then the <a id="concept&#45;progress&#45;current&#45;value"></a><strong>current value</strong> is the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;maximum&#45;2"></a>[maximum value](#concept-progress-maximum)&#44; if <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-progress-value) is greater than the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;maximum&#45;3"></a>[maximum value](#concept-progress-maximum)&#44; and <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-progress-value) otherwise&#46;

<strong>UA requirements for showing the progress bar</strong>&#58; When representing a <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;the&#45;progress&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[progress](#the-progress-element)</code> element to the user&#44; the UA should indicate whether it is a determinate or indeterminate progress bar&#44; and in the former case&#44; should indicate the relative position of the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;current&#45;value"></a>[current value](#concept-progress-current-value) relative to the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;maximum&#45;4"></a>[maximum value](#concept-progress-maximum)&#46;

<strong><code><var>progress</var>&#46;<a id="dom&#45;progress&#45;position&#45;dev"></a>[position](#dom-progress-position)</code></strong>

For a determinate progress bar &#40;one with known current and maximum values&#41;&#44; returns the result of dividing the current value by the maximum value&#46;

For an indeterminate progress bar&#44; returns −1&#46;

If the progress bar is an indeterminate progress bar&#44; then the <a id="dom&#45;progress&#45;position"></a><strong><code>position</code></strong> IDL attribute must return −1&#46; Otherwise&#44; it must return the result of dividing the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;current&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[current value](#concept-progress-current-value) by the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;maximum&#45;5"></a>[maximum value](#concept-progress-maximum)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;progress&#45;value"></a><strong><code>value</code></strong> getter steps are to return 0 if <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this) is an indeterminate progress bar&#59; otherwise <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[current value](#concept-progress-value)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Setting the <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;progress&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#dom-progress-value)</code> IDL attribute to itself when the corresponding content attribute is absent would change the progress bar from an indeterminate progress bar to a determinate progress bar with no progress&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels&#45;2"></a><code>[labels](#dom-lfe-labels)</code> IDL attribute provides a list of the element&#39;s <a id="the&#45;progress&#45;element&#58;the&#45;label&#45;element"></a><code>[label](#the-label-element)</code>s&#46;

<strong><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;concept&#45;element&#45;dom"></a>[DOM interface](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-element-dom)&#58;</strong>

<a id="htmlmeterelement"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;htmlelement"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;htmlconstructor"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;cereactions"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;meter&#45;value"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter&#45;2"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;meter&#45;min"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter&#45;3"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;meter&#45;max"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter&#45;4"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;meter&#45;low"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;5"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter&#45;5"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;meter&#45;high"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;cereactions&#45;6"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;xattr&#45;reflectsetter&#45;6"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;meter&#45;optimum"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;nodelist"></a><a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;dom&#45;lfe&#45;labels"></a>

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface HTMLMeterElement : HTMLElement {
  [HTMLConstructor] constructor();

  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute double value;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute double min;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute double max;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute double low;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute double high;
  [CEReactions, ReflectSetter] attribute double optimum;
  readonly attribute NodeList labels;
};
```

The <a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;the&#45;meter&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[meter](#the-meter-element)</code> element <a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;represents"></a>[represents](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#represents) a scalar measurement within a known range&#44; or a fractional value&#59; for example disk usage&#44; the relevance of a query result&#44; or the fraction of a voting population to have selected a particular candidate&#46;

This is also known as a gauge&#46;

The <a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;the&#45;meter&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[meter](#the-meter-element)</code> element should not be used to indicate progress &#40;as in a progress bar&#41;&#46; For that role&#44; HTML provides a separate <a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;the&#45;progress&#45;element"></a><code>[progress](#the-progress-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="the&#45;meter&#45;element&#58;the&#45;meter&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[meter](#the-meter-element)</code> element also does not represent a scalar value of arbitrary range — for example&#44; it would be wrong to use this to report a weight&#44; or height&#44; unless there is a known maximum value&#46;

There are six attributes that determine the semantics of the gauge represented by the element&#46;

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Attributes&#47;max](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/max)

Support in all current engines&#46;
