#### <a id="attributes&#45;common&#45;to&#45;form&#45;controls"></a>4&#46;10&#46;19 Attributes common to form controls[](#attributes-common-to-form-controls)

##### <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute"></a>4&#46;10&#46;19&#46;1 Naming form controls&#58; the <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute[](#naming-form-controls:-the-name-attribute)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;input&#35;name](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input#name)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox1&#43;Safari1&#43;Chrome1&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera12&#46;1&#43;Edge79&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Edge &#40;Legacy&#41;12&#43;Internet Explorer5&#46;5&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

The <a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;name"></a><strong><code>name</code></strong> content attribute gives the name of the form control&#44; as used in <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;form&#45;submission&#45;2"></a>[form submission](#form-submission-2) and in the <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;dom&#45;form&#45;elements"></a><code>[elements](#dom-form-elements)</code> object&#46; If the attribute is specified&#44; its value must not be the empty string or <code>isindex</code>&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

A number of user agents historically implemented special support for first&#45;in&#45;form text controls with the name <code>isindex</code>&#44; and this specification previously defined related user agent requirements for it&#46; However&#44; some user agents subsequently dropped that special support&#44; and the related requirements were removed from this specification&#46; So&#44; to avoid problematic reinterpretations in legacy user agents&#44; the name <code>isindex</code> is no longer allowed&#46;

Other than <code>isindex</code>&#44; any non&#45;empty value for <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;form&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#attr-form-name)</code> is allowed&#46; An <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the name <a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;charset"></a><strong><code>&#95;charset&#95;</code></strong> is special&#58; if used as the name of a <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;"></a>[Hidden](#hidden-state-(type=hidden)) control with no <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute&#44; then during submission the <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value&#45;2"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute is automatically given a value consisting of the submission character encoding&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

DOM clobbering is a common cause of security issues&#46; Avoid using the names of built&#45;in form properties with the <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> content attribute&#46;

In this example&#44; the <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element overrides the built&#45;in <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method"></a><code>[method](#attr-fs-method)</code> property&#58;

``` text
let form = document.createElement("form");
let input = document.createElement("input");
form.appendChild(input);

form.method;           // => "get"
input.name = "method"; // DOM clobbering occurs here
form.method === input; // => true
```

Since the input name takes precedence over built&#45;in form properties&#44; the JavaScript reference <code>form&#46;method</code> will point to the <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element named &#34;method&#34; instead of the built&#45;in <a id="naming&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;name&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;2"></a><code>[method](#attr-fs-method)</code> property&#46;

##### <a id="submitting&#45;element&#45;directionality&#58;&#45;the&#45;dirname&#45;attribute"></a>4&#46;10&#46;19&#46;2 Submitting element directionality&#58; the <a id="submitting&#45;element&#45;directionality&#58;&#45;the&#45;dirname&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code> attribute[](#submitting-element-directionality:-the-dirname-attribute)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

The <a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><strong><code>dirname</code></strong> attribute on a form control element enables the submission of <a id="submitting&#45;element&#45;directionality&#58;&#45;the&#45;dirname&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;directionality"></a>[the directionality](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-directionality) of the element&#44; and gives the name of the control that contains this value during <a id="submitting&#45;element&#45;directionality&#58;&#45;the&#45;dirname&#45;attribute&#58;form&#45;submission&#45;2"></a>[form submission](#form-submission-2)&#46; If such an attribute is specified&#44; its value must not be the empty string&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a form contains a text control and a submission button&#58;

``` text
<form action="addcomment.cgi" method=post>
 <p><label>Comment: <input type=text name="comment" dirname="comment.dir" required></label></p>
 <p><button name="mode" type=submit value="add">Post Comment</button></p>
</form>
```

When the user submits the form&#44; the user agent includes three fields&#44; one called &#34;comment&#34;&#44; one called &#34;comment&#46;dir&#34;&#44; and one called &#34;mode&#34;&#59; so if the user types &#34;Hello&#34;&#44; the submission body might be something like&#58;

``` text
comment=Hello&comment.dir=ltr&mode=add
```

If the user manually switches to a right&#45;to&#45;left writing direction and enters &#34;مرحبا&#34;&#44; the submission body might be something like&#58;

``` text
comment=%D9%85%D8%B1%D8%AD%D8%A8%D8%A7&comment.dir=rtl&mode=add
```

##### <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute"></a>4&#46;10&#46;19&#46;3 Limiting user input length&#58; the <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;maxlength"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-fe-maxlength)</code> attribute[](#limiting-user-input-length:-the-maxlength-attribute)

A <a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;maxlength"></a><strong>form control <code>maxlength</code> attribute</strong>&#44; controlled by the <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty)&#44; declares a limit on the number of characters a user can input&#46; The number of characters is measured using <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;length"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) and&#44; in the case of <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> elements&#44; with all newlines normalized to a single character &#40;as opposed to CRLF pairs&#41;&#46;

If an element has its <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;maxlength&#45;2"></a>[form control <code>maxlength</code> attribute](#attr-fe-maxlength) specified&#44; the attribute&#39;s value must be a <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer)&#46; If the attribute is specified and applying the <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers"></a>[rules for parsing non&#45;negative integers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers) to its value results in a number&#44; then that number is the element&#39;s <a id="maximum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length"></a><strong>maximum allowed value length</strong>&#46; If the attribute is omitted or parsing its value results in an error&#44; then there is no <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;maximum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length"></a>[maximum allowed value length](#maximum-allowed-value-length)&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If an element has a <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;maximum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length&#45;2"></a>[maximum allowed value length](#maximum-allowed-value-length)&#44; its <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty&#45;2"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) is true&#44; its <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) was last changed by a user edit &#40;as opposed to a change made by a script&#41;&#44; and the <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;length&#45;2"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) of the element&#39;s <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value) is greater than the element&#39;s <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;maximum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length&#45;3"></a>[maximum allowed value length](#maximum-allowed-value-length)&#44; then the element is <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;too&#45;long"></a>[suffering from being too long](#suffering-from-being-too-long)&#46;

User agents may prevent the user from causing the element&#39;s <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value) to be set to a value whose <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;length&#45;3"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) is greater than the element&#39;s <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;maximum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length&#45;4"></a>[maximum allowed value length](#maximum-allowed-value-length)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

In the case of <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> elements&#44; the <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value) and <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) differ&#46; In particular&#44; <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;normalize&#45;newlines"></a>[newline normalization](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#normalize-newlines) is applied before the <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;maximum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length&#45;5"></a>[maximum allowed value length](#maximum-allowed-value-length) is checked &#40;whereas the <a id="limiting&#45;user&#45;input&#45;length&#58;&#45;the&#45;maxlength&#45;attribute&#58;textarea&#45;wrapping&#45;transformation"></a>[textarea wrapping transformation](#textarea-wrapping-transformation) is not applied&#41;&#46;

##### <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute"></a>4&#46;10&#46;19&#46;4 Setting minimum input length requirements&#58; the <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;minlength"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-fe-minlength)</code> attribute[](#setting-minimum-input-length-requirements:-the-minlength-attribute)

A <a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;minlength"></a><strong>form control <code>minlength</code> attribute</strong>&#44; controlled by the <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty)&#44; declares a lower bound on the number of characters a user can input&#46; The &#34;number of characters&#34; is measured using <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;length"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) and&#44; in the case of <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> elements&#44; with all newlines normalized to a single character &#40;as opposed to CRLF pairs&#41;&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;minlength&#45;2"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-fe-minlength)</code> attribute does not imply the <code>required</code> attribute&#46; If the form control has no <code>required</code> attribute&#44; then the value can still be omitted&#59; the <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;minlength&#45;3"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-fe-minlength)</code> attribute only kicks in once the user has entered a value at all&#46; If the empty string is not allowed&#44; then the <code>required</code> attribute also needs to be set&#46;

If an element has its <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;minlength&#45;4"></a>[form control <code>minlength</code> attribute](#attr-fe-minlength) specified&#44; the attribute&#39;s value must be a <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integer"></a>[valid non&#45;negative integer](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-negative-integer)&#46; If the attribute is specified and applying the <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;rules&#45;for&#45;parsing&#45;non&#45;negative&#45;integers"></a>[rules for parsing non&#45;negative integers](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#rules-for-parsing-non-negative-integers) to its value results in a number&#44; then that number is the element&#39;s <a id="minimum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length"></a><strong>minimum allowed value length</strong>&#46; If the attribute is omitted or parsing its value results in an error&#44; then there is no <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;minimum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length"></a>[minimum allowed value length](#minimum-allowed-value-length)&#46;

If an element has both a <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;maximum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length"></a>[maximum allowed value length](#maximum-allowed-value-length) and a <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;minimum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length&#45;2"></a>[minimum allowed value length](#minimum-allowed-value-length)&#44; the <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;minimum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length&#45;3"></a>[minimum allowed value length](#minimum-allowed-value-length) must be smaller than or equal to the <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;maximum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length&#45;2"></a>[maximum allowed value length](#maximum-allowed-value-length)&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If an element has a <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;minimum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length&#45;4"></a>[minimum allowed value length](#minimum-allowed-value-length)&#44; its <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty&#45;2"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) is true&#44; its <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) was last changed by a user edit &#40;as opposed to a change made by a script&#41;&#44; its <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) is not the empty string&#44; and the <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;length&#45;2"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) of the element&#39;s <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;api&#45;value"></a>[API value](#concept-fe-api-value) is less than the element&#39;s <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;minimum&#45;allowed&#45;value&#45;length&#45;5"></a>[minimum allowed value length](#minimum-allowed-value-length)&#44; then the element is <a id="setting&#45;minimum&#45;input&#45;length&#45;requirements&#58;&#45;the&#45;minlength&#45;attribute&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;too&#45;short"></a>[suffering from being too short](#suffering-from-being-too-short)&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; there are four text controls&#46; The first is required&#44; and has to be at least 5 characters long&#46; The other three are optional&#44; but if the user fills one in&#44; the user has to enter at least 10 characters&#46;

``` text
<form action="/events/menu.cgi" method="post">
 <p><label>Name of Event: <input required minlength=5 maxlength=50 name=event></label></p>
 <p><label>Describe what you would like for breakfast, if anything:
    <textarea name="breakfast" minlength="10"></textarea></label></p>
 <p><label>Describe what you would like for lunch, if anything:
    <textarea name="lunch" minlength="10"></textarea></label></p>
 <p><label>Describe what you would like for dinner, if anything:
    <textarea name="dinner" minlength="10"></textarea></label></p>
 <p><input type=submit value="Submit Request"></p>
</form>
```

##### <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute"></a>4&#46;10&#46;19&#46;5 Enabling and disabling form controls&#58; the <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-fe-disabled)</code> attribute[](#enabling-and-disabling-form-controls:-the-disabled-attribute)

The <a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a><strong><code>disabled</code></strong> content attribute is a <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attribute](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

The <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;option&#45;disabled"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-option-disabled)</code> attribute for <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> elements and the <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;optgroup&#45;disabled"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-optgroup-disabled)</code> attribute for <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;optgroup&#45;element"></a><code>[optgroup](#the-optgroup-element)</code> elements are defined separately&#46;

A form control is <a id="concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a><strong>disabled</strong> if any of the following are true&#58;

- the element is a <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;button&#45;element"></a><code>[button](#the-button-element)</code>&#44; <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code>&#44; <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code>&#44; <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code>&#44; or <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; and the <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-fe-disabled)</code> attribute is specified on this element &#40;regardless of its value&#41;&#59; or

- the element is a descendant of a <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;fieldset&#45;element"></a><code>[fieldset](#the-fieldset-element)</code> element whose <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fieldset&#45;disabled"></a><code>[disabled](#attr-fieldset-disabled)</code> attribute is specified&#44; and the element is <em>not</em> a descendant of that <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;fieldset&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[fieldset](#the-fieldset-element)</code> element&#39;s first <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;legend&#45;element"></a><code>[legend](#the-legend-element)</code> element child&#44; if any&#46;

A form control that is <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled) must prevent any <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;event&#45;click"></a><code>[click](https://w3c.github.io/pointerevents/#click)</code> events that are <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;queue&#45;a&#45;task"></a>[queued](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-a-task) on the <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) from being dispatched on the element&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Being <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled&#45;2"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled) does not prevent all modifications to the form control&#46; For example&#44; the control&#39;s <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) or <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) could be modified programmatically from JavaScript&#46; Or&#44; they could be indirectly modified by user action&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; if other non&#45;disabled elements in the control&#39;s <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group"></a>[radio button group](#radio-button-group) were modified&#46;

<strong>Constraint validation</strong>&#58; If an element is <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled&#45;3"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled)&#44; it is <a id="enabling&#45;and&#45;disabling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;disabled&#45;attribute&#58;barred&#45;from&#45;constraint&#45;validation"></a>[barred from constraint validation](#barred-from-constraint-validation)&#46;

##### <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes"></a>4&#46;10&#46;19&#46;6 Form submission attributes[](#form-submission-attributes)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Element&#47;form&#35;Attributes&#95;for&#95;form&#95;submission](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/form#Attributes_for_form_submission)

Support in all current engines&#46;

Firefox4&#43;Safari10&#46;1&#43;Chrome10&#43;

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Opera&#63;Edge79&#43;

<a id="attributes&#45;for&#45;form&#45;submission"></a><strong>Attributes for form submission</strong> can be specified both on <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> elements and on <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button"></a>[submit buttons](#concept-submit-button) &#40;elements that represent buttons that submit forms&#44; e&#46;g&#46; an <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;submit&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;submit&#41;"></a>[Submit Button](#submit-button-state-(type=submit)) state&#41;&#46;

The <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attributes&#45;for&#45;form&#45;submission"></a>[attributes for form submission](#attributes-for-form-submission) that may be specified on <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> elements are <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;action"></a><code>[action](#attr-fs-action)</code>&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype"></a><code>[enctype](#attr-fs-enctype)</code>&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method"></a><code>[method](#attr-fs-method)</code>&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;novalidate"></a><code>[novalidate](#attr-fs-novalidate)</code>&#44; and <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;target"></a><code>[target](#attr-fs-target)</code>&#46;

The corresponding <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attributes&#45;for&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;2"></a>[attributes for form submission](#attributes-for-form-submission) that may be specified on <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;2"></a>[submit buttons](#concept-submit-button) are <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code>&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code>&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code>&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code>&#44; and <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code>&#46; When omitted&#44; they default to the values given on the corresponding attributes on the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;action"></a><strong><code>action</code></strong> and <a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><strong><code>formaction</code></strong> content attributes&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;valid&#45;non&#45;empty&#45;url&#45;potentially&#45;surrounded&#45;by&#45;spaces"></a>[valid non&#45;empty URL potentially surrounded by spaces](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#valid-non-empty-url-potentially-surrounded-by-spaces)&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;fs&#45;action"></a><strong>action</strong> of an element is the value of the element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction&#45;2"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code> attribute&#44; if the element is a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;3"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button) and has such an attribute&#44; or the value of its <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;action&#45;2"></a><code>[action](#attr-fs-action)</code> attribute&#44; if <em>it</em> has one&#44; or else the empty string&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;method"></a><strong><code>method</code></strong> and <a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><strong><code>formmethod</code></strong> content attributes are <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute"></a>[enumerated attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

<table><thead><tr><th>Keyword      </th><th>State      </th><th>Brief description    </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="form/method,button/formmethod,input/formmethod" id="attr-fs-method-get-keyword" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>get</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-fs-method-get">GET</dfn>      </td><td>Indicates the <code id="form-submission-attributes:the-form-element-4"><a href="#the-form-element">form</a></code> will use the HTTP GET method&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="form/method,button/formmethod,input/formmethod" id="attr-fs-method-post-keyword" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>post</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-fs-method-post">POST</dfn>      </td><td>Indicates the <code id="form-submission-attributes:the-form-element-5"><a href="#the-form-element">form</a></code> will use the HTTP POST method&#46;     </td></tr><tr><td><dfn data-dfn-for="form/method,button/formmethod,input/formmethod" id="attr-fs-method-dialog-keyword" data-dfn-type="attr-value"><code>dialog</code></dfn>      </td><td><dfn id="attr-fs-method-dialog">Dialog</dfn>      </td><td>Indicates the <code id="form-submission-attributes:the-form-element-6"><a href="#the-form-element">form</a></code> is intended to close the <code id="form-submission-attributes:the-dialog-element"><a href="html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-dialog-element">dialog</a></code> box in which      the form finds itself&#44; if any&#44; and otherwise not submit&#46;   </td></tr></tbody></table>

The <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;2"></a><code>[method](#attr-fs-method)</code> attribute&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;get"></a>[GET](#attr-fs-method-get) state&#46;

The <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod&#45;2"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code> attribute has no <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default&#45;2"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em>&#44; and its <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default&#45;2"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> is the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;get&#45;2"></a>[GET](#attr-fs-method-get) state&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;fs&#45;method"></a><strong>method</strong> of an element is one of those states&#46; If the element is a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;4"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button) and has a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod&#45;3"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code> attribute&#44; then the element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;fs&#45;method"></a>[method](#concept-fs-method) is that attribute&#39;s state&#59; otherwise&#44; it is the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;3"></a><code>[method](#attr-fs-method)</code> attribute&#39;s state&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

Here the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;4"></a><code>[method](#attr-fs-method)</code> attribute is used to explicitly specify the default value&#44; &#34;<a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;get&#45;keyword"></a><code>[get](#attr-fs-method-get-keyword)</code>&#34;&#44; so that the search query is submitted in the URL&#58;

``` text
<form method="get" action="/search.cgi">
 <p><label>Search terms: <input type=search name=q></label></p>
 <p><input type=submit></p>
</form>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

On the other hand&#44; here the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;5"></a><code>[method](#attr-fs-method)</code> attribute is used to specify the value &#34;<a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;post&#45;keyword"></a><code>[post](#attr-fs-method-post-keyword)</code>&#34;&#44; so that the user&#39;s message is submitted in the HTTP request&#39;s body&#58;

``` text
<form method="post" action="/post-message.cgi">
 <p><label>Message: <input type=text name=m></label></p>
 <p><input type=submit value="Submit message"></p>
</form>
```

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example&#44; a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> is used with a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[dialog](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-dialog-element)</code>&#46; The <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;6"></a><code>[method](#attr-fs-method)</code> attribute&#39;s &#34;<a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;dialog&#45;keyword"></a><code>[dialog](#attr-fs-method-dialog-keyword)</code>&#34; keyword is used to have the dialog automatically close when the form is submitted&#46;

``` text
<dialog id="ship">
 <form method=dialog>
  <p>A ship has arrived in the harbour.</p>
  <button type=submit value="board">Board the ship</button>
  <button type=submit value="call">Call to the captain</button>
 </form>
</dialog>
<script>
 var ship = document.getElementById('ship');
 ship.showModal();
 ship.onclose = function (event) {
   if (ship.returnValue == 'board') {
     // ...
   } else {
     // ...
   }
 };
</script>
```

The <a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype"></a><strong><code>enctype</code></strong> and <a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><strong><code>formenctype</code></strong> content attributes are <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;enumerated&#45;attribute&#45;2"></a>[enumerated attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#enumerated-attribute) with the following keywords and states&#58;

- The &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;urlencoded"></a><strong><code>application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded</code></strong>&#34; keyword and corresponding state&#46;
- The &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;formdata"></a><strong><code>multipart&#47;form&#45;data</code></strong>&#34; keyword and corresponding state&#46;
- The &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;text"></a><strong><code>text&#47;plain</code></strong>&#34; keyword and corresponding state&#46;

The attribute&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default&#45;3"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em> and <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default&#45;3"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> are both the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;urlencoded"></a><code>[application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded](#attr-fs-enctype-urlencoded)</code> state&#46;

The <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype&#45;2"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code> attribute has no <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;missing&#45;value&#45;default&#45;4"></a><em>[missing value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#missing-value-default)</em>&#44; and its <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;invalid&#45;value&#45;default&#45;4"></a><em>[invalid value default](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#invalid-value-default)</em> is the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;urlencoded&#45;2"></a><code>[application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded](#attr-fs-enctype-urlencoded)</code> state&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;fs&#45;enctype"></a><strong>enctype</strong> of an element is one of those three states&#46; If the element is a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;5"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button) and has a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype&#45;3"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code> attribute&#44; then the element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;fs&#45;enctype"></a>[enctype](#concept-fs-enctype) is that attribute&#39;s state&#59; otherwise&#44; it is the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;3"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;2"></a><code>[enctype](#attr-fs-enctype)</code> attribute&#39;s state&#46;

The <a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;novalidate"></a><strong><code>novalidate</code></strong> and <a id="attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate"></a><strong><code>formnovalidate</code></strong> content attributes are <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;boolean&#45;attribute"></a>[boolean attributes](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#boolean-attribute)&#46; If present&#44; they indicate that the form is not to be validated during submission&#46;

The <a id="concept&#45;fs&#45;novalidate"></a><strong>no&#45;validate state</strong> of an element is true if the element is a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;6"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button) and the element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formnovalidate&#45;2"></a><code>[formnovalidate](#attr-fs-formnovalidate)</code> attribute is present&#44; or if the element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;4"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;novalidate&#45;2"></a><code>[novalidate](#attr-fs-novalidate)</code> attribute is present&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

This attribute is useful to include &#34;save&#34; buttons on forms that have validation constraints&#44; to allow users to save their progress even though they haven&#39;t fully entered the data in the form&#46; The following example shows a simple form that has two required fields&#46; There are three buttons&#58; one to submit the form&#44; which requires both fields to be filled in&#59; one to save the form so that the user can come back and fill it in later&#59; and one to cancel the form altogether&#46;

``` text
<form action="editor.cgi" method="post">
 <p><label>Name: <input required name=fn></label></p>
 <p><label>Essay: <textarea required name=essay></textarea></label></p>
 <p><input type=submit name=submit value="Submit essay"></p>
 <p><input type=submit formnovalidate name=save value="Save essay"></p>
 <p><input type=submit formnovalidate name=cancel value="Cancel"></p>
</form>
```

The <a id="dom&#45;fs&#45;action"></a><strong><code>action</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>attribute</var> be <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;this"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;action&#45;3"></a><code>[action](#attr-fs-action)</code> attribute&#46;

2.  If <var>attribute</var> is null or <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value) is the empty string&#44; then return <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;2"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url)&#46;

3.  Let <var>urlString</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url) given <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value)&#44; relative to <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;3"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

4.  If <var>urlString</var> is not failure&#44; then return <var>urlString</var>&#46;

5.  Return <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value)&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;convert"></a>[converted to a scalar value string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-string-convert)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;fs&#45;formaction"></a><strong><code>formAction</code></strong> getter steps are&#58;

1.  Let <var>attribute</var> be <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;4"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formaction&#45;3"></a><code>[formaction](#attr-fs-formaction)</code> attribute&#46;

2.  If <var>attribute</var> is null or <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value) is the empty string&#44; then return <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;5"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address&#45;2"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url)&#46;

3.  Let <var>urlString</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing&#45;a&#45;url&#45;2"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing&#45;and&#45;serializing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-and-serializing-a-url) given <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value)&#44; relative to <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;this&#45;6"></a>[this](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#this)&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;node&#45;document&#45;4"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

4.  If <var>urlString</var> is not failure&#44; then return <var>urlString</var>&#46;

5.  Return <var>attribute</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;concept&#45;attribute&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-attribute-value)&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;convert&#45;2"></a>[converted to a scalar value string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-string-convert)&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;fs&#45;method"></a><strong><code>method</code></strong> and <a id="dom&#45;fs&#45;enctype"></a><strong><code>enctype</code></strong> IDL attributes must <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;reflect"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the respective content attributes of the same name&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46; The <a id="dom&#45;fs&#45;encoding"></a><strong><code>encoding</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;2"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;3"></a><code>[enctype](#attr-fs-enctype)</code> content attribute&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;limited&#45;to&#45;only&#45;known&#45;values&#45;2"></a>[limited to only known values](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#limited-to-only-known-values)&#46; The <a id="dom&#45;fs&#45;formenctype"></a><strong><code>formEnctype</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;3"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formenctype&#45;4"></a><code>[formenctype](#attr-fs-formenctype)</code> content attribute&#44; The <a id="dom&#45;fs&#45;formmethod"></a><strong><code>formMethod</code></strong> IDL attribute must <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;reflect&#45;4"></a>[reflect](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#reflect) the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;attributes&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formmethod&#45;4"></a><code>[formmethod](#attr-fs-formmethod)</code> content attribute&#44; ##### <a id="autofill"></a>4&#46;10&#46;19&#46;7 Autofill[](#autofill)

###### <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute"></a>4&#46;10&#46;19&#46;7&#46;1 Autofilling form controls&#58; the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute[](#autofilling-form-controls:-the-autocomplete-attribute)

<strong>✔</strong>MDN

[Attributes&#47;autocomplete](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Attributes/autocomplete)

Support in all current engines&#46;
