Firefox Android&#63;Safari iOS&#63;Chrome Android&#63;WebView Android&#63;Samsung Internet&#63;Opera Android12&#46;1&#43;

User agents sometimes have features for helping users fill forms in&#44; for example prefilling the user&#39;s address based on earlier user input&#46; The <a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><strong><code>autocomplete</code></strong> content attribute can be used to hint to the user agent how to&#44; or indeed whether to&#44; provide such a feature&#46;

There are two ways this attribute is used&#46; When wearing the <a id="autofill&#45;expectation&#45;mantle"></a><strong>autofill expectation mantle</strong>&#44; the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;2"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute describes what input is expected from users&#46; When wearing the <a id="autofill&#45;anchor&#45;mantle"></a><strong>autofill anchor mantle</strong>&#44; the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;3"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute describes the meaning of the given value&#46;

On an <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;"></a>[Hidden](#hidden-state-(type=hidden)) state&#44; the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;4"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute wears the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;anchor&#45;mantle"></a>[autofill anchor mantle](#autofill-anchor-mantle)&#46; In all other cases&#44; it wears the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;expectation&#45;mantle"></a>[autofill expectation mantle](#autofill-expectation-mantle)&#46;

When wearing the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;expectation&#45;mantle&#45;2"></a>[autofill expectation mantle](#autofill-expectation-mantle)&#44; the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;5"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is an ordered <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;set&#45;of&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens"></a>[set of space&#45;separated tokens](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#set-of-space-separated-tokens) consisting of either a single token that is an <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;off"></a><code>[off](#attr-fe-autocomplete-off)</code>&#34;&#44; or a single token that is an <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;on"></a><code>[on](#attr-fe-autocomplete-on)</code>&#34;&#44; or <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;detail&#45;tokens"></a>[autofill detail tokens](#autofill-detail-tokens)&#46;

When wearing the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;anchor&#45;mantle&#45;2"></a>[autofill anchor mantle](#autofill-anchor-mantle)&#44; the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;6"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute&#44; if specified&#44; must have a value that is an ordered <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;set&#45;of&#45;space&#45;separated&#45;tokens&#45;2"></a>[set of space&#45;separated tokens](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#set-of-space-separated-tokens) consisting of just <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;detail&#45;tokens&#45;2"></a>[autofill detail tokens](#autofill-detail-tokens) &#40;i&#46;e&#46; the &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;on&#45;2"></a><code>[on](#attr-fe-autocomplete-on)</code>&#34; and &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;off&#45;2"></a><code>[off](#attr-fe-autocomplete-off)</code>&#34; keywords are not allowed&#41;&#46;

<a id="autofill&#45;detail&#45;tokens"></a><strong>Autofill detail tokens</strong> are the following&#44; in the order given below&#58;

1.  Optionally&#44; a token whose first eight characters are an <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;3"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;section"></a><strong><code>section&#45;</code></strong>&#34;&#44; meaning that the field belongs to the named group&#46;

    <strong>Example&#58;</strong>

    For example&#44; if there are two shipping addresses in the form&#44; then they could be marked up as&#58;

    ``` text
    <fieldset>
     <legend>Ship the blue gift to...</legend>
     <p> <label> Address:     <textarea name=ba autocomplete="section-blue shipping street-address"></textarea> </label>
     <p> <label> City:        <input name=bc autocomplete="section-blue shipping address-level2"> </label>
     <p> <label> Postal Code: <input name=bp autocomplete="section-blue shipping postal-code"> </label>
    </fieldset>
    <fieldset>
     <legend>Ship the red gift to...</legend>
     <p> <label> Address:     <textarea name=ra autocomplete="section-red shipping street-address"></textarea> </label>
     <p> <label> City:        <input name=rc autocomplete="section-red shipping address-level2"> </label>
     <p> <label> Postal Code: <input name=rp autocomplete="section-red shipping postal-code"> </label>
    </fieldset>
    ```

2.  Optionally&#44; a token that is an <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;4"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for one of the following strings&#58;

    - &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;shipping"></a><strong><code>shipping</code></strong>&#34;&#44; meaning the field is part of the shipping address or contact information
    - &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;billing"></a><strong><code>billing</code></strong>&#34;&#44; meaning the field is part of the billing address or contact information

3.  Either of the following two options&#58;

    - A token that is an <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;5"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for one of the following <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;field"></a>[autofill field](#autofill-field) names&#44; excluding those that are <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;inappropriate&#45;for&#45;the&#45;control"></a>[inappropriate for the control](#inappropriate-for-the-control)&#58;

      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-autocomplete-name)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;honorific&#45;prefix"></a><code>[honorific&#45;prefix](#attr-fe-autocomplete-honorific-prefix)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;given&#45;name"></a><code>[given&#45;name](#attr-fe-autocomplete-given-name)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;additional&#45;name"></a><code>[additional&#45;name](#attr-fe-autocomplete-additional-name)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;family&#45;name"></a><code>[family&#45;name](#attr-fe-autocomplete-family-name)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;honorific&#45;suffix"></a><code>[honorific&#45;suffix](#attr-fe-autocomplete-honorific-suffix)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;nickname"></a><code>[nickname](#attr-fe-autocomplete-nickname)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;username"></a><code>[username](#attr-fe-autocomplete-username)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;new&#45;password"></a><code>[new&#45;password](#attr-fe-autocomplete-new-password)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;current&#45;password"></a><code>[current&#45;password](#attr-fe-autocomplete-current-password)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;one&#45;time&#45;code"></a><code>[one&#45;time&#45;code](#attr-fe-autocomplete-one-time-code)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;organization&#45;title"></a><code>[organization&#45;title](#attr-fe-autocomplete-organization-title)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;organization"></a><code>[organization](#attr-fe-autocomplete-organization)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;street&#45;address"></a><code>[street&#45;address](#attr-fe-autocomplete-street-address)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;address&#45;line1"></a><code>[address&#45;line1](#attr-fe-autocomplete-address-line1)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;address&#45;line2"></a><code>[address&#45;line2](#attr-fe-autocomplete-address-line2)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;address&#45;line3"></a><code>[address&#45;line3](#attr-fe-autocomplete-address-line3)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;address&#45;level4"></a><code>[address&#45;level4](#attr-fe-autocomplete-address-level4)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;address&#45;level3"></a><code>[address&#45;level3](#attr-fe-autocomplete-address-level3)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;address&#45;level2"></a><code>[address&#45;level2](#attr-fe-autocomplete-address-level2)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;address&#45;level1"></a><code>[address&#45;level1](#attr-fe-autocomplete-address-level1)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;country"></a><code>[country](#attr-fe-autocomplete-country)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;country&#45;name"></a><code>[country&#45;name](#attr-fe-autocomplete-country-name)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;postal&#45;code"></a><code>[postal&#45;code](#attr-fe-autocomplete-postal-code)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;name"></a><code>[cc&#45;name](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-name)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;given&#45;name"></a><code>[cc&#45;given&#45;name](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-given-name)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;additional&#45;name"></a><code>[cc&#45;additional&#45;name](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-additional-name)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;family&#45;name"></a><code>[cc&#45;family&#45;name](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-family-name)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;number"></a><code>[cc&#45;number](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-number)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;exp"></a><code>[cc&#45;exp](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-exp)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;exp&#45;month"></a><code>[cc&#45;exp&#45;month](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-exp-month)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;exp&#45;year"></a><code>[cc&#45;exp&#45;year](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-exp-year)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;csc"></a><code>[cc&#45;csc](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-csc)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;type"></a><code>[cc&#45;type](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-type)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;transaction&#45;currency"></a><code>[transaction&#45;currency](#attr-fe-autocomplete-transaction-currency)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;transaction&#45;amount"></a><code>[transaction&#45;amount](#attr-fe-autocomplete-transaction-amount)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;language"></a><code>[language](#attr-fe-autocomplete-language)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;bday"></a><code>[bday](#attr-fe-autocomplete-bday)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;bday&#45;day"></a><code>[bday&#45;day](#attr-fe-autocomplete-bday-day)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;bday&#45;month"></a><code>[bday&#45;month](#attr-fe-autocomplete-bday-month)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;bday&#45;year"></a><code>[bday&#45;year](#attr-fe-autocomplete-bday-year)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;sex"></a><code>[sex](#attr-fe-autocomplete-sex)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;url"></a><code>[url](#attr-fe-autocomplete-url)</code>&#34;
      - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;photo"></a><code>[photo](#attr-fe-autocomplete-photo)</code>&#34;

      &#40;See the table below for descriptions of these values&#46;&#41;

    - The following&#44; in the given order&#58;

      1.  Optionally&#44; a token that is an <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;6"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for one of the following strings&#58;

          - &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;home"></a><strong><code>home</code></strong>&#34;&#44; meaning the field is for contacting someone at their residence
          - &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;work"></a><strong><code>work</code></strong>&#34;&#44; meaning the field is for contacting someone at their workplace
          - &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;mobile"></a><strong><code>mobile</code></strong>&#34;&#44; meaning the field is for contacting someone regardless of location
          - &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;fax"></a><strong><code>fax</code></strong>&#34;&#44; meaning the field describes a fax machine&#39;s contact details
          - &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;pager"></a><strong><code>pager</code></strong>&#34;&#44; meaning the field describes a pager&#39;s or beeper&#39;s contact details

      2.  A token that is an <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;7"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for one of the following <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;2"></a>[autofill field](#autofill-field) names&#44; excluding those that are <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;inappropriate&#45;for&#45;the&#45;control&#45;2"></a>[inappropriate for the control](#inappropriate-for-the-control)&#58;

          - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;tel"></a><code>[tel](#attr-fe-autocomplete-tel)</code>&#34;
          - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;tel&#45;country&#45;code"></a><code>[tel&#45;country&#45;code](#attr-fe-autocomplete-tel-country-code)</code>&#34;
          - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;tel&#45;national"></a><code>[tel&#45;national](#attr-fe-autocomplete-tel-national)</code>&#34;
          - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;tel&#45;area&#45;code"></a><code>[tel&#45;area&#45;code](#attr-fe-autocomplete-tel-area-code)</code>&#34;
          - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;tel&#45;local"></a><code>[tel&#45;local](#attr-fe-autocomplete-tel-local)</code>&#34;
          - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;tel&#45;local&#45;prefix"></a><code>[tel&#45;local&#45;prefix](#attr-fe-autocomplete-tel-local-prefix)</code>&#34;
          - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;tel&#45;local&#45;suffix"></a><code>[tel&#45;local&#45;suffix](#attr-fe-autocomplete-tel-local-suffix)</code>&#34;
          - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;tel&#45;extension"></a><code>[tel&#45;extension](#attr-fe-autocomplete-tel-extension)</code>&#34;
          - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;email"></a><code>[email](#attr-fe-autocomplete-email)</code>&#34;
          - &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;impp"></a><code>[impp](#attr-fe-autocomplete-impp)</code>&#34;

          &#40;See the table below for descriptions of these values&#46;&#41;

4.  Optionally&#44; a token that is an <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;8"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;webauthn"></a><strong><code>webauthn</code></strong>&#34;&#44; meaning the user agent should show <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;public&#45;key&#45;credential"></a>[public key credentials](https://w3c.github.io/webauthn/#public-key-credential) available via <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;conditional&#45;mediation"></a><code>[conditional](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-credential-management/#dom-credentialmediationrequirement-conditional)</code> mediation when the user interacts with the form control&#46; <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;webauthn"></a><code>[webauthn](#attr-fe-autocomplete-webauthn)</code> is only valid for <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> and <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> elements&#46;

As noted earlier&#44; the meaning of the attribute and its keywords depends on the mantle that the attribute is wearing&#46;

<strong>When wearing the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;expectation&#45;mantle&#45;3"></a>[autofill expectation mantle](#autofill-expectation-mantle)&#46;&#46;&#46;</strong>

The &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;off"></a><strong><code>off</code></strong>&#34; keyword indicates either that the control&#39;s input data is particularly sensitive &#40;for example the activation code for a nuclear weapon&#41;&#59; or that it is a value that will never be reused &#40;for example a one&#45;time&#45;key for a bank login&#41; and the user will therefore have to explicitly enter the data each time&#44; instead of being able to rely on the UA to prefill the value for them&#59; or that the document provides its own autocomplete mechanism and does not want the user agent to provide autocompletion values&#46;

The &#34;<a id="attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;on"></a><strong><code>on</code></strong>&#34; keyword indicates that the user agent is allowed to provide the user with autocompletion values&#44; but does not provide any further information about what kind of data the user might be expected to enter&#46; User agents would have to use heuristics to decide what autocompletion values to suggest&#46;

The <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;3"></a>[autofill field](#autofill-field) listed above indicates that the user agent is allowed to provide the user with autocompletion values&#44; and specifies what kind of value is expected&#46; The meaning of each such keyword is described in the table below&#46;

If the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;7"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute is omitted&#44; the default value corresponding to the state of the element&#39;s <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#39;s <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;form&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-form-autocomplete)</code> attribute is used instead &#40;either &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;on&#45;3"></a><code>[on](#attr-fe-autocomplete-on)</code>&#34; or &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;off&#45;3"></a><code>[off](#attr-fe-autocomplete-off)</code>&#34;&#41;&#46; If there is no <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#44; then the value &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;on&#45;4"></a><code>[on](#attr-fe-autocomplete-on)</code>&#34; is used&#46;

<strong>When wearing the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;anchor&#45;mantle&#45;3"></a>[autofill anchor mantle](#autofill-anchor-mantle)&#46;&#46;&#46;</strong>

The <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;4"></a>[autofill field](#autofill-field) listed above indicates that the value of the particular kind of value specified is that value provided for this element&#46; The meaning of each such keyword is described in the table below&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In this example the page has explicitly specified the currency and amount of the transaction&#46; The form requests a credit card and other billing details&#46; The user agent could use this information to suggest a credit card that it knows has sufficient balance and that supports the relevant currency&#46;

``` text
<form method=post action="step2.cgi">
 <input type=hidden autocomplete=transaction-currency value="CHF">
 <input type=hidden autocomplete=transaction-amount value="15.00">
 <p><label>Credit card number: <input type=text inputmode=numeric autocomplete=cc-number></label>
 <p><label>Expiry Date: <input type=month autocomplete=cc-exp></label>
 <p><input type=submit value="Continue...">
</form>
```

The <a id="autofill&#45;field"></a><strong>autofill field</strong> keywords relate to each other as described in the table below&#46; Each field name listed on a row of this table corresponds to the meaning given in the cell for that row in the column labeled &#34;Meaning&#34;&#46; Some fields correspond to subparts of other fields&#59; for example&#44; a credit card expiry date can be expressed as one field giving both the month and year of expiry &#40;&#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;exp&#45;2"></a><code>[cc&#45;exp](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-exp)</code>&#34;&#41;&#44; or as two fields&#44; one giving the month &#40;&#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;exp&#45;month&#45;2"></a><code>[cc&#45;exp&#45;month](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-exp-month)</code>&#34;&#41; and one the year &#40;&#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;exp&#45;year&#45;2"></a><code>[cc&#45;exp&#45;year](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-exp-year)</code>&#34;&#41;&#46; In such cases&#44; the names of the broader fields cover multiple rows&#44; in which the narrower fields are defined&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

Generally&#44; authors are encouraged to use the broader fields rather than the narrower fields&#44; as the narrower fields tend to expose Western biases&#46; For example&#44; while it is common in some Western cultures to have a given name and a family name&#44; in that order &#40;and thus often referred to as a <em>first name</em> and a <em>surname</em>&#41;&#44; many cultures put the family name first and the given name second&#44; and many others simply have one name &#40;a <em>mononym</em>&#41;&#46; Having a single field is therefore more flexible&#46;

Some fields are only appropriate for certain form controls&#46; An <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;5"></a>[autofill field](#autofill-field) name is <a id="inappropriate&#45;for&#45;the&#45;control"></a><strong>inappropriate for a control</strong> if the control does not belong to the group listed for that <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;6"></a>[autofill field](#autofill-field) in the fifth column of the first row describing that <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;7"></a>[autofill field](#autofill-field) in the table below&#46; What controls fall into each group is described below the table&#46;

<strong><a id="control&#45;group&#45;month"></a><strong>Month</strong></strong>

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;27"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements with a <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;26"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#45;9"></a>[Hidden](#hidden-state-(type=hidden)) state

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;28"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements with a <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;27"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#45;13"></a>[Text](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)) state

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;29"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements with a <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;28"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#45;14"></a>[Search](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)) state

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;30"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements with a <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;29"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;"></a>[Month](#month-state-(type=month)) state

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> elements

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> elements

<strong><a id="control&#45;group&#45;date"></a><strong>Date</strong></strong>

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;31"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements with a <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;30"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;&#45;10"></a>[Hidden](#hidden-state-(type=hidden)) state

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;32"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements with a <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;31"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#45;15"></a>[Text](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)) state

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;33"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements with a <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;32"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#45;16"></a>[Search](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search)) state

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;34"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> elements with a <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;33"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute in the <a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;"></a>[Date](#date-state-(type=date)) state

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> elements

<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> elements

<a id="more&#45;on&#45;address&#45;levels"></a><strong>Address levels</strong>&#58; The &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;address&#45;level1&#45;2"></a><code>[address&#45;level1](#attr-fe-autocomplete-address-level1)</code>&#34; – &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;address&#45;level4&#45;2"></a><code>[address&#45;level4](#attr-fe-autocomplete-address-level4)</code>&#34; fields are used to describe the locality of the street address&#46; Different locales have different numbers of levels&#46; For example&#44; the US uses two levels &#40;state and town&#41;&#44; the UK uses one or two depending on the address &#40;the post town&#44; and in some cases the locality&#41;&#44; and China can use three &#40;province&#44; city&#44; district&#41;&#46; The &#34;<a id="autofilling&#45;form&#45;controls&#58;&#45;the&#45;autocomplete&#45;attribute&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;address&#45;level1&#45;3"></a><code>[address&#45;level1](#attr-fe-autocomplete-address-level1)</code>&#34; field represents the widest administrative division&#46; Different locales order the fields in different ways&#59; for example&#44; in the US the town &#40;level 2&#41; precedes the state &#40;level 1&#41;&#59; while in Japan the prefecture &#40;level 1&#41; precedes the city &#40;level 2&#41; which precedes the district &#40;level 3&#41;&#46; Authors are encouraged to provide forms that are presented in a way that matches the country&#39;s conventions &#40;hiding&#44; showing&#44; and rearranging fields accordingly as the user changes the country&#41;&#46;

###### <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model"></a>4&#46;10&#46;19&#46;7&#46;2 <a id="processing&#45;model&#45;3"></a>Processing model[](#autofill-processing-model)

Each <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element to which the <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;apply"></a>[applies](#concept-input-apply)&#44; each <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; and each <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element&#44; has an <a id="autofill&#45;hint&#45;set"></a><strong>autofill hint set</strong>&#44; an <a id="autofill&#45;scope"></a><strong>autofill scope</strong>&#44; an <a id="autofill&#45;field&#45;name"></a><strong>autofill field name</strong>&#44; a <a id="non&#45;autofill&#45;credential&#45;type"></a><strong>non&#45;autofill credential type</strong>&#44; and an <a id="idl&#45;exposed&#45;autofill&#45;value"></a><strong>IDL&#45;exposed autofill value</strong>&#46;

The <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;name"></a>[autofill field name](#autofill-field-name) specifies the specific kind of data expected in the field&#44; e&#46;g&#46; &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;street&#45;address"></a><code>[street&#45;address](#attr-fe-autocomplete-street-address)</code>&#34; or &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;cc&#45;exp"></a><code>[cc&#45;exp](#attr-fe-autocomplete-cc-exp)</code>&#34;&#46;

The <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;hint&#45;set"></a>[autofill hint set](#autofill-hint-set) identifies what address or contact information type the user agent is to look at&#44; e&#46;g&#46; &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;shipping"></a><code>[shipping](#attr-fe-autocomplete-shipping)</code> <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;fax"></a><code>[fax](#attr-fe-autocomplete-fax)</code>&#34; or &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;billing"></a><code>[billing](#attr-fe-autocomplete-billing)</code>&#34;&#46;

The <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;non&#45;autofill&#45;credential&#45;type"></a>[non&#45;autofill credential type](#non-autofill-credential-type) identifies a type of <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;credman&#45;credential"></a>[credential](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-credential-management/#credential) that may be offered by the user agent when the user interacts with the field alongside other <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;field"></a>[autofill field](#autofill-field) values&#46; If this value is &#34;<code>webauthn</code>&#34; instead of null&#44; selecting a credential of that type will resolve a pending <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;conditional&#45;mediation"></a><code>[conditional](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-credential-management/#dom-credentialmediationrequirement-conditional)</code> mediation <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;navigator&#46;credentials&#46;get&#40;&#41;"></a><code>[navigator&#46;credentials&#46;get&#40;&#41;](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-credential-management/#dom-credentialscontainer-get)</code> request&#44; instead of autofilling the field&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

For example&#44; a sign&#45;in page could instruct the user agent to either autofill a saved password&#44; or show a <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;public&#45;key&#45;credential"></a>[public key credential](https://w3c.github.io/webauthn/#public-key-credential) that will resolve a pending <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;navigator&#46;credentials&#46;get&#40;&#41;&#45;2"></a><code>[navigator&#46;credentials&#46;get&#40;&#41;](https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-credential-management/#dom-credentialscontainer-get)</code> request&#46; A user can select either to sign&#45;in&#46;

``` text
<input name=password type=password autocomplete="current-password webauthn">
```

The <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;scope"></a>[autofill scope](#autofill-scope) identifies the group of fields whose information concerns the same subject&#44; and consists of the <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;hint&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[autofill hint set](#autofill-hint-set) with&#44; if applicable&#44; the &#34;<code>section&#45;&#42;</code>&#34; prefix&#44; e&#46;g&#46; &#34;<code>billing</code>&#34;&#44; &#34;<code>section&#45;parent shipping</code>&#34;&#44; or &#34;<code>section&#45;child shipping home</code>&#34;&#46;

These values are defined as the result of running the following algorithm&#58;

1.  If the element has no <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;2"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>default</em>&#46;

2.  Let <var>tokens</var> be the result of <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;split&#45;a&#45;string&#45;on&#45;spaces"></a>[splitting the attribute&#39;s value on ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace)&#46;

3.  If <var>tokens</var> is empty&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>default</em>&#46;

4.  Let <var>index</var> be the index of the last token in <var>tokens</var>&#46;

5.  Let <var>field</var> be the <var>index</var>th token in <var>tokens</var>&#46;

6.  Let <var>category</var> be the result of <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;determine&#45;a&#45;field&#39;s&#45;category"></a>[determining a field&#39;s category](#determine-a-field's-category) given <var>field</var>&#46;

7.  If <var>category</var> is null&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>default</em>&#46;

8.  If <var>category</var> is Off or Automatic&#44; and either <var>tokens</var>&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;list&#45;size"></a>[size](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-size) is greater than 1 or the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;3"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute is wearing the <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;anchor&#45;mantle"></a>[autofill anchor mantle](#autofill-anchor-mantle)&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>default</em>&#46;

9.  If <var>category</var> is Off&#44; set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[autofill field name](#autofill-field-name) to the string &#34;<code>off</code>&#34;&#44; set its <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;hint&#45;set&#45;3"></a>[autofill hint set](#autofill-hint-set) to empty&#44; and set its <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;idl&#45;exposed&#45;autofill&#45;value"></a>[IDL&#45;exposed autofill value](#idl-exposed-autofill-value) to the string &#34;<code>off</code>&#34;&#46; Then&#44; return&#46;

10. If <var>category</var> is Automatic&#44; set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;name&#45;3"></a>[autofill field name](#autofill-field-name) to the string &#34;<code>on</code>&#34;&#44; set its <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;hint&#45;set&#45;4"></a>[autofill hint set](#autofill-hint-set) to empty&#44; and set its <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;idl&#45;exposed&#45;autofill&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[IDL&#45;exposed autofill value](#idl-exposed-autofill-value) to the string &#34;<code>on</code>&#34;&#46; Then&#44; return&#46;

11. Let <var>scope tokens</var> be an empty list&#46;

12. Let <var>hint tokens</var> be an empty set&#46;

13. Let <var>credential type</var> be null&#46;

14. Let <var>IDL value</var> have the same value as <var>field</var>&#46;

15. If <var>category</var> is Credential and the <var>index</var>th token in <var>tokens</var> is an <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;webauthn"></a><code>[webauthn](#attr-fe-autocomplete-webauthn)</code>&#34;&#44; then run the substeps that follow&#58;

    1.  Set <var>credential type</var> to &#34;<code>webauthn</code>&#34;&#46;

    2.  If the <var>index</var>th token in <var>tokens</var> is the first entry&#44; then skip to the step labeled <em>done</em>&#46;

    3.  Decrement <var>index</var> by one&#46;

    4.  Set <var>category</var> to the result of <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;determine&#45;a&#45;field&#39;s&#45;category&#45;2"></a>[determining a field&#39;s category](#determine-a-field's-category) given the <var>index</var>th token in <var>tokens</var>&#46;

    5.  If <var>category</var> is not Normal and <var>category</var> is not Contact&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>default</em>&#46;

    6.  Set <var>IDL value</var> to the concatenation of the <var>index</var>th token in <var>tokens</var>&#44; a U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#44; and the previous value of <var>IDL value</var>&#46;

16. If the <var>index</var>th token in <var>tokens</var> is the first entry&#44; then skip to the step labeled <em>done</em>&#46;

17. Decrement <var>index</var> by one&#46;

18. If <var>category</var> is Contact and the <var>index</var>th token in <var>tokens</var> is an <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;2"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for one of the strings in the following list&#58;

    - &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;home"></a><code>[home](#attr-fe-autocomplete-home)</code>&#34;
    - &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;work"></a><code>[work](#attr-fe-autocomplete-work)</code>&#34;
    - &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;mobile"></a><code>[mobile](#attr-fe-autocomplete-mobile)</code>&#34;
    - &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;fax&#45;2"></a><code>[fax](#attr-fe-autocomplete-fax)</code>&#34;
    - &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;pager"></a><code>[pager](#attr-fe-autocomplete-pager)</code>&#34;

    then&#58;

    1.  Let <var>contact</var> be the matching string from the list above&#46;

    2.  Insert <var>contact</var> at the start of <var>scope tokens</var>&#46;

    3.  Add <var>contact</var> to <var>hint tokens</var>&#46;

    4.  Let <var>IDL value</var> be the concatenation of <var>contact</var>&#44; a U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#44; and the previous value of <var>IDL value</var>&#46;

    5.  If the <var>index</var>th entry in <var>tokens</var> is the first entry&#44; then skip to the step labeled <em>done</em>&#46;

    6.  Decrement <var>index</var> by one&#46;

19. If the <var>index</var>th token in <var>tokens</var> is an <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;3"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for one of the strings in the following list&#58;

    - &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;shipping&#45;2"></a><code>[shipping](#attr-fe-autocomplete-shipping)</code>&#34;
    - &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;billing&#45;2"></a><code>[billing](#attr-fe-autocomplete-billing)</code>&#34;

    then&#58;

    1.  Let <var>mode</var> be the matching string from the list above&#46;

    2.  Insert <var>mode</var> at the start of <var>scope tokens</var>&#46;

    3.  Add <var>mode</var> to <var>hint tokens</var>&#46;

    4.  Let <var>IDL value</var> be the concatenation of <var>mode</var>&#44; a U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#44; and the previous value of <var>IDL value</var>&#46;

    5.  If the <var>index</var>th entry in <var>tokens</var> is the first entry&#44; then skip to the step labeled <em>done</em>&#46;

    6.  Decrement <var>index</var> by one&#46;

20. If the <var>index</var>th entry in <var>tokens</var> is not the first entry&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>default</em>&#46;

21. If the first eight characters of the <var>index</var>th token in <var>tokens</var> are not an <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive&#45;4"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for the string &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;section"></a><code>[section&#45;](#attr-fe-autocomplete-section)</code>&#34;&#44; then jump to the step labeled <em>default</em>&#46;

22. Let <var>section</var> be the <var>index</var>th token in <var>tokens</var>&#44; <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;converted&#45;to&#45;ascii&#45;lowercase"></a>[converted to ASCII lowercase](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-lowercase)&#46;

23. Insert <var>section</var> at the start of <var>scope tokens</var>&#46;

24. Let <var>IDL value</var> be the concatenation of <var>section</var>&#44; a U&#43;0020 SPACE character&#44; and the previous value of <var>IDL value</var>&#46;

25. <em>Done</em>&#58; Set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;hint&#45;set&#45;5"></a>[autofill hint set](#autofill-hint-set) to <var>hint tokens</var>&#46;

26. Set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;non&#45;autofill&#45;credential&#45;type&#45;2"></a>[non&#45;autofill credential type](#non-autofill-credential-type) to <var>credential type</var>&#46;

27. Set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;scope&#45;2"></a>[autofill scope](#autofill-scope) to <var>scope tokens</var>&#46;

28. Set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;name&#45;4"></a>[autofill field name](#autofill-field-name) to <var>field</var>&#46;

29. Set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;idl&#45;exposed&#45;autofill&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[IDL&#45;exposed autofill value](#idl-exposed-autofill-value) to <var>IDL value</var>&#46;

30. Return&#46;

31. <em>Default</em>&#58; Set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;idl&#45;exposed&#45;autofill&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[IDL&#45;exposed autofill value](#idl-exposed-autofill-value) to the empty string&#44; and its <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;hint&#45;set&#45;6"></a>[autofill hint set](#autofill-hint-set) and <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;scope&#45;3"></a>[autofill scope](#autofill-scope) to empty&#46;

32. If the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;4"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-fe-autocomplete)</code> attribute is wearing the <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;anchor&#45;mantle&#45;2"></a>[autofill anchor mantle](#autofill-anchor-mantle)&#44; then set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;name&#45;5"></a>[autofill field name](#autofill-field-name) to the empty string and return&#46;

33. Let <var>form</var> be the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner)&#44; if any&#44; or null otherwise&#46;

34. If <var>form</var> is not null and <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;form&#45;autocomplete"></a><code>[autocomplete](#attr-form-autocomplete)</code> attribute is in the <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;form&#45;autocomplete&#45;off&#45;state"></a>[Off](#attr-form-autocomplete-off-state) state&#44; then set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;name&#45;6"></a>[autofill field name](#autofill-field-name) to &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;off"></a><code>[off](#attr-fe-autocomplete-off)</code>&#34;&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; set the element&#39;s <a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;autofill&#45;field&#45;name&#45;7"></a>[autofill field name](#autofill-field-name) to &#34;<a id="autofill&#45;processing&#45;model&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;autocomplete&#45;on"></a><code>[on](#attr-fe-autocomplete-on)</code>&#34;&#46;

To <a id="determine&#45;a&#45;field&#39;s&#45;category"></a><strong>determine a field&#39;s category</strong>&#44; given <var>field</var>&#58;

1.
