1.  If this element is an <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;13"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; and <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setselectionrange"></a><code>[setSelectionRange&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setselectionrange)</code> <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;8"></a>[does not apply](#do-not-apply) to this element&#44; throw an <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;4"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;domexception&#45;4"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;set&#45;the&#45;selection&#45;range&#45;6"></a>[Set the selection range](#set-the-selection-range) with <var>start</var>&#44; <var>end</var>&#44; and <var>direction</var>&#46;

To <a id="set&#45;the&#45;selection&#45;range"></a><strong>set the selection range</strong> with an integer or null <var>start</var>&#44; an integer or null or the special value infinity <var>end</var>&#44; and optionally a string <var>direction</var>&#44; run the following steps&#58;

1.  If <var>start</var> is null&#44; let <var>start</var> be 0&#46;

2.  If <var>end</var> is null&#44; let <var>end</var> be 0&#46;

3.  Set the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selection&#45;8"></a>[selection](#concept-textarea/input-selection) of the text control to the sequence of <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;code&#45;unit&#45;6"></a>[code units](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#code-unit) within the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;relevant&#45;value&#45;16"></a>[relevant value](#concept-textarea/input-relevant-value) starting with the code unit at the <var>start</var>th position &#40;in logical order&#41; and ending with the code unit at the &#40;<var>end</var>&#45;1&#41;th position&#46; Arguments greater than the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;length"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) of the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;relevant&#45;value&#45;17"></a>[relevant value](#concept-textarea/input-relevant-value) of the text control &#40;including the special value infinity&#41; must be treated as pointing at the end of the text control&#46; If <var>end</var> is less than or equal to <var>start</var>&#44; then the start of the selection and the end of the selection must both be placed immediately before the character with offset <var>end</var>&#46; In UAs where there is no concept of an empty selection&#44; this must set the cursor to be just before the character with offset <var>end</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>direction</var> is not <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;identical&#45;to"></a>[identical to](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-is) either &#34;<code>backward</code>&#34; or &#34;<code>forward</code>&#34;&#44; or if the <var>direction</var> argument was not given&#44; set <var>direction</var> to &#34;<code>none</code>&#34;&#46;

5.  <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;set&#45;the&#45;selection&#45;direction"></a>[Set the selection direction](#set-the-selection-direction) of the text control to <var>direction</var>&#46;

6.  If the previous steps caused the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selection&#45;9"></a>[selection](#concept-textarea/input-selection) of the text control to be modified &#40;in either extent or <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;selection&#45;direction&#45;5"></a>[direction](#selection-direction)&#41;&#44; then <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;user&#45;interaction&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[user interaction task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-interaction-task-source) given the element to <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;event&#45;select"></a><code>[select](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-select)</code> at the element&#44; with the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext"></a><strong><code>setRangeText&#40;<var>replacement</var>&#44; <var>start</var>&#44; <var>end</var>&#44; <var>selectMode</var>&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run the following steps&#58;

1.  If this element is an <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;14"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element&#44; and <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code> <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;do&#45;not&#45;apply&#45;9"></a>[does not apply](#do-not-apply) to this element&#44; throw an <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;invalidstateerror&#45;5"></a>[&#34;<code>InvalidStateError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#invalidstateerror) <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;domexception&#45;5"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

2.  Set this element&#39;s <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;dirty"></a>[dirty value flag](#concept-fe-dirty) to true&#46;

3.  If the method has only one argument&#44; then let <var>start</var> and <var>end</var> have the values of the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionstart&#45;6"></a><code>[selectionStart](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart)</code> attribute and the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionend&#45;6"></a><code>[selectionEnd](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend)</code> attribute respectively&#46;

    Otherwise&#44; let <var>start</var>&#44; <var>end</var> have the values of the second and third arguments respectively&#46;

4.  If <var>start</var> is greater than <var>end</var>&#44; then throw an <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;indexsizeerror"></a>[&#34;<code>IndexSizeError</code>&#34;](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#indexsizeerror) <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;domexception&#45;6"></a><code>[DOMException](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-DOMException)</code>&#46;

5.  If <var>start</var> is greater than the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;length&#45;2"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) of the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;relevant&#45;value&#45;18"></a>[relevant value](#concept-textarea/input-relevant-value) of the text control&#44; then set it to the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;length&#45;3"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) of the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;relevant&#45;value&#45;19"></a>[relevant value](#concept-textarea/input-relevant-value) of the text control&#46;

6.  If <var>end</var> is greater than the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;length&#45;4"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) of the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;relevant&#45;value&#45;20"></a>[relevant value](#concept-textarea/input-relevant-value) of the text control&#44; then set it to the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;length&#45;5"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) of the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;relevant&#45;value&#45;21"></a>[relevant value](#concept-textarea/input-relevant-value) of the text control&#46;

7.  Let <var>selection start</var> be the current value of the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionstart&#45;7"></a><code>[selectionStart](#dom-textarea/input-selectionstart)</code> attribute&#46;

8.  Let <var>selection end</var> be the current value of the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;selectionend&#45;7"></a><code>[selectionEnd](#dom-textarea/input-selectionend)</code> attribute&#46;

9.  If <var>start</var> is less than <var>end</var>&#44; delete the sequence of <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;code&#45;unit&#45;7"></a>[code units](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#code-unit) within the element&#39;s <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;relevant&#45;value&#45;22"></a>[relevant value](#concept-textarea/input-relevant-value) starting with the code unit at the <var>start</var>th position and ending with the code unit at the &#40;<var>end</var>&#45;1&#41;th position&#46;

10. Insert the value of the first argument into the text of the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;concept&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;relevant&#45;value&#45;23"></a>[relevant value](#concept-textarea/input-relevant-value) of the text control&#44; immediately before the <var>start</var>th <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;code&#45;unit&#45;8"></a>[code unit](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#code-unit)&#46;

11. Let <var>new length</var> be the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;length&#45;6"></a>[length](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#string-length) of the value of the first argument&#46;

12. Let <var>new end</var> be the sum of <var>start</var> and <var>new length</var>&#46;

13. Run the appropriate set of substeps from the following list&#58;

    <strong>If the fourth argument&#39;s value is &#34;<a id="dom&#45;selectionmode&#45;select"></a><strong><code>select</code></strong>&#34;</strong>

    Let <var>selection start</var> be <var>start</var>&#46;

    Let <var>selection end</var> be <var>new end</var>&#46;

    <strong>If the fourth argument&#39;s value is &#34;<a id="dom&#45;selectionmode&#45;start"></a><strong><code>start</code></strong>&#34;</strong>

    Let <var>selection start</var> and <var>selection end</var> be <var>start</var>&#46;

    <strong>If the fourth argument&#39;s value is &#34;<a id="dom&#45;selectionmode&#45;end"></a><strong><code>end</code></strong>&#34;</strong>

    Let <var>selection start</var> and <var>selection end</var> be <var>new end</var>&#46;

    <strong>If the fourth argument&#39;s value is &#34;<a id="dom&#45;selectionmode&#45;preserve"></a><strong><code>preserve</code></strong>&#34;</strong>

    <strong>If the method has only one argument</strong>

    1.  Let <var>old length</var> be <var>end</var> minus <var>start</var>&#46;

    2.  Let <var>delta</var> be <var>new length</var> minus <var>old length</var>&#46;

    3.  If <var>selection start</var> is greater than <var>end</var>&#44; then increment it by <var>delta</var>&#46; &#40;If <var>delta</var> is negative&#44; i&#46;e&#46; the new text is shorter than the old text&#44; then this will <em>decrease</em> the value of <var>selection start</var>&#46;&#41;

        Otherwise&#58; if <var>selection start</var> is greater than <var>start</var>&#44; then set it to <var>start</var>&#46; &#40;This snaps the start of the selection to the start of the new text if it was in the middle of the text that it replaced&#46;&#41;

    4.  If <var>selection end</var> is greater than <var>end</var>&#44; then increment it by <var>delta</var> in the same way&#46;

        Otherwise&#58; if <var>selection end</var> is greater than <var>start</var>&#44; then set it to <var>new end</var>&#46; &#40;This snaps the end of the selection to the end of the new text if it was in the middle of the text that it replaced&#46;&#41;

14. <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;set&#45;the&#45;selection&#45;range&#45;7"></a>[Set the selection range](#set-the-selection-range) with <var>selection start</var> and <var>selection end</var>&#46;

The <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;textarea&#47;input&#45;setrangetext&#45;2"></a><code>[setRangeText&#40;&#41;](#dom-textarea/input-setrangetext)</code> method uses the following enumeration&#58;

<a id="selectionmode"></a><a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;selectionmode&#45;select"></a><a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;selectionmode&#45;start"></a><a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;selectionmode&#45;end"></a><a id="textFieldSelection&#58;dom&#45;selectionmode&#45;preserve"></a>

``` text
enum SelectionMode {
  "select",
  "start",
  "end",
  "preserve" // default
};
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

To obtain the currently selected text&#44; the following JavaScript suffices&#58;

``` text
var selectionText = control.value.substring(control.selectionStart, control.selectionEnd);
```

&#46;&#46;&#46;where <var>control</var> is the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;15"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> or <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

To add some text at the start of a text control&#44; while maintaining the text selection&#44; the three attributes must be preserved&#58;

``` text
var oldStart = control.selectionStart;
var oldEnd = control.selectionEnd;
var oldDirection = control.selectionDirection;
var prefix = "http://";
control.value = prefix + control.value;
control.setSelectionRange(oldStart + prefix.length, oldEnd + prefix.length, oldDirection);
```

&#46;&#46;&#46;where <var>control</var> is the <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;16"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> or <a id="textFieldSelection&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> element&#46;

#### <a id="constraints"></a>4&#46;10&#46;21 Constraints[](#constraints)

##### <a id="definitions"></a>4&#46;10&#46;21&#46;1 Definitions[](#definitions)

A <a id="definitions&#58;category&#45;submit"></a>[submittable element](#category-submit) is a <a id="candidate&#45;for&#45;constraint&#45;validation"></a><strong>candidate for constraint validation</strong> except when a condition has <a id="barred&#45;from&#45;constraint&#45;validation"></a><strong>barred the element from constraint validation</strong>&#46; &#40;For example&#44; an element is <a id="definitions&#58;barred&#45;from&#45;constraint&#45;validation"></a>[barred from constraint validation](#barred-from-constraint-validation) if it has a <a id="definitions&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element ancestor&#46;&#41;

An element can have a <a id="custom&#45;validity&#45;error&#45;message"></a><strong>custom validity error message</strong> defined&#46; Initially&#44; an element must have its <a id="definitions&#58;custom&#45;validity&#45;error&#45;message"></a>[custom validity error message](#custom-validity-error-message) set to the empty string&#46; When its value is not the empty string&#44; the element is <a id="definitions&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;error"></a>[suffering from a custom error](#suffering-from-a-custom-error)&#46; It can be set using the <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity"></a><code>[setCustomValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity)</code> method&#44; except for <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated custom elements](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46; <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;2"></a>[Form&#45;associated custom elements](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element) can have a <a id="definitions&#58;custom&#45;validity&#45;error&#45;message&#45;2"></a>[custom validity error message](#custom-validity-error-message) set via their <a id="definitions&#58;elementinternals"></a><code>[ElementInternals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#elementinternals)</code> object&#39;s <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method&#46; The user agent should use the <a id="definitions&#58;custom&#45;validity&#45;error&#45;message&#45;3"></a>[custom validity error message](#custom-validity-error-message) when alerting the user to the problem with the control&#46;

An element can be constrained in various ways&#46; The following is the list of <a id="validity&#45;states"></a><strong>validity states</strong> that a form control can be in&#44; making the control invalid for the purposes of constraint validation&#46; &#40;The definitions below are non&#45;normative&#59; other parts of this specification define more precisely when each state applies or does not&#46;&#41;

<strong><a id="suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;missing"></a><strong>Suffering from being missing</strong></strong>

When a control has no <a id="definitions&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) but has a <code>required</code> attribute &#40;<a id="definitions&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-input-required)</code>&#44; <a id="definitions&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;required"></a><code>[required](#attr-textarea-required)</code>&#41;&#59; or&#44; more complicated rules for <a id="definitions&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> elements and controls in <a id="definitions&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group"></a>[radio button groups](#radio-button-group)&#44; as specified in their sections&#46;

When the <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method sets <code>valueMissing</code> flag to true for a <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;3"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46;

<strong><a id="suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;type&#45;mismatch"></a><strong>Suffering from a type mismatch</strong></strong>

When a control that allows arbitrary user input has a <a id="definitions&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) that is not in the correct syntax &#40;<a id="definitions&#58;email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;"></a>[Email](#email-state-(type=email))&#44; <a id="definitions&#58;url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;"></a>[URL](#url-state-(type=url))&#41;&#46;

When the <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;3"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method sets <code>typeMismatch</code> flag to true for a <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;4"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46;

<strong><a id="suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;pattern&#45;mismatch"></a><strong>Suffering from a pattern mismatch</strong></strong>

When a control has a <a id="definitions&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) that doesn&#39;t satisfy the <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;pattern"></a><code>[pattern](#attr-input-pattern)</code> attribute&#46;

When the <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;4"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method sets <code>patternMismatch</code> flag to true for a <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;5"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46;

<strong><a id="suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;too&#45;long"></a><strong>Suffering from being too long</strong></strong>

When a control has a <a id="definitions&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;4"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) that is too long for the <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;maxlength"></a>[form control <code>maxlength</code> attribute](#attr-fe-maxlength) &#40;<a id="definitions&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;maxlength"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-input-maxlength)</code>&#44; <a id="definitions&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;maxlength"></a><code>[maxlength](#attr-textarea-maxlength)</code>&#41;&#46;

When the <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;5"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method sets <code>tooLong</code> flag to true for a <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;6"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46;

<strong><a id="suffering&#45;from&#45;being&#45;too&#45;short"></a><strong>Suffering from being too short</strong></strong>

When a control has a <a id="definitions&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;5"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) that is too short for the <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;minlength"></a>[form control <code>minlength</code> attribute](#attr-fe-minlength) &#40;<a id="definitions&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;minlength"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-input-minlength)</code>&#44; <a id="definitions&#58;the&#45;textarea&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[textarea](#the-textarea-element)</code> <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;textarea&#45;minlength"></a><code>[minlength](#attr-textarea-minlength)</code>&#41;&#46;

When the <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;6"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method sets <code>tooShort</code> flag to true for a <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;7"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46;

<strong><a id="suffering&#45;from&#45;an&#45;underflow"></a><strong>Suffering from an underflow</strong></strong>

When a control has a <a id="definitions&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;6"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) that is not the empty string and is too low for the <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;min"></a><code>[min](#attr-input-min)</code> attribute&#46;

When the <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;7"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method sets <code>rangeUnderflow</code> flag to true for a <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;8"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46;

<strong><a id="suffering&#45;from&#45;an&#45;overflow"></a><strong>Suffering from an overflow</strong></strong>

When a control has a <a id="definitions&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;7"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) that is not the empty string and is too high for the <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;max"></a><code>[max](#attr-input-max)</code> attribute&#46;

When the <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;8"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method sets <code>rangeOverflow</code> flag to true for a <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;9"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46;

<strong><a id="suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;step&#45;mismatch"></a><strong>Suffering from a step mismatch</strong></strong>

When a control has a <a id="definitions&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value&#45;8"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) that doesn&#39;t fit the rules given by the <a id="definitions&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;step"></a><code>[step](#attr-input-step)</code> attribute&#46;

When the <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;9"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method sets <code>stepMismatch</code> flag to true for a <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;10"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46;

<strong><a id="suffering&#45;from&#45;bad&#45;input"></a><strong>Suffering from bad input</strong></strong>

When a control has incomplete input and the user agent does not think the user ought to be able to submit the form in its current state&#46;

When the <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;10"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method sets <code>badInput</code> flag to true for a <a id="definitions&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element&#45;11"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#46;

<strong><a id="suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;error"></a><strong>Suffering from a custom error</strong></strong>

When a control&#39;s <a id="definitions&#58;custom&#45;validity&#45;error&#45;message&#45;4"></a>[custom validity error message](#custom-validity-error-message) &#40;as set by the element&#39;s <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity&#45;2"></a><code>[setCustomValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity)</code> method or <a id="definitions&#58;elementinternals&#45;2"></a><code>[ElementInternals](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#elementinternals)</code>&#39;s <a id="definitions&#58;dom&#45;elementinternals&#45;setvalidity&#45;11"></a><code>[setValidity&#40;&#41;](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#dom-elementinternals-setvalidity)</code> method&#41; is not the empty string&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

An element can still suffer from these states even when the element is <a id="definitions&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled)&#59; thus these states can be represented in the DOM even if validating the form during submission wouldn&#39;t indicate a problem to the user&#46;

An element <a id="concept&#45;fv&#45;valid"></a><strong>satisfies its constraints</strong> if it is not suffering from any of the above <a id="definitions&#58;validity&#45;states"></a>[validity states](#validity-states)&#46;

##### <a id="constraint&#45;validation"></a>4&#46;10&#46;21&#46;2 Constraint validation[](#constraint-validation)

When the user agent is required to <a id="statically&#45;validate&#45;the&#45;constraints"></a><strong>statically validate the constraints</strong> of <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element <var>form</var>&#44; it must run the following steps&#44; which return either a <em>positive</em> result &#40;all the controls in the form are valid&#41; or a <em>negative</em> result &#40;there are invalid controls&#41; along with a &#40;possibly empty&#41; list of elements that are invalid and for which no script has claimed responsibility&#58;

1.  Let <var>controls</var> be a list of all the <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;category&#45;submit"></a>[submittable elements](#category-submit) whose <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is <var>form</var>&#44; in <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

2.  Let <var>invalid controls</var> be an initially empty list of elements&#46;

3.  For each element <var>field</var> in <var>controls</var>&#44; in <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#58;

    1.  If <var>field</var> is not a <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;candidate&#45;for&#45;constraint&#45;validation"></a>[candidate for constraint validation](#candidate-for-constraint-validation)&#44; then move on to the next element&#46;

    2.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>field</var> <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;concept&#45;fv&#45;valid"></a>[satisfies its constraints](#concept-fv-valid)&#44; then move on to the next element&#46;

    3.  Otherwise&#44; add <var>field</var> to <var>invalid controls</var>&#46;

4.  If <var>invalid controls</var> is empty&#44; then return a <em>positive</em> result&#46;

5.  Let <var>unhandled invalid controls</var> be an initially empty list of elements&#46;

6.  For each element <var>field</var> in <var>invalid controls</var>&#44; if any&#44; in <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;3"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#58;

    1.  Let <var>notCanceled</var> be the result of <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[firing an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;event&#45;invalid"></a><code>[invalid](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-invalid)</code> at <var>field</var>&#44; with the <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;cancelable"></a><code>[cancelable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

    2.  If <var>notCanceled</var> is true&#44; then add <var>field</var> to <var>unhandled invalid controls</var>&#46;

7.  Return a <em>negative</em> result with the list of elements in the <var>unhandled invalid controls</var> list&#46;

If a user agent is to <a id="interactively&#45;validate&#45;the&#45;constraints"></a><strong>interactively validate the constraints</strong> of <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element <var>form</var>&#44; then the user agent must run the following steps&#58;

1.  <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;statically&#45;validate&#45;the&#45;constraints"></a>[Statically validate the constraints](#statically-validate-the-constraints) of <var>form</var>&#44; and let <var>unhandled invalid controls</var> be the list of elements returned if the result was <em>negative</em>&#46;

2.  If the result was <em>positive</em>&#44; then return that result&#46;

3.  Report the problems with the constraints of at least one of the elements given in <var>unhandled invalid controls</var> to the user&#46;

    - User agents may focus one of those elements in the process&#44; by running the <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;focusing&#45;steps"></a>[focusing steps](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusing-steps) for that element&#44; and may change the scrolling position of the document&#44; or perform some other action that brings the element to the user&#39;s attention&#46; For elements that are <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated custom elements](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; user agents should use their <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;face&#45;validation&#45;anchor"></a>[validation anchor](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#face-validation-anchor) instead&#44; for the purposes of these actions&#46;

    - User agents may report more than one constraint violation&#46;

    - User agents may coalesce related constraint violation reports if appropriate &#40;e&#46;g&#46; if multiple radio buttons in a <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;group"></a>[group](#radio-button-group) are marked as required&#44; only one error need be reported&#41;&#46;

    - If one of the controls is not <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;being&#45;rendered"></a>[being rendered](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#being-rendered) &#40;e&#46;g&#46; it has the <a id="constraint&#45;validation&#58;attr&#45;hidden"></a><code>[hidden](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#attr-hidden)</code> attribute set&#41;&#44; then user agents may report a script error&#46;

4.  Return a <em>negative</em> result&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity"></a><strong><code>setCustomValidity&#40;<var>error</var>&#41;</code></strong> method steps are&#58;

1.  Set <var>error</var> to the result of <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;normalize&#45;newlines"></a>[normalizing newlines](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#normalize-newlines) given <var>error</var>&#46;

2.  Set the <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;validity&#45;error&#45;message"></a>[custom validity error message](#custom-validity-error-message) to <var>error</var>&#46;

<strong>Example&#58;</strong>

In the following example&#44; a script checks the value of a form control each time it is edited&#44; and whenever it is not a valid value&#44; uses the <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;cva&#45;setcustomvalidity"></a><code>[setCustomValidity&#40;&#41;](#dom-cva-setcustomvalidity)</code> method to set an appropriate message&#46;

``` text
<label>Feeling: <input name=f type="text" oninput="check(this)"></label>
<script>
 function check(input) {
   if (input.value == "good" ||
       input.value == "fine" ||
       input.value == "tired") {
     input.setCustomValidity('"' + input.value + '" is not a feeling.');
   } else {
     // input is fine -- reset the error message
     input.setCustomValidity('');
   }
 }
</script>
```

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface ValidityState {
  readonly attribute boolean valueMissing;
  readonly attribute boolean typeMismatch;
  readonly attribute boolean patternMismatch;
  readonly attribute boolean tooLong;
  readonly attribute boolean tooShort;
  readonly attribute boolean rangeUnderflow;
  readonly attribute boolean rangeOverflow;
  readonly attribute boolean stepMismatch;
  readonly attribute boolean badInput;
  readonly attribute boolean customError;
  readonly attribute boolean valid;
};
```

A <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;validitystate&#45;3"></a><code>[ValidityState](#validitystate)</code> object has the following attributes&#46; On getting&#44; they must return true if the corresponding condition given in the following list is true&#44; and false otherwise&#46;

The <a id="check&#45;validity&#45;steps"></a><strong>check validity steps</strong> for an element <var>element</var> are&#58;

1.  If <var>element</var> is a <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;candidate&#45;for&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;3"></a>[candidate for constraint validation](#candidate-for-constraint-validation) and does not <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;fv&#45;valid"></a>[satisfy its constraints](#concept-fv-valid)&#58;

    1.  <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;event&#45;invalid&#45;3"></a><code>[invalid](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-invalid)</code> at <var>element</var>&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;cancelable"></a><code>[cancelable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable)</code> attribute initialized to true &#40;though canceling has no effect&#41;&#46;

    2.  Return false&#46;

2.  Return true&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;cva&#45;checkvalidity"></a><strong><code>checkValidity&#40;&#41;</code></strong> method&#44; when invoked&#44; must run the <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;check&#45;validity&#45;steps"></a>[check validity steps](#check-validity-steps) on this element&#46;

    1.  Let <var>report</var> be the result of <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire&#45;2"></a>[firing an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;event&#45;invalid&#45;4"></a><code>[invalid](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-invalid)</code> at <var>element</var>&#44; with the <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;cancelable&#45;2"></a><code>[cancelable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

If <var>report</var> is true&#44; then report the problems with the constraints of this element to the user&#46; When reporting the problem with the constraints to the user&#44; the user agent may run the <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;focusing&#45;steps"></a>[focusing steps](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focusing-steps) for <var>element</var>&#44; and may change the scrolling position of the document&#44; or perform some other action that brings <var>element</var> to the user&#39;s attention&#46; User agents may report more than one constraint violation&#44; if <var>element</var> suffers from multiple problems at once&#46;

    3.  Return false&#46;

2.  Return true&#46;

If this element is not a <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;candidate&#45;for&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;5"></a>[candidate for constraint validation](#candidate-for-constraint-validation) or if this element <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;concept&#45;fv&#45;valid&#45;3"></a>[satisfies its constraints](#concept-fv-valid)&#44; then return the empty string&#46;

2.  Return a suitably localized message that the user agent would show the user if this were the only form control with a validity constraint problem&#46; If the user agent would not actually show a textual message in such a situation &#40;e&#46;g&#46;&#44; it would show a graphical cue instead&#41;&#44; then return a suitably localized message that expresses &#40;one or more of&#41; the validity constraint&#40;s&#41; that the control does not satisfy&#46; If the element is a <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;candidate&#45;for&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;6"></a>[candidate for constraint validation](#candidate-for-constraint-validation) and is <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;suffering&#45;from&#45;a&#45;custom&#45;error&#45;2"></a>[suffering from a custom error](#suffering-from-a-custom-error)&#44; then the <a id="the&#45;constraint&#45;validation&#45;api&#58;custom&#45;validity&#45;error&#45;message&#45;2"></a>[custom validity error message](#custom-validity-error-message) should be present in the return value&#46;

##### <a id="security&#45;forms"></a>4&#46;10&#46;21&#46;4 Security[](#security-forms)

<a id="security&#45;0"></a>Servers should not rely on client&#45;side validation&#46; Client&#45;side validation can be intentionally bypassed by hostile users&#44; and unintentionally bypassed by users of older user agents or automated tools that do not implement these features&#46; The constraint validation features are only intended to improve the user experience&#44; not to provide any kind of security mechanism&#46;

#### <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;2"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22 <a id="form&#45;submission"></a><strong>Form submission</strong>[](#form-submission-2)

##### <a id="introduction&#45;5"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22&#46;1 Introduction[](#introduction-5)

<em>This section is non&#45;normative&#46;</em>

When a form is submitted&#44; the data in the form is converted into the structure specified by the <a id="introduction&#45;5&#58;concept&#45;fs&#45;enctype"></a>[enctype](#concept-fs-enctype)&#44; and then sent to the destination specified by the <a id="introduction&#45;5&#58;concept&#45;fs&#45;action"></a>[action](#concept-fs-action) using the given <a id="introduction&#45;5&#58;concept&#45;fs&#45;method"></a>[method](#concept-fs-method)&#46;

For example&#44; take the following form&#58;

``` text
<form action="/find.cgi" method=get>
 <input type=text name=t>
 <input type=search name=q>
 <input type=submit>
</form>
```

If the user types in &#34;cats&#34; in the first field and &#34;fur&#34; in the second&#44; and then hits the submit button&#44; then the user agent will load <code>&#47;find&#46;cgi&#63;t&#61;cats&#38;q&#61;fur</code>&#46;

On the other hand&#44; consider this form&#58;

``` text
<form action="/find.cgi" method=post enctype="multipart/form-data">
 <input type=text name=t>
 <input type=search name=q>
 <input type=submit>
</form>
```

Given the same user input&#44; the result on submission is quite different&#58; the user agent instead does an HTTP POST to the given URL&#44; with as the entity body something like the following text&#58;

``` text
------kYFrd4jNJEgCervE
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="t"

cats
------kYFrd4jNJEgCervE
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="q"

fur
------kYFrd4jNJEgCervE--
```

##### <a id="implicit&#45;submission"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22&#46;2 Implicit submission[](#implicit-submission)

A <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="default&#45;button"></a><strong>default button</strong> is the first <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button) in <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order) whose <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is that <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#46;

If the user agent supports letting the user submit a form implicitly &#40;for example&#44; on some platforms hitting the &#34;enter&#34; key while a text control is <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;focused"></a>[focused](html-language-host-facts--877d6146487f--2dd822df9d5e.md#focused) implicitly submits the form&#41;&#44; then doing so for a form&#44; whose <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;default&#45;button"></a>[default button](#default-button) has <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;activation&#45;behaviour"></a>[activation behavior](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#eventtarget-activation-behavior) and is not <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled)&#44; must cause the user agent to <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;fire&#45;a&#45;click&#45;event"></a>[fire a <code>click</code> event](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#fire-a-click-event) at that <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;default&#45;button&#45;2"></a>[default button](#default-button)&#46;

<strong>Note&#58;</strong>

There are pages on the web that are only usable if there is a way to implicitly submit forms&#44; so user agents are strongly encouraged to support this&#46;

If the form has no <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;2"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button)&#44; then the implicit submission mechanism must perform the following steps&#58;

1.  If the form has more than one <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;field&#45;that&#45;blocks&#45;implicit&#45;submission"></a>[field that blocks implicit submission](#field-that-blocks-implicit-submission)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;submit"></a>[Submit](#concept-form-submit) the <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element from the <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element itself with <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;submit&#45;user&#45;involvement"></a><em>[userInvolvement](#submit-user-involvement)</em> set to &#34;<a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;uni&#45;activation"></a><code>[activation](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#uni-activation)</code>&#34;&#46;

For the purpose of the previous paragraph&#44; an element is a <a id="field&#45;that&#45;blocks&#45;implicit&#45;submission"></a><strong>field that blocks implicit submission</strong> of a <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element if it is an <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is that <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element and whose <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in one of the following states&#58; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;"></a>[Text](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;text&#45;&#40;type&#61;text&#41;&#45;state&#45;and&#45;search&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;search&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Search](#text-(type=text)-state-and-search-state-(type=search))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;telephone&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;tel&#41;"></a>[Telephone](#telephone-state-(type=tel))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;url&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;url&#41;"></a>[URL](#url-state-(type=url))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;email&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;email&#41;"></a>[Email](#email-state-(type=email))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;password&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;password&#41;"></a>[Password](#password-state-(type=password))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;date&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;date&#41;"></a>[Date](#date-state-(type=date))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;month&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;month&#41;"></a>[Month](#month-state-(type=month))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;week&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;week&#41;"></a>[Week](#week-state-(type=week))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;time&#41;"></a>[Time](#time-state-(type=time))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;local&#45;date&#45;and&#45;time&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;datetime&#45;local&#41;"></a>[Local Date and Time](#local-date-and-time-state-(type=datetime-local))&#44; <a id="implicit&#45;submission&#58;number&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;number&#41;"></a>[Number](#number-state-(type=number))

##### <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22&#46;3 Form submission algorithm[](#form-submission-algorithm)

Each <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element has a <a id="constructing&#45;entry&#45;list"></a><strong>constructing entry list</strong> boolean&#44; initially false&#46;

Each <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element has a <a id="firing&#45;submission&#45;events"></a><strong>firing submission events</strong> boolean&#44; initially false&#46;

To <a id="concept&#45;form&#45;submit"></a><strong>submit</strong> a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element <var>form</var> from an element <var>submitter</var> &#40;typically a button&#41;&#44; given an optional boolean <a id="submit&#45;subbmitted&#45;from&#45;method"></a><strong><var>submitted from <code>submit&#40;&#41;</code> method</var></strong> &#40;default false&#41; and an optional <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;user&#45;navigation&#45;involvement"></a>[user navigation involvement](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#user-navigation-involvement) <a id="submit&#45;user&#45;involvement"></a><strong><var>userInvolvement</var></strong> &#40;default &#34;<a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;uni&#45;none"></a><code>[none](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#uni-none)</code>&#34;&#41;&#58;

1.  If <var>form</var> <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;cannot&#45;navigate"></a>[cannot navigate](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#cannot-navigate)&#44; then return&#46;

2.  If <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;constructing&#45;entry&#45;list"></a>[constructing entry list](#constructing-entry-list) is true&#44; then return&#46;

3.  Let <var>form document</var> be <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;node&#45;document"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

4.  <a id="sandboxSubmitBlocked"></a>

    If <var>form document</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;active&#45;sandboxing&#45;flag&#45;set"></a>[active sandboxing flag set](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#active-sandboxing-flag-set) has its <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;sandboxed&#45;forms&#45;browsing&#45;context&#45;flag"></a>[sandboxed forms browsing context flag](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#sandboxed-forms-browsing-context-flag) set&#44; then return&#46;

5.  If <var>submitted from <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;dom&#45;form&#45;submit"></a><code>[submit&#40;&#41;](#dom-form-submit)</code> method</var> is false&#58;

    1.  If <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;firing&#45;submission&#45;events"></a>[firing submission events](#firing-submission-events) is true&#44; then return&#46;

    2.  Set <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;firing&#45;submission&#45;events&#45;2"></a>[firing submission events](#firing-submission-events) to true&#46;

    3.  For each element <var>field</var> in the list of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;category&#45;submit"></a>[submittable elements](#category-submit) whose <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is <var>form</var>&#44; set <var>field</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;user&#45;validity"></a>[user validity](#user-validity) to true&#46;

    4.  If the <var>submitter</var> element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;fs&#45;novalidate"></a>[no&#45;validate state](#concept-fs-novalidate) is false&#44; then <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;interactively&#45;validate&#45;the&#45;constraints"></a>[interactively validate the constraints](#interactively-validate-the-constraints) of <var>form</var> and examine the result&#46; If the result is negative &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; the constraint validation concluded that there were invalid fields and probably informed the user of this&#41;&#58;

        1.  Set <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;firing&#45;submission&#45;events&#45;3"></a>[firing submission events](#firing-submission-events) to false&#46;

        2.  Return&#46;

    5.  Let <var>submitterButton</var> be null if <var>submitter</var> is <var>form</var>&#46; Otherwise&#44; let <var>submitterButton</var> be <var>submitter</var>&#46;

    6.  Let <var>shouldContinue</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[firing an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;event&#45;submit"></a><code>[submit](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-submit)</code> at <var>form</var> using <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;submitevent"></a><code>[SubmitEvent](#submitevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;dom&#45;submitevent&#45;submitter"></a><code>[submitter](#dom-submitevent-submitter)</code> attribute initialized to <var>submitterButton</var>&#44; the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#44; and the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;cancelable"></a><code>[cancelable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

    7.  Set <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;firing&#45;submission&#45;events&#45;4"></a>[firing submission events](#firing-submission-events) to false&#46;

    8.  If <var>shouldContinue</var> is false&#44; then return&#46;

    9.  If <var>form</var> <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;cannot&#45;navigate&#45;2"></a>[cannot navigate](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#cannot-navigate)&#44; then return&#46;

        <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

        <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;cannot&#45;navigate&#45;3"></a>[Cannot navigate](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#cannot-navigate) is run again as dispatching the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;event&#45;submit&#45;2"></a><code>[submit](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-submit)</code> event could have changed the outcome&#46;

6.  Let <var>encoding</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;picking&#45;an&#45;encoding&#45;for&#45;the&#45;form"></a>[picking an encoding for the form](#picking-an-encoding-for-the-form)&#46;

7.  Let <var>entry list</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;constructing&#45;the&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set"></a>[constructing the entry list](#constructing-the-form-data-set) with <var>form</var>&#44; <var>submitter</var>&#44; and <var>encoding</var>&#46;

8.  <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;assert"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>entry list</var> is not null&#46;

9.  If <var>form</var> <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;cannot&#45;navigate&#45;4"></a>[cannot navigate](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#cannot-navigate)&#44; then return&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;cannot&#45;navigate&#45;5"></a>[Cannot navigate](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#cannot-navigate) is run again as dispatching the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;event&#45;formdata"></a><code>[formdata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-formdata)</code> event in <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;constructing&#45;the&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#45;2"></a>[constructing the entry list](#constructing-the-form-data-set) could have changed the outcome&#46;

10. Let <var>method</var> be the <var>submitter</var> element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;fs&#45;method"></a>[method](#concept-fs-method)&#46;

11. If <var>method</var> is <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;dialog"></a>[dialog](#attr-fs-method-dialog)&#58;

    1.  If <var>form</var> does not have an ancestor <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element"></a><code>[dialog](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-dialog-element)</code> element&#44; then return&#46;

    2.  Let <var>subject</var> be <var>form</var>&#39;s nearest ancestor <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;dialog&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[dialog](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#the-dialog-element)</code> element&#46;

    3.  Let <var>result</var> be null&#46;

    4.  If <var>submitter</var> is an <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state&#58;

        1.  Let &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; be the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;image&#45;coordinate"></a>[selected coordinate](#concept-input-type-image-coordinate)&#46;

        2.  Set <var>result</var> to the concatenation of <var>x</var>&#44; &#34;<code>&#44;</code>&#34;&#44; and <var>y</var>&#46;

    5.  Otherwise&#44; if <var>submitter</var> is a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button)&#44; then set <var>result</var> to <var>submitter</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;optional&#45;value"></a>[optional value](#concept-fe-optional-value)&#46;

    6.  <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;close&#45;the&#45;dialog"></a>[Close the dialog](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#close-the-dialog) <var>subject</var> with <var>result</var> and null&#46;

    7.  Return&#46;

12. Let <var>action</var> be the <var>submitter</var> element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;fs&#45;action"></a>[action](#concept-fs-action)&#46;

13. If <var>action</var> is the empty string&#44; let <var>action</var> be the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;document&#39;s&#45;address"></a>[URL](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-url) of the <var>form document</var>&#46;

14. Let <var>parsed action</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;encoding&#45;parsing&#45;a&#45;url"></a>[encoding&#45;parsing a URL](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#encoding-parsing-a-url) given <var>action</var>&#44; relative to <var>submitter</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;node&#45;document&#45;2"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#46;

15. If <var>parsed action</var> is failure&#44; then return&#46;

16. Let <var>scheme</var> be the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;scheme"></a>[scheme](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-scheme) of <var>parsed action</var>&#46;

17. Let <var>enctype</var> be the <var>submitter</var> element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;fs&#45;enctype"></a>[enctype](#concept-fs-enctype)&#46;

18. Let <var>formTarget</var> be null&#46;

19. If the <var>submitter</var> element is a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button&#45;2"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button) and it has a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code> attribute&#44; then set <var>formTarget</var> to the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;formtarget&#45;2"></a><code>[formtarget](#attr-fs-formtarget)</code> attribute value&#46;

20. Let <var>target</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;get&#45;an&#45;element&#39;s&#45;target"></a>[getting an element&#39;s target](html-language-elements-attributes--877d6146487f--2ca83b5ac984.md#get-an-element's-target) given <var>submitter</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;form&#45;owner&#45;2"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) and <var>formTarget</var>&#46;

21. Let <var>noopener</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;get&#45;an&#45;element&#39;s&#45;noopener"></a>[getting an element&#39;s noopener](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#get-an-element's-noopener) with <var>form</var>&#44; <var>parsed action</var>&#44; and <var>target</var>&#46;

22. Let <var>targetNavigable</var> be the first return value of applying <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;rules&#45;for&#45;choosing&#45;a&#45;navigable"></a>[the rules for choosing a navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#the-rules-for-choosing-a-navigable) given <var>target</var>&#44; <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;node&#45;navigable"></a>[node navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#node-navigable)&#44; and <var>noopener</var>&#46;

23. If <var>targetNavigable</var> is null&#44; then return&#46;

24. Let <var>historyHandling</var> be &#34;<a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;navigationhistorybehavior&#45;auto"></a><code>[auto](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigationhistorybehavior-auto)</code>&#34;&#46;

25. If <var>form document</var> equals <var>targetNavigable</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;nav&#45;document"></a>[active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#nav-document)&#44; and <var>form document</var> has not yet <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;completely&#45;loaded"></a>[completely loaded](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#completely-loaded)&#44; then set <var>historyHandling</var> to &#34;<a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;navigationhistorybehavior&#45;replace"></a><code>[replace](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigationhistorybehavior-replace)</code>&#34;&#46;

26. Select the appropriate row in the table below based on <var>scheme</var> as given by the first cell of each row&#46; Then&#44; select the appropriate cell on that row based on <var>method</var> as given in the first cell of each column&#46; Then&#44; jump to the steps named in that cell and defined below the table&#46;

    <table><thead><tr><td>       </td><th> <a href="#attr-fs-method-get" id="form-submission-algorithm:attr-fs-method-get">GET</a>       </th><th> <a href="#attr-fs-method-post" id="form-submission-algorithm:attr-fs-method-post">POST</a>      </th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><th> <code>http</code>       </th><td> <a href="#submit-mutate-action" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-mutate-action">Mutate action URL</a>       </td><td> <a href="#submit-body" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-body">Submit as entity body</a>      </td></tr><tr><th> <code>https</code>       </th><td> <a href="#submit-mutate-action" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-mutate-action-2">Mutate action URL</a>       </td><td> <a href="#submit-body" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-body-2">Submit as entity body</a>      </td></tr><tr><th> <code>ftp</code>       </th><td> <a href="#submit-get-action" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-get-action">Get action URL</a>       </td><td> <a href="#submit-get-action" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-get-action-2">Get action URL</a>      </td></tr><tr><th> <code>javascript</code>       </th><td> <a href="#submit-get-action" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-get-action-3">Get action URL</a>       </td><td> <a href="#submit-get-action" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-get-action-4">Get action URL</a>      </td></tr><tr><th> <code>data</code>       </th><td> <a href="#submit-mutate-action" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-mutate-action-3">Mutate action URL</a>       </td><td> <a href="#submit-get-action" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-get-action-5">Get action URL</a>      </td></tr><tr><th> <code>mailto</code>       </th><td> <a href="#submit-mailto-headers" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-mailto-headers">Mail with headers</a>       </td><td> <a href="#submit-mailto-body" id="form-submission-algorithm:submit-mailto-body">Mail as body</a>     </td></tr></tbody></table>

    If <var>scheme</var> is not one of those listed in this table&#44; then the behavior is not defined by this specification&#46; User agents should&#44; in the absence of another specification defining this&#44; act in a manner analogous to that defined in this specification for similar schemes&#46;

    Each <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element has a <a id="planned&#45;navigation"></a><strong>planned navigation</strong>&#44; which is either null or a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;task"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task)&#59; when the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> is first created&#44; its <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;planned&#45;navigation"></a>[planned navigation](#planned-navigation) must be set to null&#46; In the behaviors described below&#44; when the user agent is required to <a id="plan&#45;to&#45;navigate"></a><strong>plan to navigate</strong> to a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;url"></a>[URL](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url) <var>url</var> given an optional <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;post&#45;resource"></a>[POST resource](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#post-resource)&#45;or&#45;null <var>postResource</var> &#40;default null&#41;&#44; it must run the following steps&#58;

    1.  Let <var>referrerPolicy</var> be the empty string&#46;

    2.  If the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#39;s [link types](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#linkTypes) include the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;link&#45;type&#45;noreferrer"></a><code>[noreferrer](html-language-elements-text-links--877d6146487f--8833a85fd242.md#link-type-noreferrer)</code> keyword&#44; then set <var>referrerPolicy</var> to &#34;<code>no&#45;referrer</code>&#34;&#46;

    3.  If the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;7"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> has a non&#45;null <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;planned&#45;navigation&#45;2"></a>[planned navigation](#planned-navigation)&#44; remove it from its <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;task&#45;queue"></a>[task queue](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#task-queue)&#46;

    4.  <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;queue&#45;an&#45;element&#45;task"></a>[Queue an element task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#queue-an-element-task) on the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;dom&#45;manipulation&#45;task&#45;source"></a>[DOM manipulation task source](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#dom-manipulation-task-source) given the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;8"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element and the following steps&#58;

        1.  Set the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;9"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;planned&#45;navigation&#45;3"></a>[planned navigation](#planned-navigation) to null&#46;

        2.  <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;navigate"></a>[Navigate](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigate) <var>targetNavigable</var> to <var>url</var> using the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;10"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;node&#45;document&#45;3"></a>[node document](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-node-document)&#44; with <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;navigation&#45;hh"></a><em>[historyHandling](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-hh)</em> set to <var>historyHandling</var>&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;navigation&#45;user&#45;involvement"></a><em>[userInvolvement](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-user-involvement)</em> set to <var>userInvolvement</var>&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;navigation&#45;source&#45;element"></a><em>[sourceElement](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-source-element)</em> set to <var>submitter</var>&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;navigation&#45;referrer&#45;policy"></a><em>[referrerPolicy](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-referrer-policy)</em> set to <var>referrerPolicy</var>&#44; <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;navigation&#45;resource"></a><em>[documentResource](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-resource)</em> set to <var>postResource</var>&#44; and <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;navigation&#45;form&#45;data&#45;entry&#45;list"></a><em>[formDataEntryList](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#navigation-form-data-entry-list)</em> set to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    5.  Set the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;11"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;planned&#45;navigation&#45;4"></a>[planned navigation](#planned-navigation) to the just&#45;queued <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;task&#45;2"></a>[task](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#concept-task)&#46;

    The behaviors are as follows&#58;

    <strong><a id="submit&#45;mutate&#45;action"></a><strong>Mutate action URL</strong></strong>

    Let <var>pairs</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;convert&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs"></a>[converting to a list of name&#45;value pairs](#convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs) with <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    Let <var>query</var> be the result of running the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded&#45;serializer"></a>[<code>application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded</code> serializer](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded-serializer) with <var>pairs</var> and <var>encoding</var>&#46;

    Set <var>parsed action</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;query"></a>[query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) component to <var>query</var>&#46;

    <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;plan&#45;to&#45;navigate"></a>[Plan to navigate](#plan-to-navigate) to <var>parsed action</var>&#46;

    <strong><a id="submit&#45;body"></a><strong>Submit as entity body</strong></strong>

    <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;assert&#45;2"></a>[Assert](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#assert)&#58; <var>method</var> is <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;method&#45;post&#45;2"></a>[POST](#attr-fs-method-post)&#46;

    Switch on <var>enctype</var>&#58;

    <strong><a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;urlencoded"></a><code>[application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded](#attr-fs-enctype-urlencoded)</code></strong>

    Let <var>pairs</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;convert&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#45;2"></a>[converting to a list of name&#45;value pairs](#convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs) with <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    Let <var>body</var> be the result of running the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded&#45;serializer&#45;2"></a>[<code>application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded</code> serializer](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded-serializer) with <var>pairs</var> and <var>encoding</var>&#46;

    Set <var>body</var> to the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;utf&#45;8&#45;encode"></a>[encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8-encode) <var>body</var>&#46;

    Let <var>mimeType</var> be &#96;<a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded"></a><code>[application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded)</code>&#96;&#46;

    <strong><a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;formdata"></a><code>[multipart&#47;form&#45;data](#attr-fs-enctype-formdata)</code></strong>

    Let <var>body</var> be the result of running the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;multipart&#47;form&#45;data&#45;encoding&#45;algorithm"></a>[<code>multipart&#47;form&#45;data</code> encoding algorithm](#multipart/form-data-encoding-algorithm) with <var>entry list</var> and <var>encoding</var>&#46;

    Let <var>mimeType</var> be the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;isomorphic&#45;encode"></a>[isomorphic encoding](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#isomorphic-encode) of the concatenation of &#34;<code>multipart&#47;form&#45;data&#59; boundary&#61;</code>&#34; and the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;multipart&#47;form&#45;data&#45;boundary&#45;string"></a>[<code>multipart&#47;form&#45;data</code> boundary string](#multipart/form-data-boundary-string) generated by the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;multipart&#47;form&#45;data&#45;encoding&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[<code>multipart&#47;form&#45;data</code> encoding algorithm](#multipart/form-data-encoding-algorithm)&#46;

    <strong><a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;text"></a><code>[text&#47;plain](#attr-fs-enctype-text)</code></strong>

    Let <var>pairs</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;convert&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#45;3"></a>[converting to a list of name&#45;value pairs](#convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs) with <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    Let <var>body</var> be the result of running the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;text&#47;plain&#45;encoding&#45;algorithm"></a>[<code>text&#47;plain</code> encoding algorithm](#text/plain-encoding-algorithm) with <var>pairs</var>&#46;

    Set <var>body</var> to the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;encode"></a>[encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encode) <var>body</var> using <var>encoding</var>&#46;

    Let <var>mimeType</var> be &#96;<a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;text&#47;plain"></a><code>[text&#47;plain](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.1.3)</code>&#96;&#46;

    <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;plan&#45;to&#45;navigate&#45;2"></a>[Plan to navigate](#plan-to-navigate) to <var>parsed action</var> given a <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;post&#45;resource&#45;2"></a>[POST resource](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#post-resource) whose <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;post&#45;resource&#45;request&#45;body"></a>[request body](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#post-resource-request-body) is <var>body</var> and <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;post&#45;resource&#45;request&#45;content&#45;type"></a>[request content&#45;type](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#post-resource-request-content-type) is <var>mimeType</var>&#46;

    <strong><a id="submit&#45;get&#45;action"></a><strong>Get action URL</strong></strong>

    <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;plan&#45;to&#45;navigate&#45;3"></a>[Plan to navigate](#plan-to-navigate) to <var>parsed action</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    <var>entry list</var> is discarded&#46;
    <strong><a id="submit&#45;mailto&#45;headers"></a><strong>Mail with headers</strong></strong>

    Let <var>pairs</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;convert&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#45;4"></a>[converting to a list of name&#45;value pairs](#convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs) with <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    Let <var>headers</var> be the result of running the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded&#45;serializer&#45;3"></a>[<code>application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded</code> serializer](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded-serializer) with <var>pairs</var> and <var>encoding</var>&#46;

    Replace occurrences of U&#43;002B PLUS SIGN characters &#40;&#43;&#41; in <var>headers</var> with the string &#34;<code>&#37;20</code>&#34;&#46;

    Set <var>parsed action</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;query&#45;2"></a>[query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) to <var>headers</var>&#46;

    <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;plan&#45;to&#45;navigate&#45;4"></a>[Plan to navigate](#plan-to-navigate) to <var>parsed action</var>&#46;
