    <strong><a id="submit&#45;mailto&#45;body"></a><strong>Mail as body</strong></strong>

    Let <var>pairs</var> be the result of <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;convert&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#45;5"></a>[converting to a list of name&#45;value pairs](#convert-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs) with <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    Switch on <var>enctype</var>&#58;

    <strong><a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;attr&#45;fs&#45;enctype&#45;text&#45;2"></a><code>[text&#47;plain](#attr-fs-enctype-text)</code></strong>

    Let <var>body</var> be the result of running the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;text&#47;plain&#45;encoding&#45;algorithm&#45;2"></a>[<code>text&#47;plain</code> encoding algorithm](#text/plain-encoding-algorithm) with <var>pairs</var>&#46;

    Set <var>body</var> to the result of running <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;utf&#45;8&#45;percent&#45;encode"></a>[UTF&#45;8 percent&#45;encode](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#string-utf-8-percent-encode) on <var>body</var> using the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;default&#45;encode&#45;set"></a>[default encode set](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#default-encode-set)&#46; [&#91;URL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsURL)

    <strong>Otherwise</strong>

    Let <var>body</var> be the result of running the <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded&#45;serializer&#45;4"></a>[<code>application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded</code> serializer](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded-serializer) with <var>pairs</var> and <var>encoding</var>&#46;

    If <var>parsed action</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;query&#45;3"></a>[query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) is null&#44; then set it to the empty string&#46;

    If <var>parsed action</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;query&#45;4"></a>[query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query) is not the empty string&#44; then append a single U&#43;0026 AMPERSAND character &#40;&#38;&#41; to it&#46;

    Append &#34;<code>body&#61;</code>&#34; to <var>parsed action</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;query&#45;5"></a>[query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query)&#46;

    Append <var>body</var> to <var>parsed action</var>&#39;s <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;concept&#45;url&#45;query&#45;6"></a>[query](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-url-query)&#46;

    <a id="form&#45;submission&#45;algorithm&#58;plan&#45;to&#45;navigate&#45;5"></a>[Plan to navigate](#plan-to-navigate) to <var>parsed action</var>&#46;

##### <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22&#46;4 Constructing the entry list[](#constructing-form-data-set)

An <a id="entry&#45;list"></a><strong>entry list</strong> is a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;form&#45;entry"></a>[entries](#form-entry)&#44; typically representing the contents of a form&#46; An <a id="form&#45;entry"></a><strong>entry</strong> is a tuple consisting of a <a id="form&#45;entry&#45;name"></a><strong>name</strong> &#40;a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;scalar&#45;value&#45;string"></a>[scalar value string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string)&#41; and a <a id="form&#45;entry&#45;value"></a><strong>value</strong> &#40;either a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;scalar&#45;value&#45;string&#45;2"></a>[scalar value string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string) or a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;file"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object&#41;&#46;

<a id="append&#45;an&#45;entry"></a>To <a id="create&#45;an&#45;entry"></a><strong>create an entry</strong> given a string <var>name</var>&#44; a string or <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;blob"></a><code>[Blob](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob)</code> object <var>value</var>&#44; and optionally a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;scalar&#45;value&#45;string&#45;3"></a>[scalar value string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string) <var>filename</var>&#58;

1.  Set <var>name</var> to the result of <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;convert"></a>[converting](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-string-convert) <var>name</var> into a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;scalar&#45;value&#45;string&#45;4"></a>[scalar value string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string)&#46;

2.  If <var>value</var> is a string&#44; then set <var>value</var> to the result of <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;convert&#45;2"></a>[converting](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#javascript-string-convert) <var>value</var> into a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;scalar&#45;value&#45;string&#45;5"></a>[scalar value string](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#scalar-value-string)&#46;

3.  Otherwise&#58;

    1.  If <var>value</var> is not a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;file&#45;2"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object&#44; then set <var>value</var> to a new <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;file&#45;3"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object&#44; representing the same bytes&#44; whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;dom&#45;file&#45;name"></a><code>[name](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-name)</code> attribute value is &#34;<code>blob</code>&#34;&#46;

    2.  If <var>filename</var> is given&#44; then set <var>value</var> to a new <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;file&#45;4"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object&#44; representing the same bytes&#44; whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;dom&#45;file&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-name)</code> attribute is <var>filename</var>&#46;

    <strong>Note&#58;</strong>

    These operations will create a new <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;file&#45;5"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object if either <var>filename</var> is given or the passed <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;blob&#45;2"></a><code>[Blob](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob)</code> is not a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;file&#45;6"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object&#46; In those cases&#44; the identity of the passed <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;blob&#45;3"></a><code>[Blob](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-Blob)</code> object is not kept&#46;

4.  Return an <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;2"></a>[entry](#form-entry) whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;name"></a>[name](#form-entry-name) is <var>name</var> and whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;value"></a>[value](#form-entry-value) is <var>value</var>&#46;

To <a id="constructing&#45;the&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set"></a><strong>construct the entry list</strong> given a <var>form</var>&#44; an optional <var>submitter</var> &#40;default null&#41;&#44; and an optional <var>encoding</var> &#40;default <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;utf&#45;8"></a>[UTF&#45;8](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8)&#41;&#58;

1.  If <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;constructing&#45;entry&#45;list"></a>[constructing entry list](#constructing-entry-list) is true&#44; then return null&#46;

2.  Set <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;constructing&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[constructing entry list](#constructing-entry-list) to true&#46;

3.  Let <var>controls</var> be a list of all the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;category&#45;submit"></a>[submittable elements](#category-submit) whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is <var>form</var>&#44; in <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;tree&#45;order"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#46;

4.  Let <var>entry list</var> be a new empty <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;entry&#45;list"></a>[entry list](#entry-list)&#46;

5.  For each element <var>field</var> in <var>controls</var>&#44; in <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;tree&#45;order&#45;2"></a>[tree order](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-tree-order)&#58;

    1.  If any of the following are true&#58;

        - <var>field</var> has a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;datalist&#45;element"></a><code>[datalist](#the-datalist-element)</code> element ancestor&#59;

        - <var>field</var> is <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-fe-disabled)&#59;

        - <var>field</var> is a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;button"></a>[button](#concept-button) but it is not <var>submitter</var>&#59;

        - <var>field</var> is an <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;"></a>[Checkbox](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)) state and whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) is false&#59; or

        - <var>field</var> is an <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;2"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;"></a>[Radio Button](#radio-button-state-(type=radio)) state and whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;checked&#45;2"></a>[checkedness](#concept-fe-checked) is false&#44;

        then <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;continue"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    2.  If the <var>field</var> element is an <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;3"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;3"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;image&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;image&#41;"></a>[Image Button](#image-button-state-(type=image)) state&#58;

        1.  If the <var>field</var> element is not <var>submitter</var>&#44; then <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;continue&#45;2"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

        2.  If the <var>field</var> element has a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute specified and its value is not the empty string&#44; let <var>name</var> be that value followed by U&#43;002E &#40;&#46;&#41;&#46; Otherwise&#44; let <var>name</var> be the empty string&#46;

        3.  Let <var>name<sub>x</sub></var> be the concatenation of <var>name</var> and U&#43;0078 &#40;x&#41;&#46;

        4.  Let <var>name<sub>y</sub></var> be the concatenation of <var>name</var> and U&#43;0079 &#40;y&#41;&#46;

        5.  Let &#40;<var>x</var>&#44; <var>y</var>&#41; be the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;image&#45;coordinate"></a>[selected coordinate](#concept-input-type-image-coordinate)&#46;

        6.  <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;create&#45;an&#45;entry"></a>[Create an entry](#create-an-entry) with <var>name<sub>x</sub></var> and <var>x</var>&#44; and <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list&#45;append"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) it to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

        7.  <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;create&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;2"></a>[Create an entry](#create-an-entry) with <var>name<sub>y</sub></var> and <var>y</var>&#44; and <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list&#45;append&#45;2"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) it to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

        8.  <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;continue&#45;3"></a>[Continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    3.  If the <var>field</var> is a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;form&#45;associated&#45;custom&#45;element"></a>[form&#45;associated custom element](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#form-associated-custom-element)&#44; then perform the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;face&#45;entry&#45;construction"></a>[entry construction algorithm](html-language-elements-interactive-scripting--877d6146487f--05bb1d85cc89.md#face-entry-construction) given <var>field</var> and <var>entry list</var>&#44; then <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;continue&#45;4"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    4.  If either the <var>field</var> element does not have a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;2"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute specified&#44; or its <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;3"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute&#39;s value is the empty string&#44; then <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;continue&#45;5"></a>[continue](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#iteration-continue)&#46;

    5.  Let <var>name</var> be the value of the <var>field</var> element&#39;s <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;4"></a><code>[name](#attr-fe-name)</code> attribute&#46;

    6.  If the <var>field</var> element is a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#44; then for each <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element in the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;select&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[select](#the-select-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;select&#45;option&#45;list"></a>[list of options](#concept-select-option-list) whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;selectedness"></a>[selectedness](#concept-option-selectedness) is true and that is not <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;disabled"></a>[disabled](#concept-option-disabled)&#44; <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;create&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;3"></a>[create an entry](#create-an-entry) with <var>name</var> and the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;option&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-option-value) of the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;option&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[option](#the-option-element)</code> element&#44; and <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list&#45;append&#45;3"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) it to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    7.  Otherwise&#44; if the <var>field</var> element is an <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;4"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;4"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;checkbox&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;checkbox&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Checkbox](#checkbox-state-(type=checkbox)) state or the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;radio&#45;button&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;radio&#41;&#45;2"></a>[Radio Button](#radio-button-state-(type=radio)) state&#58;

        1.  If the <var>field</var> element has a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;value"></a><code>[value](#attr-input-value)</code> attribute specified&#44; then let <var>value</var> be the value of that attribute&#59; otherwise&#44; let <var>value</var> be the string &#34;<code>on</code>&#34;&#46;

        2.  <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;create&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;4"></a>[Create an entry](#create-an-entry) with <var>name</var> and <var>value</var>&#44; and <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list&#45;append&#45;4"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) it to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    8.  Otherwise&#44; if the <var>field</var> element is an <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;5"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;5"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;file&#45;upload&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;file&#41;"></a>[File Upload](#file-upload-state-(type=file)) state&#58;

        1.  If there are no <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected)&#44; then <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;create&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;5"></a>[create an entry](#create-an-entry) with <var>name</var> and a new <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;file&#45;7"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object with an empty name&#44; <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;application&#47;octet&#45;stream"></a><code>[application&#47;octet&#45;stream](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.5.1)</code> as type&#44; and an empty body&#44; and <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list&#45;append&#45;5"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) it to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

        2.  Otherwise&#44; for each file in <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;input&#45;type&#45;file&#45;selected&#45;2"></a>[selected files](#concept-input-type-file-selected)&#44; <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;create&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;6"></a>[create an entry](#create-an-entry) with <var>name</var> and a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;file&#45;8"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object representing the file&#44; and <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list&#45;append&#45;6"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) it to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    9.  Otherwise&#44; if the <var>field</var> element is an <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;input&#45;element&#45;6"></a><code>[input](#the-input-element)</code> element whose <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;input&#45;type&#45;6"></a><code>[type](#attr-input-type)</code> attribute is in the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;hidden&#45;state&#45;&#40;type&#61;hidden&#41;"></a>[Hidden](#hidden-state-(type=hidden)) state and <var>name</var> is an <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;ascii&#45;case&#45;insensitive"></a>[ASCII case&#45;insensitive](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#ascii-case-insensitive) match for &#34;<a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;name&#45;charset"></a><code>[&#95;charset&#95;](#attr-fe-name-charset)</code>&#34;&#58;

        1.  Let <var>charset</var> be the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;encoding&#45;name"></a>[name](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#name) of <var>encoding</var>&#46;

        2.  <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;create&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;7"></a>[Create an entry](#create-an-entry) with <var>name</var> and <var>charset</var>&#44; and <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list&#45;append&#45;7"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) it to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    10. Otherwise&#44; <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;create&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;8"></a>[create an entry](#create-an-entry) with <var>name</var> and the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;fe&#45;value"></a>[value](#concept-fe-value) of the <var>field</var> element&#44; and <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list&#45;append&#45;8"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) it to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

    11. If the element has a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code> attribute&#44; that attribute&#39;s value is not the empty string&#44; and the element is an <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;auto&#45;directionality&#45;form&#45;associated&#45;elements"></a>[auto&#45;directionality form&#45;associated element](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#auto-directionality-form-associated-elements)&#58;

        1.  Let <var>dirname</var> be the value of the element&#39;s <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;attr&#45;fe&#45;dirname&#45;2"></a><code>[dirname](#attr-fe-dirname)</code> attribute&#46;

        2.  Let <var>dir</var> be the string &#34;<code>ltr</code>&#34; if <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;directionality"></a>[the directionality](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-directionality) of the element is &#39;<a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;ltr"></a>[ltr](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-ltr)&#39;&#44; and &#34;<code>rtl</code>&#34; otherwise &#40;i&#46;e&#46;&#44; when <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;the&#45;directionality&#45;2"></a>[the directionality](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#the-directionality) of the element is &#39;<a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;rtl"></a>[rtl](html-language-foundations--877d6146487f--b55e73c31978.md#concept-rtl)&#39;&#41;&#46;

        3.  <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;create&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;9"></a>[Create an entry](#create-an-entry) with <var>dirname</var> and <var>dir</var>&#44; and <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list&#45;append&#45;9"></a>[append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) it to <var>entry list</var>&#46;

6.  Let <var>form data</var> be a new <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;formdata"></a><code>[FormData](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata)</code> object associated with <var>entry list</var>&#46;

7.  <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[Fire an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;event&#45;formdata"></a><code>[formdata](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-formdata)</code> at <var>form</var> using <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;formdataevent"></a><code>[FormDataEvent](#formdataevent)</code>&#44; with the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;dom&#45;formdataevent&#45;formdata"></a><code>[formData](#dom-formdataevent-formdata)</code> attribute initialized to <var>form data</var> and the <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> attribute initialized to true&#46;

8.  Set <var>form</var>&#39;s <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;constructing&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;3"></a>[constructing entry list](#constructing-entry-list) to false&#46;

9.  Return a <a id="constructing&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set&#58;list&#45;clone"></a>[clone](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-clone) of <var>entry list</var>&#46;

##### <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22&#46;5 Selecting a form submission encoding[](#selecting-a-form-submission-encoding)

If the user agent is to <a id="picking&#45;an&#45;encoding&#45;for&#45;the&#45;form"></a><strong>pick an encoding for a form</strong>&#44; it must run the following steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>encoding</var> be the <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;document&#39;s&#45;character&#45;encoding"></a>[document&#39;s character encoding](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-encoding)&#46;

2.  If the <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element has an <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;attr&#45;form&#45;accept&#45;charset"></a><code>[accept&#45;charset](#attr-form-accept-charset)</code> attribute&#44; set <var>encoding</var> to the return value of running these substeps&#58;

    1.  Let <var>input</var> be the value of the <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element&#39;s <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;attr&#45;form&#45;accept&#45;charset&#45;2"></a><code>[accept&#45;charset](#attr-form-accept-charset)</code> attribute&#46;

    2.  Let <var>candidate encoding labels</var> be the result of <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;split&#45;a&#45;string&#45;on&#45;spaces"></a>[splitting <var>input</var> on ASCII whitespace](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#split-on-ascii-whitespace)&#46;

    3.  Let <var>candidate encodings</var> be an empty list of <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;encoding"></a>[character encodings](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encoding)&#46;

    4.  For each token in <var>candidate encoding labels</var> in turn &#40;in the order in which they were found in <var>input</var>&#41;&#44; <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;getting&#45;an&#45;encoding"></a>[get an encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-encoding-get) for the token and&#44; if this does not result in failure&#44; append the <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;encoding&#45;2"></a>[encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encoding) to <var>candidate encodings</var>&#46;

    5.  If <var>candidate encodings</var> is empty&#44; return <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;utf&#45;8"></a>[UTF&#45;8](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#utf-8)&#46;

    6.  Return the first encoding in <var>candidate encodings</var>&#46;

3.  Return the result of <a id="selecting&#45;a&#45;form&#45;submission&#45;encoding&#58;get&#45;an&#45;output&#45;encoding"></a>[getting an output encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#get-an-output-encoding) from <var>encoding</var>&#46;

##### <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22&#46;6 Converting an entry list to a list of name&#45;value pairs[](#converting-an-entry-list-to-a-list-of-name-value-pairs)

The <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded"></a><code>[application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded)</code> and <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;text&#47;plain&#45;encoding&#45;algorithm"></a><code>[text&#47;plain](#text/plain-encoding-algorithm)</code> encoding algorithms take a list of name&#45;value pairs&#44; where the values must be strings&#44; rather than an <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;entry&#45;list"></a>[entry list](#entry-list) where the value can be a <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;file"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code>&#46; The following algorithm performs the conversion&#46;

To <a id="convert&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs"></a><strong>convert to a list of name&#45;value pairs</strong> an <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;entry&#45;list&#45;2"></a>[entry list](#entry-list) <var>entry list</var>&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>list</var> be an empty <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;list"></a>[list](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list) of name&#45;value pairs&#46;

2.  <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;list&#45;iterate"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>entry</var> of <var>entry list</var>&#58;

    1.  Let <var>name</var> be <var>entry</var>&#39;s <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;name"></a>[name](#form-entry-name)&#44; with every occurrence of U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41; not followed by U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41;&#44; and every occurrence of U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41; not preceded by U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41;&#44; replaced by a string consisting of U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41; and U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41;&#46;

    2.  If <var>entry</var>&#39;s <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;value"></a>[value](#form-entry-value) is a <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;file&#45;2"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object&#44; then let <var>value</var> be <var>entry</var>&#39;s <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#form-entry-value)&#39;s <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;dom&#45;file&#45;name"></a><code>[name](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-name)</code>&#46; Otherwise&#44; let <var>value</var> be <var>entry</var>&#39;s <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#form-entry-value)&#46;

    3.  Replace every occurrence of U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41; not followed by U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41;&#44; and every occurrence of U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41; not preceded by U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41;&#44; in <var>value</var>&#44; by a string consisting of U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41; and U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41;&#46;

    4.  <a id="converting&#45;an&#45;entry&#45;list&#45;to&#45;a&#45;list&#45;of&#45;name&#45;value&#45;pairs&#58;list&#45;append"></a>[Append](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-append) to <var>list</var> a new name&#45;value pair whose name is <var>name</var> and whose value is <var>value</var>&#46;

3.  Return <var>list</var>&#46;

##### <a id="url&#45;encoded&#45;form&#45;data"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22&#46;7 URL&#45;encoded form data[](#url-encoded-form-data)

<a id="application&#45;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded&#45;encoding&#45;algorithm"></a><a id="application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded&#45;encoding&#45;algorithm"></a>See URL for details on <a id="url&#45;encoded&#45;form&#45;data&#58;application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded"></a><code>[application&#47;x&#45;www&#45;form&#45;urlencoded](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-urlencoded)</code>&#46; [&#91;URL&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsURL)

##### <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22&#46;8 Multipart form data[](#multipart-form-data)

The <a id="multipart&#47;form&#45;data&#45;encoding&#45;algorithm"></a><strong><code>multipart&#47;form&#45;data</code> encoding algorithm</strong>&#44; given an <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;entry&#45;list"></a>[entry list](#entry-list) <var>entry list</var> and an <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;encoding"></a>[encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encoding) <var>encoding</var>&#44; is as follows&#58;

1.  <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;list&#45;iterate"></a>[For each](https://infra.spec.whatwg.org/#list-iterate) <var>entry</var> of <var>entry list</var>&#58;

    1.  Replace every occurrence of U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41; not followed by U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41;&#44; and every occurrence of U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41; not preceded by U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41;&#44; in <var>entry</var>&#39;s <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;name"></a>[name](#form-entry-name)&#44; by a string consisting of a U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41; and U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41;&#46;

    2.  If <var>entry</var>&#39;s <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;value"></a>[value](#form-entry-value) is not a <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;file"></a><code>[File](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#dfn-file)</code> object&#44; then replace every occurrence of U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41; not followed by U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41;&#44; and every occurrence of U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41; not preceded by U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41;&#44; in <var>entry</var>&#39;s <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;value&#45;2"></a>[value](#form-entry-value)&#44; by a string consisting of a U&#43;000D &#40;CR&#41; and U&#43;000A &#40;LF&#41;&#46;

2.  Return the byte sequence resulting from encoding the <var>entry list</var> using the rules described by RFC 7578&#44; Returning Values from Forms&#58; <code>multipart&#47;form&#45;data</code>&#44; given the following conditions&#58; [&#91;RFC7578&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsRFC7578)

    - Each <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;form&#45;entry"></a>[entry](#form-entry) in <var>entry list</var> is a <em>field</em>&#44; the <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;name&#45;2"></a>[name](#form-entry-name) of the entry is the <em>field name</em> and the <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;form&#45;entry&#45;value&#45;3"></a>[value](#form-entry-value) of the entry is the <em>field value</em>&#46;

    - The order of parts must be the same as the order of fields in <var>entry list</var>&#46; Multiple entries with the same name must be treated as distinct fields&#46;

    - Field names&#44; field values for non&#45;file fields&#44; and filenames for file fields&#44; in the generated <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;multipart&#47;form&#45;data"></a><code>[multipart&#47;form&#45;data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#multipart/form-data)</code> resource must be set to the result of <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;encode"></a>[encoding](https://encoding.spec.whatwg.org/#encode) the corresponding entry&#39;s name or value with <var>encoding</var>&#44; converted to a byte sequence&#46;

    - For field names and filenames for file fields&#44; the result of the encoding in the previous bullet point must be escaped by replacing any 0x0A &#40;LF&#41; bytes with the byte sequence &#96;<code>&#37;0A</code>&#96;&#44; 0x0D &#40;CR&#41; with &#96;<code>&#37;0D</code>&#96; and 0x22 &#40;&#34;&#41; with &#96;<code>&#37;22</code>&#96;&#46; The user agent must not perform any other escapes&#46;

    - The parts of the generated <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;multipart&#47;form&#45;data&#45;2"></a><code>[multipart&#47;form&#45;data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#multipart/form-data)</code> resource that correspond to non&#45;file fields must not have a &#96;<a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;content&#45;type"></a><code>[Content&#45;Type](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#content-type)</code>&#96; header specified&#46;

    - The boundary used by the user agent in generating the return value of this algorithm is the <a id="multipart&#47;form&#45;data&#45;boundary&#45;string"></a><strong><code>multipart&#47;form&#45;data</code> boundary string</strong>&#46; &#40;This value is used to generate the MIME type of the form submission payload generated by this algorithm&#46;&#41;

For details on how to interpret <a id="multipart&#45;form&#45;data&#58;multipart&#47;form&#45;data&#45;3"></a><code>[multipart&#47;form&#45;data](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#multipart/form-data)</code> payloads&#44; see RFC 7578&#46; [&#91;RFC7578&#93;](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#refsRFC7578)

##### <a id="plain&#45;text&#45;form&#45;data"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22&#46;9 Plain text form data[](#plain-text-form-data)

The <a id="text&#47;plain&#45;encoding&#45;algorithm"></a><strong><code>text&#47;plain</code> encoding algorithm</strong>&#44; given a list of name&#45;value pairs <var>pairs</var>&#44; is as follows&#58;

1.  Let <var>result</var> be the empty string&#46;

2.  For each <var>pair</var> in <var>pairs</var>&#58;

    1.  Append <var>pair</var>&#39;s name to <var>result</var>&#46;

    2.  Append a single U&#43;003D EQUALS SIGN character &#40;&#61;&#41; to <var>result</var>&#46;

    3.  Append <var>pair</var>&#39;s value to <var>result</var>&#46;

    4.  Append a U&#43;000D CARRIAGE RETURN &#40;CR&#41; U&#43;000A LINE FEED &#40;LF&#41; character pair to <var>result</var>&#46;

3.  Return <var>result</var>&#46;

Payloads using the <a id="plain&#45;text&#45;form&#45;data&#58;text&#47;plain"></a><code>[text&#47;plain](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc2046#section-4.1.3)</code> format are intended to be human readable&#46; They are not reliably interpretable by computer&#44; as the format is ambiguous &#40;for example&#44; there is no way to distinguish a literal newline in a value from the newline at the end of the value&#41;&#46;

``` text
[Exposed=Window]
interface SubmitEvent : Event {
  constructor(DOMString type, optional SubmitEventInit eventInitDict = {});

  readonly attribute HTMLElement? submitter;
};

dictionary SubmitEventInit : EventInit {
  HTMLElement? submitter = null;
};
```

<strong><code><var>event</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;submitevent&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;submitevent&#45;submitter&#45;2"></a>[submitter](#dom-submitevent-submitter)</code></strong>

Returns the element representing the <a id="the&#45;submitevent&#45;interface&#58;concept&#45;submit&#45;button"></a>[submit button](#concept-submit-button) that triggered the <a id="the&#45;submitevent&#45;interface&#58;form&#45;submission&#45;2"></a>[form submission](#form-submission-2)&#44; or null if the submission was not triggered by a button&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;submitevent&#45;submitter"></a><strong><code>submitter</code></strong> attribute must return the value it was initialized to&#46;

##### <a id="the&#45;formdataevent&#45;interface"></a>4&#46;10&#46;22&#46;11 The <a id="the&#45;formdataevent&#45;interface&#58;formdataevent"></a><code>[FormDataEvent](#formdataevent)</code> interface[](#the-formdataevent-interface)

[Exposed=Window]

  readonly attribute FormData formData;
};

<strong><code><var>event</var>&#46;<a id="the&#45;formdataevent&#45;interface&#58;dom&#45;formdataevent&#45;formdata&#45;2"></a>[formData](#dom-formdataevent-formdata)</code></strong>

Returns a <a id="the&#45;formdataevent&#45;interface&#58;formdata&#45;3"></a><code>[FormData](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata)</code> object representing names and values of elements associated to the target <a id="the&#45;formdataevent&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code>&#46; Operations on the <a id="the&#45;formdataevent&#45;interface&#58;formdata&#45;4"></a><code>[FormData](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata)</code> object will affect form data to be submitted&#46;

The <a id="dom&#45;formdataevent&#45;formdata"></a><strong><code>formData</code></strong> attribute must return the value it was initialized to&#46; It represents a <a id="the&#45;formdataevent&#45;interface&#58;formdata&#45;5"></a><code>[FormData](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#formdata)</code> object associated to the <a id="the&#45;formdataevent&#45;interface&#58;entry&#45;list"></a>[entry list](#entry-list) that is <a id="the&#45;formdataevent&#45;interface&#58;constructing&#45;the&#45;form&#45;data&#45;set"></a>[constructed](#constructing-the-form-data-set) when the <a id="the&#45;formdataevent&#45;interface&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element&#45;2"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> is submitted&#46;

#### <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form"></a>4&#46;10&#46;23 Resetting a form[](#resetting-a-form)

When a <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form&#58;the&#45;form&#45;element"></a><code>[form](#the-form-element)</code> element <var>form</var> is <a id="concept&#45;form&#45;reset"></a><strong>reset</strong>&#44; run these steps&#58;

1.  Let <var>reset</var> be the result of <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form&#58;concept&#45;event&#45;fire"></a>[firing an event](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-event-fire) named <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form&#58;event&#45;reset"></a><code>[reset](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/commit-snapshots/877d6146487f15b15bc8dd0e3c625063a37b456a/#event-reset)</code> at <var>form</var>&#44; with the <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;bubbles"></a><code>[bubbles](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-bubbles)</code> and <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form&#58;dom&#45;event&#45;cancelable"></a><code>[cancelable](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-event-cancelable)</code> attributes initialized to true&#46;

2.  If <var>reset</var> is true&#44; then invoke the <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form&#58;concept&#45;form&#45;reset&#45;control"></a>[reset algorithm](#concept-form-reset-control) of each <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form&#58;category&#45;reset"></a>[resettable element](#category-reset) whose <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form&#58;form&#45;owner"></a>[form owner](#form-owner) is <var>form</var>&#46;

Each <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form&#58;category&#45;reset&#45;2"></a>[resettable element](#category-reset) defines its own <a id="concept&#45;form&#45;reset&#45;control"></a><strong>reset algorithm</strong>&#46; Changes made to form controls as part of these algorithms do not count as changes caused by the user &#40;and thus&#44; e&#46;g&#46;&#44; do not cause <a id="resetting&#45;a&#45;form&#58;event&#45;input"></a><code>[input](https://w3c.github.io/uievents/#event-type-input)</code> events to fire&#41;&#46;
